chinese: 一年有十二个月。
pinyin: Yī nián yǒu shí èr gè yuè.
english: One year has twelve months.

chinese: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十。
pinyin: Yī, èr, sān, sì, wǔ, liù, qī, bā, jiǔ, shí.
english: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

chinese: 零在一前面。
pinyin: Líng zài yī qiánmiàn.
english: Zero comes before one.

chinese: 这个老人一只眼看不见了。
pinyin: Zhège lǎorén yī zhī yǎn kànbujiàn le.
english: The old man is blind in one eye.

chinese: 我们觉得很难决定买哪一个。
pinyin: Wǒmen juéde hěn nán juédìng mǎi nǎyīge.
english: We find it difficult to decide which one to buy.

chinese: 我会在七八点回家。
pinyin: Wǒ huì zài qī bā diǎn huíjiā.
english: I'll be back by seven or eight o'clock.

chinese: 我们今天晚上七点跟他见面。
pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān wǎnshang qī diǎn gēn tā jiànmiàn.
english: We are to meet him at seven this evening.

chinese: 我三年前住在日本。
pinyin: Wǒ sān nián qián zhù zài Rìběn.
english: I lived in Japan three years ago.

chinese: 你们分了这三个苹果吧。
pinyin: Nǐmen fēn le zhè sān gè píngguǒ ba.
english: Divide these apples between you three.

chinese: 服务员，请给我三杯咖啡。
pinyin: Fúwùyuán, qǐng gěi wǒ sān bēi kāfēi.
english: Waiter, three coffees, please.

chinese: 我需要你的护照和三张照片。
pinyin: Wǒ xūyào nǐ de hùzhào hé sān zhāng zhàopiàn.
english: I need your passport and three photographs.

chinese: 猫儿在椅子上睡觉。
pinyin: Māor zài yǐzi shàng shuìjiào.
english: The cat is sleeping on the chair.

chinese: 飞机在云层上飞着。
pinyin: Fēijī zài yúncéng shàng fēi zhe.
english: The plane flew above the clouds.

chinese: 你昨天上午在哪里?
pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān shàngwǔ zài nǎlǐ?
english: Where were you yesterday morning?

chinese: 请把书放在桌子下。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi xià。
english: Please put the book under the table.

chinese: 他今天下午会来的。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān xiàwǔ huì lái de.
english: He will come this afternoon.

chinese: 今天下午会下雨吗？
pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ huì xiàyǔ ma?
english: Will it rain this afternoon?

chinese: 今天天气很好，不下雨，是晴天，不冷不热。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, bù xiàyǔ, shì qíngtiān, bù lěng bù rè.
english: The weather today's great, with no rain, clear skies, and a perfect temperature.

chinese: 我不喜欢他说的话。
pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuan tā shuō de huà.
english: I don't like what he said.

chinese: 不客气。
pinyin: Bù kèqi.
english: You're welcome.

chinese: 这些东西不是我的！
pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi bù shì wǒ de!
english: These things aren't mine!

chinese: 我写错了一个字。
pinyin: Wǒ xiě cuò le yī gè zì.
english: I miswrote a word.

chinese: 我们在中午吃了饭。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài zhōngwǔ chī le fàn.
english: We took lunch at noon.

chinese: 你明年去中国吗？
pinyin: Nǐ míngnián qù Zhōngguó ma?
english: Will you go to China next year?

chinese: 桌子上的书是谁的？
pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng de shū shì shéi de?
english: Whose book is this on the desk?

chinese: 写这本书的是医生。
pinyin: Xiě zhè běn shū de shì yīshēng.
english: The man who wrote this book is a doctor.

chinese: 这是本汉语书。
pinyin: Zhè shì běn Hànyǔ shū.
english: This is a Chinese language book.

chinese: 不要打开你的书。
pinyin: Bù yào dǎkāi nǐ de shū.
english: Don't open your book.

chinese: 我不知道你的书在哪里。
pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào nǐ de shū zài nǎlǐ.
english: I don't know where your book is.

chinese: 她在店里买了什么？
pinyin: Tā zài diàn lǐ mǎi le shénme?
english: What did she buy at the shop?

chinese: 这本书太贵了。我买不起。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū tài guì le. Wǒ mǎibuqǐ.
english: This book is too expensive. I can't afford to buy it.

chinese: 明天我要买手机了。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào mǎi shǒujī le.
english: I'm going to buy a cell phone tomorrow.

chinese: 爸爸给我买了一个照相机。
pinyin: Bàba gěi wǒ mǎi le yī gè zhàoxiàngjī.
english: Dad bought me a camera.

chinese: 我在哪里可以买到门票？
pinyin: Wǒ zài nǎlǐ kěyǐ mǎi dào ménpiào?
english: Where can I buy an entrance ticket?

chinese: 吃午饭了吗？
pinyin: Chī wǔfàn le ma?
english: Have you finished eating your lunch?

chinese: 她五点前不会回来。
pinyin: Tā wǔ diǎn qián bù huì huílai.
english: She won't be back till five.

chinese: 这五本书是我同学的。
pinyin: Zhè wǔ běn shū shì wǒ tóngxué de.
english: These five books belong to my classmate.

chinese: 我的表慢了五分钟。
pinyin: Wǒ de biǎo màn le wǔ fēnzhōng.
english: My watch is five minutes slow.

chinese: 我一周在这儿教五天书。
pinyin: Wǒ yī zhōu zài zhèr jiāo wǔ tiānshū.
english: I teach classes here five days a week.

chinese: 我们吃了一些苹果。
pinyin: Wǒmen chī le yīxiē píngguǒ.
english: We ate some apples.

chinese: 有些男孩走进了教室。
pinyin: Yǒuxiē nánhái zǒujìn le jiàoshì.
english: Some boys came into the classroom.

chinese: 我可以问你一些问题吗？
pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ wèn nǐ yīxiē wèntí ma?
english: May I ask you some more questions?

chinese: 她是怎样的人呢？
pinyin: Tā shì zěnyàng de rén ne?
english: What kind of person is she?

chinese: 你说你叫什么名字？
pinyin: Nǐ shuō nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
english: What did you say your name was?

chinese: 这个字的意思是什么？
pinyin: Zhège zì de yìsi shì shénme?
english: What is the meaning of this word?

chinese: 你能告诉我这是什么吗？
pinyin: Nǐ néng gàosu wǒ zhè shì shénme ma?
english: Can you tell me what this is?

chinese: 你的衣服是什么颜色的？
pinyin: Nǐ de yīfu shì shénme yánsè de?
english: What color is your dress?

chinese: 今天的云比昨天多。
pinyin: Jīntiān de yún bǐ zuótiān duō.
english: There's more cloud today than yesterday.

chinese: 今天不热，今天很冷。
pinyin: Jīntiān bù rè, jīntiān hěn lěng.
english: It's not hot today, it's cold.

chinese: 你今天做那个，是吗？
pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān zuò nà ge, shì ma?
english: You'll do that today, won't you?

chinese: 我今天不想起床。
pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān bù xiǎngqǐ chuáng.
english: I don't want to get out of bed today.

chinese: 今天是个阴天。
pinyin: Jīntiān shì gè yīntiān.
english: Today is a cloudy day.

chinese: 我会写五十四个汉字。
pinyin: Wǒ huì xiě wǔshí sì gè hànzì.
english: I know how to write fifty-four Chinese characters.

chinese: 你会用筷子吃饭吗？
pinyin: Nǐ huì yòng kuàizi chī fàn ma?
english: Do you know how to eat with chopsticks?

chinese: 我想知道你什么时候会离开。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào nǐ shénme shíhou huì líkāi.
english: I want to know when you're going to leave.

chinese: 她现在住在哪儿？
pinyin: Tā xiànzài zhù zài nǎr?
english: Where does she live now?

chinese: 我们住在学校附近。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhù zài xuéxiào fùjìn.
english: We live in the vicinity of the school.

chinese: 这是我年轻时候住的房子。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ niánqīng shíhou zhù de fángzi.
english: This is the house where I used to live when I was young.

chinese: 认识你们，我很高兴。
pinyin: Rènshi nǐmen, wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
english: I am very glad to know you.

chinese: 你喜不喜欢没关系。
pinyin: Nǐ xǐ bù xǐhuan méiguānxi.
english: Whether you like it or not doesn't matter.

chinese: 「你们是学生吗？」「是的。」
pinyin: 「 nǐmen shì xuésheng ma?」「 shìde.」
english: "Are you students?" "Yes, we are."

chinese: 你喜不喜欢日本菜？
pinyin: Nǐ xǐ bù xǐhuan Rìběn cài?
english: Do you like Japanese food?

chinese: 你想不想喝点儿茶？
pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng hē diǎnr chá?
english: Would you care for a cup of tea?

chinese: 你儿子在上大学吗？
pinyin: Nǐ érzi zài shàng dàxué ma?
english: Is your son studying in university?

chinese: 我儿子上小学三年级.
pinyin: Wǒ érzi shàng xiǎoxué sān niánjí.
english: My son's in the third grade.

chinese: 他使他儿子成了个有钱人。
pinyin: Tā shǐ tā érzi chéngle gè yǒuqiánrén.
english: He made his son a wealthy man.

chinese: 你认识钱先生吗？
pinyin: Nǐ rènshi qián xiānsheng ma?
english: Do you know Mr Qian?

chinese: 现在是八点一刻。
pinyin: Xiànzài shì bā diǎn yī kè.
english: It's a quarter past eight.

chinese: 我要睡到八点半才起身。
pinyin: Wǒ yào shuì dào bā diǎn bàn cái qǐshēn.
english: I will sleep until it is half past eight.

chinese: 我每六小时要服一次药。
pinyin: Wǒ měi liù xiǎoshí yào fú yīcì yào.
english: I have to take my medicine every six hours.

chinese: 每位学生必须最晚六点放学。
pinyin: Měi wèi xuésheng bìxū zuì wǎn liù diǎn fàngxué.
english: Every student has to leave school by six.

chinese: 我想说再见。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shuō zàijiàn.
english: I want to say goodbye.

chinese: 他会不会写这个字？
pinyin: Tā huìbùhuì xiě zhège zì?
english: Can he write this character?

chinese: 她在黑板上写了什么？
pinyin: Tā zài hēibǎn shàng xiě le shénme?
english: What did she write on the blackboard?

chinese: 多穿点衣服，今天真的很冷。
pinyin: Duō chuān diǎn yīfu, jīntiān zhēn de hěn lěng.
english: It's really cold today, wear some extra clothing.

chinese: 你学了几年的汉语？
pinyin: Nǐ xué le jǐnián de Hànyǔ?
english: How many years have you studied Mandarin for?

chinese: 你去北京学习几天？
pinyin: Nǐ qù Běijīng xuéxí jǐtiān?
english: For how many days will you be staying in Beijing to study?

chinese: 我坐出租车去。
pinyin: Wǒ zuò chūzūchē qù.
english: I'll go by taxi.

chinese: 她是出租车司机吗？
pinyin: Tā shì chūzūchē sījī ma?
english: Is she a taxi driver?

chinese: 几分钟后见。
pinyin: Jǐ fēnzhōng hòu jiàn.
english: See you in a couple of minutes.

chinese: 那个饭馆在火车站前面。
pinyin: Nàge fànguǎn zài huǒchēzhàn qiánmiàn.
english: That restaurant is in front of the train station.

chinese: 你能请个医生来吗？
pinyin: Nǐ néng qǐng gè yīshēng lái ma?
english: Could you call a doctor, please?

chinese: 如果你生病了，就去看医生。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ shēngbìng le, jiù qù kàn yīshēng.
english: If you get sick, go to the doctor.

chinese: 您应该让医生给您检查身体。
pinyin: Nín yīnggāi ràng yīshēng gěi nín jiǎnchá shēntǐ.
english: You should go get a physical examination from a doctor.

chinese: 我妈妈现在在医院。
pinyin: Wǒ māma xiànzài zài yīyuàn.
english: My mother is in the hospital now.

chinese: 我在这里住了十年。
pinyin: Wǒ zài zhèlǐ zhù le shí nián.
english: I have lived here for ten years.

chinese: 我明天去学校。
pinyin: Wǒ míng tiān qù xué xiào。
english: I am going to school tomorrow.

chinese: 我听见有人叫我。
pinyin: Wǒ tīngjiàn yǒurén jiào wǒ.
english: I heard my name called.

chinese: 我现在不想吃午饭。
pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài bù xiǎng chī wǔfàn.
english: I don't want to eat lunch now.

chinese: 他们没有东西吃了。
pinyin: Tāmen méiyǒu dōngxi chī le.
english: They have nothing to eat.

chinese: 你喜欢吃水果吗？
pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan chī shuǐguǒ ma?
english: Do you like to eat fruit?

chinese: 一家人一起吃了晚饭。
pinyin: Yījiārén yīqǐ chī le wǎnfàn.
english: The family ate dinner together.

chinese: 我的名字没有出现在名单上。
pinyin: Wǒ de míngzi méiyǒu chūxiàn zài míngdān shàng.
english: My name doesn't appear on the list.

chinese: 我们要给孩子起个名字。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào gěi háizi qǐ ge míngzi.
english: We have to pick a name for the child.

chinese: 我在他后面。
pinyin: Wǒ zài tā hòumiàn.
english: I'm behind him.

chinese: "他喜欢音乐吗?" "是的, 他喜欢。"
pinyin: "Tā xǐhuan yīnyuè ma?" "Shì de, tā xǐhuan."
english: "Does he like music?" "Yes, he does."

chinese: 我可以问您一个问题吗？
pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ wèn nín yī gè wèntí ma?
english: Can I ask you a question?

chinese: 没有人会听我说。
pinyin: Méiyǒu rén huì tīng wǒ shuō.
english: Nobody would listen to me.

chinese: 你现在在哪里呢？
pinyin: Nǐ xiànzài zài nǎlǐ ne?
english: Where are you now?

chinese: 我想学汉语和日语。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xué Hànyǔ hé Rìyǔ.
english: I want to learn Chinese and Japanese.

chinese: 你要去哪个高中读书？
pinyin: Nǐ yào qù nǎge gāozhōng dúshū?
english: Which high school are you going to study in?

chinese: 哪个是你的杯子？
pinyin: Nǎge shì nǐ de bēizi?
english: Which cup is yours?

chinese: 我去商店。
pinyin: Wǒ qù shāngdiàn.
english: I am going to the shop.

chinese: 喂，请问你找谁？
pinyin: Wèi， qǐng wèn nǐ zhǎo shéi？
english: Hello, who would you like to speak to?

chinese: 你喜欢去电影院吗？
pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan qù diànyǐngyuàn ma?
english: Do you like to go to the movie theater?

chinese: 我什么都不想喝。
pinyin: Wǒ shénme dōu bù xiǎng hē.
english: I don't want anything to drink.

chinese: 我喝不下这么甜的咖啡。
pinyin: Wǒ hē bù xià zhème tián de kāfēi.
english: I can't drink coffee as sweet as this.

chinese: 他是我们四人中间最年轻的。
pinyin: Tā shì wǒmen sì rén zhōngjiān zuì niánqīng de.
english: He is the youngest amongst us four.

chinese: 你什么时候回家？
pinyin: Nǐ shénmeshíhou huíjiā?
english: When will you return home?

chinese: 你是不是想坐下？
pinyin: Nǐ shìbùshì xiǎng zuòxia?
english: Do you want to sit down?

chinese: 大家都想坐在她旁边。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu xiǎng zuò zài tā pángbiān.
english: Everybody wants to sit beside her.

chinese: 这块蛋糕很好吃。
pinyin: Zhè kuài dàn gāo hěn hǎo chī。
english: This piece of cake is delicious.

chinese: 这个学校有很多学生。
pinyin: Zhège xuéxiào yǒu hěn duō xuésheng.
english: This school has many students.

chinese: 那里有多少东西？
pinyin: Nàli yǒu duōshao dōngxi?
english: How much stuff is there?

chinese: 你家有多少人？
pinyin: Nǐ jiā yǒu duōshao rén?
english: How many people are there in your family?

chinese: 你看完这本书要多少时间？
pinyin: Nǐ kàn wán zhè běn shū yào duōshao shíjiān?
english: How long did it take you to finish reading that book?

chinese: 这个店的苹果不大。
pinyin: Zhège diàn de píngguǒ bù dà.
english: This shop's apples are not big.

chinese: 你有一个大鼻子。
pinyin: Nǐ yǒu yī gè dà bízi.
english: You have a big nose.

chinese: 昨天他遇到了高大的男人。
pinyin: Zuótiān tā yù dào le gāodà de nánrén.
english: Yesterday he saw a big man.

chinese: 街角出现了一辆大面包车。
pinyin: Jiējiǎo chūxiàn le yī liàng dà miànbāochē.
english: A big van appeared on the street corner.

chinese: 我们城市的动物园又大又新。
pinyin: Wǒmen chéngshì de dòngwùyuán yòu dà yòu xīn.
english: Our city's zoo is big and new.

chinese: 那里的天气怎么样？
pinyin: Nàli de tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
english: How's the weather there?

chinese: 我不想说太多。
pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng shuō tài duō.
english: I didn't want to say too much.

chinese: 我太矮了。
pinyin: Wǒ tài ǎi le.
english: I am too short.

chinese: 你们真是太热情了。
pinyin: Nǐmen zhēnshi tài rèqíng le.
english: You're really too kind.

chinese: 变化太小，察觉不出来。
pinyin: Biànhuà tài xiǎo, chájué bù chūlái.
english: The change is too small to be observed.

chinese: 这是你的女儿吗？
pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ de nǚ'ér ma?
english: Is this your daughter?

chinese: 他一直很担心他的女儿。
pinyin: Tā yīzhí hěn dānxīn tā de nǚ'ér.
english: He's always worrying about his daughter.

chinese: 我听说她去了商店。
pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō tā qùle shāngdiàn.
english: I heard that she went to the store.

chinese: 我想她不会在家里。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tā bù huì zài jiālǐ.
english: I do not think that she is at home.

chinese: 对不起，她不在这里。
pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, tā bù zài zhèlǐ.
english: I'm sorry she's not here.

chinese: 他们都是好老师。
pinyin: Tāmen dōu shì hǎo lǎoshī.
english: All of them are good teachers.

chinese: 大家都说他是个好人。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu shuō tā shì gè hǎo rén.
english: Everyone says that he's a good man.

chinese: 他的身体很好。
pinyin: Tā de shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
english: He is in good health.

chinese: 有的人是好的，有的人是坏的。
pinyin: Yǒude rén shì hǎo de, yǒude rén shì huài de.
english: Some people are good, some people are bad.

chinese: 生啤酒在大热天时特别好喝。
pinyin: Shēngpíjiǔ zài dàrè tiānshí tèbié hǎohē.
english: Draft beer tastes especially good on a hot day.

chinese: 爸爸和妈妈都在家。
pinyin: Bàba hé māma dōu zài jiā.
english: Both dad and mom are at home.

chinese: 这个字怎么写？
pinyin: Zhè gè zì zěn me xiě？
english: How do you write this character?

chinese: 学习是学生的工作。
pinyin: Xuéxí shì xuésheng de gōngzuò.
english: Studying is a student's work.

chinese: 我明天不会去学校。
pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān bù huì qù xuéxiào.
english: I will not go to school tomorrow.

chinese: 我的学校在我家左边。
pinyin: Wǒ de xuéxiào zài wǒ jiā zuǒbian.
english: My school is to the left of my house.

chinese: 你的学校离你家很远吗?
pinyin: Nǐ de xuéxiào lí nǐ jiā hěn yuǎn ma?
english: Is your school far from your home?

chinese: 那个学生跑得很快，不是吗？
pinyin: Nèige xuésheng pǎo de hěn kuài, bù shì ma?
english: That student runs fast, doesn't he?

chinese: 过去,我是中学生,现在我是大学生.
pinyin: Guòqù, wǒ shì zhōngxuéshēng, xiànzài wǒ shì dàxuéshēng.
english: In the past, I was a middle school student. Now I am a college student.

chinese: 每个学生都被问了一个问题。
pinyin: Měi gè xuésheng dōu bèi wèn le yī gè wèntí.
english: Every student was asked one question.

chinese: 对不起，我错了。
pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ cuò le.
english: Sorry, I made a mistake.

chinese: 对不起，我忘了作业这回事了。
pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ wàng le zuòyè zhè huí shì le.
english: I'm sorry, I forgot to do my homework.

chinese: 不是有一点小吗?
pinyin: Bù shì yǒuyīdiǎn xiǎo ma?
english: Isn't it a bit small?

chinese: 我看到一位漂亮小姐。
pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào yī wèi piàoliang xiǎojie.
english: I saw a beautiful lady.

chinese: 这样想的人很少。
pinyin: Zhèyàng xiǎng de rén hěn shǎo.
english: Few people think so.

chinese: 很少有学生能了解他说的话。
pinyin: Hěn shǎoyǒu xuésheng néng liǎojiě tā shuō dehuà.
english: Few students could understand what he said.

chinese: 我的朋友十七岁了。
pinyin: Wǒ de péngyou shíqī suì le.
english: My friend is seventeen years old.

chinese: 他的哥哥比我大两岁。
pinyin: Tā de gēge bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì.
english: His older brother is two years older than I.

chinese: 他的工作现在完成了。
pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò xiànzài wánchéng le.
english: His work is now complete.

chinese: 我们几乎完成了我们的工作。
pinyin: Wǒmen jīhū wánchéng le wǒmen de gōngzuò.
english: We have almost finished our work.

chinese: 虽然我很累，但我也会努力工作的。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ hěn lèi, dàn wǒ yě huì nǔlì gōngzuò de.
english: Though I am tired, I will work hard.

chinese: 一年有十二个月。
pinyin: Yī nián yǒu shí èr gè yuè.
english: A year has twelve months.

chinese: 我今年去了好几次外国。
pinyin: Wǒ jīnnián qù le hǎo jǐ cì wàiguó.
english: I have been abroad several times this year.

chinese: 我打算明年去加拿大。
pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn míngnián qù Jiānádà.
english: I plan to go to Canada next year.

chinese: 今年的雪下得比去年多。
pinyin: Jīnnián de xuě xià de bǐ qùnián duō.
english: It snowed more this year than last.

chinese: 她很漂亮，不是吗？
pinyin: Tā hěn piàoliang, bùshìma?
english: She is very pretty, isn't she?

chinese: 我在这里很长时间了。
pinyin: Wǒ zài zhèlǐ hěn cháng shíjiān le.
english: I've been here for a very long time.

chinese: 她妹妹也唱得很漂亮。
pinyin: Tā mèimei yě chàng dehěn piàoliang.
english: Her sister also sings very beautifully.

chinese: 大家都很喜欢这个节日。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu hěn xǐhuan zhège jiérì.
english: Everyone likes this festival very much.

chinese: 他们是怎么认识的？
pinyin: Tāmen shì zěnme rènshide?
english: How did they meet?

chinese: 你的姓怎么读？
pinyin: Nǐ de xìng zěnme dú?
english: How is your surname pronounced?

chinese: 请你告诉我机场怎么去。
pinyin: Qǐng nǐ gàosu wǒ jīchǎng zěnme qù.
english: Please tell me how to get to the airport.

chinese: 你愿意告诉我怎么做吗？
pinyin: Nǐ yuànyì gàosu wǒ zěnme zuò ma?
english: Would you be willing to show me how to do that?

chinese: 你怎么敢这样跟我说话！
pinyin: Nǐ zěnme gǎn zhèyàng gēn wǒ shuōhuà!
english: How dare you speak to me like that!

chinese: 我们去电影院怎么样？
pinyin: Wǒmen qù diànyǐngyuàn zěnmeyàng?
english: How about going to the movies?

chinese: “你怎么样？”“我很好，谢谢。”
pinyin: "nǐ zěnmeyàng?""wǒ hěn hǎo, xièxie."
english: "How are you?" "I am fine, thank you."

chinese: 我们能在哪儿打电话？
pinyin: Wǒmen néng zài nǎr dǎdiànhuà?
english: Where can we make a phone call?

chinese: 你要我什么时候打电话？
pinyin: Nǐ yào wǒ shénme shíhou dǎ diànhuà?
english: When do you want me to call?

chinese: 我一小时后给你打电话。
pinyin: Wǒ yì xiǎoshí hòu géinǐ dǎdiànhuà.
english: I'll call you in an hour.

chinese: 九点以后打电话比较便宜吗？
pinyin: Jiǔ diǎn yǐhòu dǎdiànhuà bǐjiào piányi ma?
english: Is it cheaper to call after 9:00?

chinese: 今天是十月一日。
pinyin: Jīn tiān shì shí yuè yī rì。
english: Today is the first of October.

chinese: 那时候我不在这里。
pinyin: Nàshíhou wǒ bù zài zhèlǐ.
english: I wasn't here at that time.

chinese: 明天的课我能不来吗？
pinyin: Míngtiān de kè wǒ néng bù lái ma?
english: May I be excused from tomorrow's class?

chinese: 今天是周五，明天就是周末了！
pinyin: Jīntiān shì Zhōuwǔ, míngtiān jiùshì zhōumò le!
english: Today is Friday. The weekend starts already tomorrow!

chinese: 我住了一个星期的院。
pinyin: Wǒ zhù le yī gè xīngqī de yuàn.
english: I was in the hospital for a week.

chinese: 上个星期我们在我阿姨的家。
pinyin: Shàng gè xīngqī wǒmen zài wǒ āyí de jiā.
english: We were at my aunt's last week.

chinese: 昨天下了一天的雨。
pinyin: Zuótiān xià le yī tiān de yǔ.
english: Yesterday it rained all day.

chinese: 她穿着跟昨天相同的衣服。
pinyin: Tā chuān zhe gēn zuótiān xiāngtóng de yīfu.
english: She is wearing the same dress that she had on yesterday.

chinese: 他四月十八日来了。
pinyin: Tā sìyuè shí bā rì lái le.
english: He came on the 18th of April.

chinese: 你院子里有桌子吗?
pinyin: Nǐ yuànzi lǐ yǒu zhuōzi ma?
english: Do you have a table on the patio?

chinese: 你们有没有米饭？
pinyin: Nǐmen yǒuméiyǒu mǐfàn?
english: Do you have rice?

chinese: 我有一间非常大的房子。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī jiān fēicháng dà de fángzi.
english: I have a very large house.

chinese: 我没有朋友一起玩。
pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu péngyou yīqǐ wán.
english: I have no friends to play with.

chinese: 这是你朋友的车吗？
pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ péngyou de chē ma?
english: Is this your friend's car?

chinese: 书桌上有几本书。
pinyin: Shūzhuō shàng yǒu jǐ běn shū.
english: There are some books on the desk.

chinese: 她爸爸不会来的，他很忙。
pinyin: Tā bàba bù huì lái de, tā hěn máng.
english: Her father won't come, he is really busy.

chinese: 我希望他能来！我想见他。
pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng tā néng lái! wǒ xiǎngjiàn tā.
english: I hope he'll be able to come! I'd like to see him.

chinese: "你认为他会来吗?" "我希望不会。"
pinyin: "nǐ rènwéi tā huì lái ma?" "wǒ xīwàng bù huì."
english: "Do you think he will come?" "I hope not."

chinese: 我在那里要了一张桌子。
pinyin: Wǒ zài nàli yào le yī zhāng zhuōzi.
english: I asked for a table over there.

chinese: 不要把书放在那张桌子上。
pinyin: Bù yào bǎ shū fàng zài nà zhāng zhuōzi shàng.
english: Don't put books on the table.

chinese: 这个杯子里有水。
pinyin: Zhège bēizi lǐ yǒu shuǐ.
english: This glass contains water.

chinese: 热一点水。
pinyin: Rè yīdiǎn shuǐ.
english: Heat up some water.

chinese: 我喝水因为我渴了。
pinyin: Wǒ hē shuǐ yīnwèi wǒ kě le.
english: I'm drinking water because I'm thirsty.

chinese: 我有咖啡、茶、水跟新鲜果汁。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu kāfēi, chá, shuǐ gēn xīnxiān guǒzhī.
english: I have coffee, tea, water, and fresh fruit juice.

chinese: 谁是你的汉语老师?
pinyin: Shéi shì nǐ de Hànyǔ lǎoshī?
english: Who is your Chinese teacher?

chinese: 他没钱买新车。
pinyin: Tā méi qián mǎi xīn chē.
english: He does not have the money for buying a new car.

chinese: 火车站在哪里?
pinyin: Huǒchēzhàn zài nǎlǐ?
english: Where is the train station?

chinese: 我家离火车站很近。
pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí huǒchēzhàn hěn jìn.
english: My house is near the station.

chinese: 你今天是不是有点发烧？
pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān shìbùshì yǒudiǎn fāshāo?
english: You have a little fever today, don't you?

chinese: 但是，我一点儿肉也不吃。
pinyin: Dànshì, wǒ yīdiǎnr ròu yě bù chī.
english: But, I don't eat even a little bit of meat.

chinese: 我觉得这张桌子低了点。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè zhāng zhuōzi dī le diǎn.
english: This desk is a little low for me.

chinese: 我只希望有多一点时间完成。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ xīwàng yǒu duō yīdiǎn shíjiān wánchéng.
english: I only wish I had a little more time to finish this.

chinese: 你什么时候爱上我的？
pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhou àishàng wǒ de?
english: When did you fall in love with me?

chinese: 她爱上了她男友的弟弟。
pinyin: Tā àishàng le tā nányǒu de dìdi.
english: She fell in love with her boyfriend's younger brother.

chinese: 我说我爱你时是认真的。
pinyin: Wǒ shuō wǒ ài nǐ shí shì rènzhēn de.
english: I was serious when I said I love you.

chinese: 你明白我有多么爱你吗？
pinyin: Nǐ míngbai wǒ yǒu duōme ài nǐ ma?
english: Do you know how much I love you?

chinese: 现在我爸爸不在家。
pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ bàba bù zài jiā.
english: My dad is not at home for the moment.

chinese: 这是你的狗。我的呢？
pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ de gǒu. wǒ de ne?
english: Here is your dog. Where is mine?

chinese: 狗坐在碗旁边。
pinyin: Gǒu zuò zài wǎn pángbiān.
english: The dog is sitting by the bowl.

chinese: 你的电脑怎么了？
pinyin: Nǐ de diànnǎo zěnmele?
english: What happened to your computer?

chinese: 我家里没电视。
pinyin: Wǒ jiālǐ méi diànshì.
english: I don't have a television at home.

chinese: 这个房间里有个电视机。
pinyin: Zhège fángjiān lǐ yǒu ge diànshìjī.
english: There is a television in this room.

chinese: 不要再做那样的事情了。
pinyin: Bù yào zài zuò nàyàng de shìqing le.
english: Don't do anything like that again.

chinese: 很少能见到像你那么好的人。
pinyin: Hěn shǎo néng jiàndào xiàng nǐ nàme hǎo de rén.
english: It's rare to meet nice people like you.

chinese: 让我向您介绍我的妻子。
pinyin: Ràng wǒ xiàng nín jièshào wǒ de qīzi.
english: I would like to introduce you to my wife.

chinese: 我下个月会来看你。
pinyin: Wǒ xiàgèyuè huì láikàn nǐ.
english: I'll see you next month.

chinese: 最近看了什么电影没有？
pinyin: Zuìjìn kàn le shénme diànyǐng méiyǒu?
english: Have you seen any movies recently?

chinese: 我在报纸上看到了它。
pinyin: Wǒ zài bàozhǐ shàng kàn dào le tā.
english: I saw it in the newspaper.

chinese: 我看到你开着你的新车。
pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào nǐ kāi zhe nǐ de xīn chē.
english: I saw you driving your new car.

chinese: 我什么人都没看见。
pinyin: Wǒ shénmerén dōu méi kànjiàn.
english: I didn't see anybody.

chinese: 我看见她进了房间。
pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn tā jìn le fángjiān.
english: I saw her enter the room.

chinese: 我看见一个长头发的女生。
pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn yī gè cháng tóufa de nǚshēng.
english: I saw a girl with long hair.

chinese: 我看见一个穿黑衣服的女人。
pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn yī gè chuān hēi yīfu de nǚrén.
english: I saw a woman in black.

chinese: 我看见那儿有个奇怪的女人。
pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn nàr yǒu ge qíguài de nǚrén.
english: I saw a strange woman there.

chinese: 你星期天几点睡觉？
pinyin: Nǐ Xīngqītiān jǐdiǎn shuìjiào?
english: What time do you sleep on Sundays?

chinese: 你在我们家睡觉当然能让你少花点钱。
pinyin: Nǐ zài wǒmen jiā shuìjiào dāngrán néng ràng nǐ shǎo huā diǎn qián.
english: It would of course be cheaper for you to sleep at our place.

chinese: 在您国家的人是吃米饭的吗？
pinyin: Zài nín guójiā de rén shì chī mǐfàn de ma?
english: Do people in your country eat rice?

chinese: 你要吃面条还是吃米饭？
pinyin: Nǐ yào chī miàntiáo háishi chī mǐfàn?
english: Do you want to eat noodles or rice?

chinese: 比起面包，我更喜欢米饭。
pinyin: Bǐqǐ miànbāo, wǒ gèng xǐhuan mǐfàn.
english: I prefer rice to bread.

chinese: 我能和老师说话吗？
pinyin: Wǒ néng hé lǎoshī shuōhuà ma?
english: Can I speak with the teacher?

chinese: 我很害怕老师会说些什么。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn hàipà lǎoshī huì shuō xiē shénme.
english: I am afraid of what the teacher will say.

chinese: 我们老师要我们打扫这间房间。
pinyin: Wǒmen lǎoshī yào wǒmen dǎsǎo zhè jiān fángjiān.
english: Our teacher made us clean the room.

chinese: 我们的老师会给我们出难题。
pinyin: Wǒmen de lǎoshī huì gěi wǒmen chū nántí.
english: Our teacher will give us difficult problems.

chinese: 我怎能忘记那些日子呢？
pinyin: Wǒ zěnnéng wàngjì nàxiē rìzi ne?
english: How can I forget those days?

chinese: 因为下雨，我们不能出去。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒmen bù néng chūqù.
english: We can't go outside because it's raining.

chinese: 书桌上有一个苹果。
pinyin: Shūzhuō shàng yǒu yī gè píngguǒ.
english: There is an apple on the desk.

chinese: 他住在苹果里面。
pinyin: Tā zhù zài píngguǒ lǐmiàn.
english: He lives inside an apple.

chinese: 每吃一个苹果就跳一下。
pinyin: Měi chī yī gè píngguǒ jiù tiào yīxià.
english: Jump once for each apple you ate.

chinese: 你需要茶或者别的什么吗？
pinyin: Nǐ xūyào chá huòzhě biéde shénme ma?
english: Would you like tea or something?

chinese: 你可以选择红茶，咖啡或牛奶。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ xuǎnzé hóngchá, kāfēi huò niúnǎi.
english: You have a choice of black tea, coffee, or milk.

chinese: 我的姐姐经常就着牛奶喝茶。
pinyin: Wǒ de jiějie jīngcháng jiùzhe niúnǎi hēchá.
english: My older sister often drinks tea with milk.

chinese: 他们不想和我说话。
pinyin: Tāmen bù xiǎng hé wǒ shuōhuà.
english: They don't want to talk to me.

chinese: 你别⋯⋯别这样和我说话。
pinyin: Nǐ bié ⋯⋯ bié zhèyàng hé wǒ shuōhuà.
english: You don't... you don't talk to me like that.

chinese: 请来两杯茶和一杯咖啡。
pinyin: Qǐng lái liǎng bēi chá hé yī bēi kāfēi.
english: Two teas and a coffee, please.

chinese: 请问能给我一杯牛奶吗？
pinyin: Qǐngwèn néng gěi wǒ yī bēi niúnǎi ma?
english: May I have a glass of milk, please?

chinese: 我每天读一本书。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dú yī běn shū。
english: I read a book every day.

chinese: 我每次读这本书都会有新发现。
pinyin: Wǒ měicì dú zhè běn shū dōu huì yǒu xīn fāxiàn.
english: Every time I read this book, I discover something new.

chinese: 我已经吃饱了，谢谢。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng chībǎo le, xièxie.
english: I'm already full, thank you.

chinese: 这些都不是你的钱。
pinyin: Zhèxiē dōu bù shì nǐ de qián.
english: None of this is your money.

chinese: 那飞机真大！
pinyin: Nà fēijī zhēn dà!
english: That airplane is huge!

chinese: 我其实没那么说。
pinyin: Wǒ qíshí méi nàme shuō.
english: I actually didn't say that.

chinese: 你一共花了多少钱？
pinyin: Nǐ yīgòng huā le duōshao qián?
english: What is the total amount of money you spent?

chinese: 认识你们，我很高兴。
pinyin: Rènshi nǐmen, wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
english: I'm really happy to have met you.

chinese: 我很高兴再次见到了她。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn gāoxìng zàicì jiàndào le tā.
english: I was happy to see her again.

chinese: 咱们一起去图书馆学习，你看怎么样？
pinyin: Zánmen yīqǐ qù túshūguǎn xuéxí, nǐ kàn zěnmeyàng?
english: How about studying together in the library?

chinese: 我和我的丈夫都是老师。
pinyin: Wǒ hé wǒ de zhàngfu dōu shì lǎoshī.
english: My husband and I are both teachers.

chinese: 她会永远爱她的丈夫。
pinyin: Tā huì yǒngyuǎn ài tā de zhàngfu.
english: She'll love her husband forever.

chinese: 我会在七月一号开始上班。
pinyin: Wǒ huì zài qī yuè yī hào kāishǐ shàngbān.
english: I'll start my work on the first of July.

chinese: 我除了星期天外每天都上班。
pinyin: Wǒ chúle Xīngqītiān wài měi tiān dōu shàngbān.
english: I work every day except Sunday.

chinese: 除了雨天，我都是骑车去上班的。
pinyin: Chúle yǔtiān, wǒ dōu shì qíchē qù shàngbān de.
english: Apart from on rainy days, I always ride my bike to work.

chinese: 我每天做两个小时的运动。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zuò liǎng gè xiǎoshí de yùndòng.
english: I get two hours' exercise every day.

chinese: 我想要两公斤苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngyào liǎng gōngjīn píngguǒ.
english: I'd like two kilos of apples.

chinese: 有两千小学生到校。
pinyin: Yǒu liǎng qiān xiǎoxuéshēng dào xiào.
english: Two thousand pupils attend school.

chinese: 她喜欢为她的家人做饭。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuan wèi tā de jiārén zuòfàn.
english: She likes to cook for her family.

chinese: 从这儿到那儿是很近的。
pinyin: Cóng zhèr dào nàr shì hěnjìn de.
english: It's not far from here to there.

chinese: 让我为你做这件事！
pinyin: Ràng wǒ wèi nǐ zuò zhè jiàn shì!
english: Let me do this for you.

chinese: 星期日是我休息的日子。
pinyin: Xīngqīrì shì wǒ xiūxi de rìzi.
english: Sunday is my rest day.

chinese: 他不是歌手，但是个演员。
pinyin: Tā bù shì gēshǒu, dànshì ge yǎnyuán.
english: He is not a singer, but an actor.

chinese: 她虽然可爱，但是我不喜欢她。
pinyin: Tā suīrán kě'ài, dànshì wǒ bù xǐhuan tā.
english: She may be cute, but I don't like her.

chinese: 这本书虽然很厚，但是不贵。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū suīrán hěn hòu, dànshì bù guì.
english: That book is thick, but it's not very expensive.

chinese: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。
pinyin: Wǒ gǎnqíng shàng zhīchí, dànshì lǐxìng shàng fǎnduì.
english: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.

chinese: 这车便宜得让他能买得起。
pinyin: Zhè chē piányi de ràng tā néng mǎi de qǐ.
english: This car was so cheap that he could afford it.

chinese: 这本书二十元。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū èr shí yuán。
english: This book costs twenty yuan.

chinese: 哪里坐公共汽车？
pinyin: Nǎlǐ zuò gōnggòngqìchē?
english: Where can I take the public bus?

chinese: 他们不是公司员工吗？
pinyin: Tāmen bù shì gōngsī yuángōng ma?
english: Are they not company employees?

chinese: 她不是这间公司正式的职员。
pinyin: Tā bù shì zhè jiān gōngsī zhèngshì de zhíyuán.
english: She's not among the regular employees of this company.

chinese: 今年我们公司的发展速度大大超过去年。
pinyin: Jīnnián wǒmen gōngsī de fāzhǎn sùdù dàdà chāoguò qùnián.
english: This year, the speed of development in our company far exceeds that of last year.

chinese: 虽然我失败了，但我会再试一次的。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ shībài le, dàn wǒ huì zài shì yīcì de.
english: Though I failed, I will try again.

chinese: 妈妈为我准备了午饭。
pinyin: Māma wèi wǒ zhǔnbèi le wǔfàn.
english: Mother prepared lunch for me.

chinese: 爸爸出去了，但妈妈在家。
pinyin: Bàba chūqù le, dàn māma zài jiā.
english: Father is out, but Mother is at home.

chinese: 有个男人开门走了出来。
pinyin: Yǒu gè nánrén kāimén zǒu le chūlái.
english: The door opened and a man came out.

chinese: 今天晚上出去吃怎样？
pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang chūqù chī zěnyàng?
english: How about eating out this evening?

chinese: 他终于从房间里走了出来。
pinyin: Tā zhōngyú cóng fángjiān lǐ zǒu le chūlái.
english: He came out of the room at last.

chinese: 从我的房间望出去是街道。
pinyin: Cóng wǒ de fángjiān wàng chūqù shì jiēdào.
english: My room looks out on the street.

chinese: 别着急，我们马上就来。
pinyin: Biézháojí, wǒmen mǎshàng jiù lái.
english: Don't worry, we're on our way.

chinese: 别让我一直站在这里。
pinyin: Bié ràng wǒ yīzhí zhàn zài zhèlǐ.
english: Don't make me stand here.

chinese: 千万别误会我的意思。
pinyin: Qiānwàn bié wùhuì wǒ de yìsi.
english: Please don't misunderstand me.

chinese: 如果下雨的话，别忘了带把伞。
pinyin: Rúguǒ xiàyǔ dehuà, bié wàng le dài bǎ sǎn.
english: Don't forget to take an umbrella in case it rains.

chinese: 你知道他们什么时候到吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào tāmen shénmeshíhou dào ma?
english: Do you know when they will arrive?

chinese: 现在差不多是火车要到的时间。
pinyin: Xiànzài chàbuduō shì huǒchē yào dào de shíjiān.
english: It's almost time for the train to arrive.

chinese: 他们四处找来找去，但就是找不到合适的地方。
pinyin: Tāmen sìchù zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, dàn jiùshì zhǎobudào héshì de dìfang.
english: After searching and asking around, they still couldn't find a suitable place.

chinese: 我们估计能在两周内到那个地方。
pinyin: Wǒmen gūjì néng zài liǎng zhōu nèi dào nàge dìfang.
english: We calculated that we could reach the place within two weeks.

chinese: 当你到的时候发一份电报给我们。
pinyin: Dāng nǐ dào de shíhou fā yī fèn diànbào gěi wǒmen.
english: Send us a telegram when you arrive.

chinese: 我得卖我的房子。
pinyin: Wǒ děi mài wǒ de fángzi.
english: I have to sell my house.

chinese: 你有卖这种钱包吗？
pinyin: Nǐ yǒu mài zhèzhǒng qiánbāo ma?
english: Do you sell this type of wallets?

chinese: 东京去年举行的现代艺术展，我全都去过了。
pinyin: Dōngjīng qùnián jǔxíng de xiàndài yìshù zhǎn, wǒ quándōu qù guo le.
english: I went to every modern art show that took place in Tokyo last year.

chinese: 你可以在这房间吃午饭。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zài zhè fángjiān chī wǔfàn.
english: You can eat lunch here in this room.

chinese: 我们今天晚上可以运送它。
pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān wǎnshang kěyǐ yùnsòng tā.
english: We can deliver it this evening.

chinese: 你可以坐船去那。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zuò chuán qù nà.
english: You can go there in a boat.

chinese: 你有可能不知道这事。
pinyin: Nǐ yǒukěnéng bù zhīdào zhè shì.
english: It's possible that you don't know this.

chinese: 如果可能的话，我想环游世界。
pinyin: Rúguǒ kěnéng dehuà, wǒ xiǎng huányóu shìjiè.
english: If possible, I'd like to travel around the world.

chinese: “明”这个汉字左边是什么？右边是什么？
pinyin: "míng " zhège hànzì zuǒbian shì shénme? yòubian shì shénme?
english: In "明", what is the character on the left? And the one on the right?

chinese: 我的房间号是多少？
pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān hào shì duōshao?
english: What is my room number?

chinese: 这本书谁想要就给谁吧。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū shéi xiǎngyào jiù gěi shéi ba.
english: Give the book to whomever wants it.

chinese: 告诉我你的故事。 我会注意听。
pinyin: Gàosu wǒ nǐ de gùshi. wǒ huì zhùyì tīng.
english: Tell me your story. I am all ears.

chinese: 请告诉我们哪儿有食品杂货店。
pinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒmen nǎr yǒu shípǐn záhuòdiàn.
english: Please tell us where there is a grocery store.

chinese: 我们应该告诉孩子怎么保护自己。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi gàosu háizi zěnme bǎohù zìjǐ.
english: We should tell children how to protect themselves.

chinese: 我从不过滤咖啡。
pinyin: Wǒ cóngbù guòlǜ kāfēi.
english: I never filter my coffee.

chinese: “你想再来点咖啡吗？”“不，谢谢。我够了。”
pinyin: "Nǐ xiǎng zài lái diǎn kāfēi ma?" "Bù, xièxie. Wǒ gòu le."
english: "Will you have some more coffee?" "No, thanks. I've had enough."

chinese: 我有一个哥哥和一个妹妹。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī gè gēge hé yī gè mèimei.
english: I have an older brother and a younger sister.

chinese: 我有一个哥哥，也有一个姐姐。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī gè gēge, yě yǒu yī gè jiějie.
english: I have an older brother and an older sister.

chinese: 为什么哥哥是笨蛋啊？
pinyin: Wèishénme gēge shì bèndàn ā?
english: Why is my brother stupid?

chinese: 她小时候唱歌唱得很好。
pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhou chànggē chàng dehěn hǎo.
english: She could sing well when she was a child.

chinese: 他喜欢唱歌，也喜欢跳舞。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuan chànggē, yě xǐhuan tiàowǔ.
english: He likes to sing and dance.

chinese: 他很喜欢一边洗澡一边唱歌。
pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuan yībiān xǐzǎo yībiān chànggē.
english: He likes to sing in the bathtub.

chinese: 你回答了什么？
pinyin: Nǐ huídá le shénme?
english: How did you reply?

chinese: 你回答得这么简短，不觉得有点没礼貌吗？
pinyin: Nǐ huídá de zhème jiǎnduǎn, bù juéde yǒudiǎn méi lǐmào ma?
english: Don't you think it's rude to give people such a curt reply like that?

chinese: "你为什么不去？""因为我不想去。"
pinyin: "Nǐ wèishénme bù qù?" "Yīnwèi wǒ bù xiǎng qù."
english: "Why aren't you going?" "Because I don't want to."

chinese: 你不能喝海水，因为它太咸了。
pinyin: Nǐ bù néng hē hǎishuǐ, yīnwèi tā tài xián le.
english: You can't drink seawater because it is too salty.

chinese: 因为下雨了，球场上没有很多观众。
pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, qiúchǎng shàng méiyǒu hěn duō guānzhòng.
english: There weren't many spectators at the game because of the rain.

chinese: 他在门外等你。
pinyin: Tā zài mén wài děng nǐ。
english: He is waiting for you outside the door.

chinese: 大家都想见到你，你太有名了！
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu xiǎng jiàn dào nǐ, nǐ tài yǒumíng le!
english: Everyone wants to meet you. You're famous!

chinese: 大家都在空地集合开会。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zài kōngdì jíhé kāihuì.
english: Everyone gathered together in the open space to meet.

chinese: 为什么大家突然对我这么好？
pinyin: Wèishénme dàjiā tūrán duì wǒ zhème hǎo?
english: Why is everyone being so nice to me all of a sudden?

chinese: 有一个男人和一个女人。
pinyin: Yǒu yī gè nánrén hé yī gè nǚrén.
english: There is a man and a woman.

chinese: 一般来说, 男人比女人跑得快。
pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, nánrén bǐ nǚrén pǎo de kuài.
english: In general, men run faster than women.

chinese: 一个美丽的女人坐在我前面一排。
pinyin: Yī gè měilì de nǚrén zuò zài wǒ qiánmiàn yīpái.
english: A beautiful woman was seated one row in front of me.

chinese: 他们的苹果没有我们的好吃。
pinyin: Tāmen de Píngguǒ méiyǒu wǒmen de hǎochī.
english: Their apples aren't as tasty as ours.

chinese: 我妹妹的房间总是整整齐齐的。
pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de fángjiān zǒngshì zhěngzhěng-qíqí de.
english: My sister's room is always tidy.

chinese: 与她的妹妹相比，她不是很准时。
pinyin: Yǔ tā de mèimei xiāngbǐ, tā bù shì hěn zhǔnshí.
english: Compared with her sister, she isn't very punctual.

chinese: 这男人和他妻子互相帮助。
pinyin: Zhè nánrén hé tā qīzi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
english: The man and his wife helped each other.

chinese: 这个孩子正在写一本书。
pinyin: Zhège háizi zhèngzài xiě yī běn shū.
english: The child is writing a book.

chinese: 我结婚了，而且有两个孩子。
pinyin: Wǒ jiéhūn le, érqiě yǒu liǎng gè háizi.
english: I am married and have two children.

chinese: 你想我们先结婚还是先生孩子？
pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng wǒmen xiān jiéhūn háishi xiānsheng háizi?
english: Do you want to get married first or have a child first?

chinese: 他的三个孩子都成为了音乐家。
pinyin: Tā de sān gè háizi dōu chéngwéi le yīnyuèjiā.
english: His three children have all become musicians.

chinese: 今早我比平时早了一个小时起床。
pinyin: Jīn zǎo wǒ bǐ píngshí zǎo le yī gè xiǎoshí qǐchuáng.
english: This morning I got up an hour earlier than usual.

chinese: 咱们的票是得提前一小时去取得。
pinyin: Zánmen de piào shì děi tíqián yī xiǎoshí qù qǔdé.
english: We have to be there an hour in advance to get our tickets.

chinese: 有不懂的东西就去问吧。
pinyin: Yǒu bù dǒng de dōngxi jiù qù wèn ba.
english: If there's anything you don't understand, then go ask about it.

chinese: 当时人们就知道，地球是个球体。
pinyin: Dāngshí rénmen jiù zhīdào, dìqiú shì gè qiútǐ.
english: Then people knew, that the world is a sphere.

chinese: 他买一把刀行，我买就不行了吗？
pinyin: Tā mǎi yī bǎ dāo xíng, wǒ mǎi jiù bùxíngle ma?
english: If it's okay for him to buy a knife, then why on earth can't I?

chinese: 我已经找不到回家的路。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng zhǎobudào huíjiā de lù.
english: I already can't find the way home.

chinese: 这已经是你该刷牙的时间了。
pinyin: Zhè yǐjīng shì nǐ gāi shuā yá de shíjiān le.
english: It's already time to brush your teeth!

chinese: 虽然时间好早，天气已经热了。
pinyin: Suīrán shíjiān hǎo zǎo, tiānqì yǐjīng rè le.
english: Although it was still early, it was already hot outside.

chinese: 找蛋糕也没用，我已经吃完了。
pinyin: Zhǎo dàngāo yě méiyòng, wǒ yǐjīng chīwán le.
english: It is no use looking for the cake; I already ate it.

chinese: 我希望下次你会小心点。
pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng xiàcì nǐ huì xiǎoxīn diǎn.
english: I hope next time you'll be more careful.

chinese: 我们希望你喜欢这个表演。
pinyin: Wǒmen xīwàng nǐ xǐhuan zhège biǎoyǎn.
english: We hope you will enjoy the show.

chinese: 我请我的朋友来帮助我。
pinyin: Wǒ qǐng wǒ de péngyou lái bāngzhù wǒ.
english: I got my friends to help me.

chinese: 我代表全班同学谢谢你给我们的帮助。
pinyin: Wǒ dàibiǎo quánbān tóngxué xièxie nǐ gěi wǒmen de bāngzhù.
english: I represent all of the students in the class when I thank you for the help that you've given us.

chinese: 我不知道在哪里开始好。
pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào zài nǎlǐ kāishǐ hǎo.
english: I don't know where I'd begin.

chinese: 他一来我们就开始比赛。
pinyin: Tā yīlái wǒmen jiù kāishǐbǐsài.
english: We will begin the match when he comes.

chinese: 演出什么时候开始？
pinyin: Yǎnchū shénme shíhou kāishǐ?
english: What time does the play begin?

chinese: 既然你在这里, 那我们就开始吧。
pinyin: Jìrán nǐ zài zhèlǐ, nà wǒmen jiù kāishǐ ba.
english: Since you're here, we might as well begin.

chinese: 我帮我弟弟搬了他的书桌。
pinyin: Wǒ bāng wǒ dìdi bān le tā de shūzhuō.
english: I helped my brother move his desk.

chinese: 妈妈给弟弟买了个黄雨伞。
pinyin: Māma gěi dìdi mǎi le gè huáng yǔsǎn.
english: My mother bought my brother a yellow umbrella.

chinese: 我弟弟非常重要。至少他认为他是。
pinyin: Wǒ dìdi fēicháng zhòngyào. zhìshǎo tā rènwéi tā shì.
english: My brother is very important. At least he thinks he is.

chinese: 我做得好到不能再好了。
pinyin: Wǒ zuò de hǎo dào bù néng zài hǎo le.
english: I can't do any better.

chinese: 工作很忙， 连休息的时间都没有。
pinyin: Gōngzuò hěn máng, lián xiūxi de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
english: Work is so busy that I don't even have any time to relax.

chinese: 他又高又胖，还总是很忙。
pinyin: Tā yòu gāo yòu pàng, hái zǒngshì hěn máng.
english: He is tall, fat and always busy.

chinese: 我知道你想要快乐。
pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào nǐ xiǎngyào kuàilè.
english: I know you want to be happy.

chinese: 您怎样看日本的经济呢？
pinyin: Nín zěnyàng kàn Rìběn de jīngjì ne?
english: What do you think of Japan's economy?

chinese: 您不应该信任这样的人。
pinyin: Nín bù yīnggāi xìnrèn zhèyàng de rén.
english: You shouldn't trust people like this.

chinese: 我觉得很难用言语表达我的意思。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde hěn nán yòng yányǔ biǎodá wǒ de yìsi.
english: I find it difficult to express my meaning in words.

chinese: 我今天累，所以我睡得早。
pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān lèi, suǒyǐ wǒ shuì de zǎo.
english: I was tired today so I went to bed early.

chinese: 我喜欢这块手表。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zhè kuài shǒubiǎo.
english: I like this wristwatch.

chinese: 我喜欢打篮球。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú.
english: I like to play basketball.

chinese: 我会努力帮你找到他们。
pinyin: Wǒ huì nǔlì bāng nǐ zhǎodào tāmen.
english: I'll try to find them for you.

chinese: 在哪儿我能找到牙膏？
pinyin: Zài nǎr wǒ néng zhǎodào yágāo?
english: Where can I find toothpaste?

chinese: 我在这个网站上能找到什么？
pinyin: Wǒ zài zhège wǎngzhànshàng néng zhǎodào shénme?
english: What can I find on this website?

chinese: 我到处都找了，就是找不到我的钱包。
pinyin: Wǒ dàochù dōu zhǎo le, jiùshì zhǎobudào wǒ de qiánbāo.
english: I've looked everywhere, but I can't find my wallet.

chinese: 我在商店选了一个新帽子。
pinyin: Wǒ zài shāngdiàn xuǎn le yī gè xīn màozi.
english: I picked out a new hat at the store.

chinese: 妈妈买了一条新的裙子给我。
pinyin: Māma mǎi le yī tiáo xīn de qúnzi gěi wǒ.
english: My mother bought me a new dress.

chinese: 你什么时候旅游回来的啊？
pinyin: Nǐ shénmeshíhou lǚyóu huílai de ā?
english: When did you get back from your trip?

chinese: 我妈妈每天早上早起。
pinyin: Wǒ māma měitiān zǎoshang zǎoqǐ.
english: My mother gets up early every morning.

chinese: 我们今天早上有历史小考。
pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān zǎoshang yǒu lìshǐ xiǎokǎo.
english: We had a history quiz this morning.

chinese: 原谅我早上这么早给你打电话。
pinyin: Yuánliàng wǒ zǎoshang zhème zǎo gěi nǐ dǎdiànhuà.
english: Please excuse me for calling you so early in the morning.

chinese: 今天早上你为什么迟到了呢?
pinyin: Jīntiān zǎoshang nǐ wèishénme chídào le ne?
english: Why were you late this morning?

chinese: 第二天早上，我们都觉得很困。
pinyin: Dì'èrtiān zǎoshang, wǒmen dōu juéde hěn kùn.
english: We were very sleepy the next morning.

chinese: 我不知道我有没有时间。
pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào wǒ yǒuméiyǒu shíjiān.
english: I don't know if I have the time.

chinese: 他在这儿住了有一段时间了。
pinyin: Tā zài zhèr zhù le yǒu yī duàn shíjiān le.
english: He lived here for a time.

chinese: 今天晚上可能会下雪。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang kěnéng huì xiàxuě.
english: It's likely to snow this evening.

chinese: 晚上我们去吃饺子，好吗？
pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒmen qù chī jiǎozi, hǎo ma?
english: We're going out for dumplings in the evening, all right?

chinese: 你最喜欢的饮料是什么？
pinyin: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan de yǐnliào shì shénme?
english: What's your favorite drink?

chinese: 服务员，请给我们菜单。
pinyin: Fúwùyuán, qǐng gěi wǒmen càidān.
english: Waiter, please give us the menu.

chinese: 招聘服务员。
pinyin: Zhāopìn fúwùyuán.
english: Waiter needed.

chinese: 欢迎回来。我们想你了!
pinyin: Huānyíng huílai. wǒmen xiǎng nǐ le!
english: Welcome back. We missed you!

chinese: 他是个非常浪漫的男朋友，每晚都给我送花。
pinyin: Tā shì gè fēicháng làngmàn de nánpéngyou, měi wǎn dōu gěi wǒ sòng huā.
english: He's a very romantic boyfriend who brings me flowers each night.

chinese: 请把每一页复印三份。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ měi yī yè fùyìn sān fèn.
english: Please make three copies of each page.

chinese: 你游泳游得比他好得多。
pinyin: Nǐ yóuyǒng yóu de bǐ tā hǎo de duō.
english: You can swim much better than him.

chinese: 你的自行车比我的好。
pinyin: Nǐ de zìxíngchē bǐ wǒ de hǎo.
english: Your bike is better than mine.

chinese: 比起羊肉我更喜欢牛肉。
pinyin: Bǐqǐ yángròu wǒ gèng xǐhuan niúròu.
english: I like beef more than lamb.

chinese: 爸爸告诉了我要洗车。
pinyin: Bàba gàosu le wǒ yào xǐ chē.
english: Father told me to wash the car.

chinese: 小孩儿不能在这条河里游泳。
pinyin: Xiǎoháir bù néng zài zhè tiáo hé lǐ yóuyǒng.
english: Children can't swim in this river.

chinese: 这个女孩在超市买牛奶。
pinyin: Zhège nǚhái zài chāoshì mǎi niúnǎi.
english: This girl is buying milk at the supermarket.

chinese: 我刚才在喝牛奶。
pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái zài hē niúnǎi.
english: I was drinking milk just now.

chinese: 你最喜欢和朋友玩什么游戏？
pinyin: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan hé péngyou wán shénme yóuxì?
english: What's your favorite game to play with friends?

chinese: 无论我和你玩什么游戏，你也总是输。
pinyin: Wúlùn wǒ hé nǐ wán shénme yóuxì, nǐ yě zǒngshì shū.
english: Whatever game I play with you, you never win.

chinese: 今天是我的生日。
pinyin: Jīn tiān shì wǒ de shēng rì。
english: Today is my birthday.

chinese: 她今天穿着白色的衣服。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān chuān zhe báisè de yīfu.
english: She is wearing a white dress today.

chinese: 她的皮肤白得像雪。
pinyin: Tā de pífū bái de xiàng xuě.
english: Her skin is as white as snow.

chinese: 我小时候常常躺在草地上看天上的白云。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou chángcháng tǎng zài cǎodì shàng kàn tiānshàng de báiyún.
english: When I was little, I often lay on the grass and watched the white clouds in the sky.

chinese: 这件衣服一百元。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fu yī bǎi yuán。
english: This piece of clothing costs one hundred yuan.

chinese: 这可能是真的，可能不是。
pinyin: Zhè kěnéng shì zhēn de, kěnéng bù shì.
english: This might be real, or it might not.

chinese: 她看着我的眼睛。
pinyin: Tā kàn zhe wǒ de yǎnjing.
english: She looked me in the eye.

chinese: 我不知道我还有没有。
pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào wǒ hái yǒu méiyǒu.
english: I don't know if I still have it.

chinese: 我请他们再寄给我一张票。
pinyin: Wǒ qǐng tāmen zài jì gěi wǒ yī zhāng piào.
english: I told them to send me another ticket.

chinese: 学校离我家很近。
pinyin: Xué xiào lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn。
english: The school is close to my home.

chinese: 我小时候只穿裤子。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou zhǐ chuān kùzi.
english: When I was little, I would only wear pants.

chinese: 你笑什么呢？
pinyin: Nǐ xiào shénme ne?
english: What made you laugh?

chinese: 这是你第一次出国吗？
pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ dì yī cì chūguó ma?
english: Is this your first trip abroad?

chinese: 我对他的第一印象果然没有错。
pinyin: Wǒ duì tā de dì yī yìnxiàng guǒrán méiyǒu cuò.
english: My first impression of him proved to be correct.

chinese: 我累得再也走不动了。
pinyin: Wǒ lèi de zàiyě zǒu bù dòng le.
english: I'm too tired to walk any further.

chinese: 她穿着红色的衣服。
pinyin: Tā chuān zhe hóngsè de yīfu.
english: She's wearing red.

chinese: 那辆红色汽车撞到了蓝色面包车。
pinyin: Nà liàng hóngsè qìchē zhuàng dào le lánsè miànbāochē.
english: That red car hit the blue van.

chinese: 花园里树上的叶子已经完全变红了。
pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ shù shàng de yèzi yǐjīng wánquán biànhóng le.
english: The leaves of the trees in the garden have turned completely red.

chinese: 为什么对面楼的窗户里发出红光?
pinyin: Wèishénme duìmiàn lóu de chuānghu lǐ fāchū hóng guāng?
english: Why is there a red light coming out the window in the building across?

chinese: 为什么你送给他这个礼物？
pinyin: Wèishénme nǐ sònggěi tā zhège lǐwù?
english: Why did you give him this gift?

chinese: 她会把她的照片给想要的人。
pinyin: Tā huì bǎ tā de zhàopiàn gěi xiǎngyào de rén.
english: She will give her picture to whoever wants it.

chinese: 我必须读书准备考试。
pinyin: Wǒ bìxū dúshū zhǔnbèi kǎoshì.
english: I have to study for the test.

chinese: 你可以在这场考试时使用字典。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zài zhè chǎng kǎoshì shí shǐyòng zìdiǎn.
english: You may use a dictionary while taking this test.

chinese: 我们还没吃完这个西瓜。
pinyin: Wǒmen hái méi chīwán zhège xīguā.
english: We haven't finished eating the watermelon yet.

chinese: 我可不想要坏事发生在我们身上。
pinyin: Wǒ kě bù xiǎngyào huàishì fāshēng zài wǒmen shēnshang.
english: I don't want something bad to happen to us.

chinese: 师傅，方向反了，我要去东边，你怎么往西边开？
pinyin: Shīfu, fāngxiàng fǎn le, wǒ yào qù dōngbian, nǐ zěnme wǎng xībiān kāi?
english: Driver, you're driving in the opposite direction. I want to go east. Why are you driving west?

chinese: 我觉得你在笑我们。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde nǐ zài xiào wǒmen.
english: I feel like you are laughing at us.

chinese: 他觉得必须报道这件事。
pinyin: Tā juéde bìxū bàodào zhè jiàn shì.
english: He felt compelled to report the incident.

chinese: 让我们来问问这是不是真的。
pinyin: Ràng wǒmen lái wèn wèn zhè shìbùshì zhēn de.
english: Let's ask if it's true.

chinese: 你叔叔让你开他的车了吗？
pinyin: Nǐ shūshu ràng nǐ kāi tā de chē le ma?
english: Did your uncle let you drive his car?

chinese: 走自己的路，让别人去说吧。
pinyin: Zǒu zìjǐ de lù, ràng biéren qù shuō ba.
english: Follow your own path and let people talk.

chinese: 让我们和他们讨论这个问题吧。
pinyin: Ràng wǒmen hé tāmen tǎolùn zhège wèntí ba.
english: Let's discuss the problem with them.

chinese: 为什么你买了一本那么贵的词典？
pinyin: Wèishénme nǐ mǎi le yī běn nàme guì de cídiǎn?
english: Why did you buy such an expensive dictionary?

chinese: 记者租了间很贵的房。
pinyin: Jìzhě zū le jiān hěn guì de fáng.
english: The reporter rented an expensive room.

chinese: 租金贵一点儿没关系，近一些最好。
pinyin: Zūjīn guì yīdiǎnr méiguānxi, jìn yīxiē zuì hǎo.
english: The rent can be a bit expensive, but something nearby would be best.

chinese: 你每天都跑步吗？
pinyin: Nǐ měitiān dōu pǎobù ma?
english: Do you run every day?

chinese: 我们家在公路边上。
pinyin: Wǒmen jiā zài gōnglù biān shàng.
english: Our house stands by the road.

chinese: 这条路对汽车来说太窄了。
pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù duì qìchē lái shuō tài zhǎi le.
english: The road is too narrow for cars.

chinese: 他用脚踢球。
pinyin: Tā yòng jiǎo tī qiú。
english: He kicks the ball with his foot.

chinese: 他的身体太瘦了。
pinyin: Tā de shēntǐ tài shòu le.
english: His body is too thin.

chinese: 她说，虽然没发高烧，但身体暖得难受。
pinyin: Tā shuō, suīrán méi fā gāoshāo, dàn shēntǐ nuǎn de nánshòu.
english: While not experiencing high fevers, she said, her body gets uncomfortably warm.

chinese: 缺少运动有害健康。
pinyin: Quēshǎo yùndòng yǒuhài jiànkāng.
english: A lack of exercise is bad for your health.

chinese: 最好的减肥方法就是少吃多运动。
pinyin: Zuì hǎo de jiǎnféi fāngfǎ jiùshì shǎo chī duō yùndòng.
english: The best way to lose weight is to eat less and exercise more.

chinese: 我时间还来得及。
pinyin: Wǒ shíjiān hái láidejí.
english: I can still make it.

chinese: 我男朋友还没有去过长城。
pinyin: Wǒ nánpéngyou hái méiyǒu qù guo Chángchéng.
english: My boyfriend still hasn't been to the Great Wall.

chinese: 他的西语水平还应该提高。
pinyin: Tā de xīyǔ shuǐpíng hái yīnggāi tígāo.
english: His level of Spanish should still be improved.

chinese: 科学还无法解决所有生活上的问题。
pinyin: Kēxué hái wúfǎ jiějué suǒyǒu shēnghuó shàng de wèntí.
english: Science is still not capable of solving all of life's problems.

chinese: 他说他没有进房间，那是骗人的。
pinyin: Tā shuō tā méiyǒu jìn fángjiān, nà shì piànrén de.
english: He said he did not enter the room, which was a lie.

chinese: 他离网球高手还差得远呢。
pinyin: Tā lí wǎngqiú gāoshǒu hái chà de yuǎn ne.
english: He is far from a good tennis player.

chinese: 她犯这样的错真的很粗心。
pinyin: Tā fàn zhèyàng de cuò zhēn de hěn cūxīn.
english: It is careless of her to make such a mistake.

chinese: 生命不长，它是宽的！
pinyin: Shēngmìng bù cháng, tā shì kuān de!
english: Life is not long, it is wide!

chinese: 那个男生从后门进来了。
pinyin: Nàge nánshēng cóng hòumén jìnlái le.
english: The boy entered by the back door.

chinese: 出去的时候把门关上。
pinyin: Chūqù de shíhou bǎmén guānshàng.
english: Close the door when you leave.

chinese: 你问我爱你有多深，月亮代表我的心。
pinyin: Nǐ wèn wǒ ài nǐ yǒu duō shēn, yuèliang dàibiǎo wǒ de xīn.
english: You ask me how deep my love is for you? The moon represents my heart.

chinese: 据广播里讲，明天会下雪。
pinyin: Jù guǎngbō lǐ jiǎng, míngtiān huì xiàxuě.
english: According to the radio, it will snow tomorrow.

chinese: 这道题很难。
pinyin: Zhè dào tí hěn nán。
english: This question is difficult.

chinese: 除了鼻子不通以外，我还发着高烧。
pinyin: Chúle bízi bù tōng yǐwài, wǒ hái fā zhe gāoshāo.
english: In addition to a blocked nose, I'm also suffering from a high temperature.

chinese: 我们在日本常常吃生鱼。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài Rìběn chángcháng chī shēng yú.
english: We often eat fish raw in Japan.

chinese: 他有一个鸡蛋，他在吃鸡蛋。
pinyin: Tā yǒu yī gè jīdàn, tā zài chījī dàn.
english: He has an egg and is eating it.

chinese: 一会儿见！
pinyin: Yīhuìr jiàn!
english: See you soon!

chinese: 你现在有什么是一定要做的？
pinyin: Nǐ xiànzài yǒu shénme shì yīdìng yào zuò de?
english: What must you do now?

chinese: 这两个字的意思是一样的。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè zì de yìsi shì yīyàng de.
english: Those two characters mean the same thing.

chinese: 你无论用什么方法，结果都是一样。
pinyin: Nǐ wúlùn yòng shénme fāngfǎ, jiéguǒ dōu shì yīyàng.
english: However you do it, the result will be the same.

chinese: 销售部门和营销部门的目标不见得一样。
pinyin: Xiāoshòu bùmén hé yíngxiāo bùmén de mùbiāo bùjiànde yīyàng.
english: The objectives of the marketing department and the sales department are not necessarily the same.

chinese: 我们看不到月亮的另一边。
pinyin: Wǒmen kàn bù dào yuèliang de lìngyī biān.
english: We cannot see the other side of the moon.

chinese: 你能借给我一万元吗 ?
pinyin: Nǐ néng jiègěi wǒ yī wàn yuán ma?
english: Can you lend me ten thousand yuan?

chinese: 台湾岛的面积是三万六千平方公里。
pinyin: Táiwān Dǎo de miànjī shì sān wàn liù qiān píngfāng gōnglǐ.
english: The Island of Taiwan's surface area is thirty-six thousand square kilometers.

chinese: 他在上网。
pinyin: Tā zài shàngwǎng.
english: He is on the Internet.

chinese: 世界上有很多不同的民族。
pinyin: Shìjiè shàng yǒu hěn duō bù tóng de mínzú.
english: There are a lot of different peoples in the world.

chinese: 世界上有超过一百五十个国家。
pinyin: Shìjiè shàng yǒu chāoguò yī bǎi wǔshí gè guójiā.
english: There are more than 150 nations in the world.

chinese: 这是世界上最长的大桥。
pinyin: Zhè shì shìjiè shàng zuì cháng de dàqiáo.
english: This is longer than any other bridge in the world.

chinese: 世界是本书，不旅游的人只看了一页。
pinyin: Shìjiè shì běn shū, bù lǚyóu de rén zhǐ kàn le yī yè.
english: The world is a book, and those who do not travel read only a page.

chinese: 我的房间面向东边。
pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān miànxiàng dōngbian.
english: My room faces east.

chinese: 我们起得很早为了看到日出。
pinyin: Wǒmen qǐ dehěn zǎo wèile kàn dào rìchū.
english: We woke up very early in order to see the sunrise.

chinese: 我不明白为什么我得跟着去。
pinyin: Wǒ bù míngbai wèishénme wǒ děi gēnzhe qù.
english: I don't see why I had to come along.

chinese: 如果你饿了，为什么不吃饭呢？
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ è le, wèishénme bù chīfàn ne?
english: If you're hungry, why don't you eat?

chinese: 你知道天为什么是蓝色的吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào tiān wèishénme shì lánsè de ma?
english: Do you know why the sky is blue?

chinese: 主要问题是什么时候开始。
pinyin: Zhǔyào wèntí shì shénmeshíhou kāishǐ.
english: When to start is the main problem.

chinese: 会议是在这里举行的。
pinyin: Huìyì shì zài zhèlǐ jǔxíng de.
english: The meeting was held here.

chinese: 好久不见。听说你又换工作了？
pinyin: Hǎojiǔbujiàn. Tīngshuō nǐ yòu huàn gōngzuò le?
english: Long time, no see. I hear that you've changed your job again.

chinese: 我认为你考虑久了就会不一样了。
pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi nǐ kǎolǜ jiǔ le jiù huì bùyīyàng le.
english: I suppose it's different when you think about it over the long term.

chinese: 我过了这么久才回信，真的十分不好意思。
pinyin: Wǒ guo le zhème jiǔ cái huíxìn, zhēn de shífēn bù hǎoyìsi.
english: I'm extremely embarrassed that it has taken so long to reply.

chinese: 在车站，我把排队买票的地点弄清楚后，开始久等。
pinyin: Zài chēzhàn, wǒ bǎ páiduì mǎipiào de dìdiǎn nòngqīng chǔ hòu, kāishǐ jiǔděng.
english: At the train station, once I had figured out where the queue for tickets actually was, I began the long wait.

chinese: 我年轻时有每天游泳的习惯。
pinyin: Wǒ niánqīng shí yǒu měitiān yóuyǒng de xíguàn.
english: When I was young, I had a habit of swimming every day.

chinese: 你们该养成使用字典的习惯。
pinyin: Nǐmen gāi yǎngchéng shǐyòng zìdiǎn de xíguàn.
english: You should try to form the habit of using your dictionaries.

chinese: 我有手写笔记的习惯，但依然经常提笔忘字。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shǒuxiě bǐjì de xíguàn, dàn yīrán jīngcháng tíbǐwàngzì.
english: I'm in the habit of taking handwritten notes, yet I still often draw a blank when picking up a pen.

chinese: 坏习惯一旦被养成，便不能简单地改正。
pinyin: Huài xíguàn yīdàn bèi yǎngchéng, biàn bù néng jiǎndān de gǎizhèng.
english: Once you have formed a bad habit, you can't get rid of it easily.

chinese: 不要以为我什么都不知道。
pinyin: Bù yào yǐwéi wǒ shénme dōu bù zhīdào.
english: Don't think I don't know anything!

chinese: 她以为我是大夫。
pinyin: Tā yǐwéi wǒ shì dàifu.
english: She thought that I was a doctor.

chinese: 以前的人以为地球是平的。
pinyin: Yǐqián de rén yǐwéi dìqiú shì píng de.
english: It used to be thought that the earth was flat.

chinese: 我以为他没有任何权利这么做。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi tā méiyǒu rènhé quánlì zhème zuò.
english: He had, I thought, no right to do that.

chinese: 本以为他不会及格，但最终还是及格了。
pinyin: Běn yǐwéi tā bù huì jígé, dàn zuì zhōng háishi jígé le.
english: I thought he was going to fail the exam, but he passed after all.

chinese: 你比以前更容易上课迟到了。
pinyin: Nǐ bǐ yǐqián gèng róngyì shàngkè chídào le.
english: You've been late for school more often than before.

chinese: 大学毕业以后我也想考研究生。
pinyin: Dàxué bìyè yǐhòu wǒ yě xiǎng kǎoyán jiū shēng.
english: After I graduate, I'd like to take the graduate school entrance examination.

chinese: 发生了那次意外以后，她就没有再公开露面了。
pinyin: Fāshēng le nà cì yìwài yǐhòu, tā jiù méiyǒu zài gōngkāi lòumiàn le.
english: She stopped appearing in public after her accident.

chinese: 我们很快的结束了这个会议。
pinyin: Wǒmen hěn kuài de jiéshù le zhège huìyì.
english: We got the meeting over with quickly.

chinese: 你们说了要参加会议了吗？
pinyin: Nǐmen shuō le yào cānjiā huìyì le ma?
english: Did you say you wanted to participate in the meeting?

chinese: 说完这些话，他结束了会议。
pinyin: Shuō wán zhèxiē huà, tā jiéshù le huìyì.
english: With those words he brought the meeting to an end.

chinese: 你和我其中一个要出席这次的会议。
pinyin: Nǐ hé wǒ qízhōng yī gè yào chūxí zhè cì de huìyì.
english: Either you or I must attend the meeting.

chinese: 星期六你们上体育课。
pinyin: Xīngqīliù nǐmen shàng tǐyù kè.
english: On Saturday you do physical education.

chinese: 它现在起作用了。
pinyin: Tā xiànzài qǐzuòyòng le.
english: It works now.

chinese: 我在信箱中发现了你的信件。
pinyin: Wǒ zài xìnxiāng zhōng fāxiàn le nǐ de xìnjiàn.
english: I found your letter in the mailbox.

chinese: 你收到了我的信了吗？
pinyin: Nǐ shōudào le wǒ de xìn le ma?
english: Did you receive my letter?

chinese: 我想要用挂号寄这封信。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngyào yòng guàhào jì zhè fēng xìn.
english: I want to have this letter registered.

chinese: 下次去邮局的时候，请把这封信寄出去。
pinyin: Xiàcì qù yóujú de shíhou, qǐng bǎ zhè fēng xìn jìchū qù.
english: Please mail this letter the next time you go to the post office.

chinese: 你能把你的自行车借给我吗？
pinyin: Nǐ néng bǎ nǐ de zìxíngchē jiè gěi wǒ ma?
english: Will you lend me your bicycle?

chinese: 没有什么比健康更重要。
pinyin: Méiyǒushénme bǐ jiànkāng gèng zhòngyào.
english: Nothing is more valuable than good health.

chinese: 我很关心他的健康。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn guānxīn tā de jiànkāng.
english: I am very concerned about his health.

chinese: 恶劣的天气对他的健康带来了影响。
pinyin: Èliè de tiānqì duì tā de jiànkāng dàilái le yǐngxiǎng.
english: The bad weather affected his health.

chinese: 从天上看下来，这条河像一条巨蛇。
pinyin: Cóng tiānshàng kàn xiàlai, zhè tiáo hé xiàng yī tiáo jù shé.
english: Seen from the sky, the river looked like a huge snake.

chinese: 他的鼻子看起来像土豆。
pinyin: Tā de bízi kànqǐlai xiàng tǔdòu.
english: His nose looks like a potato.

chinese: 好的，但我们先吃晚饭吧。
pinyin: Hǎo de, dàn wǒmen xiān chī wǎnfàn ba.
english: Sure, but let's eat dinner first.

chinese: 先肯定后否定，一正一反，就分外有力量。
pinyin: Xiān kěndìng hòu fǒudìng, yī zhèng yī fǎn, jiù fènwài yǒulì liáng.
english: First acknowledge, then deny – one for and one against – and then you are in a powerful position.

chinese: 我家附近有个漂亮的公园。
pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu ge piàoliang de gōngyuán.
english: There is a beautiful park near my home.

chinese: 我的家在公园南边
pinyin: Wǒ de jiā zài gōngyuán nánbiān
english: My house is on the south side of the park.

chinese: 公园里有一个漂亮的黑发姑娘。
pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu yī gè piàoliang de hēifà gūniang.
english: There was a beautiful woman with black hair in the park.

chinese: 我们在代代木公园度过了一整天的时间。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài Dàidàimù Gōngyuán dùguò le yī zhěng tiān de shíjiān.
english: We spent the entire day in Yoyogi Park.

chinese: 我正在读一本关于动物的书。
pinyin: Wǒ zhèngzài dú yī běn guānyú dòngwù de shū.
english: I am reading a book about animals.

chinese: 这就是我关于他知道的一切。
pinyin: Zhè jiù shì wǒ guānyú tā zhīdào de yīqiè.
english: This is all that I know about him.

chinese: 我关于日语的知识掌握得还不是很好。
pinyin: Wǒ guānyú Rìyǔ de zhīshi zhǎngwò de hái bù shì hěn hǎo.
english: My knowledge about Japanese is not that good yet.

chinese: 她很关心孩子的营养问题。
pinyin: Tā hěn guānxīn háizi de yíngyǎng wèntí.
english: She is careful about her child's nutrition.

chinese: 这小女孩如果没人关心的话，就要走上歪路了。
pinyin: Zhè xiáo nǚhái rúguǒ méi rén guānxīn de huà, jiù yào zǒu shàng wāi lù le.
english: The little girl will go astray if no one cares much about her.

chinese: 他和那件事半点关系也没有。
pinyin: Tā hé nà jiàn shì bàndiǎn guānxi yě méiyǒu.
english: He had nothing to do with the case.

chinese: 这真的不让你感兴趣吗？
pinyin: Zhè zhēn de bù ràng nǐ gǎnxìngqù ma?
english: Does that really not interest you?

chinese: 他们想和你互相谈谈共同的兴趣领域。
pinyin: Tāmen xiǎng hé nǐ hùxiāng tántán gòngtóng de xìngqù lǐngyù.
english: They want to talk to you about areas of mutual interest.

chinese: 他和班上其他男生一样聪明。
pinyin: Tā hé bānshàng qítā nánshēng yīyàng cōngming.
english: He is as smart as any other boy in the class.

chinese: 经济的增长带来了其他的社会问题。
pinyin: Jīngjì de zēngzhǎng dàilái le qítā de shèhuì wèntí.
english: Economic development has brought other social problems.

chinese: 我们可能会将你的私人信息和其他信息结合在一起。
pinyin: Wǒmen kěnéng huì jiāng nǐ de sīrén xìnxī hé qítā xìnxī jiéhé zàiyīqǐ.
english: We may combine your personal information with other information.

chinese: 有人喜欢夏天， 有人喜欢冬天。
pinyin: Yǒurén xǐhuan xiàtiān, yǒurén xǐhuan dōngtiān.
english: Some people like summer, and others like winter.

chinese: 冬天是我最喜欢的季节。
pinyin: Dōngtiān shì wǒ zuì xǐhuan de jìjié.
english: Winter is my favorite season.

chinese: 冬天我总是需要多加条被子。
pinyin: Dōngtiān wǒ zǒngshì xūyào duō jiā tiáo bèizi.
english: In winter, I always need to add an extra quilt.

chinese: 我们的冰箱坏了。
pinyin: Wǒmen de bīngxiāng huàile.
english: Our refrigerator is out of order.

chinese: 该由你来决定我们去不去那儿。
pinyin: Gāi yóu nǐ lái juédìng wǒmen qù bù qù nàr.
english: It is up to you to decide whether we will go there or not.

chinese: 总之，下一步是要决定我们下一步应该做什么。
pinyin: Zǒngzhī, xiàyībù shì yào juédìng wǒmen xiàyībù yīnggāi zuò shénme.
english: In conclusion, the next step is to decide what we should do for the next step.

chinese: 你为什么会出现在我工作单位？
pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme huì chūxiàn zài wǒ gōngzuòdānwèi?
english: Why would you appear in my unit?

chinese: 我刚才瞧了一眼，一点没意思。
pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái qiáo le yīyǎn, yīdiǎn méiyìsi.
english: I just had a quick look. It wasn't interesting at all.

chinese: 您可以再重复一遍刚才说的话吗？
pinyin: Nín kěyǐ zài chóngfù yī biàn gāngcái shuō de huà ma?
english: Could you please repeat what you just said?

chinese: 她不关心别人；也就是说，她很自私。
pinyin: Tā bù guānxīn biéren; yějiùshìshuō, tā hěn zìsī.
english: She doesn't pay attention to others; in other words, she is selfish.

chinese: 他总是挑别人的毛病。
pinyin: Tā zǒngshì tiāo biérén de máobìng.
english: He is constantly finding fault with other people.

chinese: 你不能未经允许就看别人的私人信件。
pinyin: Nǐ bù néng wèijīng yǔnxǔ jiù kàn biéren de sīrén xìnjiàn.
english: You shouldn't read other people's private letters without permission.

chinese: 对你来说，我们可不可以评判别人的宗教？
pinyin: Duì nǐ lái shuō, wǒmen kěbu kěyǐ píngpàn biéren de zōngjiào?
english: In your view, can we judge other people's religion or not?

chinese: 今天刮大风。
pinyin: Jīn tiān guā dà fēng。
english: Strong winds are blowing today.

chinese: 我的叔叔在这个办公室里工作。
pinyin: Wǒ de shūshu zài zhège bàngōngshì lǐ gōngzuò.
english: My uncle works in this office.

chinese: 她想到了一个好的解决办法。
pinyin: Tā xiǎngdào le yī gè hǎo de jiějuébànfǎ.
english: She thought of a good solution.

chinese: 这种动物日语叫什么名字？
pinyin: Zhèzhǒng dòngwù Rìyǔ jiào shénme míngzi?
english: What do you call this animal in Japanese?

chinese: 你跟他在你这个年纪时一样努力工作。
pinyin: Nǐ gēn tā zài nǐ zhège niánjì shí yīyàng nǔlì gōngzuò.
english: You work as hard as he did at your age.

chinese: 因为你不够努力，所以才会失败。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐ bù gòu nǔlì, suǒyǐ cái huì shībài.
english: The reason why you failed is you did not try hard enough.

chinese: 我们正在努力扩展合作。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài nǔlì kuòzhǎn hézuò.
english: We are working hard to cooperate more.

chinese: 他很努力工作，所以他的同事们都尊敬他。
pinyin: Tā hěn nǔlì gōngzuò, suǒyǐ tā de tóngshì men dōu zūnjìng tā.
english: He works really hard, and his co-workers respect him for it.

chinese: 这个包是我的。
pinyin: Zhè gè bāo shì wǒ de。
english: This bag is mine.

chinese: 北方的春天送来狂风扫路。
pinyin: Běifāng de chūntiān sòng lái kuángfēng sǎo lù.
english: Spring in the north sends gales to sweep the roads.

chinese: 我自学了半个学期的德文。
pinyin: Wǒ zìxué le bànge xuéqī de Déwén.
english: I have self-studied half a semester's worth of German.

chinese: 那只鸟的体积有半只老鹰那么大。
pinyin: Nà zhǐ niǎo de tǐjī yǒu bàn zhǐ lǎoyīng nàme dà.
english: The bird was half the size of a hawk.

chinese: 光一秒钟能够环绕地球七圈半。
pinyin: Guāng yī miǎozhōng nénggòu huánrào dìqiú qī quān bàn.
english: Light travels around the earth seven and a half times a second.

chinese: 我家在十八层，主卧和客厅都面朝南方。
pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài shíbā céng, zhǔ wò hé kètīng dōu miàn cháo nánfāng.
english: My home is on the eighteenth floor, and both the master bedroom and the living room face south.

chinese: 这个国家有很丰富的历史。
pinyin: Zhège guójiā yǒu hěn fēngfù de lìshǐ.
english: This country has a rich history.

chinese: 中国历史比日本历史更悠久。
pinyin: Zhōngguó lìshǐ bǐ Rìběn lìshǐ gèng yōujiǔ.
english: The history of China is older than that of Japan.

chinese: 从今天开始，这项规定成为了历史。
pinyin: Cóng jīntiān kāishǐ, zhè xiàng guīdìng chéngwéi le lìshǐ.
english: From today on this regulation is history.

chinese: 从严格的科学观点来看，历史不能算是一门科学。
pinyin: Cóng yángé de kēxué guāndiǎn lái kàn, lìshǐ bù néng suàn shì yī mén kēxué.
english: From a strictly scientific point of view, history cannot be called a science.

chinese: 记住把厨房打扫干净。
pinyin: Jìzhu bǎ chúfáng dǎsǎo gānjìng.
english: Don't forget to sweep the kitchen clean.

chinese: 我们家有七间房间，其中一间是厨房。
pinyin: Wǒmen jiā yǒu qī jiān fángjiān, qízhōng yī jiān shì chúfáng.
english: Our house is made up of seven rooms, one of which is a kitchen.

chinese: 我可以做中英双向翻译，参加跟外国人交际谈判。
pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ zuò Zhōng Yīng shuāngxiàng fānyì, cānjiā gēn wàiguórén jiāojì tánpàn.
english: I can translate between Chinese and English, and can participate in negotiations with foreigners.

chinese: 我的车我上个月修好了，后来又坏了。
pinyin: Wǒ de chē wǒ shànggè yuè xiū hǎo le, hòulái yòu huài le.
english: I fixed my car last month, but it broke again afterwards.

chinese: 你有一双可爱的眼睛，不是吗?
pinyin: Nǐ yǒu yī shuāng kě'ài de yǎnjing, bùshìma?
english: You have lovely eyes, don't you?

chinese: 汤姆买了一双黑色皮鞋。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ mǎi le yī shuāng hēisè píxié.
english: Tom bought a pair of black leather shoes.

chinese: 我咳嗽，还有点发烧。
pinyin: Wǒ késou, hái yǒu diǎn fāshāo.
english: I have a cough and a little fever.

chinese: 当你在指「发明」的时候，不要用「发现」这个字。
pinyin: Dāng nǐ zài zhǐ 「 fāmíng 」 de shíhou, bù yào yòng 「 fāxiàn 」 zhège zì.
english: Don't use "discover" when you mean "invent".

chinese: 口中有蜜，心中有毒。
pinyin: Kǒu zhōng yǒu mì, xīnzhōng yǒudú.
english: Honey in the mouth and poison in the heart.

chinese: 这个世界语句子是什么意思？
pinyin: Zhège Shìjièyǔ jùzi shì shénme yìsi?
english: What does this Esperanto sentence mean?

chinese: 比较一下你写的句子和黑板上的句子。
pinyin: Bǐjiào yīxià nǐ xiě de jùzi hé hēibǎn shàng de jùzi.
english: Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.

chinese: 你再出个句子让我翻译翻译，好吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zài chū gè jùzi ràng wǒ fānyì fānyì, hǎo ma?
english: Can you give me another sentence to translate?

chinese: 只有得了签证才可以来中国。
pinyin: Zhǐ yǒu déle qiānzhèng cái kěyǐ lái Zhōngguó.
english: You can only come to China if you’ve got a visa.

chinese: 我们只会在那样的条件下同意。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhǐ huì zài nàyàng de tiáojiàn xiàtóng yì.
english: We will only consent on that condition.

chinese: 你批准司机把车开回家的事是真的吗？
pinyin: Nǐ pīzhǔn sījī bǎ chē kāi huíjiā de shì shì zhēnde ma?
english: Is it true that you authorized the driver to take the car home?

chinese: 司机不需要为这次的交通意外负责。
pinyin: Sījī bù xūyào wèi zhè cì de jiāotōngyìwài fùzé.
english: The driver does not have responsibility for the traffic accident.

chinese: 这衣服是我同事的，不是我的。
pinyin: Zhè yīfu shì wǒ tóngshì de, bù shì wǒ de.
english: This clothing is my coworker's, not mine.

chinese: 问题是我爸爸妈妈会不会同意。
pinyin: Wèntí shì wǒ bàba māma huìbùhuì tóngyì.
english: The problem is whether my parents will agree or not.

chinese: 上周末我爬山去了。
pinyin: Shàngzhōu mò wǒ páshān qù le.
english: On the weekend, I climbed the mountain.

chinese: 我们非常难过的时候就会哭。
pinyin: Wǒmen fēicháng nánguò de shíhou jiù huì kū.
english: When we are very sad, we will cry.

chinese: 我压力好大，我真想哭。
pinyin: Wǒ yālì hǎo dà, wǒ zhēn xiǎng kū.
english: I'm under so much pressure, I just want to cry.

chinese: 我回来了！啊？有人来看我们吗？
pinyin: Wǒ huílai le! Ǎ? Yǒu rén lái kàn wǒmen ma?
english: I'm back! Oh? Have we got a guest?

chinese: 这种啤酒有苦味。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng píjiǔ yǒu kǔwèi.
english: This beer tastes bitter.

chinese: 你国家的人吃米吗?
pinyin: Nǐ guójiā de rén chī mǐ ma?
english: Do the people of your country eat rice?

chinese: 你的国家的最低工资是多少？
pinyin: Nǐ de guójiā de zuì dī gōngzī shì duōshao?
english: What's the minimum wage in your country?

chinese: 中国是亚洲最大的国家。
pinyin: Zhōngguó shì Yàzhōu zuì dà de guójiā.
english: China is the largest country in Asia.

chinese: 我记得我把书还到图书馆了。
pinyin: Wǒ jìde wǒ bǎ shū huán dào túshūguǎn le.
english: I remember returning the book to the library.

chinese: 我很容易地解决了这个问题。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn róngyì de jiějué le zhège wèntí.
english: I solved the problem easily.

chinese: 你会发现这张地图非常有用。
pinyin: Nǐ huì fāxiàn zhè zhāng dìtú fēicháng yǒuyòng.
english: You'll find this map very useful.

chinese: 今晚七点老地方见。没问题吧？
pinyin: Jīnwǎn qī diǎn lǎodìfāng jiàn. méiwèntí ba?
english: Can you make it to our usual place at 7:00 p.m. tonight?

chinese: 我爸爸坚持要我去那地方看看。
pinyin: Wǒ bàba jiānchí yào wǒ qù nà dìfang kànkan.
english: My father insisted that I should go to see the place.

chinese: 这个地方有一种神秘的气氛。
pinyin: Zhège dìfang yǒu yī zhǒng shénmì de qìfēn.
english: This place has a mysterious atmosphere.

chinese: 最近的地铁站在哪里？
pinyin: Zuì jìn de dìtiězhàn zài nǎlǐ?
english: Where is the nearest subway station?

chinese: 战争永远谈不上好，和平永远谈不上坏。
pinyin: Zhànzhēng yǒngyuǎn tánbushàng hǎo, hépíng yǒngyuǎn tánbushàng huài.
english: There never was a good war nor a bad peace.

chinese: 没有你这个城市孤单又冷清。
pinyin: Méiyǒu nǐ zhège chéngshì gūdān yòu lěngqīng.
english: This city is cold and lonely without you.

chinese: 我的城市离首都五十千米。
pinyin: Wǒ de chéngshì lí shǒudū wǔshí qiānmǐ.
english: My city is fifty kilometres from the capital.

chinese: 人们都说，东京是座很安全的城市。
pinyin: Rénmen dōu shuō, Dōngjīng shì zuò hěn ānquán de chéngshì.
english: It is said that Tokyo is a very safe city.

chinese: 在城市里行驶的车辆数量增加了。
pinyin: Zài chéngshì lǐ xíngshǐ de chēliàng shùliàng zēngjiā le.
english: The number of cars driven in the city has increased.

chinese: 我可以听见你心里的声音。
pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ tīngjiàn nǐ xīnli de shēngyīn.
english: I can hear the sound in your mind.

chinese: 月球上没有空气，也自然没有声音。
pinyin: Yuèqiú shàng méiyǒu kōngqì, yě zìrán méiyǒu shēngyīn.
english: Since there is no air on the moon, there is no sound at all.

chinese: 唯一能听到的声音是钟的滴答声。
pinyin: Wéiyī néng tīngdào de shēngyīn shì zhōng de dīdashēng.
english: The only sound to be heard was the ticking of the clock.

chinese: 光传播得比声音快，所以我们先看到闪电，然后才会听见雷声。
pinyin: Guāng chuánbō de bǐ shēngyīn kuài, suǒyǐ wǒmen xiān kàn dào shǎndiàn, ránhòu cái huì tīngjiàn léishēng.
english: It is because light travels faster than sound that we see lightning before we hear thunder.

chinese: 我会尽量不打扰你复习。
pinyin: Wǒ huì jǐnliàng bù dǎrǎo nǐ fùxí.
english: I'll do my best not to disturb your studying.

chinese: 今年夏天你打算去哪里玩啊？
pinyin: Jīnnián xiàtiān nǐ dǎsuàn qù nǎlǐ wán ā?
english: Where do you want to go this summer?

chinese: 整个夏天，我们在那里过得很愉快。
pinyin: Zhěnggè xiàtiān, wǒmen zài nàli guòde hěn yúkuài.
english: We spent happy days there all the summer.

chinese: 两个小时内太阳就下山了。
pinyin: Liǎng gè xiǎoshí nèi tàiyang jiù xiàshān le.
english: Within two hours the sun had set.

chinese: 太阳在西边下山。
pinyin: Tàiyang zài xībiān xiàshān.
english: The sun sets in the west.

chinese: 他常常坐着晒太阳，什么也不做。
pinyin: Tā chángcháng zuò zhe shàitàiyáng, shénme yě bù zuò.
english: He would sit in the sun doing nothing.

chinese: 就连最黑暗的夜晚都会结束，太阳仍会照常升起。
pinyin: Jiù lián zuì hēi'àn de yèwǎn dōu huì jiéshù, tàiyang réng huì zhàocháng shēngqǐ.
english: Even the darkest night will end and the sun will rise.

chinese: 她的头发长回原来的长度了。
pinyin: Tā de tóufa zhǎng huí yuánlái de chángdù le.
english: Her hair grew back to its original length.

chinese: 一个女人的头发很长，她的舌头更长。
pinyin: Yī gè nǚrén de tóufa hěn cháng, tā de shétou gèng cháng.
english: A woman's hair is long; her tongue is longer.

chinese: 理发师正在用剪刀剪头发。
pinyin: Lǐfàshī zhèngzài yòng jiǎndāo jiǎntóufa.
english: The hair dresser is cutting the hair with scissors.

chinese: 她是一个奇怪，神秘和鼓舞人心的诗人。
pinyin: Tā shì yī gè qíguài, shénmì hé gǔwǔ rénxīn de shīrén.
english: She's a strange, enigmatic and inspiring poet.

chinese: 我们担心着爷爷和奶奶。
pinyin: Wǒmen dānxīn zhe yéye hé nǎinai.
english: We're worried about Grandma and Grandpa.

chinese: 这个词字典里面怎么查不到？
pinyin: Zhège cí zìdiǎn lǐmiàn zěnme chábudào?
english: Why can't I find it in this dictionary?

chinese: 这本字典虽然很贵，但还是值得买的。
pinyin: Zhè běn zìdiǎn suīrán hěn guì, dàn háishi zhíde mǎi de.
english: This dictionary is very expensive, but is worth buying.

chinese: 在日本，梅雨季节从六月初持续到七月中旬。
pinyin: Zài Rìběn, méiyǔ jìjié cóng Liùyuè chū chíxù dào Qīyuè zhōngxún.
english: In Japan, the rainy season lasts from the beginning of June to the middle of July.

chinese: 请安静！孩子们在睡觉。
pinyin: Qǐng'ān jìng! háizimen zài shuìjiào.
english: Be quiet. The kids are asleep.

chinese: 我回来了！啊？我们有客人啊？
pinyin: Wǒ huílai le! ā? wǒmen yǒu kèrén ā?
english: I'm back! Oh? Have we got a guest?

chinese: 我觉得事情不会那么容易。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde shìqing bù huì nàme róngyì.
english: I don't think it'll be that easy.

chinese: 这项工作未必容易。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò wèibì róngyì.
english: This work is not necessarily easy.

chinese: 这家宾馆很干净。
pinyin: Zhè jiā bīn guǎn hěn gān jìng。
english: This hotel is clean.

chinese: 小心不要感冒了。
pinyin: Xiǎoxīn bù yào gǎnmào le.
english: Be careful not to catch a cold.

chinese: 他只要一动, 伤口就连带整个胳膊都疼。
pinyin: Tā zhǐyào yī dòng, shāngkǒu jiù liándài zhěnggè gēbo dōu téng.
english: Whenever he moved, the wound sent pains all along his arm.

chinese: 他们说他们不需要我们帮忙。
pinyin: Tāmen shuō tāmen bù xūyào wǒmen bāngmáng.
english: They said that they didn't need our help.

chinese: 他不知道该怎么做，于是便找我帮忙。
pinyin: Tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme zuò, yúshì biàn zhǎo wǒ bāngmáng.
english: Not knowing what to do, he asked me for help.

chinese: 你想要一把干净的叉子吗？
pinyin: Nǐ xiǎngyào yī bǎ gānjìng de chāzi ma?
english: Do you want a clean fork?

chinese: 他很年轻，更重要的是，他很帅。
pinyin: Tā hěn niánqīng, gèng zhòngyào de shì, tā hěn shuài.
english: He is young and, what is more, handsome.

chinese: 他遇到了一个优秀的年轻人。
pinyin: Tā yùdào le yī gè yōuxiù de niánqīngrén.
english: He came across an outstanding young person.

chinese: 她在入口看到一个年轻男人。
pinyin: Tā zài rùkǒu kàn dào yī gè niánqīng nánrén.
english: She saw a young man at the entrance.

chinese: 我觉得应该向她道歉的人是你。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde yīnggāi xiàng tā dàoqiàn de rén shì nǐ.
english: I think it's you who should apologize to her.

chinese: 我们还应该看下这个房子的内部。
pinyin: Wǒmen hái yīnggāi kàn xià zhège fángzi de nèibù.
english: We should look inside this house as well.

chinese: 他在商界有很大的影响力。
pinyin: Tā zài shāngjiè yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎnglì.
english: He has a strong influence over the business world.

chinese: 你觉得气候会不会影响人的性格呢？
pinyin: Nǐ juéde qìhòu huì bù huì yǐngxiǎng rén de xìnggé ne?
english: Do you think our climate has an influence on our character?

chinese: 这种玩具会对小孩子带来不良的影响。
pinyin: Zhèzhǒng wánjù huì duì xiǎoháizi dàilái bù liáng de yǐngxiǎng.
english: Such toys have a bad influence on children.

chinese: 你必须分些零工给其他人做。
pinyin: Nǐ bìxū fēn xiē línggōng gěi qítā rén zuò.
english: You must share your jobs with others.

chinese: 你必须马上开始。
pinyin: Nǐ bìxū mǎshàng kāishǐ.
english: You must start at once.

chinese: 如果您想抽烟的话，您必须出去。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nín xiǎng chōuyān dehuà, nín bìxū chūqù.
english: You must go outside if you want to smoke.

chinese: 如果签证过期，你就必须离开中国。
pinyin: Rúguǒ qiānzhèng guòqī, nǐ jiù bìxū líkāi Zhōngguó.
english: If your visa expires, you must leave China.

chinese: 我们必须始终为灾害做好准备。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū shǐzhōng wèi zāihài zuò hǎo zhǔnbèi.
english: We must always be prepared for disasters.

chinese: 如果我忘记了请提醒我。
pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒ wàngjì le qǐng tíxǐng wǒ.
english: In case I forget, please remind me.

chinese: 我决不会忘记去年与总统握手的情景。
pinyin: Wǒ juébù huì wàngjì qùnián yǔ zǒngtǒng wòshǒu de qíngjǐng.
english: I'll never forget shaking the President's hand last year.

chinese: 他们并不总是服从他们的父母。
pinyin: Tāmen bìngbù zǒngshì fúcóng tāmen de fùmǔ.
english: They don't always obey their parents.

chinese: 她穿的衣服总是很朴素。
pinyin: Tā chuān de yīfu zǒngshì hěn pǔsù.
english: The clothes she wears are always plain.

chinese: 早上起来，嗓子变得很沙哑，我想是不是感冒了。
pinyin: Zǎoshang qǐlai, sǎngzi biànde hěn shāyǎ, wǒ xiǎng shìbùshì gǎnmào le.
english: I've had a scratchy throat since this morning. I wonder if I've caught a cold.

chinese: 他数学得了一个好成绩。
pinyin: Tā shùxué déle yī gè hǎo chéngjì.
english: He got a good grade in mathematics.

chinese: 我们才一到家就下起雨来了。
pinyin: Wǒmen cái yī dào jiā jiù xià qǐ yǔ lái le.
english: Hardly had we come home when it began to rain.

chinese: 我会帮你买菜，打扫，以及做晚餐。
pinyin: Wǒ huì bāng nǐ mǎi cài, dǎsǎo, yǐjí zuò wǎncān.
english: I'll do your shopping, clean up the house, and cook your dinner for you.

chinese: 你打算什么时候出发去日本？
pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuàn shénme shíhou chūfā qù Rìběn?
english: When do you plan to set out for Japan?

chinese: 你打算自己一人把它全部吃了吗？
pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuàn zìjǐ yī rén bǎ tā quánbù chī le ma?
english: Did you plan to eat all of that yourself?

chinese: 我找到那把我一直在找的钥匙了。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǎodào nèi bǎ wǒ yīzhí zài zhǎo de yàoshi le.
english: I found the key for which I had been looking.

chinese: 她弄丢了她的护照，所以遇到了麻烦。
pinyin: Tā nòngdiū le tā de hùzhào, suǒyǐ yùdào le máfan.
english: She was in trouble because she lost her passport.

chinese: 先生，请出示护照或者身份证，让我登记一下。
pinyin: Xiānsheng, qǐng chūshì hùzhào huòzhě shēnfènzhèng, ràng wǒ dēngjì yīxià.
english: Sir, please present your passport or identity card, so I can register it.

chinese: 不要担心，我会帮你的。
pinyin: Bù yào dānxīn, wǒ huì bāng nǐ de.
english: Don't worry, I'll help you.

chinese: 请拿一本书给我。
pinyin: Qǐng ná yī běn shū gěi wǒ。
english: Please bring me a book.

chinese: 请你帮我换一点零钱行吗？
pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ huàn yīdiǎn língqián xíng ma?
english: Could you please exchange some small change with me?

chinese: 我会安排一下，叫个人去你家接你。
pinyin: Wǒ huì ānpái yīxià, jiào ge rén qù nǐ jiā jiē nǐ.
english: I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.

chinese: 你不需要提高你的音量。
pinyin: Nǐ bù xūyào tígāo nǐ de yīnliàng.
english: You don't have to raise your voice.

chinese: 不要把马车放在马的前面。
pinyin: Bù yào bǎ mǎchē fàng zài mǎ de qiánmiàn.
english: Don't put the cart before the horse.

chinese: 我把鞋脱了，然后将它们放在床下。
pinyin: Wǒ bǎ xié tuō le, ránhòu jiāng tāmen fàng zài chuáng xià.
english: I took my shoes off and put them under the bed.

chinese: 他把他的手温柔地放在她的肩上。
pinyin: Tā bǎ tā de shǒu wēnróu de fàng zài tā de jiān shàng.
english: He put a hand gently on her shoulder.

chinese: 他小心地把他的东西放进了抽屉。
pinyin: Tā xiǎoxīn de bǎ tā de dōngxi fàngjìn le chōuti.
english: He carefully put his things in the drawer.

chinese: 你可以放心，他会准时的。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ fàngxīn, tā huì zhǔnshí de.
english: You can rely upon his being punctual.

chinese: 那个故事是我爷爷告诉我的。
pinyin: Nàge gùshi shì wǒ yéye gàosu wǒ de.
english: It was my grandfather that told me that story.

chinese: 「故事？」妇女问道。「您是什么意思？」
pinyin: 「 gùshi?」 fùnǚ wèndào.「 nín shì shénme yìsi?」
english: "'Story'?" the woman asked. "What do you mean?"

chinese: 书里讲的是一条不会喷火的龙的故事。
pinyin: Shū lǐ jiǎng de shì yī tiáo bù huì pēnhuǒ de lóng de gùshi.
english: The book tells the story of a dragon that can't breathe fire.

chinese: 他喜欢数学，但我不喜欢。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuan shùxué, dàn wǒ bù xǐhuan.
english: He likes mathematics, but I don't.

chinese: 自由的本质就是数学。
pinyin: Zìyóu de běnzhì jiùshì shùxué.
english: The essence of liberty is mathematics.

chinese: 他们有他们自己的文化。
pinyin: Tāmen yǒu tāmen zìjǐ de wénhuà.
english: They had a culture of their own.

chinese: 一个国家的风俗习惯反映了它的文化。
pinyin: Yī gè guójiā de fēngsú xíguàn fǎnyìng le tā de wénhuà.
