english: The manners and customs of a country reflect its culture.

chinese: 跟她说我正在看新闻。
pinyin: Gēn tā shuō wǒ zhèngzài kàn xīnwén.
english: Tell her that I am watching the news.

chinese: 这辆卡车从青森运输新鲜食品到东京。
pinyin: Zhè liàng kǎchē cóng Qīngsēn yùnshū xīnxiān shípǐn dào Dōngjīng.
english: This truck transports fresh food from Aomori to Tokyo.

chinese: 去东京站怎么走最方便？
pinyin: Qù Dōngjīng zhàn zěnme zǒu zuì fāngbiàn?
english: What's the most convenient way to get to Tokyo Station?

chinese: 「不方便」的相反词是「方便」。
pinyin: 「 bù fāngbiàn 」 de xiāngfǎn cí shì 「 fāngbiàn 」.
english: The opposite of "inconvenient" is "convenient".

chinese: 我用我的旧车换了一辆新的。
pinyin: Wǒ yòng wǒ de jiù chē huàn le yī liàng xīn de.
english: I traded in my old car for a new one.

chinese: 旧村屋有它自己一定的魅力。
pinyin: Jiù cūn wū yǒu tā zìjǐ yīdìng de mèilì.
english: The old cottage has a certain charm about it.

chinese: 我偶然在巴士上碰见了一位旧朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ ǒurán zài bāshì shàng pèngjiàn le yī wèi jiù péngyou.
english: I bumped into an old friend on the bus.

chinese: 那间旧屋里只有一张床，所以我们便轮流睡觉。
pinyin: Nà jiān jiù wū lǐ zhǐ yǒu yī zhāng chuáng, suǒyǐ wǒmen biàn lúnliú shuìjiào.
english: The old cottage had only one bed, so we all took turns sleeping in it.

chinese: 一年四季中我最喜欢春天了。
pinyin: Yī nián sìjì zhōng wǒ zuì xǐhuan chūntiān le.
english: Spring is my favorite season.

chinese: 春天和秋天，你更喜欢哪个？
pinyin: Chūntiān hé qiūtiān, nǐ gèng xǐhuan něige?
english: Which do you like better, spring or autumn?

chinese: 我的广东话比我的普通话好。
pinyin: Wǒ de Guǎngdōnghuà bǐ wǒ de pǔtōnghuà hǎo.
english: My Cantonese is better than my Mandarin.

chinese: 他不但会说普通话，而且会说上海话。
pinyin: Tā bù dàn huì shuō pǔtōnghuà, érqiě huì shuōshàng hǎi huà.
english: Not only can he speak Mandarin, but Shanghainese as well.

chinese: 让我们别来，我们就更想来了。
pinyin: Ràng wǒmen bié lái, wǒmen jiù gèng xiǎng lái le.
english: When we are told not to come, we become all the more eager to go.

chinese: 我需要更经常地锻炼。
pinyin: Wǒ xūyào gèng jīngcháng de duànliàn.
english: I need to exercise more often.

chinese: 这个房间最近都没打扫过，有一股臭味。
pinyin: Zhège fángjiān zuì jìn dōu méi dǎsǎo guo, yǒu yī gǔ chòuwèi.
english: The room hasn't been cleaned recently, so it now has a foul aroma.

chinese: 他们喜欢美丽的星星和月亮。
pinyin: Tāmen xǐhuan měilì de xīngxing hé yuèliang.
english: They like the beautiful stars and moon.

chinese: 她将来会是一个有名的艺术家。
pinyin: Tā jiānglái huì shì yī gè yǒumíng de yìshùjiā.
english: She will be a famous artist in the future.

chinese: 很多有名的哲学家和诗人都来自雅典。
pinyin: Hěn duō yǒumíng de zhéxuéjiā hé shīrén dōu láizì Yǎdiǎn.
english: Many famous philosophers and poets come from Athens.

chinese: 我有个到国外旅游的机会。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu gè dào guówài lǚyóu de jīhuì.
english: I had a chance to travel abroad.

chinese: 面对这个机会不能犹豫，要赶快行动。
pinyin: Miànduì zhège jīhuì bù néng yóuyù, yào gǎnkuài xíngdòng.
english: When facing this opportunity, you can't hesitate to take advantage of it.

chinese: 电脑可以做极为复杂的工作。
pinyin: Diànnǎo kěyǐ zuò jíwéi fùzá de gōngzuò.
english: Computers are capable of doing extremely complicated work.

chinese: 那辆在树下的自行车是我的。
pinyin: Nà liàng zài shù xià de zìxíngchē shì wǒ de.
english: The bicycle under the tree is mine.

chinese: 一只鸟正在树上唱歌。
pinyin: Yī zhī niǎo zhèngzài shù shàng chànggē.
english: A bird is singing in the tree.

chinese: 那里以前有一棵高大的雪松树。
pinyin: Nàli yǐqián yǒu yī kē gāodà de xuěsōng shù.
english: There used to be a large cedar tree there.

chinese: 树投下长长的影子。
pinyin: Shù tóuxià chángchángde yǐngzi.
english: The tree cast a long shadow.

chinese: 第一批桃子已经从树上掉下来了。
pinyin: Dìyī pī táozi yǐjīng cóng shù shàng diàoxià lái le.
english: The first peaches were already falling from the tree.

chinese: 我校校长很老了。
pinyin: Wǒ xiào xiàozhǎng hěn lǎo le.
english: Our school's principal is very old.

chinese: 你这种想法有没有根据？
pinyin: Nǐ zhèzhǒng xiǎngfǎ yǒuméiyǒu gēnjù?
english: Do you have any grounds for thinking so?

chinese: 根据天气预报，雨季下周会开始。
pinyin: Gēnjù tiānqìyùbào, yǔjì xiàzhōu huì kāishǐ.
english: According to the weather forecast, the rainy season will set in next week.

chinese: 我想去医院做一个全面的检查。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù yīyuàn zuò yī gè quánmiàn de jiǎnchá.
english: I want to go to the hospital to get a complete check-up.

chinese: 你把购物单上的全都检查过了吗？
pinyin: Nǐ bǎ gòuwù dān shàng de quándōu jiǎnchá guo le ma?
english: Did you check all the items on the shopping list?

chinese: 我们听见了他下楼的声音。
pinyin: Wǒmen tīngjiàn le tā xià lóu de shēngyīn.
english: We heard him come downstairs.

chinese: 令人遗憾的是，他并没有在决赛发挥他的最佳水平。
pinyin: Lìngrén yíhàn de shì, tā bìng méiyǒu zài juésài fāhuī tā de zuì jiā shuǐpíng.
english: The regrettable thing is that he didn't even play at his highest level in the finals.

chinese: 我们公司的技术已经达到了发达国家九十年代的水平。
pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī de jìshù yǐjīng dádào le fādáguójiā jiǔshí niándài de shuǐpíng.
english: Our company's technology has already reached the level of a developed country in the 1990s.

chinese: 河对岸有很多的垃圾。
pinyin: Hé duì'àn yǒu hěn duō de lājī.
english: There's a lot of trash on the far bank of the river.

chinese: 他的车在掉进河里前翻转了好几次。
pinyin: Tā de chē zài diào jìn hé lǐ qián fānzhuǎn le hǎojǐ cì.
english: His car flipped over several times before it fell into the river.

chinese: 对于我们来说爱惜河川是很重要的。
pinyin: Duìyú wǒmen lái shuō àixī héchuān shì hěn zhòngyào de.
english: It is very important for us to love a river.

chinese: 我该怎么做才能让你更注意我？
pinyin: Wǒ gāi zěnme zuò cáinéng ràng nǐ gèng zhùyì wǒ?
english: What have I got to do so that you'll pay attention to me?

chinese: 尤其是要注意你吃的和喝的东西。
pinyin: Yóuqí shì yào zhùyì nǐ chī de hé hē de dōngxi.
english: You have to pay special attention to what you eat and drink.

chinese: 展览大大地吸引了公众的注意。
pinyin: Zhǎnlǎn dàdà de xīyǐn le gōngzhòng de zhùyì.
english: The exhibition has drawn much attention from the public.

chinese: 请问，洗手间在哪里？
pinyin: Qǐngwèn, xǐshǒujiān zài nǎlǐ?
english: Excuse me, where's the toilet?

chinese: 我想我没有把话说清楚。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng wǒ méiyǒu bǎ huàshuō qīngchu.
english: I guess I haven't made myself clear.

chinese: 那条新裙子让她很满意。
pinyin: Nà tiáo xīn qúnzi ràng tā hěn mǎnyì.
english: She was satisfied with the new dress.

chinese: 我们将要整理房间，这样妈妈就会满意了。
pinyin: Wǒmen jiāngyào zhěnglǐ fángjiān, zhèyàng māma jiù huì mǎnyì le.
english: We will tidy up our room so that Mom is satisfied.

chinese: 把灯打开。我什么都看不见了。
pinyin: Bǎ dēng dǎkāi. wǒ shénme dōu kànbujiàn le.
english: Switch on the light. I can't see anything.

chinese: 先洗个热水澡，然后上床睡觉。
pinyin: Xiān xǐ gè rèshuǐzǎo, ránhòu shàngchuáng shuìjiào.
english: A hot bath and then bed.

chinese: 我要给我自己买一个新照相机，这次要数码的。
pinyin: Wǒ yào gěi wǒ zìjǐ mǎi yī gè xīn zhàoxiàngjī, zhè cìyào shùmǎ de.
english: I'm going to buy myself a new camera, digital this time.

chinese: 你要做的只是照顾好你自己。
pinyin: Nǐ yào zuò de zhǐshì zhàogu hǎo nǐ zìjǐ.
english: All you have to do is to take care of yourself.

chinese: 因此，我们必须自己照顾自己。
pinyin: Yīncǐ, wǒmen bìxū zìjǐ zhàogu zìjǐ.
english: Hence, we have to take care of ourselves.

chinese: 她没有任何亲戚朋友照顾她。
pinyin: Tā méiyǒu rènhé qīnqi péngyou zhàogu tā.
english: She doesn't have any friends or relatives to take care of her.

chinese: 你是熊猫。
pinyin: Nǐ shì xióngmāo.
english: You are a panda.

chinese: 他的爱好是画有花的图。
pinyin: Tā de àihào shì huà yǒu huā de tú.
english: His hobby is painting pictures of flowers.

chinese: 我的爱好是游览古老的庙宇。
pinyin: Wǒ de àihào shì yóulǎn gǔlǎo de miàoyǔ.
english: My hobby is visiting old temples.

chinese: 我是一个特别的人吗？谢谢。;)
pinyin: Wǒ shì yī gè tèbié de rén ma? xièxie.;)
english: I'm a special person? Thanks. ;)

chinese: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。
pinyin: Wànyī chuányùn chí le, wǒmen yǒu tèbié de chídào bǎoxiǎn.
english: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.

chinese: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。
pinyin: Rúguǒ bìyào dehuà, wǒ bù fǎnduì fù tèbié fèiyòng.
english: I have no objection to paying a special fee if it is necessary.

chinese: 它们对环境一点都没有影响。
pinyin: Tāmen duì huánjìng yīdiǎn dōu méiyǒu yǐngxiǎng.
english: They have no impact on the environment.

chinese: 熟练的士兵知道怎么以他们的环境为武器。
pinyin: Shúliàn dīshì bīng zhīdào zěnme yǐ tāmen de huánjìng wèi wǔqì.
english: Skilled soldiers know how to use their environment as a weapon.

chinese: 上大学的时候，小王担任过班长。
pinyin: Shàng dàxué de shíhou, xiǎo Wáng dānrèn guo bānzhǎng.
english: Whilst at university, Xiaowang held the post of class monitor.

chinese: 那些葡萄看起来很甜，但其实是酸的。
pinyin: Nàxiē pútao kànqǐlai hěn tián, dàn qíshí shì suān de.
english: Those grapes look sweet, but in fact they're sour.

chinese: 蜂鸟会吸食某些花朵的甜美花蜜。
pinyin: Fēngniǎo huì xīshí mǒuxiē huāduǒ de tiánměi huāmì.
english: Hummingbirds drink the sweet nectar from certain flowers.

chinese: 他什么也没说，这让她很生气。
pinyin: Tā shénme yě méi shuō, zhè ràng tā hěn shēngqì.
english: He said nothing, which made her angry.

chinese: 问题是那天我们的车不能用。
pinyin: Wèntí shì nèitiān wǒmen de chē bù néng yòng.
english: The problem is we can't use our car on that day.

chinese: 我只想查一下我的电子邮件。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng chá yīxià wǒ de diànzǐyóujiàn.
english: I just wanted to check my email.

chinese: 没关系，送你到电梯口。
pinyin: Méiguānxi, sòng nǐ dào diàntī kǒu.
english: No worries, I will send you to the elevator.

chinese: 你可以给我画张画。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ gěi wǒ huà zhāng huà.
english: Maybe you could draw me a picture.

chinese: 用尺子画线。
pinyin: Yòng chǐzi huà xiàn.
english: Draw a line with a ruler.

chinese: 他们告诉我们他们头疼。
pinyin: Tāmen gàosu wǒmen tāmen tóuténg.
english: They told us that they had a headache.

chinese: 我的盘子在哪?
pinyin: Wǒ de pánzi zài nǎ?
english: Where is my plate?

chinese: 不要相信你听到的每件事。
pinyin: Bù yào xiāngxìn nǐ tīngdào de měi jiàn shì.
english: Don't believe everything you hear.

chinese: 我们有充分的理由相信这是真的。
pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu chōngfèn de lǐyóu xiāngxìn zhè shì zhēn de.
english: We have full reason to believe that it is true.

chinese: 除非他亲口对我说，否则我决不相信。
pinyin: Chúfēi tā qīnkǒu duì wǒ shuō, fǒuzé wǒ juébù xiāngxìn.
english: I will not believe it unless and until he tells me so.

chinese: 我相信良好的教育能改变人的社会地位。
pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn liánghǎo de jiàoyù néng gǎibiàn rén de shèhuì dìwèi.
english: I believe that a fine education can change one's social status.

chinese: 除非有可靠的证据，不然我们不应该相信任何事。
pinyin: Chúfēi yǒu kěkào de zhèngjù, bù rán wǒmen bù yīnggāi xiāngxìn rènhé shì.
english: Unless there is reliable evidence for it, we should not believe anything.

chinese: 我没带眼镜就什么都看不到。
pinyin: Wǒ méi dài yǎnjìng jiù shénme dōu kàn bù dào.
english: I can't see anything without my glasses.

chinese: 那条裙子是不是太短了？
pinyin: Nà tiáo qúnzi shì bù shì tài duǎn le?
english: Isn't that skirt too short?

chinese: 兔子长着长长的耳朵和短短的尾巴。
pinyin: Tùzi zhǎng zhe cháng cháng de ěrduo hé duǎn duǎn de wěiba.
english: A rabbit has long ears and a short tail.

chinese: 蝴蝶的寿命短。
pinyin: Húdié de shòumìng duǎn.
english: The life span of a butterfly is short.

chinese: 为了感谢您，这里有份礼物。
pinyin: Wèile gǎnxiè nín, zhèlǐ yǒufèn lǐwù.
english: To thank you, here is a gift.

chinese: 生命是一份礼物，你需要为此奋斗。
pinyin: Shēngmìng shì yī fèn lǐwù, nǐ xūyào wèicǐ fèndòu.
english: Life is a gift and you have to fight for it.

chinese: 祝你学习进步。
pinyin: Zhù nǐ xué xí jìn bù。
english: I wish you progress in your studies.

chinese: 我在这里有家人，离开时会很舍不得他们。
pinyin: Wǒ zài zhèlǐ yǒu jiārén, líkāi shí huì hěn shěbude tāmen.
english: I have family here that I'll be sad to leave behind.

chinese: 电脑是一种现代工具。
pinyin: Diànnǎo shì yīzhǒng xiàndài gōngjù.
english: A computer is a type of modern tool.

chinese: 胡同是一种跟中国北京有关的窄街路。
pinyin: Hútòng shì yīzhǒng gēn Zhōngguó Běijīng yǒuguān de zhǎi jiē lù.
english: Hutongs are a type of narrow street, most commonly associated with Beijing, China.

chinese: 我习惯在没有空调的房间里睡觉。
pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn zài méiyǒu kōngtiáo de fángjiān lǐ shuìjiào.
english: I'm accustomed to sleeping in a room without air conditioning.

chinese: 学校不给开空调，学生们就会从阳台上扔热水瓶抗议。
pinyin: Xuéxiào bù gěi kāi kōngtiáo, xuéshengmen jiù huì cóng yángtái shàng rēng rèshuǐpíng kàngyì.
english: The school won't turn on the air conditioning, so the students are going to throw their hot water flasks off of the balcony in protest.

chinese: 她声调突然变了。
pinyin: Tā shēngdiào tūrán biàn le.
english: There was a sudden change in her tone.

chinese: 我一站起来就觉得头晕。
pinyin: Wǒ yī zhànqǐlai jiù juéde tóuyūn.
english: I get dizzy spells when I stand up.

chinese: 不赶时间的人们站在自动扶梯的右边。
pinyin: Bù gǎn shíjiān de rénmen zhàn zài zìdòng fútī de yòubian.
english: People who are not in a hurry stand on the right side of the escalator.

chinese: 这么简单的东西三岁小孩也会。
pinyin: Zhème jiǎndān de dōngxi sān suì xiǎohái yě huì.
english: The smallest child knows such a simple thing.

chinese: 世界语语法很简单。
pinyin: Shìjièyǔ yǔfǎ hěn jiǎndān.
english: The grammar of Esperanto is very simple.

chinese: 一粒米都不要浪费!
pinyin: Yī lì mǐ dōu bù yào làngfèi!
english: Waste not a single grain of rice!

chinese: 要加点牛奶或者糖吗？
pinyin: Yào jiādiǎn niúnǎi huòzhě táng ma?
english: Any milk or sugar?

chinese: 你可以和我一起练习日语吗？
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ hé wǒ yīqǐ liànxí Rìyǔ ma?
english: Can you practice Japanese with me?

chinese: 我们终于登上了富士山山顶。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngyú dēngshàng le Fùshì Shān shāndǐng.
english: We gained the top of Mt. Fuji at last.

chinese: 我爸爸经常去美国出差。
pinyin: Wǒ bàba jīngcháng qù Měiguó chūchāi.
english: My father often goes to America on business.

chinese: 您这个年龄的人经常有这个问题。
pinyin: Nín zhège niánlíng de rén jīngcháng yǒu zhège wèntí.
english: People your age often have this problem.

chinese: 他们俩工作上联系多，经常打交道。
pinyin: Tāmen liǎ gōngzuò shàng liánxì duō, jīngcháng dǎjiāodào.
english: Those two communicate a lot with each other at work, often rubbing shoulders.

chinese: 她要求要见见经理。
pinyin: Tā yāoqiú yào jiàn jiàn jīnglǐ.
english: She demanded to see the manager.

chinese: 我刚从这里经过。
pinyin: Wǒ gāng cóng zhèlǐ jīngguò.
english: I only happened to pass here just now.

chinese: 日本女性平均在二十五岁结婚。
pinyin: Rìběn nǚxìng píngjūn zài èrshí wǔ suì jiéhūn.
english: Japanese women get married at 25 on average.

chinese: 如果她和你结婚了，她现在会很幸福。
pinyin: Rúguǒ tā hé nǐ jiéhūn le, tā xiànzài huì hěn xìngfú.
english: If she had married you, she would be happy now.

chinese: 我曾经希望我妈妈能活到我结婚的时候。
pinyin: Wǒ céngjīng xīwàng wǒ māma néng huó dào wǒ jiéhūn de shíhou.
english: I once hoped that my mother would survive until I got married.

chinese: 请给我看看这件绿色的衬衫。
pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ kànkan zhè jiàn lǜsè de chènshān.
english: Please show me the green shirt.

chinese: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？
pinyin: Nǐ néng gàosu wǒ hóngchá hé lǜchá de qūbié ma?
english: Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?

chinese: 无色的绿色的观念疯狂地睡觉。
pinyin: Wúsè de lǜsè de guānniàn fēngkuáng de shuìjiào.
english: Colorless green ideas sleep furiously.

chinese: 红色，相对于绿色，是危险的标志。
pinyin: Hóngsè, xiāngduì yú lǜsè, shì wēixiǎn de biāozhì.
english: Red, as opposed to green, is a sign of danger.

chinese: 我父亲很老了，耳朵也听不清楚了。
pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn hěn lǎo le, ěrduo yě tīng bù qīngchu le.
english: My father is so old that he is hard of hearing.

chinese: 我的父母告诉我, 必须尊重老年人。
pinyin: Wǒ de fùmǔ gàosu wǒ, bìxū zūnzhòng lǎoniánrén.
english: My parents told me that I need to respect old people.

chinese: “好人不长命”是句或真或假的老话。
pinyin: "hǎo rén bù cháng mìng " shì jù huò zhēn huò jiǎde lǎo huà.
english: "The good die young" is an old saying which may or may not be true.

chinese: 他把他的铅笔放在他的耳朵后面。
pinyin: Tā bǎ tā de qiānbǐ fàng zài tā de ěrduo hòumiàn.
english: He stuck his pencil behind his ear.

chinese: 没有聪明人喝了酒再开车。
pinyin: Méiyǒu cōngming rén hē le jiǔ zàikāi chē.
english: No intelligent person drinks and then drives.

chinese: 她家在一座山的山脚下。
pinyin: Tā jiā zài yī zuò shān de shānjiǎo xià.
english: Her house is at the foot of a mountain.

chinese: 她在从自行车上摔下来时伤到了脚。
pinyin: Tā zài cóng zìxíngchē shàng shuāi xiàlai shí shāng dào le jiǎo.
english: She hurt her foot when she fell off her bicycle.

chinese: 在他的脸上我看到了快乐的笑容。
pinyin: Zài tā de liǎn shàng wǒ kàn dào le kuàilè de xiàoróng.
english: I saw a joyful smile on his face.

chinese: 他擦去了脸上的汗水。
pinyin: Tā cā qù le liǎn shàng de hànshuǐ.
english: He wiped the sweat off his face.

chinese: 脸色这么差不要紧吗？要不还是去一趟医院比较好吧？
pinyin: Liǎnsè zhème chà bù yàojǐn ma? Yàobù háishi qù yī tàng yīyuàn bǐjiào hǎo ba?
english: Your face looks pale. Are you OK? Maybe it would be better if you went to the hospital, don't you think?

chinese: 走了很久，我的腿有点累。
pinyin: Zǒu le hěn jiǔ， wǒ de tuǐ yǒu diǎn lèi。
english: My legs are a little tired after walking for a long time.

chinese: 我不能让自己做这样的事。
pinyin: Wǒ bù néng ràng zìjǐ zuò zhèyàng de shì.
english: I cannot bring myself to do such a thing.

chinese: 这把椅子坐着很舒服。
pinyin: Zhè bǎ yǐ zi zuò zhe hěn shū fu。
english: This chair is very comfortable to sit on.

chinese: 你最喜欢的电视节目是什么？
pinyin: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan de diànshì jiémù shì shénme?
english: What is your favorite TV program?

chinese: 我叔叔在车站附近有一家花店。
pinyin: Wǒ shūshu zài chēzhàn fùjìn yǒu yījiā huādiàn.
english: My uncle has a flower shop near the station.

chinese: 这朵花是所有花中最漂亮的。
pinyin: Zhè duǒ huā shì suǒyǒu huā zhōng zuì piàoliang de.
english: This flower is the most beautiful of all flowers.

chinese: 她给花园里的花都起了名字。
pinyin: Tā gěi huāyuán lǐ de Huādū qǐ le míngzi.
english: She named all the flowers in the garden.

chinese: 她在她花园里种西红柿。
pinyin: Tā zài tā huāyuán lǐ zhòng xīhóngshì.
english: She grows tomatoes in her garden.

chinese: 孩子们正在花园里摘花。
pinyin: Háizimen zhèngzài huāyuán lǐ zhāi huā.
english: The kids are picking flowers in the garden.

chinese: 花园里有竹子在生长。
pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ yǒu zhúzi zài shēngzhǎng.
english: There's bamboo growing in the garden.

chinese: 这几种动物是吃草的。
pinyin: Zhè jǐ zhǒng dòngwù shì chī cǎo de.
english: These animals feed on grass.

chinese: 这不是葡萄酒，是葡萄汁。
pinyin: Zhè bù shì pútaojiǔ, shì pútaozhī.
english: That isn't wine. It's grape juice.

chinese: 他虽然不是歌手，但他唱的非常优美。
pinyin: Tā suīrán bú shì gēshǒu, dàn tā chàng de fēicháng yōuměi.
english: Although he is not a singer, he has beautiful voice.

chinese: 你能帮我拿这个行李箱吗？
pinyin: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ ná zhège xínglixiāng ma?
english: Will you please help me carry this suitcase?

chinese: 在那里，人们把熊猫训练得能表演许多节目。
pinyin: Zài nàli, rénmen bǎ xióngmāo xùnliàn de néng biǎoyǎn xǔduō jiémù.
english: There, pandas have been trained to perform dozens of items.

chinese: 他们表示喜欢那样做。
pinyin: Tāmen biǎoshì xǐhuan nàyàng zuò.
english: They say that they like to do that.

chinese: 妈妈买了一条新的裙子给我。
pinyin: Māma mǎi le yī tiáo xīn de qúnzi gěi wǒ.
english: My mom bought me a new skirt.

chinese: 我姑姑做了一条新裙子给我。
pinyin: Wǒ gūgu zuò le yī tiáo xīn qúnzi gěi wǒ.
english: My aunt made me a new skirt.

chinese: 他的要求如下。
pinyin: Tā de yāoqiú rúxià.
english: His request is as follows.

chinese: 很抱歉，我们不能接受你的要求。
pinyin: Hěn bàoqiàn, wǒmen bù néng jiēshòu nǐ de yāoqiú.
english: We are sorry we are unable to accept your request.

chinese: 那些人一见面就吵架。
pinyin: Nàxiē rén yī jiànmiàn jiù chǎojià.
english: Whenever they meet, they quarrel.

chinese: 这个问题不能以常规方法解决。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí bù néng yǐ chángguī fāngfǎ jiějué.
english: You cannot solve this problem with the usual method.

chinese: 我认为我有义务保护这些孩子。
pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi wǒ yǒu yìwù bǎohù zhèxiē háizi.
english: I believe it my duty to protect these children.

chinese: 我认为，你已经完全具备了潜伏的资质。
pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi, nǐ yǐjīng wánquán jùbèi le qiánfú de zīzhì.
english: I believe you already possess all the qualities needed to go undercover.

chinese: 用大智慧做股票，说明您对投资是认真的！
pinyin: Yòng dàzhìhuì zuò gǔpiào, shuōmíng nín duì tóuzī shì rènzhēn de!
english: Managing your stocks with Big Wisdom shows that you are serious about investing!

chinese: 你能大声点讲吗？我听不太清。
pinyin: Nǐ néng dàshēng diǎn jiǎng ma? wǒ tīng bù tài qīng.
english: Could you please talk a bit louder? I can't hear very well.

chinese: 昨晚我们听了总统在电视上的讲话。
pinyin: Zuówǎn wǒmen tīng le zǒngtǒng zài diànshì shàng de jiǎnghuà.
english: Yesterday evening we heard the President talk on television.

chinese: 请用这些词语造句。
pinyin: Qǐng yòng zhè xiē cí yǔ zào jù。
english: Please make sentences using these words and expressions.

chinese: 周末我在超市打工。
pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ zài chāoshì dǎgōng.
english: I work part-time at the supermarket on weekends.

chinese: 你看的书越多，你知道的越多。
pinyin: Nǐ kàn de shū yuè duō, nǐ zhīdào de yuè duō.
english: The more books you read, the more you'll know.

chinese: 到哪里我都会跟着你。
pinyin: Dào nǎlǐ wǒ dōu huì gēnzhe nǐ.
english: I'll follow you anywhere.

chinese: 你更喜欢哪个，这个还是那个？
pinyin: Nǐ gèng xǐhuan něige, zhège háishi nèige?
english: Which do you like better, this or that?

chinese: 这个世界还有救，还是为时已晚？
pinyin: Zhège shìjiè háiyǒu jiù, háishi wéishíyǐwǎn?
english: Can we still save the world, or is it too late?

chinese: 虽然他对我反复解释这首诗的意思，我还是不懂。
pinyin: Suīrán tā duì wǒ fǎnfù jiěshì zhè shǒu shī de yìsi, wǒ háishi bù dǒng.
english: Even though he explained to me over and over again the meaning of this poem, I still don't get it.

chinese: 在某种程度上你是对的，但我还是有疑问。
pinyin: Zài mǒu zhǒng chéngdù shàng nǐ shì duì de, dàn wǒ háishi yǒu yíwèn.
english: In a way you are right, but I still have doubts.

chinese: 快点，不然你吃午饭就要迟到了。
pinyin: Kuàidiǎn, bù rán nǐ chī wǔfàn jiùyào chídào le.
english: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late for lunch.

chinese: 咱们现在走吧。要不咱们要迟到了。
pinyin: Zánmen xiànzài zǒu ba. Yàobù zánmen yào chídào le.
english: Let's go now. Otherwise, we'll be late.

chinese: 我请我的邻居来吃早饭。
pinyin: Wǒ qǐng wǒ de línjū lái chī zǎofàn.
english: I invited my neighbor to breakfast.

chinese: 他指出了遵守法律的重要性。
pinyin: Tā zhǐchū le zūnshǒu fǎlǜ de zhòngyàoxìng.
english: He pointed out how important it is to observe the law.

chinese: 没有什么东西比友谊更重要。
pinyin: Méiyǒu shénme dōngxi bǐ yǒuyì gèng zhòngyào.
english: There's nothing more important than friendship.

chinese: 早饭是一天中最重要的一顿饭。
pinyin: Zǎofàn shì yī tiān zhōng zuì zhòngyào de yī dùn fàn.
english: Breakfast is the most important meal of the day.

chinese: 我身负一个重要的任务。
pinyin: Wǒ shēn fù yī gè zhòngyào de rènwu.
english: I am charged with an important mission.

chinese: 我能用一下你的铅笔吗？
pinyin: Wǒ néng yòng yīxià nǐ de qiānbǐ ma?
english: Can I borrow your pencil for a bit?

chinese: 她用铅笔在纸上画了一个圈。
pinyin: Tā yòng qiānbǐ zài zhǐ shàng huà le yī gè quān.
english: She drew a circle on a piece of paper with a pencil.

chinese: 从地上捡起这支铅笔。
pinyin: Cóng dìshang jiǎn qǐ zhè zhī qiānbǐ.
english: Pick up the pencil from the floor.

chinese: 你知道银行什么时候关门吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào yínháng shénmeshíhou guānmén ma?
english: Do you have any idea when the bank closes?

chinese: 他是个国际银行的翻译。
pinyin: Tā shì gè guójì yínháng de fānyì.
english: He's an interpreter in an international bank.

chinese: 他从银行得到了贷款。
pinyin: Tā cóng yínháng dédào le dàikuǎn.
english: He got a loan from the bank.

chinese: 我的银行账户里没留下钱。
pinyin: Wǒ de yínháng zhànghù lǐ méi liúxià qián.
english: There's no money left in my bank account.

chinese: 这本书对你来说读起来太难了。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū duì nǐ lái shuō dú qǐlai tài nán le.
english: This book is too difficult for you to read.

chinese: 要找人代替像他这么有资历的员工很难。
pinyin: Yào zhǎo rén dàitì xiàng tā zhème yǒu zīlì de yuángōng hěn nán.
english: It is difficult to replace an employee that is as qualified as he is.

chinese: 一整个月没看到他们让我感觉很难过。
pinyin: Yī zhěnggè yuè méi kàn dào tāmen ràng wǒ gǎnjué hěn nánguò.
english: Not seeing them for a whole month makes me sad.

chinese: 牛提供给我们很多需要的东西。
pinyin: Niú tígōng gěi wǒmen hěn duō xūyào de dōngxi.
english: Cows supply us with many things we need.

chinese: 不，谢谢。我不需要塑料袋。
pinyin: Bù, xièxie. wǒ bù xūyào sùliàodài.
english: No thank you, I don't need a plastic bag.

chinese: 面包是用小麦做成的。
pinyin: Miànbāo shì yòng xiǎomài zuò chéng de.
english: Bread is made from wheat.

chinese: 穿上你的鞋，我们出去吃晚饭。
pinyin: Chuānshang nǐ de xié, wǒmen chūqù chī wǎnfàn.
english: Put on your shoes. Let's go out for dinner.

chinese: 我来这个国家的目的是学习音乐。
pinyin: Wǒ lái zhège guójiā de mùdì shì xuéxí yīnyuè.
english: I came to this country for the purpose of studying music.

chinese: 我妹妹喜欢古典音乐的程度不亚于我。
pinyin: Wǒ mèimei xǐhuan gǔdiǎnyīnyuè de chéngdù bùyàyú wǒ.
english: My sister likes classical music no less than I do.

chinese: 他等火车的时候，一会儿听音乐，一会儿发短信。
pinyin: Tā děng huǒchē de shíhou, yīhuìr tīng yīnyuè, yīhuìr fāduǎnxìn.
english: While he was waiting for the train, he listened to music and sent text messages.

chinese: 我回到家的时候肚子十分饿。
pinyin: Wǒ huídào jiāde shíhou dùzi shífēn è.
english: When I got home, I was very hungry.

chinese: 他刚刚才吃完午饭，不可能会肚子饿。
pinyin: Tā gānggang cái chīwán wǔfàn, bù kěnéng huì dùzi è.
english: He cannot be hungry; he has just had lunch.

chinese: 我从没给我的狗喂过香蕉。
pinyin: Wǒ cóngméi gěi wǒ de gǒu wèi guo xiāngjiāo.
english: I have never fed my dog a banana.

chinese: 除此之外，马还是人才的代名词。
pinyin: Chúcǐzhīwài, mǎ háishi réncái de dàimíngcí.
english: As well as this, the horse is also representative of human talent.

chinese: 我发现了一只翅膀受了重伤的鸟儿。
pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn le yī zhī chìbǎng shòu le zhòngshāng de niǎor.
english: I found a bird whose wing was severely damaged.

chinese: 如果相信，一切皆有可能。
pinyin: Rúguǒ xiāngxìn, yīqiè jiē yǒu kěnéng.
english: All things are possible if you believe.

chinese: 你不妨告诉我一切。
pinyin: Nǐ bù fáng gàosu wǒ yīqiè.
english: You may as well tell me all about it.

chinese: 想像力是一切文明的根源。
pinyin: Xiǎngxiànglì shì yīqiè wénmíng de gēnyuán.
english: Imagination is the root of all civilization.

chinese: 你必须尽一切可能尽力而为, 免得你以后后悔。
pinyin: Nǐ bìxū jìn yīqiè kěnéng jìnlì'érwéi, miǎnde nǐ yǐhòu hòuhuǐ.
english: You must do all you can lest you should regret later.

chinese: 他不仅给了我们衣服，还有一点钱。
pinyin: Tā bùjǐn gěi le wǒmen yīfu, hái yǒu yīdiǎn qián.
english: He gave us not only clothes but some money.

chinese: 我们不仅需要充足的水，还需要干净的水。
pinyin: Wǒmen bù jǐn xūyào chōngzú de shuǐ, hái xūyào gānjìng de shuǐ.
english: We need not only adequate water but clean water.

chinese: 有时候，我不得不读一些无聊的小说。
pinyin: Yǒushíhou, wǒ bùdébù dú yīxiē wúliáo de xiǎoshuō.
english: Sometimes I have to read boring novels.

chinese: 你不得不制造一些借口。
pinyin: Nǐ bùdébù zhìzào yīxiē jièkǒu.
english: You'll have to manufacture some kind of excuse.

chinese: 我们不得不把游戏搁到下周日了。
pinyin: Wǒmen bùdébù bǎ yóuxì gē dào xià Zhōurì le.
english: We have to put off the game till next Sunday.

chinese: 不管我做什么，她都说我能做得更好。
pinyin: Bù guǎn wǒ zuò shénme, tā dōu shuō wǒ néng zuò de gèng hǎo.
english: No matter what I do, she says I can do better.

chinese: 不管风吹浪打，胜似闲庭信步。
pinyin: Bù guǎn fēng chuī làng dǎ, shèngsì xián tíng xìnbù.
english: No matter how fierce the winds blow or the waves crash, it feels as effortless as strolling leisurely in a quiet courtyard.

chinese: 不管你去哪里，天空都是同样的颜色。
pinyin: Bù guǎn nǐ qù nǎlǐ, tiānkōng dōu shì tóngyàng de yánsè.
english: No matter where you go, the sky will always be the same color.

chinese: 因为他有忧郁症，所以不管你说什么他都会被无罪释放。
pinyin: Yīnwèi tā yǒu yōuyùzhèng, suǒyǐ bù guǎn nǐ shuō shénme tā dōu huì bèi wúzuì shìfàng.
english: It doesn’t matter what you say, he’ll be acquitted because of depression.

chinese: 当然会的，不过上海话不太会讲。
pinyin: Dāngrán huì de, bùguò Shànghǎihuà bù tài huì jiǎng.
english: Sure I can, although I can't really speak Shanghainese.

chinese: 我在电视上看到过他，不过没有看到过他本人。
pinyin: Wǒ zài diànshì shàng kàn dào guo tā, bùguò méiyǒu kàn dào guo tā běnrén.
english: I have seen him on TV but not in the flesh.

chinese: 我企图与她保持友好的关系，不过那是不可能的。
pinyin: Wǒ qǐtú yǔ tā bǎochí yǒuhǎo de guānxi, bùguò nàshi bù kěnéng de.
english: I tried to stay on friendly terms with her, but it was impossible.

chinese: 我会把我的地址与电话号码写下来。
pinyin: Wǒ huì bǎ wǒ de dìzhǐ yǔ diànhuà hàomǎ xiěxià lái.
english: I'll write down my address and phone number.

chinese: 我的儿子想成为一个专业高尔夫球手。
pinyin: Wǒ de érzi xiǎng chéngwéi yī gè zhuānyè gāo'ěrfūqiú shǒu.
english: My son wants to become a professional golf player.

chinese: 这是一家专门为学生提供服务的商店。
pinyin: Zhè shì yījiā zhuānmén wèi xuésheng tígōng fúwù de shāngdiàn.
english: This is a store that caters specially to students.

chinese: 二十一世纪是在二零零一年开始的。
pinyin: Èrshíyīshìjì shì zài èr líng líng yī nián kāishǐ de.
english: The twenty-first century begins in 2001.

chinese: 在二十世纪末期，南斯拉夫被美国认为是一个流氓国家。
pinyin: Zài èrshíshìjì mòqī, Nánsīlāfū bèi Měiguó rènwéi shì yī gè liúmángguójiā.
english: In the late 20th century, Yugoslavia was considered a rogue state by the United States.

chinese: 众所周知，直到上个世纪中叶日本是一个封建国家。
pinyin: Zhòngsuǒzhōuzhī, zhídào shàngge shìjì zhōngyè Rìběn shì yī gè fēngjiàn guójiā.
english: It is well known that up to the middle of the last century Japan was a feudal state.

chinese: 我把钥匙丢了。
pinyin: Wǒ bǎ yào shi diū le。
english: I lost my key.

chinese: 不要太严格，他们只是小孩。
pinyin: Bù yào tài yángé, tāmen zhǐshì xiǎohái.
english: Don't be too strict. They're just kids.

chinese: 你受过的最严重的伤是什么？
pinyin: Nǐ shòu guo de zuì yánzhòng de shāng shì shénme?
english: What's the worst injury you've ever had?

chinese: 我看见你和一个高个子男孩在一起。
pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn nǐ hé yī gè gāogèzi nánhái zàiyīqǐ.
english: I saw you with a tall boy.

chinese: 中文并不是世界上最难的语言。
pinyin: Zhōngwén bìngbúshì shìjiè shàng zuì nán de yǔyán.
english: Chinese is not the hardest language in the world.

chinese: 我很希望可以说一口地道的中文。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn xīwàng kěyǐ shuō yīkǒu dìdào de Zhōngwén.
english: I really hope that I can speak authentic Chinese.

chinese: 你中文真好，都能引用俗语了。
pinyin: Nǐ Zhōngwén zhēn hǎo, dōu néng yǐnyòng súyǔ le.
english: Your Chinese is so good, you can quote proverbs.

chinese: 他主动帮他妈妈做家务。
pinyin: Tā zhǔdòng bāng tā māma zuò jiāwù.
english: He takes the initiative in helping his mother do the housework.

chinese: 无论他说什么，我也不会改变主意。
pinyin: Wúlùn tā shuō shénme, wǒ yě bù huì gǎibiàn zhǔyi.
english: Whatever he may say, I won't change my mind.

chinese: 下一场音乐会将在六月份举办。
pinyin: Xià yī chǎng yīnyuèhuì jiāng zài liùyuèfèn jǔbàn.
english: The next concert will take place in June.

chinese: 学习是成功之路。
pinyin: Xué xí shì chéng gōng zhī lù。
english: Study is a path to success.

chinese: 我们周末一起打乒乓球。
pinyin: Wǒ men zhōu mò yī qǐ dǎ pīng pāng qiú。
english: We play table tennis together on weekends.

chinese: 我喜欢乘坐火车。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chéngzuò huǒchē.
english: I like to ride on trains.

chinese: 是警察，也许我们应该让道。
pinyin: Shì jǐngchá, yěxǔ wǒmen yīnggāi ràng dào.
english: It's the police, perhaps we should get out of their way.

chinese: 你可以看，可以听，但手脚不要乱动。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ kàn, kěyǐ tīng, dàn shǒujiǎo bù yào luàndòng.
english: Hear and see and be still.

chinese: 天开始下雨，于是我们回家了。
pinyin: Tiān kāi shǐ xià yǔ， yú shì wǒ men huí jiā le。
english: It started raining, so we went home.

chinese: 任何工作你都可以放心的交给他。
pinyin: Rènhé gōngzuò nǐ dōu kěyǐ fàngxīn de jiāo gěi tā.
english: You can trust him with any job.

chinese: 语言是人们与他人交流的手段。
pinyin: Yǔyán shì rénmen yǔ tārén jiāoliú de shǒuduàn.
english: Language is the means by which people communicate with others.

chinese: 凡是大城市都有交通堵塞的问题。
pinyin: Fánshì dàchéngshì dōu yǒu jiāotōngdǔsè de wèntí.
english: All big cities have traffic problems.

chinese: 我们黎明时起床以避开交通堵塞。
pinyin: Wǒmen límíng shí qǐchuáng yǐ bìkāi jiāotōngdǔsè.
english: We got up at dawn to avoid a traffic jam.

chinese: 这次交通事故中只有一个小男孩幸存了下来。
pinyin: Zhè cì jiāotōng shìgù zhōng zhǐ yǒu yī gè xiǎo nánhái xìngcún le xiàlai.
english: Only one little boy survived the traffic accident.

chinese: 当你穿越交通繁忙的街道时要小心注意。
pinyin: Dāng nǐ chuānyuè jiāotōng fánmáng de jiēdào shí yào xiǎoxīn zhùyì.
english: Be careful when you pass through the street's busy traffic.

chinese: 她每周都练习京剧。
pinyin: Tā měi zhōu dōu liàn xí jīng jù。
english: She practices Beijing Opera every week.

chinese: 我喜欢明亮的颜色。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan míngliàng de yánsè.
english: I like bright colors.

chinese: 广场被鲜明的灯火照亮。
pinyin: Guǎngchǎng bèi xiānmíng de dēnghuǒ zhàoliàng.
english: The square was illuminated by bright lights.

chinese: 请问，我要用美元换人民币，这儿可以换给我人民币吗？
pinyin: Qǐngwèn, wǒ yào yòng Měiyuán huànrén mín bì, zhèr kěyǐ huàn gěi wǒrén mín bì ma?
english: Excuse me, I'd like to exchange US dollars for RMB - can I get RMB here?

chinese: 四亿人以英语作为他们的第一语言。
pinyin: Sì yì rén yǐ Yīngyǔ zuòwéi tāmen de dìyī yǔyán.
english: Four hundred million people speak English as their first language.

chinese: 即使我穿得很多仍然是很冷。
pinyin: Jíshǐ wǒ chuān dehěn duō réngrán shì hěn lěng.
english: Even though I'm wearing a lot of clothing, it is still cold.

chinese: 他的大脑仍然很活跃。
pinyin: Tā de dànǎo réngrán hěn huóyuè.
english: His brain is still very active.

chinese: 地面仍然很湿滑，看来比赛要被取消了。
pinyin: Dìmiàn réngrán hěn shī huá, kànlai bǐsài yào bèi qǔxiāo le.
english: The ground is still wet. As likely as not, the game will be cancelled.

chinese: 苹果在发售日期和价格上口风仍然很紧。
pinyin: Píngguǒ zài fāshòu rìqī hé jiàgé shàngkǒu fēng réngrán hěn jǐn.
english: Apple is still very secretive with regard to the release date and the price.

chinese: 虽然她节食, 巧克力蛋糕仍然诱惑着她。
pinyin: Suīrán tā jiéshí, qiǎokèlì dàngāo réngrán yòuhuò zhe tā.
english: Even though she is dieting, the chocolate cake still tempts her.

chinese: 我一直想认识她，但从来不敢。
pinyin: Wǒ yīzhí xiǎng rènshi tā, dàn cóngláibù gǎn.
english: I've always wanted to meet her, but I've never dared.

chinese: 我仔细地考虑了这个问题。
pinyin: Wǒ zǐxì de kǎolǜ le zhège wèntí.
english: I gave careful consideration to the problem.

chinese: 据说葡萄酒的价格可以随时增长。
pinyin: Jùshuō pútaojiǔ de jiàgé kěyǐ suíshí zēngzhǎng.
english: It is said that the price of wine may go up at any time now.

chinese: 大量生产降低许多商品的价格。
pinyin: Dàliàng shēngchǎn jiàngdī xǔduō shāngpǐn de jiàgé.
english: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.

chinese: 我觉得一部电影比任何书都有趣。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde yī bù diànyǐng bǐ rènhé shū dōu yǒuqù.
english: I think a movie is more entertaining than any book.

chinese: 这个玻璃杯里没有任何的牛奶。
pinyin: Zhège bōlibēi lǐ méiyǒu rènhé de niúnǎi.
english: There isn't any milk in the glass.

chinese: 不要问她任何有关婚姻的问题。
pinyin: Bù yào wèn tā rènhé yǒuguān hūnyīn de wèntí.
english: Don't ask her any questions about her marriage.

chinese: 美国的任务是将共产主义从世界上消除。
pinyin: Měiguó de rènwu shì jiāng gòngchǎnzhǔyì cóng shìjièshàng xiāochú.
english: The American mission is to eliminate communism from the world.

chinese: 你做你的部份, 其他的我来做。
pinyin: Nǐ zuò nǐ de bù fèn, qítā de wǒ lái zuò.
english: You do your part and I'll do the rest.

chinese: 你们的优点和缺点是什么？
pinyin: Nǐmen de yōudiǎn hé quēdiǎn shì shénme?
english: What are your strengths and weaknesses?

chinese: 我前几天收到了你的传真。
pinyin: Wǒ qiánjǐtiān shōudào le nǐ de chuánzhēn.
english: I got your fax the other day.

chinese: 我伤心的时候，我的朋友会鼓励我。
pinyin: Wǒ shāngxīn de shíhou, wǒ de péngyou huì gǔlì wǒ.
english: When I'm sad, my friends encourage me.

chinese: 我不理解作者在这儿有什么用意。
pinyin: Wǒ bù lǐjiě zuòzhě zài zhèr yǒu shénme yòngyì.
english: I don't understand what the author means here.

chinese: 我对这位作者的名字很熟悉。
pinyin: Wǒ duì zhèwèi zuòzhě de míngzi hěn shúxī.
english: I am familiar with the author's name.

chinese: 欧几里得是第一本数学著作的作者。
pinyin: Ōujǐlǐdé shì dìyī běn shùxué zhùzuò de zuòzhě.
english: Euclid was the author of the first book on mathematics.

chinese: 在句子中不要写入额外信息，比如作者姓名。
pinyin: Zài jùzi zhōng bù yào xiěrù éwài xìnxī, bǐrú zuòzhě xìngmíng.
english: Don't write extra information, such as the name of the author, within the sentence.

chinese: 例如，这是一支笔。
pinyin: Lìrú, zhè shì yī zhī bǐ.
english: For example, this is a pen.

chinese: 爱国者的责任就是保护国家不受政府侵犯。
pinyin: Àiguózhě de zérèn jiùshì bǎohùguó jiā bù shòu zhèngfǔ qīnfàn.
english: It is the duty of every patriot to protect his country from its government.

chinese: 大多数动物都有保护幼仔的本能。
pinyin: Dàduōshù dòngwù dōu yǒu bǎohù yòu zǎi de běnnéng.
english: Most animals have an instinct to protect their young.

chinese: 他们保证这个时钟可用一年。
pinyin: Tāmen bǎozhèng zhège shízhōng kě yòng yī nián.
english: They guarantee this clock for a year.

chinese: 真正的友谊建立在彼此信任的基础上。
pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de yǒuyì jiànlì zài bǐcǐ xìnrèn de jīchǔ shàng.
english: True friendship is based on mutual trust.

chinese: 他对自己没有多少信心。
pinyin: Tā duì zìjǐ méiyǒu duōshao xìnxīn.
english: He has little confidence in himself.

chinese: 这台公共电话可以刷信用卡吗 ？
pinyin: Zhè tái gōnggòng diànhuà kěyǐ shuā xìnyòngkǎ ma?
english: Can I make a credit card call on this public phone?

chinese: 我们俩是很好的朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ men liǎ shì hěn hǎo de péng you。
english: The two of us are good friends.

chinese: 他正在修自行车。
pinyin: Tā zhèng zài xiū zì xíng chē。
english: He is repairing a bicycle.

chinese: 我现在的收入比两年前多了一倍。
pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài de shōurù bǐ liǎng niánqián duō le yī bèi.
english: Now my income is twice what it was two years ago.

chinese: 不管他是上学还是做生意，我不会反对。
pinyin: Bù guǎn tā shì shàngxué háishi zuòshēngyì, wǒ bù huì fǎnduì.
english: Whether he studies or goes into business, I won't stop him.

chinese: 如果地球停止自传，你认为会发生什么？
pinyin: Rúguǒ dìqiú tíngzhǐ zìzhuàn, nǐ rènwéi huì fāshēng shénme?
english: Were the earth to stop revolving, what do you suppose would happen?

chinese: 停止射击。
pinyin: Tíngzhǐ shèjī.
english: Stop shooting.

chinese: 他没有看见十字路口的停止标志，和一辆迎面而来的汽车撞个正着。
pinyin: Tā méiyǒu kànjiàn shízìlùkǒu de tíngzhǐ biāozhì, hé yī liàng yíngmiàn'érlái de qìchē zhuàng gè zhèngzháo.
english: He failed to see the stop sign at the intersection and hit an oncoming car.

chinese: 我偶尔会打高尔夫球。
pinyin: Wǒ ǒu'ěr huì dǎgāo'ěrfūqiú.
english: Occasionally I play golf.

chinese: 很久以后我才明白到教育儿童有多重要。
pinyin: Hěn jiǔ yǐhòu wǒ cái míngbai dào jiàoyù értóng yǒu duōchóng yào.
english: It was only much later that I came to understand the importance of child education.

chinese: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi jìnzhǐ zhēnduì értóng de guǎnggào.
english: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.

chinese: 比起父母，儿童更喜欢模仿自己的同龄人。
pinyin: Bǐqǐ fùmǔ, értóng gèng xǐhuan mófǎng zìjǐ de tónglíngrén.
english: Children imitate their peers rather than their parents.

chinese: 这家出版社专门出版儿童文学。
pinyin: Zhè jiā chūbǎnshè zhuānmén chūbǎn értóng wénxué.
english: This publisher specializes in children's literature.

chinese: 我们会把一部分筹得的款项用来帮助残疾儿童。
pinyin: Wǒmen huì bǎ yībùfen chóu de díkuǎn xiàng yònglái bāngzhù cánjí'ér tóng.
english: A portion of the proceeds will go to benefit children with disabilities.

chinese: 我做的每件事都要通过他的允许。
pinyin: Wǒ zuò de měijiànshì dōu yào tōngguò tā de yǔnxǔ.
english: Everything I do requires his permission.

chinese: 星体和星体之间的距离是用光年来量度的。
pinyin: Xīngtǐ hé xīngtǐ zhījiān de jùlí shì yòngguāng niánlái liángdù de.
english: The distance between stars is measured in light years.

chinese: 亲切的灯光让他的身上充满了温暖的感觉。
pinyin: Qīnqiè de dēngguāng ràng tā de shēnshang chōngmǎn le wēnnuǎn de gǎnjué.
english: He was bathed in the warmth of the kind light.

chinese: 她乘着光之翼飞走了。
pinyin: Tā chéng zhe guāng zhī yì fēi zǒu le.
english: She flew away on wings of light.

chinese: 停车场是免费的。
pinyin: Tíngchēchǎng shì miǎnfèi de.
english: The parking lot is free of charge.

chinese: 学校离我家有五公里远。
pinyin: Xuéxiào lí wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ gōnglǐ yuǎn.
english: The school is five kilometers from my home.

chinese: 今天下午我们要共同度过美好的时光了。
pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒmen yào gòngtóng dùguò měihǎo de shíguāng le.
english: We are going to have a great time together this afternoon.

chinese: 这是一个关键点。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè guānjiàn diǎn.
english: This is a crucial point.

chinese: 我兴奋得吃不下任何东西。
pinyin: Wǒ xīngfèn de chībuxià rènhé dōngxi.
english: I'm too excited to eat anything.

chinese: 首先，我一点钱也没有。其次，我也没有时间。
pinyin: Shǒuxiān, wǒ yīdiǎn qián yě méiyǒu. qícì, wǒ yě méiyǒu shíjiān.
english: First, I don't have any money. Second, I don't have the time.

chinese: 烤箱内如有液体洒出，应立即清理，以免留下顽固污渍。
pinyin: Kǎoxiāng nèi rú yǒu yètǐ sǎ chū, yīng lìjí qīnglǐ, yǐmiǎn liúxià wángù wūzì.
english: Clean up spills inside the oven as soon as they happen to avoid stubborn stains.

chinese: 用自己的语言把课文内容复述。
pinyin: Yòng zìjǐ de yǔyán bǎ kèwén nèiróng fùshù.
english: Use your own words to retell the content of the lesson.

chinese: 农村好像要大规模发展了。
pinyin: Nóngcūn hǎoxiàng yào dàguīmó fāzhǎn le.
english: It seems the rural area will be developed on a large scale.

chinese: 当事情发生在自己身上时，就无法客观冷静地处理。
pinyin: Dāng shìqing fāshēng zài zìjǐ shēnshang shí, jiù wúfǎ kèguān lěngjìng di chǔlǐ.
english: It's hard to stay objective and calm when it happens to you.

chinese: 一个时钟最重要的是准确。
pinyin: Yī gè shízhōng zuì zhòngyào de shì zhǔnquè.
english: Most important of all a clock has to be accurate.

chinese: 今天很凉快。
pinyin: Jīntiān hěn liángkuai.
english: It's cool today.

chinese: 节约能源可减少温室气体排出到大气层。
pinyin: Jiéyuē néngyuán kě jiǎnshǎo wēnshì qìtǐ páichū dào dàqìcéng.
english: Saving energy can reduce the emission of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.

chinese: 我在一九七二年十月十日出生。
pinyin: Wǒ zài yī jiǔ qī èr nián shí yuè shí rì chūshēng.
english: I was born on October 10, 1972.

chinese: 他出生在一个宫殿里，那宫殿已经不存在了。
pinyin: Tā chūshēng zài yī gè gōngdiàn lǐ, nà gōngdiàn yǐjīng bù cúnzài le.
english: He was born in a palace that isn't there any more.

chinese: 他用哥哥送给他的刀子切开了。
pinyin: Tāyòng gēge sònggěi tā de dāozi qiē kāi le.
english: He cut it with the knife that he received as a present from his brother.

chinese: 汤姆小心翼翼地把刀子上的指纹擦掉。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ xiǎoxīnyìyì de bǎ dāozi shàng de zhǐwén cādiào.
english: Tom carefully wiped his fingerprints off the knife.

chinese: 这把菜刀不够锋利，所以我用了我的折叠刀来切肉。
pinyin: Zhè bǎ càidāo bù gòu fēnglì, suǒyǐ wǒ yòng le wǒ de zhédiédāo lái qiē ròu.
english: The kitchen knife wasn't sharp enough to cut the meat, so I used my pocket knife.

chinese: 有五分之四的会员反对这个计划。
pinyin: Yǒu wǔ fēnzhī sì de huìyuán fǎnduì zhège jìhuà.
english: Four-fifths of all the members were against the plan.

chinese: 她刚刚买了两本娱乐杂志。
pinyin: Tā gānggang mǎi le liǎng běn yúlè zázhì.
english: She just bought two entertainment magazines.

chinese: 雅尼刚刚对他的挤奶桶进行了消毒。
pinyin: Yǎ ní gānggang duì tā de jǐnǎi tǒng jìnxíng le xiāodú.
english: Yanni has just sterilized his milking bucket.

chinese: 我们刚刚收到情报，敌方正在前方两英里处埋伏。
pinyin: Wǒmen gānggang shōudào qíngbào, dífāng zhèngzài qiánfāng liǎng Yīnglǐ chǔ máifú.
english: We've just received intelligence that the enemy is waiting in ambush two miles down the road.

chinese: 你应该自己判断什么时候喝了太多酒。
pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi zìjǐ pànduàn shénmeshíhou hē le tài duō jiǔ.
english: You should be able to judge when you've had too much to drink.

chinese: 不能根据服装来判断一个人。
pinyin: Bù néng gēnjù fúzhuāng lái pànduàn yī gè rén.
english: You can't judge a person based on clothing.

chinese: 你到底有没有听我说的话？
pinyin: Nǐ dàodǐ yǒuméiyǒu tīng wǒ shuō dehuà?
english: Did you listen at all to what I said?

chinese: 他剩下的时间已经不多了。
pinyin: Tā shèngxià de shíjiān yǐjīng bù duō le.
english: He doesn't have long to live.

chinese: 我星期天常常到丈人丈母家去帮他们干点力气活。
pinyin: Wǒ Xīngqītiān chángcháng dào zhàngrén zhàngmǔ jiā qù bāng tāmen gàn diǎn lìqi huó.
english: I often go to my mother-in-law and father-in-law's house on Sundays to help them do physical work.

chinese: 我们在下个加油站停一下。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài xià gè jiāyóuzhàn tíng yīxià.
english: Let's stop at the next gas station.

chinese: 恐怕你要加班了。
pinyin: Kǒngpà nǐ yào jiābān le.
english: I'm afraid you have to work overtime.

chinese: 公司为了削减成本，拒绝让员工自行加班。
pinyin: Gōngsī wèile xuējiǎn chéngběn, jùjué ràng yuángōng zìxíng jiābān.
english: In order to cut down on costs, the company refuses to allow employees to work overtime.

chinese: 这舞者的每一个动作都是完美的。
pinyin: Zhè wǔzhě de měi yī gè dòngzuò dōu shì wánměi de.
english: Each movement of the dancer was perfect.

chinese: 我们知道他是个勇敢的人。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhīdào tā shì gè yǒnggǎn de rén.
english: We know him to be a brave man.

chinese: 费用包括午饭和饮料。
pinyin: Fèi yòng bāo kuò wǔ fàn hé yǐn liào。
english: The price includes lunch and a drink.

chinese: 当我忘记约定时，他十分愤怒。
pinyin: Dāng wǒ wàngjì yuēdìng shí, tā shífēn fènnù.
english: He was very angry with me when I forgot the appointment.

chinese: 这里的气候和英国十分相似。
pinyin: Zhèlǐ de qìhòu hé Yīngguó shífēn xiāngsì.
english: The climate here is very similar to that of England.

chinese: 你千万不要和你父母说这件事。
pinyin: Nǐ qiānwàn bù yào hé nǐ fùmǔ shuō zhè jiàn shì.
english: You mustn't tell that to your parents.

chinese: 如果你彩票中一千万美金的话，你会用那点钱干什么？
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ cǎipiào zhòng yī qiān wàn Měijīn dehuà, nǐ huì yòng nà diǎn qián gàn shénme?
english: If you won ten million dollars in a lottery, what would you do with that money?

chinese: 她正在读博士。
pinyin: Tā zhèng zài dú bó shì。
english: She is studying for a doctorate.

chinese: 中国让人印象最深的就是中国菜.
pinyin: Zhōngguó ràng rén yìnxiàng zuì shēn de jiùshì Zhōngguó cài.
english: The thing that left the biggest impression on me in China was the Chinese food.

chinese: 你说的话给我留下了很深刻的印象。
pinyin: Nǐ shuō dehuà gěi wǒ liúxià le hěn shēnkè de yìnxiàng.
english: What you said left a deep impression on me.

chinese: 不管我们选哪条路，都会有危险。
pinyin: Bù guǎn wǒmen xuǎn nǎ tiáo lù, dōu huì yǒu wēixiǎn.
english: Whichever way we choose will involve danger.

chinese: 即使我知道答案，我也不会告诉你。
pinyin: Jíshǐ wǒ zhīdào dá'àn, wǒ yě bù huì gàosu nǐ.
english: Even if I knew the answer, I wouldn't tell you.

chinese: 毕竟，即使是神也会偶尔出差错。
pinyin: Bìjìng, jíshǐ shì shén yě huì ǒu'ěr chū chācuò.
english: After all, even the gods may err at times.

chinese: 即使在受到表扬的时候，谦虚也是很重要的。
pinyin: Jíshǐ zài shòudào biǎoyáng de shíhou, qiānxū yě shì hěn zhòngyào de.
english: Even when one is being praised, modesty is important.

chinese: 即使离开父母，也不会思念他们。
pinyin: Jíshǐ líkāi fùmǔ, yě bù huì sīniàn tāmen.
english: Even if you leave your parents, you still won't think of them.

chinese: 他去年试过戒烟，但却以失败告终。
pinyin: Tā qùnián shì guo jièyān, dàn què yǐ shībài gàozhōng.
english: He tried to give up smoking last year, but it was in vain.

chinese: 我想买那辆车，可是我却没有钱。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi nà liàng chē, kěshì wǒ què méiyǒu qián.
english: I would buy the car, but I am poor.

chinese: 我的哥哥比我大两岁，但他却比我矮三厘米。
pinyin: Wǒ de gēge bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì, dàn tā què bǐ wǒ ǎi sān límǐ.
english: My brother is two years older than I, but he is three centimeters shorter.

chinese: 我们把他称为“英雄”，但是他却背叛了我们。
pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ tā chēngwéi "yīngxióng ", dànshì tā què bèipàn le wǒmen.
english: We called him a "hero", but he betrayed us.

chinese: 那场演讲很长，但我却听得津津有味。
pinyin: Nà chǎng yǎnjiǎng hěn cháng, dàn wǒ què tīng de jīnjīnyǒuwèi.
english: The lecture was very long, but I enjoyed it none the less.

chinese: 我听说他打麻将很厉害。
pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō tā dǎ májiàng hěn lìhai.
english: I hear he is good at mahjong.

chinese: 老师们都顶着巨大的压力在坚持上课。
pinyin: Lǎoshīmen dōu dǐng zhe jùdà de yālì zài jiānchí shàngkè.
english: The teachers are all continuing to teach despite the immense pressure.

chinese: 计划受到舆论的压力而被取消了。
pinyin: Jìhuà shòudào yúlùn de yālì ér bèi qǔxiāo le.
english: The plan was given up under the pressure of public opinion.

chinese: 天行健，君子以自强不息；地势坤，君子以厚德载物。
pinyin: Tiān xíng jiàn, jūnzǐ yǐ zìqiángbùxī; dìshì kūn, jūnzǐ yǐ hòudézàiwù.
english: As heaven maintains its vigorous motion, the noble person should strive for continuous self-improvement. As the earth's nature is receptive and nurturing, the noble person should cultivate great virtue to support and carry all things.

chinese: 这就是他失败的原因了。
pinyin: Zhè jiù shì tā shībài de yuányīn le.
english: That's the cause of his failure.

chinese: 结婚是所有离婚的主要原因。
pinyin: Jiéhūn shì suǒyǒu líhūn de zhǔyào yuányīn.
english: The root cause of any divorce is marriage.

chinese: 哪些原因可能导致男性高潮障碍？
pinyin: Nǎxiē yuányīn kěnéng dǎozhì nánxìng gāocháo zhàng'ài?
english: What can cause orgasm problems in men?

chinese: 如果时间允许，我会去参观博物馆。
pinyin: Rúguǒ shíjiān yǔnxǔ, wǒ huì qù cānguān bówùguǎn.
english: If time permits, I'll visit the museum.

chinese: 她会尽全力及时赶到这儿的。
pinyin: Tā huì jìn quánlì jíshí gǎndào zhèr de.
english: She will do her best to be here on time.

chinese: 时间能够加深友谊，但是却会冲淡爱情。
pinyin: Shíjiān nénggòu jiāshēn yǒuyì, dànshì què huì chōngdàn àiqíng.
english: Time, which strengthens friendship, weakens love.

chinese: 他和她之间的友谊，渐渐地酝酿成了爱情。
pinyin: Tā hé tā zhījiān de yǒuyì, jiànjiàn de yùnniàng chéngle àiqíng.
english: By degrees the friendship between him and her grew into love.

chinese: 我们的友谊受到了考验。
pinyin: Wǒmen de yǒuyì shòudào le kǎoyàn.
english: Our friendship was put to the test.

chinese: 我肯定事情会往好的方向发展。
pinyin: Wǒ kěndìng shìqing huì wǎng hǎo de fāngxiàng fāzhǎn.
english: I am sure the situation will take a turn for the better.

chinese: 有时候，发生的事情并不是合情合理的。
pinyin: Yǒushíhou, fāshēng de shìqing bìngbù shì héqínghélǐ de.
english: Sometimes things that happen do not make sense.

chinese: 奇迹就是因为不会发生，所以才叫奇迹的嘛。
pinyin: Qíjì jiùshì yīnwèi bù huì fāshēng, suǒyǐ cái jiào qíjì de ma.
english: Miracles are called miracles because they don't happen!

chinese: 请到门口取你的包裹。
pinyin: Qǐng dào mén kǒu qǔ nǐ de bāo guǒ。
english: Please collect your parcel at the entrance.

chinese: 我受不了她没完没了的爱。
pinyin: Wǒ shòubùliǎo tā méiwánméiliǎo de ài.
english: I cannot bear her endless love.

chinese: 你能受到教育，对我来说很重要。
pinyin: Nǐ néng shòudào jiàoyù, duìwǒláishuō hěn zhòngyào.
english: It's important to me that you receive an education.

chinese: 我认为大家都应该学另外一种语言。
pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi dàjiā dōu yīnggāi xué lìngwài yīzhǒng yǔyán.
english: I think everybody should learn another language.

chinese: 对某人有利的对另外的人未必有利。
pinyin: Duì mǒurén yǒulì de duì lìngwài de rén wèibì yǒu lì.
english: One man's meat is another man's poison.

chinese: 因为车子坏了，他们只好步行。
pinyin: Yīnwèi chēzi huàile, tāmen zhǐhǎo bùxíng.
english: The car broke down, so they had to walk.

chinese: 我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。
pinyin: Wǒmen de qián bù gòu, suǒyǐ wǒ zhǐhǎo bǎ dìngdān qǔxiāo le.
english: I had to cancel that order because we didn't have enough money to pay for it.

chinese: 只要你准备了，你就不会遇到问题。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ zhǔnbèi le, nǐ jiù bù huì yùdào wèntí.
english: As long as you’ve prepared, you won’t have any problems.

chinese: 只要我们彼此相爱，我们会没事的。
pinyin: Zhǐyào wǒmen bǐcǐ xiāng'ài, wǒmen huì méishì de.
english: As long as we love each other, we'll be all right.

chinese: 自行车当然会磨损，但只要你保养得好，就能骑很长一段时间。
pinyin: Zìxíngchē dāngrán huì mósǔn, dàn zhǐyào nǐ bǎoyǎng de hǎo, jiù néng qí hěn cháng yī duàn shíjiān.
english: Bicycles wear out, of course, but with proper care they may be made to last a long time.

chinese: 只要你有一个心爱的人,你就有了原动力,你就能面对全世界。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ yǒu yī gè xīn'ài de rén, nǐ jiù yǒule yuándònglì, nǐ jiù néng miànduì quánshìjiè.
english: As long as you have someone you love from the heart, you have a motivating force and you can face the entire world.

chinese: 那可怜的孩子快饿死了。
pinyin: Nà kělián de háizi kuài èsǐ le.
english: The poor child was on the verge of starvation.

chinese: 可惜他是一个完全没有幽默感的人。
pinyin: Kěxī tā shì yī gè wánquán méiyǒu yōumògǎn de rén.
english: It is a pity that he has no sense of humor.

chinese: 我买了一台电脑。
pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yī tái diàn nǎo。
english: I bought a computer.

chinese: 他问我知不知道她的电话号码。
pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ zhī bù zhīdào tā de diànhuà hàomǎ.
english: He asked me if I knew her telephone number.

chinese: 我会将您的电话号码记下来，方便以后联络。
pinyin: Wǒ huì jiāng nín de diànhuà hàomǎ jì xiàlai, fāngbiàn yǐhòu liánluò.
english: I'll keep your phone number in case I need to contact you later.

chinese: 我听到这个消息很吃惊。
pinyin: Wǒ tīng dào zhège xiāoxi hěn chījīng.
english: I was surprised at the news.

chinese: 对这个词，专家们各有不同的看法。
pinyin: Duì zhège cí, zhuānjiā men gè yǒu bù tóng de kànfǎ.
english: Concerning this word, each expert has a different point of view.

chinese: 往返各地的收费如下。
pinyin: Wǎngfǎn gèdì de shōufèi rúxià.
english: Round-trip fares to each destination are as follows.

chinese: 戏法人人会变，各有巧妙不同。
pinyin: Xìfǎ rénrén huì biàn, gè yǒu qiǎomiào bù tóng.
english: Everyone's tricks are different; each differs in ingenious ways.

chinese: 各尽所能、按需分配。
pinyin: Gè jìn suǒ néng, àn xū fēnpèi.
english: From each according to their ability, to each according to their needs.

chinese: 每个人在各国境内均享有迁徙自由与居住自由的权利。
pinyin: Měigerén zài gèguó jìngnèi jūn xiǎngyǒu qiānxǐ zìyóu yǔ jūzhù zìyóu de quánlì.
english: Everyone has the right to freedom of movement and residence within the borders of each State.

chinese: 没有合格的申请人吗？
pinyin: Méiyǒu hégé de shēnqǐngrén ma?
english: Aren't there any qualified applicants?

chinese: 我觉得这个赞助不太合适。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhège zànzhù bù tài héshì.
english: I don't think this sponsor is very suitable.

chinese: 虽然我很同情他，但却帮不上忙。
pinyin: Suīrán wǒ hěn tóngqíng tā, dàn què bāng bù shàng máng.
english: Much as I pitied him, I could not help him.

chinese: 不要做任何会让你后悔的事。
pinyin: Bù yào zuò rènhé huì ràng nǐ hòuhuǐ de shì.
english: Don't do anything you'll regret.

chinese: 我们的对话总是以争吵收场。
pinyin: Wǒmen de duìhuà zǒngshì yǐ zhēngchǎo shōuchǎng.
english: Our conversation always ends in a quarrel.

chinese: 他被她的笑容吸引住了。
pinyin: Tā bèi tā de xiàoróng xīyǐn zhù le.
english: He was attracted by her smile.

chinese: 呀，你怎么来了？
pinyin: Ya， nǐ zěn me lái le？
english: Oh, what brings you here?

chinese: 在北海道周围可以看到这些花。
pinyin: Zài Běihǎidào zhōuwéi kěyǐ kàn dào zhèxiē huā.
english: These flowers can be seen around Hokkaido.

chinese: 这个饮料的味道很明显是茶的味道。
pinyin: Zhège yǐnliào de wèidao hěn míngxiǎn shì chá de wèidao.
english: This drink's flavor is obviously that of tea.

chinese: 我被那声响吵醒了。
pinyin: Wǒ bèi nà shēngxiǎng chǎoxǐng le.
english: The sound woke me up.

chinese: 这位售货员很有经验。
pinyin: Zhè wèi shòu huò yuán hěn yǒu jīng yàn。
english: This salesclerk is very experienced.

chinese: 我不知道该和谁商量好。
pinyin: Wǒ bùzhī dào gāi hé shéi shāngliang hǎo.
english: I don't know who to consult with.

chinese: 嘴里有东西的时候不准说话。
pinyin: Zuǐlǐ yǒu dōngxi de shíhou bù zhǔn shuōhuà.
english: You must not speak with your mouth full.

chinese: 我看到了一条狗。狗嘴里叼着一块肉。
pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào le yī tiáo gǒu. gǒu zuǐlǐ diāo zhe yīkuài ròu.
english: I saw a dog. The dog held a piece of meat in its mouth.

chinese: 你不要用嘴呼吸，用鼻呼吸。
pinyin: Nǐ bù yào yòng zuǐ hūxī, yòng bí hūxī.
english: Breathe through your nose, not your mouth.

chinese: 土豆太热，以至于烫到了我的嘴。
pinyin: Tǔdòu tài rè, yǐzhìyú tàng dào le wǒ de zuǐ.
english: The potato was so hot that it burned my mouth.

chinese: 每次听到这首歌，都会让我回忆起自己年轻的时候。
pinyin: Měicì tīng dào zhè shǒu gē, dōu huì ràng wǒ huíyì qǐ zìjǐ niánqīng de shíhou.
english: Whenever I hear that song, I remember my youth.

chinese: 我感觉困得几乎不能睁开我的眼睛了。
pinyin: Wǒ gǎnjué kùn de jīhū bù néng zhēngkāi wǒ de yǎnjing le.
english: I felt so sleepy that I could hardly keep my eyes open.

chinese: 我在解决这个问题上有困难。
pinyin: Wǒ zài jiějué zhège wèntí shàng yǒu kùnnan.
english: I had difficulty in solving this problem.

chinese: 我们将于几分钟内降落在新东京国际机场。
pinyin: Wǒmen jiāng yú jǐ fēnzhōng nèi jiàngluò zài xīn Dōngjīng guójìjīchǎng.
english: In a few minutes we'll be landing at New Tokyo International Airport.

chinese: 国际问题必须靠外交而非战争解决。
pinyin: Guójì wèntí bìxū kào wàijiāo ér fēi zhànzhēng jiějué.
english: International problems must be solved by diplomacy, not war.

chinese: 旗袍因有与众不同的特点而在国际时尚界享有与日俱增的名望。
pinyin: Qípáo yīn yǒu yǔzhòngbùtóng de tèdiǎn ér zài guójì shíshàng jiè xiǎngyǒu yǔrìjùzēng de míngwàng.
english: With its distinctive Chinese features, the qipao enjoys growing popularity in the international world of high fashion.

chinese: 坚果是圆的，但不是光是圆的就是坚果。
pinyin: Jiānguǒ shì yuán de, dàn bù shì guāngshì yuán de jiùshì jiānguǒ.
english: The nut is round, but not everything round is a nut.

chinese: 人孔是圆的，因为这样人孔盖就不会意外地掉进洞里。
pinyin: Rénkǒng shì yuán de, yīnwèi zhèyàng rénkǒnggài jiù bù huì yìwài de diào jìn dòng lǐ.
english: Manholes are round because that way they won't accidentally fall through the hole.

chinese: 对了，可以把你的地址告诉我吗？
pinyin: Duìle, kěyǐ bǎ nǐ de dìzhǐ gàosu wǒ ma?
english: By the way, what is your address?

chinese: 把你的姓名和地址写在这个信封上。
pinyin: Bǎ nǐ de xìngmíng hé dìzhǐ xiě zài zhège xìnfēng shàng.
english: Write your name and address on this envelope.

chinese: 地球跟其它星球不同是因为它有水。
pinyin: Dìqiú gēn qítā xīngqiú bù tóng shì yīnwèi tā yǒushuǐ.
english: The difference between Earth and the other planets is that Earth has water.

chinese: 地球是由海洋和陆地组成的。
pinyin: Dìqiú shì yóu hǎiyáng hé lùdì zǔchéng de.
english: The earth is made up of sea and land.

chinese: 地球的表面约有三分之一是陆地。
pinyin: Dìqiú de biǎomiàn yuē yǒu sānfēnzhīyī shì lùdì.
english: About one third of the earth's surface is land.

chinese: 今天有一场比赛。
pinyin: Jīn tiān yǒu yī chǎng bǐ sài。
english: There is a match today.

chinese: 垃圾桶空了。
pinyin: Lājītǒng kōng le.
english: The trash can is empty.

chinese: 你的理论是以什么为基础?
pinyin: Nǐ de lǐlùn shìyǐ shénme wèi jīchǔ?
english: What do you base your theory on?

chinese: 你现在出门的话，肯定会堵车的。
pinyin: Nǐ xiànzài chūmén dehuà, kěndìng huì dǔchē de.
english: If you leave now, I'm sure you'll be caught in a traffic jam.

chinese: 请根据课文内容填空。
pinyin: Qǐng gēn jù kè wén nèi róng tián kòng。
english: Please fill in the blanks using the lesson text.

chinese: 你从来不听，就好像我是在跟一堵墙说话。
pinyin: Nǐ cóngláibù tīng, jiù hǎoxiàng wǒ shì zài gēn yī dǔ qiáng shuōhuà.
english: You never listen. Talking to you is like talking to a wall.

chinese: 随着汽车的增加，空气也跟着变糟。
pinyin: Suízhe qìchē de zēngjiā, kōngqì yě gēnzhe biànzāo.
english: With the increase of cars, the air pollution has gotten worse.

chinese: 顾客投诉量增加，可能代表生意正在走下坡。
pinyin: Gùkè tóusù liáng zēngjiā, kěnéng dàibiǎo shēngyi zhèngzài zǒu xiàpō.
english: An increase in customer complaints could signal a decline in business.

chinese: 他们想栽培新品种的米来增加粮食生产。
pinyin: Tāmen xiǎng zāipéi xīn pǐnzhǒng de mǐ lái zēngjiā liángshi shēngchǎn.
english: They want to increase food production by growing new kinds of rice.

chinese: 世界上已经够热的地方会变得让人无法忍受。
pinyin: Shìjiè shàng yǐjīng gòu rè de dìfang huì biànde ràng rén wúfǎrěnshòu.
english: Parts of the world that are already hot enough might become unbearably so.

chinese: 绳子不够牢固，撑不住他。
pinyin: Shéngzi bù gòu láogù, chēng bù zhù tā.
english: The rope wasn't strong enough to support him.

chinese: 日本大使馆在哪里？
pinyin: Rìběn dàshǐguǎn zài nǎlǐ?
english: Where is the Japanese Embassy?

chinese: 大使馆就在最高法院旁边。
pinyin: Dàshǐguǎn jiù zài zuìgāo fǎyuàn pángbiān.
english: The embassy is located next to the Supreme Court.

chinese: 在法国，你在大使馆工作还是领事馆？
pinyin: Zài Fǎguó, nǐ zài dàshǐguǎn gōngzuò háishi lǐngshìguǎn?
english: In France did you work at the embassy or in the consulate?

chinese: 你大概会需要三小时读这本书。
pinyin: Nǐ dàgài huì xūyào sānxiǎo shí dú zhè běn shū.
english: It's probably going to take you about three hours to read this book.

chinese: 我每天读书大约两个小时。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dúshū dàyuē liǎng gè xiǎoshí.
english: I study about two hours every day.

chinese: 成千上万的人对这个广告很失望。
pinyin: Chéngqiānshàngwàn de rén duì zhège guǎnggào hěn shīwàng.
english: Thousands of people were very disappointed with this advertisement.

chinese: 我们或多或少对这次的选举感到失望。
pinyin: Wǒmen huòduōhuòshǎo duì zhè cì de xuǎnjǔ gǎndào shīwàng.
english: We were more or less disappointed about the election.

chinese: 被征服的人永远是错的。历史只记得他们的失败。
pinyin: Bèi zhēngfú de rén yǒngyuǎn shì cuò de. lìshǐ zhǐ jìde tāmen de shībài.
english: Those who are defeated are always wrong. History only remembers their failure.

chinese: 你应该得到这个奖金。
pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi dédào zhège jiǎngjīn.
english: You deserve the prize.

chinese: 好像快要下雨了。我们把窗关上吧。
pinyin: Hǎoxiàng kuàiyào xiàyǔ le. wǒmen bǎ chuāng guānshàng ba.
english: It looks like rain. We had better shut the windows.

chinese: 这么做有什么好处吗？
pinyin: Zhème zuò yǒu shénme hǎochu ma?
english: Does doing things in this way have a benefit?

chinese: 有一位奶奶带着小孙子上学。
pinyin: Yǒu yī wèi nǎinai dài zhe xiǎo sūnzi shàngxué.
english: A grandmother is sending her grandson to school.

chinese: 可能我的孙子会是登陆火星的第一人。
pinyin: Kěnéng wǒ de sūnzi huì shì dēnglù Huǒxīng de dì-yī rén.
english: Perhaps my grandson will be the first person to land on Mars.

chinese: 不是所有的网路浏览器都是安全的。
pinyin: Bù shì suǒyǒu de wǎnglù liúlǎnqì dōu shì ānquán de.
english: Not all internet browsers are safe.

chinese: 小区安全吗？夜晚有照明设施吗？
pinyin: Xiǎoqū ānquán ma? yèwǎn yǒu zhàomíng shèshī ma?
english: Is this community safe? Are there lighting installations for the night?

chinese: 你该把你的值钱物品保存在一个安全的地方。
pinyin: Nǐ gāi bǎ nǐ de zhíqián wùpǐn bǎocún zài yī gè ānquán de dìfang.
english: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.

chinese: 她对我来说是一个完全陌生的人。
pinyin: Tā duìwǒláishuō shì yī gè wánquán mòshēng de rén.
english: As far as I'm concerned, she's a complete stranger.

chinese: 让我在几天内完成这些活实在不可能。
pinyin: Ràng wǒ zài jǐtiān nèi wánchéng zhèxiē huó shízài bù kěnéng.
english: I could not possibly finish the work in a few days.

chinese: 当我发现我没通过测验时我实在是太沮丧了。
pinyin: Dāng wǒ fāxiàn wǒ méi tōngguò cèyàn shí wǒ shízài shì tài jǔsàng le.
english: I was really disappointed when I found out that I hadn't passed the exam.

chinese: 他的实际年龄比他看起来老得多。
pinyin: Tā de shíjì niánlíng bǐ tā kànqǐlai lǎo de duō.
english: He is much older than he looks.

chinese: 对啊，她以前是一个很害羞的女孩。
pinyin: Duì ā, tā yǐqián shì yī gè hěn hàixiū de nǚhái.
english: Yes. She used to be a very shy girl.

chinese: 汤姆害羞胆怯。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ hàixiū dǎnqiè.
english: Tom is shy and cowardly.

chinese: 用优质材料做的家具卖得很好。
pinyin: Yòng yōuzhì cáiliào zuò de jiājù mài de hěn hǎo.
english: Furniture made of good materials sells well.

chinese: 本来这间房间里没有家具。
pinyin: Běnlái zhè jiān fángjiān lǐ méiyǒu jiājù.
english: The room originally had no furniture.

chinese: 你想要哪种风格的家具？
pinyin: Nǐ xiǎngyào nǎ zhǒng fēnggé de jiājù?
english: What style of furniture would you like?

chinese: 我卖了房子和家具，连同我的手饰一起才凑了五十万。
pinyin: Wǒ mài le fángzi hé jiājù, liántóng wǒ de shǒu shì yīqǐ cái còu le wǔshí wàn.
english: I sold my house and furniture, together with my jewelry, in order to scrape together a half a million.

chinese: 我的一位朋友要求我寄给她一张明信片。
pinyin: Wǒ de yī wèi péngyou yāoqiú wǒ jì gěi tā yī zhāng míngxìnpiàn.
english: A friend of mine asked me to send her a postcard.

chinese: 我能破译这个箱子的密码。
pinyin: Wǒ néng pòyì zhège xiāngzi de mìmǎ.
english: I can crack the password of this box.

chinese: 就连世界首富也不可能得到一切。
pinyin: Jiù lián shìjiè shǒufù yě bù kěnéng dédào yīqiè.
english: The richest man in the world cannot buy everything.

chinese: 你的寒假怎么过的？
pinyin: Nǐ de hánjià zěnme guò de?
english: How did you spend your winter vacation?

chinese: 他对这个问题给了正确的答案。
pinyin: Tā duì zhège wèntí gěi le zhèngquè de dá'àn.
english: He gave correct answers to the questions.

chinese: 我们姑且认为它是对的。
pinyin: Wǒmen gūqiě rènwéi tā shì duì de.
english: Let's assume this is correct for now.

chinese: 你家对面的房子是谁的?
pinyin: Nǐ jiā duìmiàn de fángzi shì shéi de?
english: Whose house is opposite to yours?

chinese: 我在东京做导游。
pinyin: Wǒ zài Dōngjīng zuò dǎoyóu.
english: I'm a tour guide in Tokyo.

chinese: 我为你充当导游。
pinyin: Wǒ wèi nǐ chōngdāng dǎoyóu.
english: I'll act as a guide for you.

chinese: 我们希望在不久的将来邀请彼得去日本。
pinyin: Wǒmen xīwàng zài bù jiǔ de jiānglái yāoqǐng Bǐdé qù Rìběn.
english: We wish to invite Peter to Japan in the near future.

chinese: 他昨天看了一部最有趣的小说。
pinyin: Tā zuótiān kàn le yī bù zuì yǒuqù de xiǎoshuō.
english: He read a most interesting novel yesterday.

chinese: 他们把这本小说变成戏剧。
pinyin: Tāmen bǎ zhè běn xiǎoshuō biànchéng xìjù.
english: They made the novel into a drama.

chinese: 他最后一本小说的主题是什么？
pinyin: Tā zuì hòu yī běn xiǎoshuō de zhǔtí shì shénme?
english: What is the theme of his latest novel?

chinese: 望着天花板发呆,还不如读一读小说。
pinyin: Wàng zhe tiānhuābǎn fādāi, háibùrú dú yī dú xiǎoshuō.
english: You might as well read a novel instead of staring at the ceiling.

chinese: 这种葡萄酒比我们之前尝过的那种有更多果香。
pinyin: Zhèzhǒng pútaojiǔ bǐ wǒmen zhīqián cháng guo de nàzhǒng yǒu gèng duō guǒ xiāng.
english: This wine has a fruitier taste than the one we tasted before.

chinese: 尽管他很富有，他还是不满足。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā hěn fùyǒu, tā háishi bù mǎnzú.
english: Despite his riches, he's not contented.

chinese: 尽管有逆境，建筑师还是获得了享誉全球的荣誉。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yǒu nìjìng, jiànzhùshī háishi huòdé le xiǎngyù quánqiú de róngyù.
english: Despite adversity, the architect achieved worldwide fame.

chinese: 我们罢工是因为公司没有改善我们的工资。
pinyin: Wǒmen bàgōng shì yīnwèi gōngsī méiyǒu gǎishàn wǒmen de gōngzī.
english: The reason we're on strike is that the company hasn't improved our wages.

chinese: 一些同学看见我给了他巧克力。
pinyin: Yīxiē tóngxué kànjiàn wǒ gěi le tā qiǎokèlì.
english: Some classmates saw me give him chocolate.

chinese: 巧克力不放在冰箱里的话会融化的。
pinyin: Qiǎokèlì bù fàng zài bīngxiāng lǐ dehuà huì rónghuà de.
english: The chocolate is going to melt if you keep it out of the fridge.

chinese: 这座巧克力工厂每一天消耗二十公吨可可原料。
pinyin: Zhè zuò qiǎokèlì gōngchǎng měi yī tiān xiāohào èrshí gōngdūn kěkě yuánliào.
english: This chocolate factory consumes twenty metric tons of raw cocoa per day.

chinese: 世上的罪恶差不多总是由愚昧无知造成的。
pinyin: Shìshàng de zuì'è chàbuduō zǒngshì yóu yúmèiwúzhī zàochéng de.
english: The world's evil almost always comes from ignorance.

chinese: 有什么办法呢？这些都是市场决定的。
pinyin: Yǒu shénme bànfǎ ne? zhèxiē dōu shì shìchǎng juédìng de.
english: What can be done? These are market forces.

chinese: 市场上到处都很热闹。
pinyin: Shìchǎng shàng dàochù dōu hěn rènao.
english: There isn't a place in this market that isn't lively.

chinese: 他上身长得呈倒三角形，站在那里看上去特帅！
pinyin: Tā shàngshēn zhǎngde chéng dǎo sānjiǎoxíng, zhàn zài nàli kànshangqu tè shuài!
english: His upper body looks like it has the shape of an inverted triangle; standing there, he seems extremely handsome!

chinese: 师傅，请送我去机场。
pinyin: Shī fu， qǐng sòng wǒ qù jī chǎng。
english: Driver, please take me to the airport.

chinese: 这件事你干得很好。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ gàn de hěn hǎo。
english: You did this very well.

chinese: 请诸位斟满酒，为新郎和新娘干杯！
pinyin: Qǐng zhūwèi zhēn mǎn jiǔ, wèi xīnláng hé xīnniáng gānbēi!
english: Please charge your glasses and drink a toast to the bride and groom!

chinese: 这里的夏天很潮湿，另外，冬天很干燥。
pinyin: Zhèlǐ de xiàtiān hěn cháoshī, lìngwài, dōngtiān hěn gānzào.
english: It gets very humid here in the summer. In the winter, on the other hand, it gets very dry.

chinese: 寒冷干燥，灿烂的阳光，多么美丽的冬日天气!
pinyin: Hánlěng gānzào, cànlàn de yángguāng, duōme měilì de dōng rì tiānqì!
english: Cold and dry, splendid sunshine, what beautiful winter weather!

chinese: 看着他并且跟他做同样的事情。
pinyin: Kàn zhe tā bìngqiě gēn tā zuò tóngyàng de shìqing.
english: Watch him and do the same thing.

chinese: 她在桌子底下找到了她的钱包。
pinyin: Tā zài zhuōzi dǐxia zhǎodào le tā de qiánbāo.
english: She found her purse under the desk.

chinese: 他家后面有小溪，清可见底。
pinyin: Tā jiā hòumiàn yǒu xiǎoxī, qīng kějiàn dǐ.
english: Behind his house is a stream so clear that you can see the bottom of it.

chinese: 她把她的座位让给了一个老人。
pinyin: Tā bǎ tā de zuòwèi ràng gěi le yī gè lǎorén.
english: She gave her seat to a senior citizen.

chinese: 你可以帮我保留这个座位吗?
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ bǎoliú zhège zuòwèi ma?
english: Can you save this seat for me?

chinese: 他这么说就是为了开玩笑。
pinyin: Tā zhème shuō jiùshì wèile kāiwánxiào.
english: He said it merely as a joke.

chinese: 你进来的时候最好不要把我弄醒。
pinyin: Nǐ jìnlái de shíhou zuì hǎobù yào bǎ wǒ nòngxǐng.
english: You had better not wake me up when you come in.

chinese: 这场森林大火是自然引起的。
pinyin: Zhè chǎng sēnlín dàhuǒ shì zìrán yǐnqǐ de.
english: This forest fire was naturally caused.

chinese: 她会弹钢琴。
pinyin: Tā huì tán gāng qín。
english: She can play the piano.

chinese: 当你年轻的时候, 你应该多读点儿书。
pinyin: Dāng nǐ niánqīng de shíhou, nǐ yīnggāi duō dú diǎnr shū.
english: While you're young, you should read a lot.

chinese: 现在东京当地时间是几点钟？
pinyin: Xiànzài Dōngjīng dāngdì shíjiān shì jǐ diǎnzhōng?
english: What's the local time in Tokyo now?

chinese: 这家报社在当地知名度颇高。
pinyin: Zhè jiā bàoshè zài dāngdì zhīmíngdù pō gāo.
english: This newspaper is well known in the local area.

chinese: 温度计往往低于零度。
pinyin: Wēndùjì wǎngwǎng dīyú língdù.
english: Thermometers often go below zero.

chinese: 我认识一个不错的律师，他可以帮你。
pinyin: Wǒ rènshi yī gè bù cuò de lǜshī, tā kěyǐ bāng nǐ.
english: I know a good lawyer who can help you.

chinese: 最后笑的人，才是笑得最得意的人。
pinyin: Zuìhòu xiào de rén, cái shì xiào de zuì déyì de rén.
english: He laughs best who laughs last.

chinese: 你今天早上为什么心情这么差？
pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang wèishénme xīnqíng zhème chà?
english: Why are you in such a bad mood this morning?

chinese: 我忽然想起了我死去的妈妈。
pinyin: Wǒ hūrán xiǎngqǐ le wǒ sǐqù de māma.
english: I suddenly thought of my dead mother.

chinese: 我怀疑我是不是一个好作家。
pinyin: Wǒ huáiyí wǒ shìbùshì yī gè hǎo zuòjiā.
english: I doubt that I'm a good writer.

chinese: 我开始怀疑他陈述的准确性。
pinyin: Wǒ kāishǐ huáiyí tā chénshù de zhǔnquèxìng.
english: I began to doubt the accuracy of his statement.

chinese: 我受不了他那种无礼的态度。
pinyin: Wǒ shòubùliǎo tā nàzhǒng wúlǐ de tàidu.
english: I have trouble putting up with his rude manner.

chinese: 你的性别是什么？
pinyin: Nǐ de xìngbié shì shénme?
english: What is your gender?

chinese: 性别规范不应该规定个人如何面对或处理自己的情绪。
pinyin: Xìngbié guīfàn bù yīnggāi guīdìng gèrén rúhé miànduì huò chǔlǐ zìjǐ de qíngxù.
english: Gender norms should not dictate how individuals cope with and process their emotions.

chinese: 请总结一下今天的学习内容。
pinyin: Qǐng zǒng jié yī xià jīn tiān de xué xí nèi róng。
english: Please summarize what we studied today.

chinese: 恐怕就这点上，我和你持不同意见。
pinyin: Kǒngpà jiù zhè diǎn shàng, wǒ hé nǐ chí bùtóng yìjiàn.
english: I'm afraid I differ with you on this point.

chinese: 恐怕他永远也不会承认自己的罪行。
pinyin: Kǒngpà tā yǒngyuǎn yě bùhuì chéngrèn zìjǐ de zuìxíng.
english: I'm afraid he will never admit his guilt.

chinese: 恐怕这里提法不妥当。
pinyin: Kǒngpà zhèlǐ tífǎ bù tuǒdang.
english: I'm afraid this is an incorrect formulation of the question.

chinese: 这首诗是不是莎士比亚写的，恐怕是无从考究的了。
pinyin: Zhè shǒu shī shìbùshì Shāshìbǐyà xiě de, kǒngpà shì wúcóng kǎojiū de le.
english: Whether Shakespeare wrote this poem or not will probably remain a mystery.

chinese: 请写信告诉我你们学校的情况。
pinyin: Qǐng xiě xìn gàosu wǒ nǐmen xuéxiào de qíngkuàng.
english: Please write to me about conditions at your school.

chinese: 你可能是对的，但我和你意见相反。
pinyin: Nǐ kěnéng shì duì de, dàn wǒ hé nǐ yìjiàn xiāngfǎn.
english: You may be right, but I am against your opinion.

chinese: 汤姆在表达自己的意见的时候总是很慌张。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ zài biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn de shíhou zǒngshì hěn huāngzhāng.
english: Tom never felt comfortable expressing his own opinion.

chinese: 他还没有把情况了解清楚就急忙发表意见。
pinyin: Tā hái méiyǒu bǎ qíngkuàng liǎojiě qīngchu jiù jímáng fābiǎo yìjiàn.
english: Before understanding the situation clearly, he hastily gave his opinion.

chinese: 所有意见是真相和错误的综合。
pinyin: Suǒyǒu yìjiàn shì zhēnxiàng hé cuòwù de zōnghé.
english: Every opinion is a mixture of truth and mistakes.

chinese: 没有人看了这部电影会不感动的。
pinyin: Méiyǒu rén kàn le zhè bù diànyǐng huì bù gǎndòng de.
english: Nobody can see this movie without being moved.

chinese: 我深深地被她的仁慈所感动。
pinyin: Wǒ shēnshēn de bèi tā de réncí suǒ gǎndòng.
english: I was greatly moved by her kindness.

chinese: 我以感情为生活里最重要的事。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐ gǎnqíng wéi shēnghuó lǐ zuì zhòngyào de shì.
english: I consider relationships to be the most important thing in life.

chinese: 你对他说的话让他感觉好多了。
pinyin: Nǐ duì tā shuō dehuà ràng tā gǎnjué hǎoduō le.
english: Whatever you said to him made him feel better.

chinese: 她一戴上安全帽就感觉安全多了。
pinyin: Tā yī dàishang ānquánmào jiù gǎnjué ānquán duō le.
english: She felt much safer once she’d put her helmet on.

chinese: 我们感觉到房子摇动了一下。
pinyin: Wǒmen gǎnjuédào fángzi yáodòng le yīxià.
english: We felt the house shake a little.

chinese: 来摸摸这个感觉一下。真的很柔软啊。
pinyin: Lái mōmo zhège gǎnjué yīxià. Zhēnde hěn róuruǎn ā.
english: Feel this. It's really soft.

chinese: 今天早上我因为太懒而没有出门。
pinyin: Jīntiān zǎoshang wǒ yīnwèi tài lǎn ér méiyǒu chūmén.
english: This morning, I was very lazy and didn't go out.

chinese: 英语现已成为世界上许多国家的通用语言了。
pinyin: Yīngyǔ xiàn yǐ chéngwéi shìjiè shàng xǔduō guójiā de tōngyòngyǔ yán le.
english: English has now become the common language of several nations in the world.

chinese: 我的梦想是要成为一个顶级的麻将高手。
pinyin: Wǒ de mèngxiǎng shì yào chéngwéi yī gè dǐngjí de májiàng gāoshǒu.
english: My dream is to become a very strong mahjong player.

chinese: 由于他的财富，他能够成为这个俱乐部的成员。
pinyin: Yóuyú tā de cáifù, tā nénggòu chéngwéi zhège jùlèbù de chéngyuán.
english: Because of his wealth, he was able to become a member of that club.

chinese: 听到她成功的消息，他很高兴。
pinyin: Tīngdào tā chénggōng de xiāoxi, tā hěn gāoxìng.
english: He was happy at the news of her success.

chinese: 他们互帮互助，把校庆搞得很成功。
pinyin: Tāmen hùbāng hùzhù, bǎ xiàoqìng gǎo de hěn chénggōng.
english: They helped one another to make the school festival a success.

chinese: 就像你们知道的那样，毅力是成功的关键。
pinyin: Jiù xiàng nǐmen zhīdào de nàyàng, yìlì shì chénggōng de guānjiàn.
english: Perseverance, as you know, is the key to success.

chinese: 请接受我对您今天的成功最诚挚的祝贺。
pinyin: Qǐng jiēshòu wǒ duì nín jīntiān de chénggōng zuì chéngzhì de zhùhè.
english: Please accept my sincere congratulations on your success today.

chinese: 世上没有任何的成功，能够弥补家庭的失败。
pinyin: Shìshàng méiyǒu rènhé de chénggōng, nénggòu míbǔ jiātíng de shībài.
english: There is no success in the world that makes up for the failure of the family.

chinese: 他留了胡子，为了让自己看起来更成熟。
pinyin: Tā liú le húzi, wèile ràng zìjǐ kànqǐlai gèng chéngshú.
english: He grew a beard to look more mature.

chinese: 所有人都在等你。
pinyin: Suǒyǒu rén dōu zài děng nǐ.
english: Everybody is waiting for you.

chinese: 我昨天买了这个打印机。
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān mǎi le zhège dǎyìnjī.
english: I bought this printer yesterday.

chinese: 她很会打扮，所以不管穿上什么都合适。
pinyin: Tā hěn huì dǎban, suǒyǐ bù guǎn chuānshang shénme dōu héshì.
english: She has good style, so she looks good in anything she wears.

chinese: 当我学习的时候不要打扰我。
pinyin: Dāng wǒ xuéxí de shíhou bù yào dǎrǎo wǒ.
english: Don't disturb me while I'm studying.

chinese: 你能不能给我打折？
pinyin: Nǐ néng bù néng gěi wǒ dǎzhé?
english: Can you give me a discount?

chinese: 护士正在给病人打针。
pinyin: Hù shi zhèng zài gěi bìng rén dǎ zhēn。
english: The nurse is giving the patient an injection.

chinese: 这本杂志不要扔。我还没看呢。
pinyin: Zhè běn zázhì bù yào rēng. Wǒ hái méi kàn ne.
english: Don't throw away this magazine. I haven't read it yet.

chinese: 在新加坡的街道上扔垃圾会被罚款。
pinyin: Zài Xīnjiāpō de jiēdào shàng rēng lājī huì bèi fákuǎn.
english: They fine you in Singapore if you throw trash in the streets.

chinese: 他试图扩大自己的势力范围。
pinyin: Tā shìtú kuòdà zìjǐ de shìli fànwéi.
english: He tried to enlarge his sphere of influence.

chinese: 很少有人会批评他，即使有也不多。
pinyin: Hěn shǎo yǒu rén huì pīpíng tā, jíshǐ yǒu yě bù duō.
english: Few, if any, will criticize him.

chinese: 除了语言，我也对技术感兴趣。
pinyin: Chúle yǔyán, wǒ yě duì jìshù gǎnxìngqù.
english: Apart from languages, I'm also interested in technology.

chinese: 现代科学技术让我们的生活更加舒适。
pinyin: Xiàndài kēxué jìshù ràng wǒmen de shēnghuó gèngjiā shūshì.
english: Modern technology has made our lives more comfortable.

chinese: 护士用温度计量了量他的体温。
pinyin: Hùshi yòng wēndùjì liáng le liáng tā de tǐwēn.
english: The nurse took his temperature with a thermometer.

chinese: 我怎样报名参加呢？
pinyin: Wǒ zěnyàng bàomíng cānjiā ne?
english: How do I sign up?

chinese: 我父亲无法抬起它。
pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn wúfǎ táiqǐ tā.
english: My father cannot lift it up.

chinese: 他把她抱在怀里，并把她抱到床上。
pinyin: Tā bǎ tā bào zài huáilǐ, bìngbǎ tā bào dào chuáng shàng.
english: He lifted her in his arms and carried her to her bed.

chinese: 今天很抱歉，让你等了这么多时间。
pinyin: Jīntiān hěn bàoqiàn, ràng nǐděng le zhème duō shíjiān.
english: I'm sorry that I made you wait for so long today.

chinese: 抱歉，这只是一个又大又无情的笑话。
pinyin: Bàoqiàn, zhè zhǐshì yī gè yòu dà yòu wúqíng de xiàohuà.
english: Sorry, it was just a big, heartless joke.

chinese: 很抱歉，我还有另一个约会。
pinyin: Hěn bàoqiàn, wǒ háiyǒu lìng yī gè yuēhuì.
english: I'm sorry. I have another appointment.

chinese: 照这样的情况，很抱歉，我不能接受你的盛情邀请。
pinyin: Zhào zhèyàng de qíngkuàng, hěn bàoqiàn, wǒ bù néng jiēshòu nǐ de shèngqíng yāoqǐng.
english: As such is the case, I am sorry I can't accept your kind invitation.

chinese: 请拉开这扇门。
pinyin: Qǐng lā kāi zhè shàn mén。
english: Please pull this door open.

chinese: 我不知道应该接受还是拒绝。
pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào yīnggāi jiēshòu háishi jùjué.
english: I don't know whether to accept or refuse.

chinese: 等一下，我马上就回来。不要挂断电话！
pinyin: Děngyīxià, wǒ mǎshàng jiù huílai. bù yào guàduàn diànhuà!
english: Hold on a second, I'll be right back. Don't hang up!

chinese: 把你的外套挂在钩子上。
pinyin: Bǎ nǐ de wàitào guà zài gōuzi shàng.
english: Hang your coat on the hook.

chinese: 若没有将衣服折起来或是挂在衣架上，会起皱纹。
pinyin: Ruò méiyǒu jiāng yīfu zhé qǐlai huòshì guà zài yījià shàng, huì qǐzhòuwén.
english: If you don't fold your clothes or hang them, they will be wrinkled.

chinese: 教师用手指指着我，要我跟她走。
pinyin: Jiàoshī yòng shǒuzhǐ zhǐ zhe wǒ, yào wǒ gēn tā zǒu.
english: The teacher pointed her finger at me and asked me to come with her.

chinese: 指南针的指针指向北边。
pinyin: Zhǐnánzhēn de zhǐzhēn zhǐxiàng běibiān.
english: Compass needles point to the north.

chinese: 不好意思，让我指出先前文章的三个错误。
pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, ràng wǒ zhǐchū xiānqián wénzhāng de sān gè cuòwù.
english: Excuse me, let me point out three mistakes in the above article.

chinese: 不管你选哪条路，你都能按时到那里。
pinyin: Bù guǎn nǐ xuǎn nǎ tiáo lù, nǐ dōu néng ànshí dào nàli.
english: Whichever route you take, you will get there in time.

chinese: 每天早上我都要靠闹钟来按时叫醒我。
pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang wǒ dōu yào kào nàozhōng lái ànshí jiàoxǐng wǒ.
english: I depend on the alarm clock to wake up on time every morning.

chinese: 我们会按照你的工作量付钱给你。
pinyin: Wǒmen huì ànzhào nǐ de gōngzuòliàng fùqián gěi nǐ.
english: We will pay you according to the amount of work you do.

chinese: 天气挺冷的。
pinyin: Tiānqì tǐng lěng de.
english: It's pretty cold.

chinese: 安静到连针掉在地上的声音你都会听得到。
pinyin: Ānjìng dào lián zhēn diào zài dìshàng de shēngyīn nǐ dōu huì tīng dédào.
english: It was so still that you would have heard a pin drop.

chinese: 你能把这清单按字母顺序排列吗？
pinyin: Nǐ néng bǎ zhè qīngdān àn zìmǔ shùnxù páiliè ma?
english: Could you rearrange this list so it's in alphabetical order?

chinese: 很多保守的女生还是接受不了网袜。
pinyin: Hěn duō bǎoshǒu de nǚshēng háishi jiēshòu buliǎo wǎngwà.
english: Many conservative women still can't accept fishnet stockings.

chinese: 赞扬比批评更容易让人接受。
pinyin: Zànyáng bǐ pīpíng gèng róngyì ràng rén jiēshòu.
english: People can accept praise more easily than criticism.

chinese: 推送通知太多了，我在设定里关掉了。
pinyin: Tuīsòng tōngzhī tài duō le, wǒ zài shèdìng lǐ guāndiào le.
english: There are too many push notifications, so I turned them off in the settings.

chinese: 我得推我的自行车，因为有个轮胎漏气了。
pinyin: Wǒ de tuī wǒ de zìxíngchē, yīnwèi yǒu gè lúntāi lòuqì le.
english: I had to push my bicycle because I had a flat tire.

chinese: 我也不知道为什么聚会被推迟了。
pinyin: Wǒ yě bù zhīdào wèishénme jùhuì bèi tuīchí le.
english: I don't know why the meeting was postponed, either.

chinese: 不论黑暗多么辽阔，我们都必须提供自身的光明。
pinyin: Bù lùn hēi'àn duōme liáokuò, wǒmen dōu bìxū tígōng zìshēn de guāngmíng.
english: However vast the darkness, we must supply our own light.

chinese: 他拒绝跟我握手。
pinyin: Tā jùjué gēn wǒ wòshǒu.
english: He refused to shake hands with me.

chinese: 和别人握手的时候，一定要有眼神接触。
pinyin: Hé biéren wòshǒu de shíhou, yīdìng yào yǒu yǎnshén jiēchù.
english: When you shake hands with somebody, you must look him in the eye.

chinese: 哎哟，撞到你了，对不起！
pinyin: Āiyō, zhuàngdào nǐ le, duìbuqǐ!
english: Ah, I hit you, sorry!

chinese: 汤姆被卡车撞到而且当场死亡。
pinyin: Tāng mǔ bèi kǎchē zhuàngdào érqiě dāngchǎng sǐwáng.
english: Tom was hit by a truck and died instantly.

chinese: 你最后一次替别人擦眼泪是什么时候？
pinyin: Nǐ zuì hòu yīcì tì biéren cā yǎnlèi shì shénmeshíhou?
english: When did you last wipe someone's tears away?

chinese: 我妈要求我把我的房间收拾好。
pinyin: Wǒ mā yāoqiú wǒ bǎ wǒ de fángjiān shōushi hǎo.
english: My mother told me to clean the room.

chinese: 这样做的话什么都不会改变的。
pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò dehuà shénme dōu bù huì gǎibiàn de.
english: That won't change anything.

chinese: 把水加热不改变它的化学成分。
pinyin: Bǎ shuǐ jiārè bù gǎibiàn tā de huàxuéchéngfèn.
english: Heating water does not change its chemical composition.

chinese: 我们必须放弃这个计划。
pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū fàngqì zhège jìhuà.
english: We have to abandon the plan.

chinese: 离放暑假还有五天。
pinyin: Lí fàng shǔjià háiyǒu wǔ tiān.
english: We have five days to go before the summer vacation.

chinese: 你是故意这么做的！
pinyin: Nǐ shì gùyì zhème zuò de!
english: You did this intentionally!

chinese: 这种学习方法的效果很好。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xué xí fāng fǎ de xiào guǒ hěn hǎo。
english: This study method works very well.

chinese: 每个星期二下午是这个教授的办公时间。
pinyin: Měi gè Xīngqī'èr xiàwǔ shì zhège jiàoshòu de bàngōngshíjiān.
english: The professor has office hours every Tuesday afternoon.

chinese: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。
pinyin: Wénzhāng de fābiǎo bèi yùdìng zàijiào shòu shēngrì nàtiān.
english: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.

chinese: 父母很重视孩子的教育。
pinyin: Fùmǔ hěn zhòngshì háizi de jiàoyù.
english: The parents value their children's education.

chinese: 子女培养全社会都很关心，教育要进行改革。
pinyin: Zǐnǚ péiyǎng quán shèhuì dōu hěn guānxīn, jiàoyù yào jìnxíng gǎigé.
english: The raising of children is something that concerns the entire community. There will be an education reform.

chinese: 我连去散步的时间也没有。
pinyin: Wǒ lián qù sànbù de shíjiān yě méiyǒu.
english: I don't even have time for a walk.

chinese: 他给自己定下每天早上散步的规矩。
pinyin: Tā gěi zìjǐ dìng xià měitiān zǎoshang sànbù de guīju.
english: He makes it a rule to take a walk every morning.

chinese: 四在日本是一个不幸的数字。
pinyin: Sì zài Rìběn shì yī gè bù xìng de shùzì.
english: Four is an unlucky number in Japan.

chinese: 在这个密码里，每个数字取代了一个字母。
