pinyin: Zài zhège mìmǎ lǐ, měi gè shùzì qǔdài le yī gè zìmǔ.
english: In this secret code, each number stands for a letter of the alphabet.

chinese: 你进入我的房间之前都要敲门。
pinyin: Nǐ jìnrù wǒ de fángjiān zhīqián dōu yào qiāomén.
english: You are always to knock before entering my room.

chinese: 你把床单收起来，我整理一下床。
pinyin: Nǐ bǎ chuángdān shōu qǐlai, wǒ zhěnglǐ yīxià chuáng.
english: You put away the sheets, and I'll make the bed.

chinese: 那就是那台他用来写文章的电脑。
pinyin: Nà jiù shì nèi tái tā yònglái xiě wénzhāng de diànnǎo.
english: That's the computer he used to write the article.

chinese: 她几乎没有说完话，就被他打断了。
pinyin: Tā jīhū méiyǒu shuō wán huà, jiù bèi tā dǎduàn le.
english: She had scarcely finished speaking when he cut in.

chinese: 你一点方向感都没有。
pinyin: Nǐ yīdiǎn fāngxiànggǎn dōu méiyǒu.
english: You have no sense of direction.

chinese: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。
pinyin: Xiǎngxiànglì yǐngxiǎng zhe wǒmen shēnghuó de gègè fāngmiàn.
english: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.

chinese: 有缘千里来相会，无缘对面不相逢。
pinyin: Yǒuyuán qiānlǐ lái xiānghuì, wúyuán duìmiàn bù xiāngféng.
english: Those fated to meet will do so regardless of distance. Those not fated will not, even if they are across from one another.

chinese: 我不是诗人，无法用一行文字描绘它的美丽。
pinyin: Wǒ bù shì shīrén, wúfǎ yòng yīxíng wénzì miáohuì tā de měilì.
english: I'm not a poet; I couldn't write a single line to depict its beauty.

chinese: 我向天地神明发誓我的话绝无一丝虚假。
pinyin: Wǒ xiàng tiāndì shénmíng fāshì wǒ de huà jué wú yī sī xūjiǎ.
english: I'm not lying. I swear to God!

chinese: 这部电影很无聊，最好的部分是结局。
pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng hěn wúliáo, zuì hǎo de bùfen shì jiéjú.
english: This film is really boring - the best bit is when it finishes.

chinese: 无论发生什么我都不会改主意的。
pinyin: Wúlùn fāshēng shénme wǒ dōu bù huì gǎi zhǔyi de.
english: No matter what happens, I won't change my mind.

chinese: 我上中学的时候有写日记的习惯。
pinyin: Wǒ shàng zhōngxué de shíhou yǒu xiě rìjì de xíguàn.
english: I used to keep a diary when I was at high school.

chinese: 是谁趁我不在的时候看我的日记？
pinyin: Shì shéi chèn wǒ bù zài de shíhou kàn wǒ de rìjì?
english: Who was it that read my diary while I was out?

chinese: 学术造假比你想象的普遍。
pinyin: Xuéshù zàojiǎ bǐ nǐ xiǎngxiàng de pǔbiàn.
english: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.

chinese: 他们说情况只是暂时的。
pinyin: Tāmen shuō qíngkuàng zhǐ shì zànshí de.
english: They said the situation was only temporary.

chinese: 这个房间里面很暖和。
pinyin: Zhège fángjiān lǐmiàn hěn nuǎnhuo.
english: This room is very warm.

chinese: 因为气候又暖和又湿润，所以广州一年到头都有花。
pinyin: Yīnwèi qìhòu yòu nuǎnhuo yòu shīrùn, suǒyǐ Guǎngzhōu yīniándàotóu dōu yǒu huā.
english: With a warm and wet climate, Guangzhou has fresh flowers all year round.

chinese: 我们的眼睛需要时间来适应黑暗。
pinyin: Wǒmen de yǎnjing xūyào shíjiān lái shìyìng hēi'àn.
english: Our eyes take time to adjust to the dark.

chinese: 通常女人都是最后发言有决定权的。
pinyin: Tōngcháng nǚrén dōu shì zuì hòu fāyán yǒu juédìng quán de.
english: Women will have the last word.

chinese: 到了最后的一刻，我的决心突然动摇了。
pinyin: Dào le zuì hòu de yī kè, wǒ de juéxīn tūrán dòngyáo le.
english: My resolution dissolved at the last moment.

chinese: 最后，他们感受到了胜利的喜悦。
pinyin: Zuì hòu, tāmen gǎnshòu dào le shènglì de xǐyuè.
english: At last, they experienced the joy of victory.

chinese: 了解一个国家最好的方法是亲自去看一看。
pinyin: Liǎojiě yī gè guójiā zuì hǎo de fāngfǎ shì qīnzì qù kànyīkàn.
english: The best way to know what a country is like is to go and see it with your own eyes.

chinese: 这本是我拥有的字典之中最好的一本。
pinyin: Zhè běn shì wǒ yōngyǒu de zìdiǎn zhīzhōng zuì hǎo de yī běn.
english: This is the best dictionary that I have.

chinese: 我觉得一部电影比任何书都有趣。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde yī bù diànyǐng bǐ rènhé shū dōu yǒuqù.
english: I think a film is more interesting than any book.

chinese: 那份工作挺有趣味，而且薪金也不错。
pinyin: Nà fèn gōngzuò tǐng yǒuqù wèi, érqiě xīnjīn yě bù cuò.
english: The job is interesting, and then again, the pay is good.

chinese: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。
pinyin: Mòzhī yòngzuò rǎnliào shí huì chǎnshēng yǒuqù de tú'àn.
english: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.

chinese: 他看见色彩鲜艳的鸟、花朵和树叶。
pinyin: Tā kànjiàn sècǎi xiānyàn de niǎo, huāduǒ hé shùyè.
english: He saw brightly-colored birds, flowers and leaves.

chinese: 她为一本书收集材料。
pinyin: Tā wèi yī běn shū shōují cáiliào.
english: She is collecting material for a book.

chinese: 不，如果不从现在开始练习，就来不及了 。
pinyin: Bù, rúguǒ bù cóng xiànzài kāishǐ liànxí, jiù láibují le.
english: No, if you do not start practising from now onwards, it would be too late.

chinese: 那是出车祸了吗？可恶，我现在绝对来不及准时上班了！
pinyin: Nàshi chūchē huò le ma? kěwù, wǒ xiànzài juéduì láibují zhǔnshí shàngbān le!
english: Is that a car accident? Crap, now I'll never make it to work on time!

chinese: 不能吃甜食是极其痛苦的事情。
pinyin: Bù néng chī tiánshí shì jíqí tòngkǔ de shìqing.
english: Not being able to eat sweets is an extremely painful thing.

chinese: 我们昨天试了一下，果然是很好。
pinyin: Wǒmen zuótiān shì le yīxià, guǒrán shì hěn hǎo.
english: We tried it out yesterday; as expected, it was really good.

chinese: 这不是标准的英式读法。
pinyin: Zhè bù shì biāozhǔn de yīng shì dúfǎ.
english: That's not standard English pronunciation.

chinese: 我喜欢她因我的笑话而欢笑的样子。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan tā yīn wǒ de xiàohuà ér huānxiào de yàngzi.
english: I like the way she laughs at my jokes.

chinese: 去年夏天，我们在桥上看焰火看得很过瘾。
pinyin: Qùnián xiàtiān, wǒmen zài qiáo shàng kàn yànhuǒ kàn dehěn guòyǐn.
english: We enjoyed watching the fireworks on a bridge last summer.

chinese: 撇开费用不说，建这座桥也会耗费不少的时间。
pinyin: Piēkāi fèiyòng bù shuō, jiàn zhè zuò qiáo yě huì hàofèi bù shǎo de shíjiān.
english: Apart from the cost, it will take long to build the bridge.

chinese: 我醒来，发现原来一切都是场梦。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐnglái, fāxiàn yuánlái yīqiè dōu shì cháng mèng.
english: I awoke to find everything had been a dream.

chinese: 昨晚我作了一个可怕的梦。
pinyin: Zuówǎn wǒ zuò le yī gè kěpà de mèng.
english: I had a terrible dream last night.

chinese: 我们开出了一条穿过森林的小路。
pinyin: Wǒmen kāi chū le yī tiáo chuānguò sēnlín de xiǎolù.
english: We hacked a path through the forest.

chinese: 森林外有一个美丽的湖泊。
pinyin: Sēnlín wài yǒu yī gè měilì de húpō.
english: A beautiful lake lay just beyond the forest.

chinese: 她缓缓消失在雾气弥漫的森林中。
pinyin: Tā huǎnhuǎn xiāoshī zài wùqì mímàn de sēnlín zhōng.
english: She slowly disappeared into the foggy forest.

chinese: 这种植物在春天开花。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhí wù zài chūn tiān kāi huā。
english: This plant flowers in spring.

chinese: 这类植物只生长在热带地区。
pinyin: Zhèlèi zhíwù zhǐ shēngzhǎng zài rèdàidìqū.
english: This kind of plant grows only in the tropical regions.

chinese: 紫三叶草是一种被蜜蜂用来当作食物来源的植物。
pinyin: Zǐ sānyècǎo shì yīzhǒng bèi mìfēng yònglái dàngzuò shíwù láiyuán de zhíwù.
english: Purple clover is a type of plant that bees use as a source of food.

chinese: 正好那个时候，公交车停下来了。
pinyin: Zhènghǎo nàge shíhou, gōngjiāochē tíngxiàlái le.
english: Just at that time, the bus stopped.

chinese: 这个男人的体温高于正常体温。
pinyin: Zhège nánrén de tǐwēn gāoyú zhèngcháng tǐwēn.
english: The man's body temperature is higher than normal.

chinese: 现在很多年轻人追捧小鲜肉的现象正常吗？
pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō niánqīngrén zhuīpěng xiǎoxiānròu de xiànxiàng zhèngcháng ma?
english: Is it normal that many young people these days idolize pretty boy stars?

chinese: 老王身体检查的结果别的方面都挺正常，就是血压有点高。
pinyin: Lǎo Wáng shēntǐjiǎnchá de jiéguǒ biéde fāngmiàn dōu tǐng zhèngcháng, jiùshì xuèyā yǒudiǎn gāo.
english: In other aspects, the results of Laowang's health examination were all quite normal; it was just that his blood pressure was a bit high.

chinese: 就好像那证明了英语是正确的。
pinyin: Jiù hǎoxiàng nà zhèngmíng le Yīngyǔ shì zhèngquè de.
english: Just as if that was proof that that was correct English.

chinese: 她坚持认为自己的分析是正确的。
pinyin: Tā jiānchí rènwéi zìjǐ de fēnxī shì zhèngquè de.
english: She persists in saying that her analysis is correct.

chinese: 每个人都可以协助确保句子念起来正确且拼写正确。
pinyin: Měigerén dōu kěyǐ xiézhù quèbǎo jùzi niàn qǐlai zhèngquè qiě pīnxiě zhèngquè.
english: Everyone can help ensure that sentences sound correct, and are correctly spelled.

chinese: 如果你死了，你的家人会怎样呢？
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ sǐ le, nǐ de jiārén huì zěnyàng ne?
english: If you should die, what would become of your family?

chinese: 胆小鬼在真正断气之前已经死过很多次。
pinyin: Dǎnxiǎoguǐ zài zhēnzhèng duànqì zhīqián yǐjīng sǐ guo hěn duōcì.
english: Cowards die many times before their deaths.

chinese: 人固有一死。
pinyin: Rén gù yǒu yī sǐ.
english: All shall die.

chinese: 我母亲在水果店买了好几个苹果。
pinyin: Wǒ mǔqīn zài shuǐguǒ diàn mǎi le hǎojǐ gè píngguǒ.
english: My mother bought several apples at the fruit store.

chinese: 母亲从来没有因为我们而不耐烦。
pinyin: Mǔqīn cóngláiméiyǒu yīnwèi wǒmen ér bù nàifán.
english: Mother is never impatient with us.

chinese: 他母亲的离世带给他悲伤和遗憾。
pinyin: Tā mǔqīn de líshì dàigěi tā bēishāng hé yíhàn.
english: The loss of his mother brought him sorrow and regret.

chinese: 每个母亲都疼爱自己的孩子。
pinyin: Měi gè mǔqīn dōu téng'ài zìjǐ de háizi.
english: Every mother has affection for her child.

chinese: 母亲把药膏涂在了我膝盖的伤口上。
pinyin: Mǔqīn bǎ yàogāo tú zài le wǒ xīgài de shāngkǒu shàng.
english: Mother applied the medicine to the sore on my knee.

chinese: 他用毛巾弄干自己。
pinyin: Tā yòng máojīn nòng gàn zìjǐ.
english: He dried himself with a towel.

chinese: 帮我递一下毛巾。
pinyin: Bāng wǒ dì yīxià máojīn.
english: Hand me my towel.

chinese: 汤姆拧干毛巾挂起来晾干。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ níng gān máojīn guàqǐlái liànggān.
english: Tom wrung out the towel and hung it up to dry.

chinese: 我国是温带气候。
pinyin: Wǒguó shì wēndài qìhòu.
english: Our country's climate is temperate.

chinese: 我毫无希望地走着，已经屈服在永远被抛弃的命运之下。
pinyin: Wǒ háowú xīwàng de zǒu zhe, yǐjīng qūfú zài yǒngyuǎn bèi pāoqì de mìngyùn zhīxià.
english: I walked without hope, already resigned to the certain fate of being abandoned forever.

chinese: 这座村没有空气污染。
pinyin: Zhè zuò cūn méiyǒu kōngqìwūrǎn.
english: This village is free from air pollution.

chinese: 我们有一节关于环境污染的讲座。
pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu yī jiē guānyú huánjìngwūrǎn de jiǎngzuò.
english: We had a lecture on environmental pollution.

chinese: 工厂的废料导致了严重的环境污染。
pinyin: Gōngchǎng de fèiliào dǎozhì le yánzhòng de huánjìng wūrǎn.
english: The factory waste gave rise to serious environmental pollution.

chinese: 环境污染正造成异常的天气情况。
pinyin: Huánjìngwūrǎn zhèng zàochéng yìcháng de tiānqì qíngkuàng.
english: Environmental pollution is causing abnormal weather conditions.

chinese: 一个好的厨师不会丢掉昨天的汤。
pinyin: Yī gè hǎo de chúshī bù huì diūdiào zuótiān de tāng.
english: A good cook doesn't throw out yesterday's soup.

chinese: 我姥姥只喝了点儿汤。
pinyin: Wǒ lǎolao zhǐ hē le diǎnr tāng.
english: My grandma just drank a bit of soup.

chinese: 有人在这张沙发上睡过。
pinyin: Yǒurén zài zhè zhāng shāfā shàng shuì guo.
english: Somebody has been sleeping on this sofa.

chinese: 这张沙发起码可以坐三个人。
pinyin: Zhè zhāng shāfā qǐmǎ kěyǐ zuò sān gèrén.
english: This sofa can seat three people easily.

chinese: 尊重法律是我们社会的基础。
pinyin: Zūnzhòng fǎlǜ shì wǒmen shèhuì de jīchǔ.
english: Respect for law is fundamental to our society.

chinese: 如果你违反了法律, 你将受到惩罚。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ wéifǎn le fǎlǜ, nǐ jiāng shòudào chéngfá.
english: You'll be punished if you break the law.

chinese: 他得到了法律硕士学位。
pinyin: Tā dédào le fǎlǜ shuòshìxuéwèi.
english: He got a master's degree in law.

chinese: 一项新的法律生效了。
pinyin: Yī xiàng xīn de fǎlǜ shēngxiào le.
english: A new law has come into existence.

chinese: 你把衣服从洗衣机里拿出来了吗？
pinyin: Nǐ bǎ yīfu cóng xǐyījī lǐ náchū lái le ma?
english: Did you take the clothes out of the washing machine?

chinese: 在我们公司每月都会举办社团活动。
pinyin: Zài wǒmen gōngsī měiyuè dōu huì jǔbàn shètuán huódòng.
english: Every month at our company, they run a community activity.

chinese: 网络是一个相通的渠道，而不是物质或具体的活动。
pinyin: Wǎngluò shì yī gè xiāngtōng de qúdào, ér bù shì wùzhì huò jùtǐ de huódòng.
english: It’s a communication medium, not a substance or specific activity.

chinese: 他有点活泼。
pinyin: Tā yǒudiǎn huópo.
english: He's a bit lively.

chinese: 他说法语说得很流利。
pinyin: Tā shuō Fǎyǔ shuō de hěn liúlì.
english: He is fluent in French.

chinese: 她流泪了。
pinyin: Tā liúlèi le.
english: She shed tears.

chinese: 这个说法一下子就流行开来了。
pinyin: Zhège shuōfa yīxiàzi jiù liúxíng kāi lái le.
english: This saying suddenly became popular.

chinese: 这一天只是浪费时间，浪费金钱。
pinyin: Zhè yī tiān zhǐ shì làngfèi shíjiān, làngfèi jīnqián.
english: This day was just a waste of time and money.

chinese: 太平洋是世界上最大的海洋。
pinyin: Tàipíng Yáng shì shìjiè shàng zuì dà de hǎiyáng.
english: The Pacific is the largest ocean in the world.

chinese: 他听到消息后从椅子里跳了出来。
pinyin: Tā tīngdào xiāoxi hòu cóng yǐzi lǐ tiào le chūlái.
english: Hearing the news, he jumped out of his chair.

chinese: 今天的报纸中有没有什么特殊消息呢？
pinyin: Jīntiān de bàozhǐ zhōng yǒuméiyǒu shénme tèshū xiāoxi ne?
english: Is there any special news in today's paper?

chinese: 充分氧化反应赋予红茶浓郁醇厚的风味和深琥珀色。
pinyin: Chōngfèn yǎnghuà fǎnyìng fùyǔ hóngchá nóng yù chúnhòu de fēngwèi hé shēn hǔpò sè.
english: Full oxidation gives black tea its deep, robust flavor and dark amber color.

chinese: 这班公车客满了。你必须等下一班。
pinyin: Zhè bān gōngchē kèmǎn le. nǐ bìxū děng xià yī bān.
english: The bus is full. You'll have to wait for the next one.

chinese: 房子里放满了五颜六色的艺术品。
pinyin: Fángzi lǐ fàng mǎn le wǔyánliùsè de yìshùpǐn.
english: The house was full of colorful art objects.

chinese: 对不起，航班已经客满了。
pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, hángbān yǐjīng kèmǎn le.
english: Sorry, the flight is already full.

chinese: 她心中充满了成为女演员的梦想。
pinyin: Tā xīnzhōng chōngmǎn le chéngwéi nǚ yǎnyuán de mèngxiǎng.
english: Her mind is filled with dreams of becoming an actress.

chinese: 我快要激动得说不出话来了。
pinyin: Wǒ kuài yào jīdòng de shuōbuchū huà lái le.
english: I'm getting choked up.

chinese: 你现在说这种话，只会火上加油。
pinyin: Nǐ xiànzài shuō zhèzhǒng huà, zhǐ huì huǒshàngjiāyóu.
english: For you to come out and say that kind of thing now would just be pouring oil on the fire.

chinese: 这简直是太可惜了，他们没有买火险。
pinyin: Zhè jiǎnzhí shì tài kěxī le, tāmen méiyǒu mǎi huǒ xiǎn.
english: It's a crying shame that they weren't insured against fire.

chinese: 我们昨天进行了火警演习。
pinyin: Wǒmen zuótiān jìnxíng le huǒjǐng yǎnxí.
english: We had a fire drill yesterday.

chinese: 现在有什么烦恼的事情吗？
pinyin: Xiànzài yǒu shénme fánnǎo de shìqing ma?
english: Is there anything that worries you right now?

chinese: 然而这也算不上什么像样的东西。
pinyin: Rán'ér zhè yě suànbúshàng shénme xiàngyàng de dōngxi.
english: But it isn't even worth calling stuff.

chinese: 起初我们并不熟悉，渐渐地就熟悉起来了。
pinyin: Qǐchū wǒmen bìngbù shúxī, jiànjiàn de jiù shúxī qǐlai le.
english: At first, we weren't familiar at all. Over time we got to know each other.

chinese: 你不喜欢爱情故事，是吗？
pinyin: Nǐ bù xǐhuan àiqíng gùshi, shì ma?
english: You don't like love stories, do you?

chinese: 生命中唯一重要的事情是爱情和工作。
pinyin: Shēngmìng zhōng wéiyī zhòngyào de shìqing shì àiqíng hé gōngzuò.
english: The only important things in life are love and work.

chinese: 他俩的爱情，已经上升了一个台阶。
pinyin: Tā liǎ de àiqíng, yǐjīng shàngshēng le yī gè táijiē.
english: Their love has gone to the next level.

chinese: 爱情让他盲目到看不到她的错。
pinyin: Àiqíng ràng tā mángmù dào kàn bù dào tā de cuò.
english: Love blinded him to her faults.

chinese: 我父亲很穷并不让我觉得丢脸。
pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn hěn qióng bìngbù ràng wǒ juéde diūliǎn.
english: I'm not ashamed of my father being poor.

chinese: 我有一位朋友，他的父亲是著名小说家。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī wèi péngyou, tā de fùqīn shì zhùmíng xiǎoshuōjiā.
english: I have a friend whose father is a famous novelist.

chinese: 听到你父亲去世的消息我很难过。
pinyin: Tīngdào nǐ fùqīn qùshì de xiāoxi wǒ hěn nánguò.
english: I'm sorry to hear that your father passed away.

chinese: 父亲给我买了最新型的摩托车。
pinyin: Fùqīn gěi wǒ mǎi le zuì xīnxíng de mótuōchē.
english: Father bought me the latest model motorcycle.

chinese: 这种新型的城市生活有什么特点？
pinyin: Zhèzhǒng xīnxíng de chéngshì shēnghuó yǒu shénme tèdiǎn?
english: What's new about this way of urban living?

chinese: 每条狗在自己家就是狮子。
pinyin: Měi tiáo gǒu zài zìjǐ jiā jiùshì shīzi.
english: Every dog is a lion at home.

chinese: 狮子在跟踪它的猎物。
pinyin: Shīzi zài gēnzōng tā de lièwù.
english: The lion is stalking its prey.

chinese: 但你很可能猜得到会发生什么。
pinyin: Dàn nǐ hěn kěnéng cāi de dào huì fāshēng shénme.
english: You can probably guess what happens though.

chinese: 元宵节要猜灯谜。
pinyin: Yuánxiāojié yào cāi dēngmí.
english: It is a must to guess lantern riddles during the Lantern Festival.

chinese: 那不是猪，而是猴子。
pinyin: Nà bù shì zhū, érshì hóuzi.
english: It's not a pig; it's a monkey.

chinese: 我不是在跟你说话，我在跟猴子说话。
pinyin: Wǒ bù shì zài gēn nǐ shuōhuà, wǒ zài gēn hóuzi shuōhuà.
english: I'm not talking to you; I'm talking to the monkey.

chinese: 现代交通使我们能在几天内环绕地球。
pinyin: Xiàndài jiāotōng shǐ wǒmen néng zài jǐ tiān nèi huánrào dìqiú.
english: Modern travel enables us to go around the world in a few days.

chinese: 天文学同时是最古老也最现代的科学。
pinyin: Tiānwénxué tóngshí shì zuì gǔlǎo yě zuì xiàndài de kēxué.
english: Astronomy is at the same time the most ancient and the most modern science.

chinese: 我明天去理发。
pinyin: Wǒ míng tiān qù lǐ fà。
english: I am getting a haircut tomorrow.

chinese: 他表明自己是一个理想的丈夫。
pinyin: Tā biǎomíng zìjǐ shì yī gè lǐxiǎng de zhàngfu.
english: He's making it clear that he's an ideal husband.

chinese: 海滩是一个供孩子们玩乐的理想场所。
pinyin: Hǎitān shì yī gè gōng háizimen wánlè de lǐxiǎng chǎngsuǒ.
english: The beach is an ideal place for children to play.

chinese: 看起来，这是一个你无法理解的东西。
pinyin: Kànqǐlai, zhè shì yī gè nǐ wúfǎ lǐjiě de dōngxi.
english: It seems this is something you can't comprehend.

chinese: 这个理论对我来说太难了，理解不了。
pinyin: Zhège lǐlùn duì wǒ lái shuō tài nán le, lǐjiěbuliǎo.
english: This theory is too difficult for me to comprehend.

chinese: 瓶子里面已经没有水了。
pinyin: Píngzi lǐ miàn yǐjīng méiyǒu shuǐ le.
english: There is no water left in the bottle.

chinese: 甚至在日落之后，气温也不见降低。
pinyin: Shènzhì zài rìluò zhīhòu, qìwēn yě bù jiàn jiàngdī.
english: Even after sunset there was little moderation in the temperature.

chinese: 丹甚至没有上过基础解剖课。
pinyin: Dān shènzhì méiyǒu shàng guo jīchǔ jiěpōu kè.
english: Dan didn't even take basic anatomy classes.

chinese: 你是我的生命当中最重要的人。
pinyin: Nǐ shì wǒ de shēngmìng dāngzhōng zuì zhòngyào de rén.
english: You are the most important person in my life.

chinese: 生命确实是好的东西。
pinyin: Shēngmìng quèshí shì hǎo de dōngxi.
english: Life is indeed a good thing.

chinese: 生命是一种致命的性传染病。
pinyin: Shēngmìng shì yīzhǒng zhìmìng de xìng chuánrǎnbìng.
english: Life is a fatal sexually transmitted disease.

chinese: 与她的相遇丰富了他的精神生活。
pinyin: Yǔ tā de xiāngyù fēngfù le tā de jīngshénshēnghuó.
english: His encounter with her is enriching his inner life.

chinese: 我来到这里以后，一直过着单调乏味的生活。
pinyin: Wǒ láidào zhèlǐ yǐhòu, yīzhí guo zhe dāndiàofáwèi de shēnghuó.
english: Life has been so flat since I came here.

chinese: 长年累月东奔西走忙死了，生活太没有规律了。
pinyin: Chángniánlěiyuè dōngbēnxīzǒu máng sǐ le, shēnghuó tài méiyǒu guīlǜ le.
english: I'm so busy running about year in, year out. My life has no consistency.

chinese: 由于缺水，花园里所有的花都死了。
pinyin: Yóuyú quēshuǐ, huāyuán lǐ suǒyǒu de Huādū sǐ le.
english: Due to the water shortage, all the flowers in the garden have died.

chinese: 由于诸多不幸因素，单亲家庭在增长中。
pinyin: Yóuyú zhūduō bù xìng yīnsù, dānqīn jiātíng zài zēngzhǎng zhōng.
english: Due to a number of unfortunate causes, one-parent families are on the increase.

chinese: 由于全球气候变暖，城市可能被完全地淹没。
pinyin: Yóuyú quánqiúqìhòubiànnuǎn, chéngshì kěnéng bèi wánquán de yānmò.
english: Due to global warming, cities could be completely submerged.

chinese: 如果你想要这份工作的话，就一定要在明天之前申请。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎngyào zhè fèn gōngzuò dehuà, jiù yīdìngyào zài míngtiān zhīqián shēnqǐng.
english: If you want this job, you must apply for it by tomorrow.

chinese: 这些女孩当中其中一个被留下来了。
pinyin: Zhèxiē nǚhái dāngzhōng qízhōng yī gè bèi liúxià lái le.
english: One of the girls was left behind.

chinese: 我吃两颗葡萄，剩下的留给你。
pinyin: Wǒ chī liǎng kē pútao, shèngxià de liúgěi nǐ.
english: I'll eat two grapes and leave the rest for you.

chinese: 我打算明年去美国留学。
pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn míngnián qù Měiguó liúxué.
english: I intend to study abroad in America next year.

chinese: 不要把皮肤长时间暴露在阳光里。
pinyin: Bù yào bǎ pífū cháng shíjiān bàolù zài yángguāng lǐ.
english: Skin shouldn't be exposed to sunlight for too long.

chinese: 你觉得再加一点盐味道会更好？
pinyin: Nǐ juéde zài jiā yīdiǎn yán wèidao huì gèng hǎo?
english: You think adding a little salt will make it taste much better?

chinese: 我在鱼上洒盐和胡椒作调味。
pinyin: Wǒ zài yú shàng sǎ yán hé hújiāo zuò tiáowèi.
english: I seasoned the fish with salt and pepper.

chinese: 限制白糖和盐的摄取量。
pinyin: Xiànzhì báitáng hé yán de shèqǔ liáng.
english: Limit the consumption of white sugar and salt.

chinese: 你可以拿大的盒子或是小的盒子。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ ná dà de hézi huòshì xiǎo de hézi.
english: You may take either the big box or the small one.

chinese: 他买土地的目的是要造房子。
pinyin: Tā mǎi tǔdì de mùdì shì yào zào fángzi.
english: He bought the land for the purpose of building a house on it.

chinese: 批评的目的是建设而不是破坏。
pinyin: Pīpíng de mùdì shì jiànshè ér búshì pòhuài.
english: The purpose of criticism is to construct, not to destroy.

chinese: 每一个函数都应该有描述其目的的注释以避免误解。
pinyin: Měi yī gè hánshù dōu yīnggāi yǒu miáoshù qí mùdì de zhùshì yǐ bìmiǎn wùjiě.
english: Every function should have comments describing its purpose in order to avoid confusion.

chinese: 这条路是不是直接通往普拉多博物馆？
pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù shìbùshì zhíjiē tōngwǎng Pǔlā duō bówùguǎn?
english: Is this the direct way to the Prado?

chinese: 他既诚实又勤劳，而他的弟弟正好相反。
pinyin: Tā jì chéngshí yòu qínláo, ér tā de dìdi zhènghǎo xiāngfǎn.
english: He is honest and hard-working, but his brother is the exact opposite.

chinese: 杭州是浙江省的省会。
pinyin: Hángzhōu shì Zhèjiāng Shěng de shěnghuì.
english: Hangzhou is the provincial capital of Zhejiang Province.

chinese: 以下是我们不支持他的看法的理由。
pinyin: Yǐxià shì wǒmen bù zhīchí tā de kànfǎ de lǐyóu.
english: The reason why we cannot support his view will be given below.

chinese: 他坦率地提出了自己的看法
pinyin: Tā tǎnshuài de tíchū le zìjǐ de kànfǎ
english: He frankly expressed his own view.

chinese: 我已经很久没再真正地放假了。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng hěn jiǔ méi zài zhēnzhèng de fàngjià le.
english: It's been a while since I've had a real vacation.

chinese: 没知识的无事干，没事干的无饭吃。
pinyin: Méi zhīshi de wú shì gàn, méishì gàn de wú fàn chī.
english: Those without knowledge can do nothing, and those who can do nothing can eat nothing.

chinese: 我相信，知识就是力量。
pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn, zhīshi jiùshì lìliang.
english: It's my belief that knowledge is power.

chinese: 箱子里面的鸡蛋全都破掉了。
pinyin: Xiāngzi lǐ miàndī jīdàn quándōu pò diào le.
english: All the eggs in the box were broken.

chinese: 下个月就要进行硕士论文答辩了。
pinyin: Xiàgèyuè jiùyào jìnxíng shuòshì lùnwén dábiàn le.
english: The defense of the master thesis is just happening next month.

chinese: 这块石头很硬。
pinyin: Zhè kuài shí tou hěn yìng。
english: This stone is very hard.

chinese: 我不小心格式化了你的硬盘。
pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎoxīn géshìhuà le nǐ de yìngpán.
english: I've formatted your hard disk by mistake.

chinese: 美国是一个自称没有社会阶层的国家。
pinyin: Měiguó shì yī gè zìchēng méiyǒu shèhuìjiēcéng de guójiā.
english: America likes to claim that it is a "classless" society.

chinese: 大家都祝贺她通过了考试。
pinyin: Dà jiā dōu zhù hè tā tōng guò le kǎo shì。
english: Everyone congratulated her on passing the exam.

chinese: 他的父亲把一生奉献给了科学。
pinyin: Tā de fùqīn bǎ yīshēng fèngxiàn gěi le kēxué.
english: His father dedicated his life to science.

chinese: 为什么这个月房东还不来收房租？
pinyin: Wèishénme zhège yuè fángdōng hái bù lái shōu fángzū?
english: Why hasn't the landlord come to collect rent this month?

chinese: 你必须付三个月的房租作为押金。
pinyin: Nǐ bìxū fù sān gè yuè de fángzū zuòwéi yājīn.
english: You have to give three months' rent as a deposit.

chinese: 试着用积极的态度去面对任何事情。
pinyin: Shìzhe yòng jījí de tàidu qù miànduì rènhé shìqing.
english: Try to have a positive attitude about everything.

chinese: 我们需要积累经验。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào jī lěi jīng yàn。
english: We need to accumulate experience.

chinese: 稍微等一等，马上就好！
pinyin: Shāowēi děngyideng, mǎshàng jiù hǎo!
english: Wait just a little bit. It'll be done immediately.

chinese: 那里究竟发生了什么事？
pinyin: Nàli jiūjìng fāshēng le shénme shì?
english: What exactly happened there?

chinese: 那位老者捐了一大笔钱去帮助穷人。
pinyin: Nà wèi lǎozhě juān le yī dà bǐ qián qù bāngzhù qióngrén.
english: The old man contributed a large sum of money to the poor.

chinese: 这个穷小子最后成为了一个了不起的艺术家。
pinyin: Zhège qióng xiǎozǐ zuì hòu chéngwéi le yī gè liǎobuqǐ de yìshùjiā.
english: The poor young man finally became a great artist.

chinese: 每一个人对事情的看法不同是依据他们是富有还是贫穷。
pinyin: Měi yīgèrén duì shìqing de kànfǎ bù tóng shì yījù tāmen shì fùyǒu háishi pínqióng.
english: A person views things differently according to whether they are rich or poor.

chinese: 这个家庭非常贫穷以至于无法偿还贷款。
pinyin: Zhège jiātíng fēicháng pínqióng yǐzhìyú wúfǎ chánghuán dàikuǎn.
english: The family is too poor to pay back the debts.

chinese: 众所周知，空气是多种气体的混合体。
pinyin: Zhòngsuǒzhōuzhī, kōngqì shì duōzhǒng qìtǐ de hùnhétǐ.
english: As everyone knows, air is a mixture of gases.

chinese: 她把窗帘挂在窗户上。
pinyin: Tā bǎ chuānglián guà zài chuānghu shàng.
english: She hung a curtain over the window.

chinese: 透过办公室的窗户可以清晰地看见城市的风景。
pinyin: Tòuguò bàngōngshì de chuānghu kěyǐ qīngxī de kànjiàn chéngshì de fēngjǐng.
english: You can see the city view clearly from the office window.

chinese: 但是，在「真实的大人世界」里是有很多竞争的。
pinyin: Dànshì, zài 「 zhēnshí de dàren shìjiè 」 lǐ shì yǒu hěn duō jìngzhēng de.
english: And yet, in the "real adult world" there are a lot of competitions.

chinese: 他竟然厚着脸皮穿过我们的花园。
pinyin: Tā jìngrán hòu zhe liǎnpí chuānguò wǒmen de huāyuán.
english: He had the impudence to cut across our garden.

chinese: 在我的笔记本里早就有这个词了。
pinyin: Zài wǒ de bǐjìběn lǐ zǎojiù yǒu zhège cí le.
english: This word has been in my notebook for a long time.

chinese: 我的笔记本是粉色的。
pinyin: Wǒ de bǐjìběn shì fěnsè de.
english: My notebook is pink.

chinese: 我不认识符合条件的人。
pinyin: Wǒ bù rènshi fúhé tiáojiàn de rén.
english: I don't know anyone who meets that description.

chinese: “拜个不够行的师父，很伤脑筋吧？”　“我也很笨，所以没关系。”
pinyin: "bài gè bù gòu xíng de shīfu, hěn shāngnǎojīn ba?" "wǒ yě hěn bèn, suǒyǐ méiguānxi."
english: "It must bother you to have taken a bad master." "I'm stupid too. So, it's all right."

chinese: 请你把这张表填一下，等我们的通知。
pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè zhāng biǎo tián yīxià, děng wǒmen de tōngzhī.
english: Please fill out this form and wait for us to notify you.

chinese: 世上有两件事不能等：一、孝顺 二、行善。
pinyin: Shìshàng yǒu liǎng jiàn shì bù néng děng: yī, xiàoshùn èr, xíngshàn.
english: There are two things in the world that cannot wait: 1. Filial piety, 2. Doing good.

chinese: 你真的需要提问题来知道答案吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zhēn de xūyào tí wèntí lái zhīdào dá'àn ma?
english: Do you really need to ask the question to know the answer?

chinese: 她给了我们一个模糊的答案。
pinyin: Tā gěi le wǒmen yī gè móhu de dá'àn.
english: She gave us a vague answer.

chinese: 就算你不喜欢，你也要负责管理。
pinyin: Jiùsuàn nǐ bù xǐhuan, nǐ yě yào fùzé guǎnlǐ.
english: Even if you do not like it, you must take charge of it.

chinese: 我读了三篇文章。
pinyin: Wǒ dú le sān piān wén zhāng。
english: I read three articles.

chinese: 你一定不要错过这部精彩的电影。
pinyin: Nǐ yīdìng bù yào cuòguò zhè bù jīngcǎi de diànyǐng.
english: You mustn't miss seeing this wonderful film.

chinese: 他被很多人围着，自然变得有点紧张。
pinyin: Tā bèi hěn duō rén wéi zhe, zìrán biànde yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng.
english: With so many people around he naturally became a bit nervous.

chinese: 没有你们，就没有这个组织。
pinyin: Méiyǒu nǐmen, jiù méiyǒu zhège zǔzhī.
english: This organization cannot exist without you.

chinese: 我们在那里有一个不愉快的经历。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài nàli yǒu yī gè bù yúkuài de jīnglì.
english: We had an unpleasant experience there.

chinese: 它也会促进城市的经济发展。
pinyin: Tā yě huì cùjìn chéngshì de jīngjìfāzhǎn.
english: It will also help to strengthen the city's economy.

chinese: 台湾是出口导向的经济体。
pinyin: Táiwān shì chūkǒu dǎoxiàng de jīngjì tǐ.
english: Taiwan is an export-oriented economy.

chinese: 减税常被用作刺激经济的主要财政手段。
pinyin: Jiǎnshuì cháng bèi yòngzuò cìjī jīngjì de zhǔyào cáizhèng shǒuduàn.
english: Tax cuts are often used as a major fiscal tool to stimulate the economy.

chinese: 美国是世界最大的经济体并拥有最强的军队。
pinyin: Měiguó shì shìjiè zuì dà de jīngjì tǐ bìng yōngyǒu zuì qiáng de jūnduì.
english: America has the world’s largest economy, and its army is the most powerful.

chinese: 他刚刚大学毕业，所以没什么经验。
pinyin: Tā gānggang dàxué bìyè, suǒyǐ méishénme jīngyàn.
english: He is fresh from college, so he has no experience.

chinese: 我们正在寻找具有客服工作经验的人。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài xúnzhǎo jùyǒu kèfú gōngzuò jīngyàn de rén.
english: We're looking for someone who has experience in customer service.

chinese: 他的智慧和经验使他能处理这个麻烦。
pinyin: Tā de zhìhuì hé jīngyàn shǐ tā néng chǔlǐ zhège máfan.
english: His intelligence and experience enabled him to deal with the trouble.

chinese: 他们的调查结果显示这篇报导是真实的。
pinyin: Tāmen de diàochájiéguǒ xiǎnshì zhè piān bàodǎo shì zhēnshí de.
english: The report proved true as a result of their investigation.

chinese: 机械力代替人力, 这是蒸汽机发明的结果。
pinyin: Jīxiè lì dàitì rénlì, zhè shì zhēngqìjī fāmíng de jiéguǒ.
english: The result of the invention of the steam engine was that human power was replaced by mechanical power.

chinese: 预言被实验结果推翻了。
pinyin: Yùyán bèi shíyàn jiéguǒ tuīfān le.
english: The prediction was falsified by the result.

chinese: 我们可以继续玩，别吵到别人就行了。
pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ jìxù wán, bié chǎo dào biéren jiù xíng le.
english: We can continue playing, as long as we don't make too much noise.

chinese: 如果系统工程师继续离开，公司的竞争优势将会被削弱。
pinyin: Rúguǒ xìtǒng gōngchéngshī jìxù líkāi, gōngsī de jìngzhēng yōushì jiānghuì bèi xuēruò.
english: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.

chinese: 裁判根据有利原则，举起手示意继续进攻。
pinyin: Cáipàn gēnjù yǒulì yuánzé, jǔqǐ shǒu shìyì jìxù jìngōng.
english: The referee, according to principle of advantage, raised his hand and motioned for the advance to continue.

chinese: 她有很多缺点，但我还是这么信她。
pinyin: Tā yǒu hěn duō quēdiǎn, dàn wǒ háishi zhème xìn tā.
english: She has many faults, but I trust her none the less.

chinese: 从现实的角度看，他的计划有很多缺点。
pinyin: Cóng xiànshí de jiǎodù kàn, tā de jìhuà yǒu hěn duō quēdiǎn.
english: From the practical point of view, there are many shortcomings in his plan.

chinese: 我以前星期天常常和他去打网球。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián Xīngqītiān chángcháng hé tā qù dǎ wǎngqiú.
english: I often used to play tennis with him on Sundays.

chinese: 她喜欢网球并成为了一个网球教练。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuan wǎngqiú bìng chéngwéi le yī gè wǎngqiú jiàoliàn.
english: She liked tennis and became a tennis coach.

chinese: 我有些同学喜欢排球，也有些喜欢网球。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒuxiē tóngxué xǐhuan páiqiú, yě yǒuxiē xǐhuan wǎngqiú.
english: Some of my classmates like volleyball and others enjoy tennis.

chinese: 我觉得这个网站的概念非常好。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhège wǎngzhàn de gàiniàn fēicháng hǎo.
english: I really like the concept of this website.

chinese: 我改了一下我的网站的布局。
pinyin: Wǒ gǎi le yīxià wǒ de wǎngzhàn de bùjú.
english: I've changed my website's layout.

chinese: 我们望着这美丽的风景。
pinyin: Wǒmen wàng zhe zhè měilì de fēngjǐng.
english: We gazed at the beautiful scenery.

chinese: 阿尔及尔有一条美丽的海滨长廊。
pinyin: Ā'ěrjí'ěr yǒu yī tiáo měilì de hǎibīn chángláng.
english: Algiers has a beautiful promenade on the seashore.

chinese: 从飞机上看，那是个非常美丽的岛屿。
pinyin: Cóng fēijī shàng kàn, nàshi gè fēicháng měilì de dǎoyǔ.
english: Seen from a plane, that island is very beautiful.

chinese: 你们家去北海道旅游是真的么？我羡慕你。
pinyin: Nǐmen jiā qù Běihǎidào lǚyóu shì zhēn de me? wǒ xiànmù nǐ.
english: Is it true that your family will travel in Hokkaido? I envy you.

chinese: 我差点在人群中和你失散了。
pinyin: Wǒ chàdiǎn zài rénqún zhōnghé nǐ shīsàn le.
english: I all but lost you in the crowd.

chinese: 小偷迅速地窜入了人群。
pinyin: Xiǎotōu xùnsù de cuàn rù le rénqún.
english: The thief whipped out into the crowd.

chinese: 我以前常去打羽毛球，但现在不打了。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián cháng qù dǎ yǔmáoqiú, dàn xiànzài bù dǎ le.
english: I used to play badminton a lot, but I don’t play anymore.

chinese: 要翻译那篇论文，我最少需要三天时间。
pinyin: Yào fānyì nà piān lùnwén, wǒ zuì shǎo xūyào sān tiānshí jiān.
english: I'll need at least three days to translate that thesis.

chinese: 那个男人戴着一个老虎的面具。
pinyin: Nàge nánrén dài zhe yī gè lǎohǔ de miànjù.
english: That man was wearing a tiger mask.

chinese: 耐心地坚持下去，这些事急不来。
pinyin: Nàixīn de jiānchí xiàqù, zhè xiē shì jí bù lái.
english: Be patient and persistent. These things take time.

chinese: 她非常周到和耐心。
pinyin: Tā fēicháng zhōudào hé nàixīn.
english: She is very thoughtful and patient.

chinese: 这发明是多年来耐心实验的成果。
pinyin: Zhè fāmíng shì duōniánlái nàixīn shíyàn de chéngguǒ.
english: This invention was the result of years of patient experiment.

chinese: 我要么去看电影，要么和朋友聊天。
pinyin: Wǒ yàome qù kàn diànyǐng, yàome hé péngyou liáotiān.
english: I am either going to watch a movie, or chat with my friends.

chinese: 教书是我自己选择的职业。
pinyin: Jiāoshū shì wǒ zìjǐ xuǎnzé de zhíyè.
english: Teaching is a profession of my own choosing.

chinese: 我们联系上他们已经为时已晚。
pinyin: Wǒmen liánxì shàng tāmen yǐjīng wéishíyǐwǎn.
english: We were unable to make contact with them until it was too late.

chinese: 我们的工作人员会在三个工作日内联系您。
pinyin: Wǒmen de gōngzuòrényuán huì zài sān gè gōngzuòrì nèi liánxì nín.
english: Our staff will contact you in three working days.

chinese: 你记事情的能力并不比我好多少。
pinyin: Nǐ jì shìqíng de nénglì bìngbù bǐ wǒ hǎo duōshao.
english: You are no better at remembering things than I am.

chinese: 这些衣服很脏，需要洗一洗。
pinyin: Zhè xiē yī fu hěn zāng， xū yào xǐ yī xǐ。
english: These clothes are dirty and need washing.

chinese: 他动不动就发脾气，所以人人都怕了他。
pinyin: Tā dòngbudòng jiù fāpíqì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu pà le tā.
english: He loses his temper so easily that everybody avoids him.

chinese: 自然中没有什么是无用的。
pinyin: Zìrán zhōng méiyǒushénme shì wúyòng de.
english: Nothing in nature is useless.

chinese: 彩虹是自然界最美的现象之一。
pinyin: Cǎihóng shì zìránjiè zuì Měidí xiànxiàng zhīyī.
english: A rainbow is one of the most beautiful phenomena of nature.

chinese: 她通过一首诗表达了她对大自然的感受。
pinyin: Tā tōngguò yī shǒu shī biǎodá le tā duì dàzìrán de gǎnshòu.
english: She expressed her feelings for nature in a poem.

chinese: 自然从不会欺骗我们，骗我们的永远是我们自己。
pinyin: Zìrán cóngbù huì qīpiàn wǒmen, piàn wǒmen de yǒngyuǎn shì wǒmen zìjǐ.
english: Nature never deceives us; it is always we who deceive ourselves.

chinese: 我想要再确认一下我的航班。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngyào zài quèrèn yīxià wǒ de hángbān.
english: I want to quickly confirm my flight again.

chinese: 一些抽象艺术是很难理解的。
pinyin: Yīxiē chōuxiàng yìshù shì hěn nán lǐjiě de.
english: Some abstract art is difficult to understand.

chinese: 生活真正的艺术是在平凡中看到不平凡。
pinyin: Shēnghuó zhēnzhèng de yìshù shì zài píngfán zhōngkàn dào bù píngfán.
english: True art of life is to see the extraordinary amongst the ordinary.

chinese: 线条艺术强调形式和轮廓，而不是颜色、阴影和纹理。
pinyin: Xiàntiáo yìshù qiángdiào xíngshì hé lúnkuò, ér bù shì yánsè, yīnyǐng hé wénlǐ.
english: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.

chinese: 这样做你能节约几个小时。
pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò nǐ néng jiéyuē jǐge xiǎoshí.
english: If you do it this way, you can save several hours.

chinese: 这超出了我的想像范围。
pinyin: Zhè chāochū le wǒ de xiǎngxiàng fànwéi.
english: This is beyond the scope of my imagination.

chinese: 他告诉我他已经获得了原谅。
pinyin: Tā gàosu wǒ tā yǐjīng huòdé le yuánliàng.
english: He told me that he'd been forgiven.

chinese: 我一生中从没见过那么多血。
pinyin: Wǒ yīshēng zhōng cóngméi jiàn guo nàme duō xuè.
english: I've never seen so much blood in my life.

chinese: 这样做行吗？
pinyin: Zhè yàng zuò xíng ma？
english: Is it okay to do it this way?

chinese: 您只需填写这个表格就可以了。
pinyin: Nín zhǐ xū tiánxiě zhège biǎogé jiù kěyǐ le.
english: All you have to do is fill in this form.

chinese: 民间运动表达了民间的不满。
pinyin: Mínjiān yùndòng biǎodá le mínjiān de bù mǎn.
english: Popular movements express popular displeasure.

chinese: 男孩穿着袜子就上床睡觉了。
pinyin: Nánhái chuān zhe wàzi jiù shàngchuáng shuìjiào le.
english: The boy went to bed with his socks on.

chinese: 请解释一下这个词的意思。
pinyin: Qǐng jiě shì yī xià zhè gè cí de yì si。
english: Please explain what this word means.

chinese: 等到警察来的时候，天大概也黑了吧。
pinyin: Děngdào jǐngchá lái de shíhou, tiān dàgài yě hēi le ba.
english: It will be dark by the time the police come here.

chinese: 警察收集了很多对他不利的证据。
pinyin: Jǐngchá shōují le hěn duō duì tā bù lì de zhèngjù.
english: The police assembled a lot of evidence against him.

chinese: 这个男人被警察拘留了。
pinyin: Zhège nánrén bèi jǐngchá jūliú le.
english: The man was held in police custody.

chinese: 警察以走私为由逮捕了他。
pinyin: Jǐngchá yǐ zǒusī wèi yóu dàibǔ le tā.
english: The police arrested him for smuggling.

chinese: 我们的计划从一开始就出错了。
pinyin: Wǒmen de jìhuà cóng yī kāishǐ jiù chūcuò le.
english: Our plan went wrong from the beginning.

chinese: 那就是我不赞同你的计划的原因。
pinyin: Nà jiùshì wǒ bù zàntóng nǐ de jìhuà de yuányīn.
english: That's why I don't approve of your plan.

chinese: 我在这项计划上投入了所有精力。
pinyin: Wǒ zài zhè xiàng jìhuà shàng tóurù le suǒyǒu jīnglì.
english: I've put all of my energy into this plan.

chinese: 以前我是讨厌做菜，可现在我很喜欢。
pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ shì tǎoyàn zuòcài, kě xiànzài wǒ hěn xǐhuan.
english: I used to hate cooking, but now I like it.

chinese: 最近的咖啡短缺带来了许多问题。
pinyin: Zuì jìn de kāfēi duǎnquē dàilái le xǔduō wèntí.
english: The recent coffee shortage brought about many problems.

chinese: 许多动画的共同语言是字幕。
pinyin: Xǔduō dònghuà de gòngtóng yǔyán shì zìmù.
english: The common language of many anime is subtitles.

chinese: 印度尼西亚有许多残留日本兵。
pinyin: Yìndùníxīyà yǒu xǔduō cánliú Rìběn bīng.
english: Indonesia had many Japanese holdout soldiers.

chinese: 许多年轻人在战争中因为民主而死去。
pinyin: Xǔduō niánqīngrén zài zhànzhēng zhōng yīnwèi mínzhǔ ér sǐqù.
english: Many young men died in the cause of democracy during the war.

chinese: 每年有成千上万的外国人访问日本。
pinyin: Měinián yǒu chéngqiān-shàngwàn de wàiguórén fǎngwèn Rìběn.
english: Thousands of foreigners visit Japan every year.

chinese: 他迫不及待地想试一下他的新冲浪板。
pinyin: Tā pòbùjídài de xiǎng shì yīxià tā de xīn chōnglàngbǎn.
english: He couldn't wait to try out his new surfboard.

chinese: 我认为她是一个诚实的女人。
pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi tā shì yī gè chéngshí de nǚrén.
english: I think she's an honest woman.

chinese: 我们无法否认，他确实是很诚实的人。
pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ fǒurèn, tā quèshí shì hěn chéngshí de rén.
english: We can't deny the fact that he's honest.

chinese: 不留名或详细的参考什么都可以。
pinyin: Bù liú míng huò xiángxì de cānkǎo shénme dōu kěyǐ.
english: Anonymity or detailed reference are both fine.

chinese: 他详细地叙述了那场意外的经过。
pinyin: Tā xiángxì de xù shù le nà chǎng yìwài de jīngguò.
english: He gave a detailed description of the accident.

chinese: 听说意大利语是一门很难的语言 。
pinyin: Tīngshuō Yìdàlìyǔ shì yī mén hěn nán de yǔyán.
english: I've heard Italian is a tricky language.

chinese: 请说明你选择这个方法的原因。
pinyin: Qǐng shuō míng nǐ xuǎn zé zhè gè fāng fǎ de yuán yīn。
english: Please explain why you chose this method.

chinese: 我不知道他请假的原因。
pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào tā qǐngjià de yuányīn.
english: I don't know the reason why he was absent.

chinese: 革命不是请客吃饭。
pinyin: Gémìng bù shì qǐngkè chīfàn.
english: A revolution is not a dinner party.

chinese: 中国科学院的调查结果是这样的。
pinyin: Zhōngguó Kēxuéyuàn de diàochájiéguǒ shì zhèyàng de.
english: The results of the Chinese Academy of Sciences' survey are like this.

chinese: 我没有任何可以谈这件事的朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu rènhé kěyǐ tán zhè jiàn shì de péngyou.
english: I have no friend with whom to talk about it.

chinese: 您确信您不想让我和汤姆谈谈这事儿吗？
pinyin: Nín quèxìn nín bù xiǎng ràng wǒ hé Tāngmǔ tántán zhè shìr ma?
english: Are you sure you don't want me to talk to Tom about that?

chinese: 外行谈策略，内行谈后勤。
pinyin: Wàiháng tán cèlüè, nèiháng tán hòuqín.
english: Amateurs talk strategy, professionals talk logistics.

chinese: 父母要对他们子女的安全负责。
pinyin: Fùmǔ yào duì tāmen zǐnǚ de ānquán fùzé.
english: Parents are responsible for the safety of their children.

chinese: 他要负责任，但这责任他可担当不了。
pinyin: Tā yào fùzérèn, dàn zhè zérèn tā kě dāndāng buliǎo.
english: He had to be responsible, but this was a responsibility that he couldn’t bear.

chinese: 从此起我们为您的安全负责。
pinyin: Cóngcǐ qǐ wǒmen wèi nín de ānquán fùzé.
english: We are responsible for your protection from now on.

chinese: 那个责任对他是个负担。
pinyin: Nàge zérèn duì tā shì gè fùdān.
english: That responsibility is a burden to him.

chinese: 这地毯在质量上比那个好得多。
pinyin: Zhè dìtǎn zài zhìliàng shàng bǐ nà gè hǎo de duō.
english: This carpet is superior to that one in quality.

chinese: 这个购物中心在前面一英里远的地方。
pinyin: Zhège gòuwùzhōngxīn zài qiánmiàn yì Yīnglǐ yuǎn de dìfang.
english: The shopping center is one mile ahead.

chinese: 他靠工作赚钱。
pinyin: Tā kào gōng zuò zhuàn qián。
english: He earns money by working.

chinese: 你真觉得我们有机会赢吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zhēn juéde wǒmen yǒu jīhuì yíng ma?
english: Do you really think we have a chance to win?

chinese: 自己赢不重要，重要的是对手要输。
pinyin: Zìjǐ yíng bù zhòngyào, zhòngyào de shì duìshǒu yào shū.
english: The important thing is not to win, but that the other loses.

chinese: 如果我运气够好的话，说不定会赢。
pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒ yùnqi gòu hǎo dehuà, shuōbudìng huì yíng.
english: I may win if I have luck.

chinese: 我在推测他可能赢得比赛。
pinyin: Wǒ zài tuīcè tā kěnéng yíngdé bǐsài.
english: I am speculating that he may win the game.

chinese: 飞往北京的飞机就要起飞了。
pinyin: Fēi wǎng Běijīng de fēijī jiùyào qǐfēi le.
english: The plane bound for Beijing is going to take off soon.

chinese: 飞机起飞后，很快就消失在了眼前。
pinyin: Fēijī qǐfēi hòu, hěn kuài jiù xiāoshī zài le yǎnqián.
english: The plane took off and was soon out of sight.

chinese: 如果你有时间的话，请过来一趟。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu shíjiān dehuà, qǐng guòlai yī tàng.
english: Please come over if you have time.

chinese: 你的智慧广大的有如孟买和孟买之间的距离。
pinyin: Nǐ de zhìhuì guǎngdà de yǒurú Mèngmǎi hé Mèngmǎi zhījiān de jùlí.
english: Your intelligence is as vast as the distance between Bombay and Mumbai.

chinese: 由于轨道是椭圆形的，行星和太阳之间的距离不会总是相同。
pinyin: Yóuyú guǐdào shì tuǒyuánxíng de, xíngxīng hé tàiyang zhījiān de jùlí bù huì zǒngshì xiāngtóng.
english: Since the orbits are elliptical, the planets do not always have the same distance from the Sun.

chinese: 我住的那家旅馆的床太软了。
pinyin: Wǒ zhù de nà jiā lǚguǎn de chuáng tài ruǎn le.
english: The bed at the hotel where I stayed was too soft.

chinese: 问心无愧是一个非常柔软的枕头。
pinyin: Wènxīnwúkuì shì yī gè fēicháng róuruǎn de zhěntou.
english: A clear conscience is an extraordinarily soft pillow.

chinese: 我轻轻地对她说：《不要怕，我在这儿》
pinyin: Wǒ qīngqīng de duì tā shuō:《 Bù yào pà, wǒ zài zhèr 》
english: I whispered to her quietly "Don't be afraid, I'm here."

chinese: 我上个星期天在家里放轻松。
pinyin: Wǒ shànggèxīngqī tiān zài jiālǐ fàng qīngsōng.
english: I relaxed at home last Sunday.

chinese: 你工作得太辛苦了。放轻松一下。
pinyin: Nǐ gōngzuò de tài xīnkǔ le. fàng qīngsōng yīxià.
english: You are working too hard. Take it easy for a while.

chinese: 有时候我会想吃辣的东西。
pinyin: Yǒushíhou wǒ huì xiǎng chī là de dōngxi.
english: Every now and then I like to have hot and spicy food.

chinese: 说实话，这对我来说有点太辣了。
pinyin: Shuō shíhuà, zhè duì wǒ lái shuō yǒudiǎn tài là le.
english: To tell you the truth, this is a little too spicy for me.

chinese: 我已经习惯了家门口过火车的声音了。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng xíguàn le jiāménkǒu guò huǒchē de shēngyīn le.
english: I am used to hearing the train pass by my house.

chinese: 在这过程中，我回答了好几个问题。
pinyin: Zài zhè guòchéng zhōng, wǒ huídá le hǎojǐ gè wèntí.
english: During this process, I answered quite a few questions.

chinese: 这场谈话真是无法再进行下去了。
pinyin: Zhè chǎng tánhuà zhēnshi wúfǎ zài jìnxíng xiàqù le.
english: There's really no way to continue this conversation any longer.

chinese: 难怪连他自己都害怕这个字眼儿了。
pinyin: Nánguài lián tā zìjǐ dōu hàipà zhège zìyǎn r le.
english: No wonder that even he feared this word himself.

chinese: 他连字都不会念，更别说写了。
pinyin: Tā lián zì dōu bù huì niàn, gèng bié shuō xiě le.
english: He can't even read, let alone write.

chinese: 那个人那么小气，连谷壳都不让老鼠吃。
pinyin: Nàgèrén nàme xiǎoqì, lián gǔké dōu bù ràng lǎoshǔ chī.
english: That person's so stingy that he won't even let the mouse have the chaff.

chinese: 我不觉得她适合做这份工作。
pinyin: Wǒ bù juéde tā shìhé zuò zhè fèn gōngzuò.
english: I don't think she is fit for the job.

chinese: 我们的眼睛需要时间来适应黑暗。
pinyin: Wǒmen de yǎnjing xūyào shíjiān lái shìyìng hēi'àn.
english: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.

chinese: 到了十一月，天就开始逐渐变凉了。
pinyin: Dào le shí yī yuè, tiān jiù kāishǐ zhújiàn biàn liáng le.
english: From November onwards, it gets colder.

chinese: 我很喜欢逛二手书店和二手衣店。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan guàng èrshǒu shūdiàn hé èrshǒu yī diàn.
english: I like shopping in used-book stores and in used-clothing shops.

chinese: 总线速度逐步回升。
pinyin: Zǒngxiàn sùdù zhúbù huíshēng.
english: The bus picked up the speed gradually.

chinese: 这些新模块毫无疑问会影响主页的加载速度。
pinyin: Zhèxiē xīn mókuài háo wú yíwèn huì yǐngxiǎng zhǔyè de jiāzài sùdù.
english: All these new blocks will undoubtedly impact the loading speed of the home page.

chinese: 他慢慢地把自己的名字再说了一遍。
pinyin: Tā mànmàn de bǎ zìjǐ de míngzi zàishuō le yībiàn.
english: He repeated his name slowly.

chinese: 他应该为自己对客人的粗鲁无礼而道歉。
pinyin: Tā yīnggāi wèi zìjǐ duì kèrén de cūlǔ wúlǐ ér dàoqiàn.
english: He should apologize for being rude to the guests.

chinese: 你最喜欢这部电影的哪一部分呢？
pinyin: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan zhè bù diànyǐng de nǎ yībùfen ne?
english: What part of the movie did you like best?

chinese: 房子的那个部分以前不在那个位置。
pinyin: Fángzi de nàge bùfen yǐqián bù zài nàge wèizhi.
english: That part of the house didn't use to be there.

chinese: 我们的世界只不过是宇宙的一小部分。
pinyin: Wǒmen de shìjiè zhǐbuguò shì yǔzhòu de yīxiǎobùfèn.
english: Our world is only one small part of the universe.

chinese: 打印机只打了一半儿就停了，我手上只有他简历的一部分。
pinyin: Dǎyìnjī zhǐ dǎ le yībàn r jiù tíng le, wǒ shǒu shàng zhǐ yǒu tā jiǎnlì de yībùfen.
english: The printer stopped in the middle, so I only have part of his CV.

chinese: 我希望我们能重新做朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng wǒmen néng chóngxīn zuò péngyou.
english: I'd like us to be friends again.

chinese: 我很想跟你一起去, 但重点是我不能去。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng gēn nǐ yīqǐ qù, dàn zhòngdiǎn shì wǒ bù néng qù.
english: I'd like to go with you, but as it is I can't.

chinese: 如果我弄丢了我的钥匙，我就无法锁门了。
pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒ nòngdiū le wǒ de yàoshi, wǒ jiù wúfǎ suǒmén le.
english: If I lost my key, I wouldn't be able to lock the door.

chinese: 我在校庆后打扫的时候弄掉了一把学校的钥匙，我被迫写了一份检讨。
pinyin: Wǒ zài xiàoqìng hòu dǎsǎo de shíhou nòng diào le yī bǎ xuéxiào de yàoshi, wǒ bèipò xiě le yī fèn jiǎntǎo.
english: I lost a school key when I was cleaning up after the school festival and I was then required to write an apology letter.

chinese: 在你说别人坏话之前，自己先照照镜子吧。
pinyin: Zài nǐ shuō biéren huàihuà zhīqián, zìjǐ xiān zhàozhao jìngzi ba.
english: Before you speak ill of people, look at yourself in the mirror.

chinese: 长江是中国重要的河流。
pinyin: Cháng Jiāng shì Zhōng guó zhòng yào de hé liú。
english: The Yangtze is an important river in China.

chinese: 它花了我三天时间去阅读这本书。
pinyin: Tā huā le wǒ sān tiānshí jiān qù yuèdú zhè běn shū.
english: It took me three days to read through this book.

chinese: 如果您想学习卡达山语，请务必阅读此内容。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nín xiǎng xuéxí Kǎdáshānyǔ, qǐng wùbì yuèdú cǐ nèiróng.
english: Make sure you read this if you want to learn the Kadazan language.

chinese: 到目前为止，你认为你阅读过多少书籍？
pinyin: Dào mùqián wéi zhǐ, nǐ rènwéi nǐ yuèdú guo duōshǎo shūjí?
english: How many books do you think you have read so far?

chinese: 你是我的阳光。
pinyin: Nǐ shì wǒ de yángguāng.
english: You are my sunshine.

chinese: 对严格限制经济的批评蜂拥而来。
pinyin: Duì yángé xiànzhì jīngjì de pīpíng fēngyōng ér lái.
english: Critics are coming down hard on tightened economic restrictions.

chinese: 可惜你很快又会回中国，没人陪我了呢。
pinyin: Kěxī nǐ hěn kuài yòu huì huí Zhōngguó, méi rén péi wǒ le ne.
english: Unfortunately, you will return to China soon, so I will have nobody to accompany me.

chinese: 随便！两个我都喜欢。
pinyin: Suíbiàn! liǎng gè wǒ dōu xǐhuan.
english: Either one! They're both fine.

chinese: 难道我没有告诉你演唱会的时候要早点去吗？
pinyin: Nándào wǒ méiyǒu gàosu nǐ yǎnchànghuì de shíhou yào zǎodiǎn qù ma?
english: I thought I told you that you should get to the concert early.

chinese: 侧边栏显示在网站标志下方的页面边缘。
pinyin: Cèbiānlán xiǎnshì zài wǎngzhàn biāozhì xiàfāng de yèmiàn biānyuán.
english: The sidebar is displayed on the edge of the page below the site logo.

chinese: 顺便说一句，你最近见过他吗？
pinyin: Shùnbiàn shuō yījù, nǐ zuìjìn jiàn guo tā ma?
english: By the way, have you seen him lately?

chinese: 你让我看到了一切顺利时的样子。
pinyin: Nǐ ràng wǒ kàn dào le yīqiè shùnlì shí de yàngzi.
english: You opened up my eyes to what it's like when everything is right.

chinese: 顾客永远是正确的吗？
pinyin: Gùkè yǒngyuǎn shì zhèngquè de ma?
english: Is the customer always right?

chinese: 请在上课前预习课文。
pinyin: Qǐng zài shàng kè qián yù xí kè wén。
english: Please prepare the lesson text before class.

chinese: 你最喜欢的饮料是什么？
pinyin: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan de yǐnliào shì shénme?
english: What's your favorite beverage?

chinese: 想吃多少饼干就吃多少。
pinyin: Xiǎng chī duōshao bǐnggān jiù chī duōshao.
english: Take as many cookies as you want.

chinese: 英国首都伦敦在泰晤士河畔。
pinyin: Yīngguó shǒudū Lúndūn zài Tàiwùshì Hé pàn.
english: London, the capital of England, is on the Thames.

chinese: 这些花很香。
pinyin: Zhè xiē huā hěn xiāng。
english: These flowers smell lovely.

chinese: 他有时候很马虎。
pinyin: Tā yǒu shí hou hěn mǎ hu。
english: He is sometimes careless.

chinese: 他完全可以为他的儿子们感到骄傲。
pinyin: Tā wánquán kěyǐ wèi tā de érzi men gǎndào jiāo'ào.
english: He may well be proud of his sons.

chinese: 汤姆买了台很高级的相机。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ mǎi le tái hěn gāojí de xiàngjī.
english: Tom bought a very good camera.

chinese: 尽量避免制造任何更多的麻烦。
pinyin: Jìnliàng bìmiǎn zhìzào rènhé gèng duō de máfan.
english: Try to avoid making any more trouble.

chinese: 小心点驾驶，不然你就麻烦了。
pinyin: Xiǎoxīn diǎn jiàshǐ, bù rán nǐ jiù máfan le.
english: Drive carefully, or you'll run into trouble.

chinese: 如果你女朋友发现真相的话，你会有麻烦的。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ nǚpéngyou fāxiàn zhēnxiàng dehuà, nǐ huì yǒu máfan de.
english: You'll get into trouble if your girlfriend finds out the truth.

chinese: 所有的观众都站起来鼓掌。
pinyin: Suǒyǒu de guānzhòng dōu zhànqǐlai gǔzhǎng.
english: The whole audience got up and started to applaud.

chinese: 他的日常行为并不和他的原则相一致。
pinyin: Tā de rìcháng xíngwéi bìng bù hé tā de yuánzé xiāng yīzhì.
english: His daily behavior is not consistent with his principles.

chinese: 你一路往前走，过了红绿灯就到了。
pinyin: Nǐ yīlù wǎngqián zǒu, guo le hónglǜdēng jiù dào le.
english: Go straight down the road, and when you pass the traffic light you're there.

chinese: 彼此必须一辈子努力,才能把感情维系好。
pinyin: Bǐcǐ bìxū yībèizi nǔlì, cáinéng bǎ gǎnqíng wéixì hǎo.
english: Each of you must work hard for a lifetime, and only then will you be able to maintain a relationship.

chinese: 甲、乙、丙、丁是四个不同的小组。
pinyin: Jiǎ、 yǐ、 bǐng、 dīng shì sì gè bù tóng de xiǎo zǔ。
english: A, B, C, and D are four different groups.

chinese: 直到那时，他才意识到他已经上当受骗。
pinyin: Zhídào nàshí, tā cái yìshí dào tā yǐjīng shàngdàng shòupiàn.
english: Only then did he realize he had been deceived.

chinese: 假如你没有这个程序，你现在就可以去下载。
pinyin: Jiǎrú nǐ méiyǒu zhège chéngxù, nǐ xiànzài jiù kěyǐ qù xiàzǎi.
english: If you do not have this program, you can download it now.

chinese: 他是个忠厚老实的人，不免上当。
pinyin: Tā shì gè zhōnghòu lǎoshi de rén, bù miǎn shàngdàng.
english: He is an honest person, and he will always be lied to.

chinese: 上海有什么不如北京的方面吗？
pinyin: Shànghǎi yǒu shénme bù rú Běijīng de fāngmiàn ma?
english: Are there any aspects of Shanghai that are not as good as those of Beijing?

chinese: 想到自己的未来，她不安起来。
pinyin: Xiǎngdào zìjǐ de wèilái, tā bù ān qǐlai.
english: She felt uneasy at the thought of her future.

chinese: 我把他叫做「矮子」，他就气得不得了。
pinyin: Wǒ bǎ tā jiàozuò 「 ǎizi 」, tā jiù qì de bù déliǎo.
english: He got mad at me for calling him Shorty.

chinese: 如果你不想的话你不必告诉我。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù xiǎng de huà nǐ bù bì gàosu wǒ.
english: You do not need to tell me if you do not want to.

chinese: 我努力地平息他们不断加温的争执。
pinyin: Wǒ nǔlì de píngxī tāmen bù duàn jiāwēn de zhēngzhí.
english: I tried very hard to put an end to their heated argument.

chinese: 幸好你提醒我，不然我永远记不起来了。
pinyin: Xìnghǎo nǐ tíxǐng wǒ, bù rán wǒ yǒngyuǎn jì bù qǐlai le.
english: Good that you told me, otherwise I would never have remembered it.

chinese: ...不然难免会有适得其反的情况出现。
pinyin: ... bù rán nánmiǎn huì yǒu shìdéqífǎn de qíngkuàng chūxiàn.
english: ... Otherwise it is (or will be) hard to avoid a counterproductive situation.

chinese: 睡眠不足增加心脏病发作的危险。
pinyin: Shuìmiánbùzú zēngjiā xīnzàngbìng fāzuò de wēixiǎn.
english: Sleep deprivation increases risk of heart attacks.

chinese: 与其知道你要走，我宁肯你没有回来过。
pinyin: Yǔqí zhīdào nǐ yào zǒu, wǒ nìngkěn nǐ méiyǒu huílai guo.
english: I would rather that you never returned than know that you wanted to leave.

chinese: 那个丑男人在节食，这个我们知道就好。
pinyin: Nàge chǒu nánrén zài jiéshí, zhège wǒmen zhīdào jiù hǎo.
english: Between you and me, the fat ugly man is on a diet.

chinese: 航空专家详细分析了统计数据。
pinyin: Hángkōng zhuānjiā xiángxì fēnxī le tǒngjìshùjù.
english: The aviation expert analyzed the statistics in detail.

chinese: 他专心致志地学习拉丁语。
pinyin: Tā zhuānxīnzhìzhì de xuéxí Lādīngyǔ.
english: He is absorbed in the study of Latin.

chinese: 她把所有的业余时间都用在钓鱼上了。
pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de yèyú shíjiān dōu yòng zài diàoyú shàng le.
english: She devoted all her spare time to fishing.

chinese: 因为你们公司的业务能够发挥我的特长。
pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐmen gōngsī de yèwù nénggòu fāhuī wǒ de tècháng.
english: Because your business can play to my strengths.

chinese: 他到名古屋洽谈业务。
pinyin: Tā dào Mínggǔwū qiàtán yèwù.
english: He went to Nagoya on business.

chinese: 我没有丝毫的想法。
pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu sīháo de xiǎngfǎ.
english: I don't have the slightest idea.

chinese: 这个小孩穿着一件丝绸织成的肚兜.
pinyin: Zhège xiǎohái chuān zhe yī jiàn sīchóu zhī chéng de dùdōu.
english: The child is wearing a belly-slip made of silk.

chinese: 海水蓝蓝的，远远看去像一大片丝绸铺开。
pinyin: Hǎishuǐ lán lán de, yuǎnyuǎn kàn qù xiàng yī dàpiàn sīchóu pū kāi.
english: The sea is deep blue, and from afar it looks like a vast sheet of silk spread out.

chinese: 她穿着华丽的丝绸服饰。
pinyin: Tā chuān zhe huálì de sīchóu fúshì.
english: She is wearing gorgeous silk clothes.

chinese: 老师的表情很严肃。
pinyin: Lǎo shī de biǎo qíng hěn yán sù。
english: The teacher has a serious expression.

chinese: 你要先输入好个人资料，然后才能买票。
pinyin: Nǐ yào xiān shūrù hǎo gèrén zīliào, ránhòu cái néng mǎi piào.
english: To purchase a ticket, you need to enter your personal details.

chinese: 只有个别人才懂了我的意思。
pinyin: Zhǐ yǒu gèbié réncái dǒng le wǒ de yìsi.
english: Only a few people understood me.

chinese: 我的个性还有很多方面是你不了解的。
pinyin: Wǒ de gèxìng háiyǒu hěn duōfāngmiàn shì nǐ buliǎo jiě de.
english: There are a lot of things you don't know about my personality.

chinese: 听说您已经跟中介公司联系过了。
pinyin: Tīngshuō nín yǐjīng gēn zhōngjiè gōngsī liánxì guo le.
english: I hear you've already contacted the broker.

chinese: 新的社区中心在昨天隆重落成。
pinyin: Xīn de shèqū zhōngxīn zài zuótiān lóngzhòng luòchéng.
english: The new community center was inaugurated yesterday with pomp and circumstance.

chinese: 正式工比临时工要好。
pinyin: Zhèngshìgōng bǐ línshígōng yào hǎo.
english: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.

chinese: 每个人都应该做自己命运的主人。
pinyin: Měigerén dōu yīnggāi zuò zìjǐ mìngyùn de zhǔrén.
english: Everyone ought to be a master of his own destiny.

chinese: 你赞成也好，不赞成也好，我也会推荐他当主席的。
pinyin: Nǐ zànchéng yě hǎo, bù zànchéng yě hǎo, wǒ yě huì tuījiàn tā dāng zhǔxí de.
english: I'll recommend him as chairman, whether you are in favour of it or not.

chinese: 中国主张钓鱼岛的主权。
pinyin: Zhōngguó zhǔzhāng Diàoyú Dǎo de zhǔquán.
english: China is an advocate for the Diaoyu Islands' sovereignty.

chinese: 她负责主持今天的会议。
pinyin: Tā fù zé zhǔ chí jīn tiān de huì yì。
english: She is chairing today's meeting.

chinese: 他写文章写得很主观。
pinyin: Tā xiě wénzhāng xiě dehěn zhǔguān.
english: His writing is very subjective.

chinese: 她试了试举起箱子，但举不起来。
pinyin: Tā shì le shì jǔqǐ xiāngzi, dàn jǔ bù qǐlai.
english: She tried to lift the box, but found it impossible.

chinese: 没有悲观主义者就没有乐观主义者。
pinyin: Méiyǒu bēiguān zhǔyì zhě jiù méiyǒu lèguānzhǔyì zhě.
english: If there were no pessimists, neither would there be any optimists.

chinese: 你今天乖吗？
pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān guāi ma?
english: Did you behave today?

chinese: 你乘出租车去和走路去也没有什么分别。
pinyin: Nǐ chéng chūzūchē qù hé zǒu lù qù yě méiyǒu shénme fēnbié.
english: It will make little difference whether you go there by taxi or on foot.

chinese: 我有大量的书在我的书架上。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu dàliàng de shū zài wǒ de shūjià shàng.
english: I have numerous books on my bookshelf.

chinese: 今天晚上我先用一下，争取明天还给你。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒ xiān yòng yīxià, zhēngqǔ míngtiān huángěi nǐ.
english: I'll use it a bit this evening, and try my best to give it back to you tomorrow.

chinese: 我们为该写些什么而争论了好几个小时。
pinyin: Wǒmen wèi gāi xiě xiē shénme ér zhēnglùn le hǎojǐ gè xiǎoshí.
english: We disputed for hours about what to write.

chinese: 事先打个招呼，别叫我临时抓瞎。
pinyin: Shìxiān dǎ gè zhāohu, bié jiào wǒ línshí zhuāxiā.
english: Let me know beforehand instead of catching me on the hop at the last minute.

chinese: 比尔不喜欢他父亲抽很多烟的这个事实。
pinyin: Bǐ'ěr bù xǐhuan tā fùqīn chōu hěn duō yān de zhège shìshí.
english: Bill doesn't like the fact that his father smokes a lot.

chinese: 我们可以用望远镜来观察远方的事物。
pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ yòng wàngyuǎnjìng lái guānchá yuǎnfāng de shìwù.
english: We can see things in the distance using a telescope.

chinese: 我想用汉语交换另一种语言.
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yòng Hànyǔ jiāohuàn lìngyī zhǒng yǔyán.
english: I'd like to teach you Chinese in exchange for your teaching me another language.

chinese: 舅舅的公司上个月推出了一款新产品。
pinyin: Jiùjiu de gōngsī shànggèyuè tuīchū le yī kuǎnxīn chǎnpǐn.
english: My uncle's company launched a new product last month.

chinese: 我觉得现在是发表这个产品的好时机。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde xiànzài shì fābiǎo zhège chǎnpǐn de hǎo shíjī.
english: I think the time is right to introduce this product.

chinese: 这将会对阿尔及利亚产生巨大的影响。
pinyin: Zhè jiānghuì duì Ā'ěrjílìyà chǎnshēng jùdà de yǐngxiǎng.
english: This will have enormous implications for Algeria.

chinese: 大学生活就是你尽量享受自己的时候！
pinyin: Dàxuéshēng huó jiùshì nǐ jǐnliàng xiǎngshòu zìjǐ de shíhou!
english: University life is the time when you enjoy yourself to the fullest!

chinese: 据说日本人对认识的人亲切，对不认识的人却是十分冷淡。
pinyin: Jùshuō Rìběnrén duì rènshi de rén qīnqiè, duì bù rènshi de rén quèshì shífēn lěngdàn.
english: It is said that Japanese people are kind to people they know, but rather cold to those they don't.

chinese: 亲爱的朋友，欢迎你来我们家。
pinyin: Qīn ài de péng you， huān yíng nǐ lái wǒ men jiā。
english: Dear friend, welcome to our home.

chinese: 公司的人事部门正在招聘。
pinyin: Gōng sī de rén shì bù mén zhèng zài zhāo pìn。
english: The company's personnel department is recruiting.

chinese: 老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。
pinyin: Lǎolínghuà de rénkǒu xūyào gèng duō yīliáobǎojiàn zhīchū.
english: An aging population will require more spending on health care.

chinese: 日本的人口密度很高。
pinyin: Rìběn de rénkǒumìdù hěn gāo.
english: Japan has a high population density.

chinese: 这家商店人员的态度特好，怪不得顾客也好多。
pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn rényuán de tàidu tè hǎo, guàibude gùkè yě hǎoduō.
english: The staff in this shop are really friendly; no wonder they've got so many customers.

chinese: 我一直都更喜欢有些神秘的小说人物。
pinyin: Wǒ yīzhí dōu gèng xǐhuan yǒuxiē shén mì de xiǎoshuō rénwù.
english: I always liked mysterious characters more.

chinese: 如果人生是凸的，那我们可以优化它。
pinyin: Rúguǒ rénshēng shì tū de, nà wǒmen kěyǐ yōuhuà tā.
english: If human life is convex, we can optimize it.

chinese: 热爱生活中的日常琐事，人生才会快乐。
pinyin: Rèài shēnghuó zhōng de rìcháng suǒshì, rénshēng cái huì kuàilè.
english: In order to make life happy, you must love the everyday trifles.

chinese: 我很感激我能够领受到这样的人生体验。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn gǎnjī wǒ nénggòu lǐngshòu dào zhèyàng de rénshēng tǐyàn.
english: I am thankful to have been given the experience of life.

chinese: 这件事是他人生的一个重要的转折点。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì shì tārén shēng de yī gè zhòngyào de zhuǎnzhédiǎn.
english: This was the turning point of his life.

chinese: 我对于自己为实现人生目标所做的事有何感受？
pinyin: Wǒ duìyú zìjǐ wèi shíxiàn rénshēng mùbiāo suǒ zuò de shì yǒu hé gǎnshòu?
english: How do I feel about what I'm doing to get what I want out of life?

chinese: 一旦爆发核战争，受苦的将会是全人类。
pinyin: Yīdàn bàofā hézhàn zhēng, shòukǔ de jiānghuì shì quán rénlèi.
english: All humanity will suffer if a nuclear war breaks out.

chinese: 您在英国从事中医工作的原因是什么？
pinyin: Nín zài Yīngguó cóngshì Zhōngyī gōngzuò de yuányīn shì shénme?
english: What are your reasons for practising Chinese medicine in the UK?

chinese: 从前，这里没有桥。
pinyin: Cóng qián， zhè lǐ méi yǒu qiáo。
english: There used to be no bridge here.

chinese: 他们创作出令人惊叹的艺术作品，从而让人们驻足欣赏宇宙之美。
pinyin: Tāmen chuàngzuò chū lìngrén jīngtàn de yìshù zuòpǐn, cóng'ér ràng rénmen zhùzú xīnshǎng yǔzhòu zhī měi.
english: They're creating stunning works of art to force people to stop and appreciate the beauty of the universe.

chinese: 「我们还得去领现金。」「不用，刷卡付款就好。」
pinyin: 「 wǒmen hái de qù lǐng xiànjīn.」「 bù yòng, shuākǎ fùkuǎn jiù hǎo.」
english: "We still need to get cash out." "No we don't. We'll just pay by card."

chinese: 今年以来，她每天都练习中文。
pinyin: Jīn nián yǐ lái， tā měi tiān dōu liàn xí zhōng wén。
english: She has practiced Chinese every day since the start of this year.

chinese: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。
pinyin: Qiánbì de jiàzhí qǔjué yú suǒ shǐyòng de jīnshǔ de zhòngliàng.
english: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.

chinese: 我们一定不能忘记每个人的内在价值。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīdìng bù néng wàngjì měigerén de nèizài jiàzhí.
english: We must never forget the inherent value of every human being.

chinese: 他安静地读著书，仿佛什么事都没发生过。
pinyin: Tā ānjìng de dú zhùshū, fǎngfú shénmeshì dōu méi fāshēng guo.
english: He read a book quietly, as though nothing had happened.

chinese: 工会和企业一致同意了一份新的合同。
pinyin: Gōnghuì hé qǐyè yīzhì tóngyì le yī fèn xīn de hétong.
english: The union and the company have agreed upon a new contract.

chinese: 你有很多休闲时间吗？
pinyin: Nǐ yǒu hěn duō xiūxián shíjiān ma?
english: Do you have a lot of time to relax?

chinese: 他们很努力地超过对方获得优势。
pinyin: Tāmen hěn nǔlì de chāoguò duìfāng huòdé yōushì.
english: They tried very hard to gain an advantage over one another.

chinese: 哪一个国家拥有生产玉米的绝对优势？
pinyin: Nǎyīge guójiā yōngyǒu shēngchǎn yùmǐ de juéduì yōushì?
english: What country has the absolute advantage in the production of corn?

chinese: 首次订购可获九五折的特别优惠。
pinyin: Shǒucì dìnggòu kě huò jiǔ wǔ zhé de tèbié yōuhuì.
english: Your initial order is subject to a special discount of 5%.

chinese: 他和他的伙伴让我跟他们一起去。
pinyin: Tā hé tā de huǒbàn ràng wǒ gēn tāmen yīqǐ qù.
english: He and his companion asked me to come along with them.

chinese: 我是个会计师。
pinyin: Wǒ shì gè kuàijìshī.
english: I'm an accountant.

chinese: 他很自豪他父亲是个伟大的科学家。
pinyin: Tā hěn zìháo tā fùqīn shì gè wěidà de kēxuéjiā.
english: He is proud that his father was a great scientist.

chinese: 每一个伟大的作家似乎已经对英语感兴趣。
pinyin: Měi yī gè wěidà de zuòjiā sìhū yǐjīng duì Yīngyǔ gǎnxìngqù.
english: Every great writer seems to have been interested in English.

chinese: 我们伟大的祖国无敌于天下。
pinyin: Wǒmen wěidà de zǔguó wúdí yú tiānxià.
english: Our great country is unmatched in the world.

chinese: 一名伟大的战士威力显著，无需抵死奋战。
pinyin: Yī míng wěidà de zhànshì wēilì xiǎnzhù, wúxū dǐ sǐ fènzhàn.
english: A great warrior radiates strength. He doesn't have to fight to the death.

chinese: 生活的伟大奥秘其中之一是猫如何决定下一步要做什么。
pinyin: Shēnghuó de wěidà Ào mì qízhōng zhīyī shì māo rúhé juédìng xiàyībù yào zuò shénme.
english: One of the great mysteries of life is how a cat decides what to do next.

chinese: 中国的卫生当局正在采取措施来阻止冠状病毒的传播。
pinyin: Zhōngguó de wèishēng dāngjú zhèngzài cǎiqǔ cuòshī lái zǔzhǐ guānzhuàng bìngdú de chuánbō.
english: China's health authorities are taking steps to stop the spread of the coronavirus.

chinese: 那个古老的传统已经不复存在了。
pinyin: Nàge gǔlǎo de chuántǒng yǐjīng bù fù cúnzài le.
english: That old tradition has disappeared.

chinese: 神话和传说应该一代一代的传承下去。
pinyin: Shénhuà hé chuánshuō yīnggāi yīdài yīdài de chuánchéng xiàqù.
english: Myths and legends should be handed down from generation to generation.

chinese: 在印度，人们在餐桌上用右手传递食物。
pinyin: Zài Yìndù, rénmen zài cānzhuō shàng yòng yòushǒu chuándì shíwù.
english: In India, people pass food at the dinner table with the right hand.

chinese: 在泳池游完泳后要拉伸肌肉。
pinyin: Zài yǒngchí yóu wán yǒng hòu yào lāshēn jīròu.
english: You have to stretch your muscles after swimming in the pool.

chinese: 从他脸上的神情来看，他似乎是成功了。
pinyin: Cóng tā liǎn shàng de shénqíng láikàn, tā sìhū shì chénggōng le.
english: Judging from the look on his face, it seems that he has succeeded.

chinese: 从整体看，计划似乎很好。
pinyin: Cóng zhěngtǐ kàn, jìhuà sìhū hěn hǎo.
english: As a whole, the plan seems to be good.

chinese: 这个土壤似乎长不出任何东西来。
pinyin: Zhège tǔrǎng sìhū zhǎngbuchū rènhé dōngxi lái.
english: Nothing seems to grow in this soil.

chinese: 一年过去了，但仿佛我们昨天还见过面似的。
pinyin: Yī nián guòqù le, dàn fǎngfú wǒmen zuótiān hái jiàn guo miàn shìde.
english: A year has passed, but it's as if we'd seen each other only yesterday.

chinese: 这次旅行让我体会到学习语言的重要性。
pinyin: Zhè cì lǚ xíng ràng wǒ tǐ huì dào xué xí yǔ yán de zhòng yào xìng。
english: This trip helped me appreciate the importance of learning a language.

chinese: 这件事体现了他的责任感。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tǐ xiàn le tā de zé rèn gǎn。
english: This incident reflects his sense of responsibility.

chinese: 他是个很体贴的人。
pinyin: Tā shì gè hěn tǐtiē de rén.
english: He is a very thoughtful person.

chinese: 宝宝连走都不会，更何况是跑。
pinyin: Bǎobǎo lián zǒu dōu bù huì, gèng hékuàng shì pǎo.
english: The baby can't walk, much less run.

chinese: 你何必为这点小事生气呢？
pinyin: Nǐ hé bì wèi zhè diǎn xiǎo shì shēng qì ne？
english: Why get angry over such a small matter?

chinese: 我爸爸买了个相机作为我的生日礼物。
pinyin: Wǒ bàba mǎi le gè xiàngjī zuòwéi wǒ de shēngrì lǐwù.
english: My father bought me a camera for my birthday.

chinese: 文学作品中常用夜来香来象征思念与柔情。
pinyin: Wénxué zuòpǐn zhōngcháng yòng yèláixiāng lái xiàngzhēng sīniàn yǔ róuqíng.
english: In literary works, night-blooming jasmine is often used to symbolize longing and tenderness.

chinese: 这篇作文花了我两个小时来完成。
pinyin: Zhè piān zuòwén huā le wǒ liǎng gè xiǎoshí lái wánchéng.
english: It took me 2 hours to finish the essay.

chinese: 我真的很佩服你的汉语水平。
pinyin: Wǒ zhēn de hěn pèifú nǐ de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng.
english: I wholeheartedly admire your understanding of Chinese.

chinese: 他使劲儿推开了那扇门。
pinyin: Tā shǐ jìn r tuī kāi le nà shàn mén。
english: He pushed the door open with all his strength.

chinese: 侵略者注定要被打败。
pinyin: Qīnlüèzhě zhùdìng yào bèi dǎbài.
english: The aggressors are bound to be defeated.

chinese: 饥饿促使他偷窃。
pinyin: Jī'è cùshǐ tā tōuqiè.
english: Hunger urged him to steal.

chinese: 旅游的时候我可以通过网吧保持联系。
pinyin: Lǚyóu de shíhou wǒ kěyǐ tōngguò wǎngbā bǎochí liánxì.
english: I can keep in touch when I travel by finding an internet café.

chinese: 在结冰的街道上我们很难保持平衡。
pinyin: Zài jiébīng de jiēdào shàng wǒmen hěn nánbǎo chípíng héng.
english: It is hard to keep our balance on icy streets.

chinese: 大部份的保险计划不包含整容手术。
pinyin: Dàbù fèn de bǎoxiǎn jìhuà bù bāohán zhěngróng shǒushù.
english: Cosmetic surgery is not covered by most insurance plans.

chinese: 公司的医疗保险覆盖了全部的医疗费用。
pinyin: Gōngsī de yīliáobǎoxiǎn fùgài le quánbù de yīliáofèi yòng.
english: The company medical treatment insurance covered all the medical treatment costs.

chinese: 你说什么？我听不见，这里信号太差了。
pinyin: Nǐ shuō shénme? Wǒ tīngbujiàn, zhèlǐ xìnhào tài chà le.
english: What are you saying? I cannot hear, the signal here is too bad.

chinese: 小心地打开信封，以免撕破。
pinyin: Xiǎoxīn de dǎkāi xìnfēng, yǐmiǎn sīpò.
english: Open the envelope carefully so it doesn't tear.

chinese: 我会把所有有用的信息提供给您的。
pinyin: Wǒ huì bǎ suǒyǒu yǒuyòng de xìnxī tígōng gěi nín de.
english: I will provide you all the necessary information.

chinese: 使用这个信息时，我当然会遵循您的要求。
pinyin: Shǐyòng zhège xìnxī shí, wǒ dāngrán huì zūnxún nín de yāoqiú.
english: When using this information, I will of course follow your requirements.

chinese: 在得到确认之前不要进行任何修改。
pinyin: Zài dédào quèrèn zhīqián bù yào jìnxíng rènhé xiūgǎi.
english: Do not make any modifications before you get confirmations.

chinese: 你还不如立刻退出这个俱乐部。
pinyin: Nǐ háibùrú lìkè tuìchū zhège jùlèbù.
english: You may as well withdraw from the club right away.

chinese: 他触犯会规，被踢出了俱乐部。
pinyin: Tā chùfàn huì guī, bèi tī chū le jùlèbù.
english: He was excluded from the club for infractions of the rules.

chinese: 这件衣服样式倒是挺好，就是贵了点儿。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu yàngshì dàoshi tǐnghǎo, jiùshì guì le diǎnr.
english: The style of this item of clothing is good; it's just a bit expensive.

chinese: 我真的很倒霉！
pinyin: Wǒ zhēn de hěn dǎoméi!
english: How unlucky I am!

chinese: 即使我承认你说的是真的，但这并不是借口。
pinyin: Jíshǐ wǒ chéngrèn nǐ shuō de shì zhēn de, dàn zhè bìngbù shì jièkǒu.
english: Even if I grant that what you say is true, it is no excuse.

chinese: 你没必要假装你不会讲法语。
pinyin: Nǐ méi bìyào jiǎzhuāng nǐ bù huì jiǎng Fǎyǔ.
english: There's no need to pretend you don't speak French.

chinese: 你今天去不去健身房？
pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān qù bù qù jiànshēnfáng?
english: Are you going to the gym today?

chinese: 我完全是在偶然的情况下发现了密室。
pinyin: Wǒ wánquán shì zài ǒurán de qíngkuàng xiàfā xiàn le mìshì.
english: I found the secret compartment quite by accident.

chinese: 我们曾经总在星期六傍晚去看电影。
pinyin: Wǒmen céngjīng zǒng zài Xīngqīliù bàngwǎn qù kàn diànyǐng.
english: We used to go to the movies on Saturday evening.

chinese: 催促客户去完成一件任务是很让人头疼的事。
pinyin: Cuīcù kèhù qù wánchéng yī jiàn rènwu shì hěn ràng réntóu téng de shì.
english: Pushing customers to complete a task can be a headache.

chinese: 别做这种傻事。
pinyin: Bié zuò zhè zhǒng shǎ shì。
english: Do not do something so foolish.

chinese: 很多日本人都会在元旦到神社参拜。
pinyin: Hěn duō Rìběnrén dōu huì zài Yuándàn dào shénshè cānbài.
english: On New Year's Day many Japanese go to the shrine to worship.

chinese: 我的一个兄弟是老师，其他都是律师。
pinyin: Wǒ de yī gè xiōngdì shì lǎoshī, qítā dōu shì lǜshī.
english: One of my brothers is a teacher and the others are lawyers.

chinese: 他履行了他的承诺，并且帮助了他的兄弟。
pinyin: Tā lǚxíng le tā de chéngnuò, bìngqiě bāngzhù le tā de xiōngdì.
english: He kept his promise and helped his brothers.

chinese: 我把充电器的型号记下了。
pinyin: Wǒ bǎ chōngdiànqì de xínghào jì xià le.
english: I've memorized the model number of the charger.

chinese: 欢迎光临，现在人很多，请坐下来等一等。
pinyin: Huānyíngguānglín, xiànzài rén hěn duō, qǐng zuòxia lái děngyīděng.
english: Welcome. Now that many people have arrived, please take a seat and wait for a while.

chinese: 你有光明的未来。
pinyin: Nǐ yǒu guāngmíng de wèilái.
english: You have a bright future.

chinese: 在光滑的路上开车会导致车祸。
pinyin: Zài guānghuá de lùshang kāichē huì dǎozhì chēhuò.
english: Driving on a slippery road can lead to a car wreck.

chinese: 我的父母准备买一个新的光盘。
pinyin: Wǒ de fùmǔ zhǔnbèi mǎi yī gè xīn de guāngpán.
english: My parents are going to buy a new CD.

chinese: 他英勇的行为带给了他光荣。
pinyin: Tā yīngyǒng de xíngwéi dàigěi le tā guāngróng.
english: His acts of courage brought him glory.

chinese: 这个苹果重一百克。
pinyin: Zhè gè píng guǒ zhòng yī bǎi kè。
english: This apple weighs one hundred grams.

chinese: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。
pinyin: Rúhé kèfú Rìyuán shēnggāo shì ge dà wèntí.
english: How to overcome the high value of the yen is a big problem.

chinese: 你妹妹看上去那么高贵，就像是个公主一样。
pinyin: Nǐ mèimei kànshangqu nàme gāoguì, jiù xiàng shì ge gōngzhǔ yīyàng.
english: Your sister looks as noble as if she were a princess.

chinese: 她为了掩饰自己公主的身份，女扮男装，逃出了皇宫。
pinyin: Tā wèile yǎnshì zìjǐ gōngzhǔ de shēnfèn, nǚbàn-nánzhuāng, táo chū le huánggōng.
english: To hide the fact that she's a princess, she disguised herself as a boy and escaped the palace.

chinese: 公主向皇帝请求饶恕。
pinyin: Gōngzhǔ xiàng huángdì qǐngqiú ráoshù.
english: The princess begged forgiveness from the emperor.

chinese: 这座桥建于公元一千年。
pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo jiàn yú gōng yuán yī qiān nián。
english: This bridge was built in the year 1000 CE.

chinese: 我住的公寓距离车站步行不到五分钟。
pinyin: Wǒ zhù de gōngyù jùlí chēzhàn bùxíng bù dào wǔ fēnzhōng.
english: My apartment is located within five minutes' walk of the station.

chinese: 她单独一人在公寓里住。
pinyin: Tā dāndú yī rén zài gōngyù lǐ zhù.
english: She lives in an apartment alone.

chinese: 阿尔及利亚公布了新的经济计画。
pinyin: Ā'ěrjílìyà gōngbù le xīn de jīngjì jìhuà.
english: Algeria has unveiled a new economic plan.

chinese: 这不公平！凭什么我必须做艰苦的工作。
pinyin: Zhè bù gōngpíng! píngshénme wǒ bìxū zuò jiānkǔ de gōngzuò.
english: It's not fair! I have to do the hard work!

chinese: 在异乡生活，偶尔收到朋友的关怀让人倍感温暖。
pinyin: Zài yìxiāng shēnghuó, ǒu'ěr shōudào péngyou de guānhuái ràng rén bèigǎn wēnnuǎn.
english: As a stranger in a strange land, the sporadic solicitude from friends can be especially heart-warming.

chinese: 昨天我们早三个小时关闭餐馆。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen zǎo sān gè xiǎoshí guānbì cānguǎn.
english: We closed the restaurant three hours early yesterday.

chinese: 他有三个女儿，一个结了婚，其余两个还没有。
pinyin: Tā yǒu sān gè nǚ'ér, yī gè jiéle hūn, qíyú liǎng gè hái méiyǒu.
english: He has three daughters; one is married, but the others aren't.

chinese: 让我们来研究一个具体的例子。
pinyin: Ràng wǒmen lái yánjiū yī gè jùtǐ de lìzi.
english: Let's study a specific example.

chinese: 他看到了一位内科医师。
pinyin: Tā kàn dào le yī wèi nèikē yīshī.
english: He saw a physician.

chinese: 我买了两册书。
pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le liǎng cè shū。
english: I bought two volumes.

chinese: 我再三申明无罪，但是没人听我讲。
pinyin: Wǒ zàisān shēnmíng wúzuì, dànshì méi rén tīng wǒ jiǎng.
english: I keep saying that I'm innocent, but no one will listen.

chinese: 要这么做，你需要冒险。
pinyin: Yào zhème zuò, nǐ xūyào màoxiǎn.
english: In order to do that, you have to take risks.

chinese: 这个国家的军事力量很先进。
pinyin: Zhège guójiā de jūnshìlìliang hěn xiānjìn.
english: The military power of this country is very advanced.

chinese: 这附近有一个军事基地。
pinyin: Zhè fùjìn yǒu yī gè jūnshìjīdì.
english: There is a military base near here.

chinese: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yīnggāi jiādà duì nóngyè de tóuzī.
english: The government should invest more money in agriculture.

chinese: 农民是国家的心脏。
pinyin: Nóngmín shì guójiā de xīnzàng.
english: Farmers are the heart of a country.

chinese: 只有一个人能成为世界冠军。问题是：会是谁呢？
pinyin: Zhǐ yǒu yīgèrén néng chéngwéi shìjiè guànjūn. wèntí shì: huì shì shéi ne?
english: There can only be one world champion. The question is: Who will it be?

chinese: 天气太冷，水冻成了冰。
pinyin: Tiān qì tài lěng， shuǐ dòng chéng le bīng。
english: It was so cold that the water froze into ice.

chinese: 有紧急情况时，必须通过这个出口跑出房子。
pinyin: Yǒu jǐnjí qíngkuàng shí, bìxū tōngguò zhège chūkǒu pǎochū fángzi.
english: If there's an emergency, you must run out of the house through this exit.

chinese: 他写了一本书，但是没有钱出版。
pinyin: Tā xiě le yī běn shū, dànshì méiyǒu qián chūbǎn.
english: He has written a book, however, he has no money to publish it.

chinese: 他在运动会上的表现十分出色。
pinyin: Tā zài yùndònghuì shàng de biǎoxiàn shífēn chūsè.
english: He was able to put up remarkable performances at the sports competition.

chinese: 你知道显微镜和望远镜有什么分别吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào xiǎnwēijìng hé wàngyuǎnjìng yǒu shénme fēnbié ma?
english: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?

chinese: 苗瑶语系的语言分布于东南亚和中国南方山区。
pinyin: Miáo yáo yǔxì de yǔyán fēnbù yú Dōngnányà hé Zhōngguó nánfāng shānqū.
english: Languages in the Hmong-Mien language family, also referred to as the Miao-Yao language family, are spoken across Southeast Asia and mountainous areas of southern China.

chinese: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。
pinyin: Wèile cānjiā huáchuán bǐsài, yī zhī xīn de duìwǔ zǔchéng le.
english: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.

chinese: 报纸上有一则新闻。
pinyin: Bào zhǐ shàng yǒu yī zé xīn wén。
english: There is a news item in the newspaper.

chinese: 预知未来的最好方法就是自己创造未来。
pinyin: Yùzhī wèilái de zuì hǎo fāngfǎ jiùshì zìjǐ chuàngzào wèilái.
english: The best way to predict the future is to create it yourself.

chinese: 她正在参加初级汉语课程。
pinyin: Tā zhèng zài cān jiā chū jí Hàn yǔ kè chéng。
english: She is taking an elementary Chinese course.

chinese: 从申请单中删除他的名字。
pinyin: Cóng shēnqǐng dān zhōng shānchú tā de míngzi.
english: Delete his name from the list of the applicants.

chinese: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。
pinyin: Yínháng duì fēngxiǎn kèhù shōuqǔ jiào gāo de dàikuǎn lìxī.
english: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.

chinese: 这家店今年的利润增加了。
pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn jīn nián de lì rùn zēng jiā le。
english: This shop's profits have increased this year.

chinese: 你如果能利用重力，那就这么做吧。
pinyin: Nǐ rúguǒ néng lìyòng zhònglì, nà jiù zhème zuò ba.
english: If you can use gravity to your advantage, do so.

chinese: 为了长期利益，我们决定把开发部门卖掉。
pinyin: Wèile chángqī lìyì, wǒmen juédìng bǎ kāifā bùmén màidiào.
english: For the sake of long-term interests, we have decided to sell the development department.

chinese: 如果天气好的话，我们明天就会到达了。
pinyin: Rúguǒ tiānqì hǎo dehuà, wǒmen míngtiān jiù huì dàodá le.
english: Given good weather, we will reach there tomorrow.

chinese: 孩子们常用彩纸制作手工艺品。
pinyin: Háizimen chángyòng cǎi zhǐ zhìzuò shǒugōngyì pǐn.
english: Children often use construction paper to make crafts.

chinese: 你们准备如何达到你们制定的目标？
pinyin: Nǐmen zhǔnbèi rúhé dádào nǐmen zhìdìng de mùbiāo?
english: How do you plan to achieve the goals you set?

chinese: 公司从下个月开始推行新的管理制度。
pinyin: Gōngsī cóng xiàgèyuè kāishǐ tuīxíng xīn de guǎnlǐ zhìdù.
english: The company is starting to implement the new management system from next month.

chinese: 你今年做的最刺激的事是什么？
pinyin: Nǐ jīnnián zuò de zuì cìjī de shì shì shénme?
english: What's the most exciting thing you've done this year?

chinese: 他比您更刻苦。
pinyin: Tā bǐ nín gèng kèkǔ.
english: He's even more hardworking than you are.

chinese: 他将要负责一个关系公司前途的项目。
pinyin: Tā jiāngyào fùzé yī gè guānxi gōngsī qiántú de xiàngmù.
english: He is going to take charge of a project concerning the future of the company.

chinese: 我努力劝他远离那个计划，但是他不听。
pinyin: Wǒ nǔlì quàn tā yuǎnlí nàge jìhuà, dànshì tā bù tīng.
english: I tried to talk him out of the project, but in vain.

chinese: 联合航空公司办理登机手续的柜台在哪里？
pinyin: Liánhé Hángkōng gōngsī bànlǐ dēngjī shǒuxù de guìtái zài nǎlǐ?
english: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?

chinese: 他有个很有意思但很费功夫的工作。
pinyin: Tā yǒu ge hěn yǒu yìsi dàn hěn fèi gōngfu de gōngzuò.
english: He has an interesting job, for which he has to work a lot.

chinese: 记忆是我们大脑的一种主要功能。
pinyin: Jìyì shì wǒmen dànǎo de yīzhǒng zhǔyào gōngnéng.
english: Memory is an essential function of our brain.

chinese: 刹车的功能是使车停下。
pinyin: Shāchē de gōngnéng shì shǐ chē tíngxià.
english: The function of the brake is to stop the car.

chinese: 我想学日语，但是我不喜欢看日本动画片。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xué Rìyǔ, dànshì wǒ bù xǐhuan kàn Rìběn dònghuàpiàn.
english: I want to learn Japanese but I don't like watching anime.

chinese: 她星期天也只能去公司做义务劳动了。
pinyin: Tā Xīngqītiān yě zhǐnéng qù gōngsī zuò yìwù láodòng le.
english: She can only go to the company to do voluntary work on Sundays.

chinese: 可否劳驾你帮我个忙？
pinyin: Kěfǒu láojià nǐ bāng wǒ gè máng?
english: Could you please do me a favor?

chinese: 他有勇气承认自己的错误。
pinyin: Tā yǒu yǒng qì chéng rèn zì jǐ de cuò wù。
english: He has the courage to admit his mistakes.

chinese: 他的勇气将帮助他度过这艰难的任务。
pinyin: Tā de yǒngqì jiāng bāngzhù tā dùguò zhè jiānnán de rènwu.
english: His courage will carry him through this difficult job.

chinese: 他是众多学生之中最勤奋用功的一个。
pinyin: Tā shì zhòngduō xuésheng zhīzhōng zuì qínfèn yònggōng de yī gè.
english: He studies hardest of all the students.

chinese: 宝宝还不会使用勺子。
pinyin: Bǎobǎo hái bù huì shǐyòng sháozi.
english: The baby cannot use a spoon yet.

chinese: 在同一句中不要包含多个可选单词。
pinyin: Zài tóngyī jù zhōng bù yào bāohán duō ge kěxuǎn dāncí.
english: Don't include multiple alternative words inside the same sentence.

chinese: 大学时期，买零食很便宜。我常常会吃个咖哩牛肉包子或一个大肉桂卷，再喝杯茶。
pinyin: Dàxué shíqī, mǎi língshí hěn piányi. wǒ chángcháng huì chī gè kāli niúròu bāozi huò yī gè dàròu guì juǎn, zài hē bēi chá.
english: During my university days, it was cheap then to buy a snack. I would munch on a curried beef bun or a big cinnamon roll and drink a cup of tea.

chinese: 我花了两千日圆把包裹空运寄出去。
pinyin: Wǒ huā le liǎng qiān Rìyuán bǎ bāoguǒ kōngyùn jìchū qù.
english: I paid 2,000 yen for the parcel to be sent by air.

chinese: 我匆匆忙忙，为的是能赶上第一班火车。
pinyin: Wǒ cōngcōng-mángmáng, wèi de shì néng gǎnshàng dì-yī bān huǒchē.
english: I hurried in order to catch the first train.

chinese: 这里是普通中学的化学实验室。
pinyin: Zhèlǐ shì pǔtōngzhōngxué de huàxué shíyànshì.
english: This is a chemistry laboratory in an ordinary secondary school.

chinese: “放射性”是一个化学术语。
pinyin: "fàngshèxìng " shì yī gè huàxué shùyǔ.
english: 'Radioactivity' is a chemistry term.

chinese: 田里有一匹马。
pinyin: Tián lǐ yǒu yī pǐ mǎ。
english: There is a horse in the field.

chinese: 这个政策导致物价大幅度的上升。
pinyin: Zhège zhèngcè dǎozhì wùjià dàfúdù de shàngshēng.
english: This policy resulted in a great rise in prices.

chinese: 原材料的价格如石油或者煤的不停地上升。
pinyin: Yuáncáiliào de jiàgé rú shíyóu huòzhě méi de bù tíng dìshang shēng.
english: The prices of raw materials such as oil or coal continue to rise.

chinese: 我在想是否北极的冰融化的时候, 海平面就会上升。
pinyin: Wǒ zài xiǎng shìfǒu běijí de bīng rónghuà de shíhou, hǎipíngmiàn jiù huì shàngshēng.
english: I wonder if the sea levels will rise when the North Pole melts.

chinese: 她是一位华裔作家。
pinyin: Tā shì yī wèi Huá yì zuò jiā。
english: She is a writer of Chinese descent.
