chinese: 他的第三点说明的是，埃米特试图协调现实与他的理论设计。
pinyin: Tā de dì sān diǎn shuōmíng de shì, āi mǐ tè shìtú xiétiáo xiànshí yǔ tā de lǐlùn shèjì.
english: The third point to make is that Emmet attempted to harmonize his theory with the reality of designing.

chinese: 请介绍一下这个单元。
pinyin: Qǐng jiè shào yī xià zhè gè dān yuán。
english: Please tell us about this unit.

chinese: 留西雅是一个很单纯的姑娘。
pinyin: Liú xī yǎ shì yī gè hěn dānchún de gūniang.
english: Lucia is a simple kind of girl.

chinese: 可惜电话占线。
pinyin: Kěxī diànhuà zhànxiàn.
english: The number is unfortunately busy.

chinese: 我说过了，这是一个会议室，不是卧室。
pinyin: Wǒ shuō guo le, zhè shì yī gè huìyìshì, bù shì wòshì.
english: I said that this was a meeting room, not a bedroom!

chinese: 服务站的卫生间大多很脏。
pinyin: Fúwù zhàn de wèishēngjiān dàduō hěn zāng.
english: The toilets at motorway service stations are often very dirty.

chinese: 有些药品会对身体产生危害。
pinyin: Yǒuxiē yàopǐn huì duì shēntǐ chǎnshēng wēihài.
english: Some medicines can be harmful to the body.

chinese: 请把这张纸卷起来。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè zhāng zhǐ juǎn qi lai。
english: Please roll up this sheet of paper.

chinese: 汤姆在需要上厕所的时候会梦见厕所。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ zài xūyào shàng cèsuǒ de shíhou huì mèngjiàn cèsuǒ.
english: Tom dreams of the toilet when he has to go to the bathroom.

chinese: 每个人都将在原则上同意那个想法。
pinyin: Měigerén dōu jiāng zài yuánzéshang tóngyì nàge xiǎngfǎ.
english: Everyone will accept that idea in principle.

chinese: 日本从国外进口各种原料。
pinyin: Rìběn cóng guówài jìnkǒu gèzhǒng yuánliào.
english: Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.

chinese: 她在睡眠中安详地去世了。
pinyin: Tā zài shuìmián zhōng ānxiáng de qùshì le.
english: She passed away peacefully in her sleep.

chinese: 我在兵库县立大学学习。
pinyin: Wǒ zài Bīngkùxiàn lì dàxué xuéxí.
english: I'm studying at the University of Hyogo.

chinese: 政府将会对参与该项计划的企业提供无息贷款。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jiānghuì duì cānyù gāi xiàng jìhuà de qǐyè tígōng wú xī dàikuǎn.
english: The government will provide interest-free loans to firms that participate in the program.

chinese: 双方在会谈中友好地交换了看法。
pinyin: Shuāngfāng zài huìtán zhōng yǒuhǎo de jiāohuàn le kànfǎ.
english: Both parties exchanged ideas cordially in the discussion.

chinese: 事故双方的说法相差太大，当局难以判断哪一方说的是实话。
pinyin: Shìgù shuāngfāng de shuōfa xiāngchà tài dà, dāngjú nányǐ pànduàn nǎ yīfāng shuō de shì shíhuà.
english: The discrepancy between the stories of the two parties involved in the accident was so great that the authorities had a hard time deciding which side was telling the truth.

chinese: 如果有人激怒你，你最好不要立刻做出反应。
pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒurén jīnù nǐ, nǐ zuì hǎo bù yào lìkè zuòchū fǎnyìng.
english: If someone irritates you, it is best not to react immediately.

chinese: 反正事情已过去了，那不用再提了。
pinyin: Fǎnzhèng shìqing yǐ guòqù le, nà bù yòng zài tí le.
english: Anyway the event has already passed, there is no point in mentioning it again.

chinese: 她不仅没责怪他，反而称赞他。
pinyin: Tā bù jǐn méi zéguài tā, fǎn'ér chēngzàn tā.
english: It wasn't just that she didn't blame him - she actually praised the guy.

chinese: 不要为这事发愁。
pinyin: Bù yào wèi zhè shì fāchóu.
english: Don't worry about it.

chinese: 只跑了一点点，膝盖就开始发抖。
pinyin: Zhǐ pǎo le yīdiǎndiǎn, xīgài jiù kāishǐ fādǒu.
english: All I did was run a little and now my knees are wobbly.

chinese: 为了保持竞争力，我们得发挥我们的优势。
pinyin: Wèile bǎochí jìngzhēnglì, wǒmen de fāhuī wǒmen de yōushì.
english: To remain competitive, we've got to play to our strengths.

chinese: 请把发票放在桌上。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ fā piào fàng zài zhuō shàng。
english: Please put the receipt on the table.

chinese: 中国大陆的沿海城市普遍比内陆城市发达。
pinyin: Zhōngguó dàlù de yánhǎi chéngshì pǔbiàn bǐ nèilù chéngshì fādá.
english: Chinese coastal cities are generally more developed than the inland ones.

chinese: 我一星期前意外受伤，现在不能出外。
pinyin: Wǒ yī xīngqī qián yìwài shòushāng, xiànzài bù néng chūwài.
english: I can't go out, because I was injured a week ago in an accident.

chinese: 你喜欢什么口味的咖啡？浓的黑咖啡？
pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan shénme kǒuwèi de kāfēi? Nóng de hēi kāfēi?
english: How do you like your coffee? Strong and black?

chinese: 我真想看看古代的世界是怎样的。
pinyin: Wǒ zhēn xiǎng kànkan gǔdài de shìjiè shì zěnyàng de.
english: I wish I could see the ancient world.

chinese: 你必须每天背一篇古典文献。
pinyin: Nǐ bìxū měitiān bèi yī piān gǔdiǎn wénxiàn.
english: You should memorize a piece of classical literature every day.

chinese: 那么首先我们应该召开一次家庭会议。
pinyin: Nàme shǒuxiān wǒmen yīnggāi zhàokāi yīcì jiātíng huìyì.
english: In that case we should start by having a family meeting.

chinese: 不懂规则的人容易吃亏。
pinyin: Bù dǒng guī zé de rén róng yì chī kuī。
english: People who do not know the rules can suffer losses.

chinese: 请回到你们各自的座位。
pinyin: Qǐng huídào nǐmen gèzì de zuòwèi.
english: Go to your respective seats.

chinese: 合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。
pinyin: Hétong yǐjīng dàoshǒu le, nà jiù chūqù qìngzhù yīxià ba.
english: The contract is in the bag, so let's go out and celebrate.

chinese: 你在签字前必须仔细看合同。
pinyin: Nǐ zài qiānzì qián bìxū zǐxì kàn hétong.
english: You must look over the contract before you sign it.

chinese: 发给好朋友的请帖上有新郎新娘合影的照片。
pinyin: Fāgěi hǎopéngyou de qǐngtiě shàng yǒu xīnláng xīnniáng héyǐng de zhàopiàn.
english: There's a photo of the bride and groom together on the invitation sent to friends.

chinese: 自行车在汽车的右侧行驶是不合法的。
pinyin: Zìxíngchē zài qìchē de yòu cè xíngshǐ shì bù héfǎ de.
english: Bicycles traveling to the right of automobiles is illegal.

chinese: 房间里的所有人都同时看了看自己的手表。
pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ de suǒyǒurén dōu tóngshí kàn le kàn zìjǐ de shǒubiǎo.
english: Everyone in the room checked their watches at the same time.

chinese: 两位跑手同时到达了终点线。
pinyin: Liǎng wèi pǎo shǒu tóngshí dàodá le zhōngdiǎnxiàn.
english: The two runners reached the finish line at the same time.

chinese: 看，这是我的名片。
pinyin: Kàn, zhè shì wǒ de míngpiàn.
english: Look, this is my business card.

chinese: 他不在意衣服是不是名牌。
pinyin: Tā bù zài yì yī fu shì bù shì míng pái。
english: He does not care whether his clothes are a famous brand.

chinese: 我们参观了当地的名胜。
pinyin: Wǒ men cān guān le dāng dì de míng shèng。
english: We visited the local places of scenic or historical interest.

chinese: 对现有代码做出任何修改前，你需要考虑后果。
pinyin: Duì xiànyǒu dàimǎ zuòchū rènhé xiūgǎi qián, nǐ xūyào kǎolǜ hòuguǒ.
english: You need to consider the consequences before making any modifications to existing code.

chinese: 我昨晚吐了。
pinyin: Wǒ zuówǎn tù le.
english: Last night I puked.

chinese: 我决定要去外国读书，把父母吓了一跳。
pinyin: Wǒ juédìng yào qù wàiguó dúshū, bǎ fùmǔ xià le yī tiào.
english: My decision to study abroad surprised my parents.

chinese: 但是歌手并不否认她的出身。
pinyin: Dànshì gēshǒu bìngbù fǒurèn tā de chūshēn.
english: However, the singer does not deny her ancestry.

chinese: 货车的载货量超过了三吨。
pinyin: Huòchē de zàihuò liáng chāoguò le sān dūn.
english: The load of the truck was in excess of three tons.

chinese: 他们的评论很有启发性。
pinyin: Tāmen de pínglùn hěn yǒu qǐfā xìng.
english: Their comments were illuminating.

chinese: 我想知道这些物质是怎么被人体吸收的。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào zhèxiē wùzhì shì zěnme bèi réntǐ xīshōu de.
english: I would like to know how these substances are absorbed by the body.

chinese: 树木排出氧气，吸收二氧化碳。
pinyin: Shùmù páichū yǎngqì, xīshōu èryǎnghuàtàn.
english: Trees give off oxygen and absorb carbon dioxide.

chinese: 她给了他一个温柔的吻。
pinyin: Tā gěi le tā yī gè wēnróu de wěn.
english: She gave him a tender kiss.

chinese: 如果你不想一个人呆着，我可以陪着你。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù xiǎng yīgèrén dāi zhe, wǒ kěyǐ péi zhe nǐ.
english: If you don't want to stay alone, I can keep you company.

chinese: 他向学生们告别了。
pinyin: Tā xiàng xuéshengmen gàobié le.
english: He bade farewell to the students.

chinese: 你知道怎样使用这些命令行工具吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào zěnyàng shǐyòng zhèxiē mìnglìngháng gōngjù ma?
english: Do you know how to use these command line tools?

chinese: 天知道他们的命运到底是什么。
pinyin: Tiān zhīdào tāmen de mìngyùn dàodǐ shì shénme.
english: God knows what their fate will be.

chinese: 好的，您想咨询什么事情？
pinyin: Hǎo de, nín xiǎng zīxún shénmeshì qíng?
english: OK, what would you like advice on?

chinese: 小狗咬住了绳子。
pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu yǎo zhù le shéng zi。
english: The puppy bit onto the rope.

chinese: 这品种的蝴蝶现在已经绝种了。
pinyin: Zhè pǐnzhǒng de húdié xiànzài yǐjīng juézhǒng le.
english: Butterflies of this species are now extinct.

chinese: 哈哈，这个笑话真有趣！
pinyin: Hā hā， zhè gè xiào hua zhēn yǒu qù！
english: Ha ha, this joke is really funny!

chinese: 哪怕没有人陪我，我也要去看这部电影。
pinyin: Nǎpà méiyǒu rén péi wǒ, wǒ yě yào qù kàn zhè bù diànyǐng.
english: Even if no one goes with me, I still want to see this movie.

chinese: 哲学不是我们用六个月就能学的东西。
pinyin: Zhéxué bù shì wǒmen yòng liù gè yuè jiù néng xué de dōngxi.
english: Philosophy is not a thing one can learn in six months.

chinese: 哲学不是书面上的学问，而是一种生活的方式。
pinyin: Zhéxué bù shì shūmiàn shàng de xuéwèn, érshì yīzhǒng shēnghuó de fāngshì.
english: Philosophy is not a written subject, but a way of life.

chinese: 唉，今天又错过了公共汽车。
pinyin: Ài， jīn tiān yòu cuò guo le gōng gòng qì chē。
english: Oh dear, I missed the bus again today.

chinese: 这封信是揭开谜团的唯一线索。
pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn shì jiēkāi mítuán de wéiyī xiànsuǒ.
english: This letter is the only key to the mystery.

chinese: 一个差劲的厨师和下毒者唯一的不同在于他们的意图。
pinyin: Yī gè chàjìn de chúshī hé xiàdú zhě wéiyī de bù tóngzài yú tāmen de yìtú.
english: The only difference between a bad cook and a poisoner is the intent.

chinese: 人类是在没吃掉对方前能够与对方和睦相处的唯一动物。
pinyin: Rénlèi shì zài méi chīdiào duìfāng qián nénggòu yǔ duìfāng hémùxiāngchǔ de wéiyī dòngwù.
english: Man is the only animal that can remain on friendly terms with the victims he intends to eat until he eats them.

chinese: 我坚信他在商业界会有所作为。
pinyin: Wǒ jiānxìn tā zài shāngyè jiè huì yǒusuǒ zuòwéi.
english: I'm sure he will go far in the business world.

chinese: 她善于照顾孩子。
pinyin: Tā shàn yú zhào gu hái zi。
english: She is good at caring for children.

chinese: 她很漂亮，聪明，并且最重要的是，她有一颗善良的心。
pinyin: Tā hěn piàoliang, cōngming, bìngqiě zuì zhòngyào de shì, tā yǒu yī kē shànliáng de xīn.
english: She's beautiful, smart, and - most importantly - has a good heart.

chinese: 突然间她开始用尖锐的声音大喊。
pinyin: Tūránjiān tā kāishǐ yòng jiānruì de shēngyīn dàhǎn.
english: All at once she began to shout in a shrill voice.

chinese: 今天的嘉宾是一位著名的作家。
pinyin: Jīn tiān de jiā bīn shì yī wèi zhù míng de zuò jiā。
english: Today's guest is a famous writer.

chinese: 妈妈嘱咐我早点回家。
pinyin: Mā ma zhǔ fu wǒ zǎo diǎn huí jiā。
english: Mother told me to come home early.

chinese: 为何大声喧嚷？
pinyin: Wèihé dàshēng xuān rǎng?
english: Why are you speaking loudly?

chinese: 中国幅员辽阔,因而茶的品种繁多。
pinyin: Zhōngguó fúyuán-liáokuò, yīn'ér chá de pǐnzhǒng fánduō.
english: China's territory is vast, thus the types of tea vary.

chinese: 请问你们几位是美国贸易代表团的吗？
pinyin: Qǐngwèn nǐmen jǐ wèi shì Měiguó màoyì dàibiǎotuán de ma?
english: Are some of you from the US trade delegation?

chinese: 女孩的脖子上围着一条长长的围巾。
pinyin: Nǚhái de bózi shàng wéi zhe yī tiáo cháng cháng de wéijīn.
english: The girl had a long scarf around her neck.

chinese: 我被各国语言及文字的爱好者所围绕。
pinyin: Wǒ bèi gèguó yǔyán jí wénzì de àihàozhě suǒ wéirào.
english: I'm surrounded by linguaphiles!

chinese: 地球大约每三百六十五天就会围绕太阳旋转一周。
pinyin: Dìqiú dàyuē měi sān bǎi liùshí wǔ tiān jiù huì wéirào tàiyang xuánzhuǎn yīzhōu.
english: The earth makes one revolution around the sun in about 365 days.

chinese: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。
pinyin: Shuǐ shì yètǐ. dòng qǐlai jiù chéngle gùtǐ.
english: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.

chinese: 行星围着固定不动的恒星转。
pinyin: Xíngxīng wéi zhe gùdìng bù dòng de héngxīng zhuǎn.
english: Planets move around a fixed star.

chinese: 国庆节的时候，我们会和家人团聚。
pinyin: Guó qìng jié de shí hou， wǒ men huì hé jiā rén tuán jù。
english: During National Day, we will get together with our family.

chinese: 这家公司不分种族、宗教或国籍雇用人。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī bù fēn zhǒngzú, zōngjiào huò guójí gùyòng rén.
english: That company hires people without regard to race, religion, or nationality.

chinese: 日历上画着红圈的截稿日期使我陷入了焦虑。
pinyin: Rìlì shàng huà zhe hóng quān de jiégǎo rìqī shǐ wǒ xiànrù le jiāolǜ.
english: The red circle on the calendar marking the deadline causes me to fall into anxiety.

chinese: 唯一比无论什么资源都珍贵的是土地。
pinyin: Wéiyī bǐ wúlùn shénme zīyuán dōu zhēnguì de shì tǔdì.
english: The one resource more precious than any other was land.

chinese: 资本、土地和劳动是生产的三大要素。
pinyin: Zīběn, tǔdì hé láodòng shì shēngchǎn de sān dà yàosù.
english: Capital, land and labor are the three key factors of production.

chinese: 这是一片肥沃的土地，居住着不同的民族。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī piàn féiwò de tǔdì, jūzhù zhe bù tóng de mínzú.
english: It's fertile land inhabited by diverse nations.

chinese: 小的时候，我住在阿尔及尔的一个森林地区。
pinyin: Xiǎode shíhou, wǒ zhù zài Ā'ěrjí'ěr de yī gè sēnlín dìqū.
english: Growing up, I lived in a forested area of Algiers.

chinese: 我们表示希望他们能再次出国学习地理。
pinyin: Wǒmen biǎoshì xīwàng tāmen néng zàicì chūguó xuéxí dìlǐ.
english: We expressed the hope that they could go abroad again to study geography.

chinese: 地理课上，老师向同学们展示了地球仪。
pinyin: Dìlǐ kè shàng, lǎoshī xiàng tóngxué men zhǎnshì le dìqiúyí.
english: In geography class, the teacher showed a globe to the students.

chinese: 在建筑物里的所有人都感觉到了地震。
pinyin: Zài jiànzhùwù lǐ de suǒyǒurén dōu gǎnjuédào le dìzhèn.
english: Everybody in the building felt the earthquake.

chinese: 这是我们历来经历过最大的地震。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen lìlái jīnglì guo zuì dà de dìzhèn.
english: The earthquake was the biggest one that we had ever experienced.

chinese: 某些动物烦躁不安, 可能是地震临震前的预兆。
pinyin: Mǒuxiē dòngwù fánzào bù ān, kěnéng shì dìzhèn lín zhèn qián de yùzhào.
english: Agitated activity by certain animals may be a sign of an impending earthquake.

chinese: 若有大地震，房屋会倒塌呀！
pinyin: Ruò yǒu dàdì zhèn, fángwū huì dǎotā ya!
english: If there's a big earthquake, the house could really collapse!

chinese: 一场毁灭性的地震袭击了这个州的首府。
pinyin: Yī chǎng huǐmièxìng de dìzhèn xíjī le zhège zhōu de shǒufǔ.
english: A devastating earthquake hit the state capital.

chinese: 将混合物搅拌均匀。
pinyin: Jiāng hùnhéwù jiǎobàn jūnyún.
english: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.

chinese: 我们坚决反对浪费。
pinyin: Wǒ men jiān jué fǎn duì làng fèi。
english: We firmly oppose waste.

chinese: 她是一个性格坚强的女人。
pinyin: Tā shì yī gè xìnggé jiānqiáng de nǚrén.
english: She's a woman of strong character.

chinese: 我认为你的基本理论是错的。
pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi nǐ de jīběn lǐlùn shì cuò de.
english: I think your basic theory is wrong.

chinese: 在限定时间内完成任务是一个职员的基本素质。
pinyin: Zài xiàndìng shíjiān nèi wánchéng rènwu shì yī gè zhíyuán de jīběn sùzhì.
english: It is a basic quality of an employee to complete his tasks within a fixed time.

chinese: 广告商最基本的工作就是把人的欲望转化成需要。
pinyin: Guǎnggàoshāng zuì jīběn de gōngzuò jiùshì bǎ rén de yùwàng zhuǎnhuà chéng xūyào.
english: The basic job of an advertising agency is to figure out how to turn a desire into a need.

chinese: 他们看了看那堆垃圾，再互相望了一眼。
pinyin: Tāmen kàn le kàn nà duī lājī, zài hùxiāng wàng le yīyǎn.
english: They looked at the rubbish, then they looked at each other.

chinese: 哈里发塔是现时世界上最高的摩天大楼。
pinyin: Hālǐfā Tǎ shì xiànshí shìjiè shàng zuì gāo de mótiāndàlóu.
english: Burj Khalifa is currently the tallest skyscraper in the world.

chinese: 那位士兵变成老师了。
pinyin: Nà wèi shìbīng biànchéng lǎoshī le.
english: The soldier became a teacher.

chinese: 这名士兵痛苦地呻吟。
pinyin: Zhè míng shìbīng tòngkǔ de shēnyín.
english: The soldier groaned with pain.

chinese: 如果你喝速溶咖啡，就不需要咖啡壶了。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ hē sùróngkāfēi, jiù bù xūyào kāfēihú le.
english: If you drink instant coffee you do not need a coffee pot.

chinese: 复制/粘贴是很有用的。
pinyin: Fùzhì / zhāntiē shì hěn yǒuyòng de.
english: Copy-and-paste is very useful.

chinese: 多亏了顺风，我们很快就到了那个小岛。
pinyin: Duōkuī le shùnfēng, wǒmen hěn kuài jiù dào le nàge xiǎodǎo.
english: Thanks to the favorable wind, we soon reached the island.

chinese: 多亏你我胃口都没了。
pinyin: Duōkuī nǐ wǒ wèikǒu dōu méile.
english: Thanks to you I've lost my appetite.

chinese: 事实证明了我们的担心是多余的。
pinyin: Shìshí zhèngmíng le wǒmen de dānxīn shì duōyú de.
english: The facts proved that our worries were unnecessary.

chinese: 周围环境怎么样？静不静？夜晚闹不闹？
pinyin: Zhōuwéi huánjìng zěnmeyàng? Jìng bù jìng? Yèwǎn nào bù nào?
english: How's the neighborhood? Quiet? Noisy at night?

chinese: 住在城市里最让我怀念的，是夜晚的星空。
pinyin: Zhù zài chéngshì lǐ zuì ràng wǒ huáiniàn de, shì yèwǎn de xīngkōng.
english: Living in the city makes me miss starry night skies the most.

chinese: 你度过了很不安宁的一夜。
pinyin: Nǐ dùguò le hěn bù ānníng de yī yè.
english: You've had a very restless night.

chinese: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ suǒ jiànguo de zuì dàxíng de gòuzào le.
english: This is the most massive structure I have ever seen.

chinese: 好像所有的人喜欢大方地欢迎客人来他们家。
pinyin: Hǎoxiàng suǒyǒu de rén xǐhuan dàfāng de huānyíng kèrén lái tāmen jiā.
english: It seems that everyone likes to be generous in welcoming guests to their home.

chinese: 一天早晨我穿着睡衣射了一头大象
pinyin: Yī tiān zǎochén wǒ chuān zhe shuìyī shè le yītóu dàxiàng
english: One morning I shot an elephant in my pyjamas.

chinese: 他以为事情会很简单，想法太天真了。
pinyin: Tā yǐ wéi shì qing huì hěn jiǎn dān， xiǎng fǎ tài tiān zhēn le。
english: He thought it would be easy; that idea was too naive.

chinese: 许多鸟儿高高地飞翔在天空中
pinyin: Xǔduō niǎor gāo gāodì fēixiáng zài tiānkōng zhōng
english: Many birds fly high in the sky.

chinese: 黄昏时分，天空染上了紫色的光。
pinyin: Huánghūn shífēn, tiānkōng rǎnshàng le zǐsè de guāng.
english: At dusk, the sky was dyed with purple light.

chinese: 我太太的所有亲戚都是我的姻亲。
pinyin: Wǒ tàitai de suǒyǒu qīnqi dōu shì wǒ de yīnqīn.
english: All of my wife's relatives are my in-laws.

chinese: 我太太兼职的工作赚进了一些额外的钱。
pinyin: Wǒ tàitai jiānzhí de gōngzuò zhuàn jìn le yīxiē éwài de qián.
english: My wife's part-time job brings in a little extra money.

chinese: 他认为太极拳改善了他的生活。
pinyin: Tā rènwéi tàijíquán gǎishàn le tā de shēnghuó.
english: He believes that Tai Ji has improved his life.

chinese: 我失业又没钱。真不知该何去何从。
pinyin: Wǒ shīyè yòu méi qián. zhēn bù zhī gāi héqùhécóng.
english: I lost my job and I have no money. I'm at my wit's end.

chinese: 汤姆失业后，为了排遣郁闷的心情而开始了赌博。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ shīyè hòu, wèile páiqiǎn yùmèn de xīnqíng ér kāishǐ le dǔbó.
english: After Tom lost his job, he started to gamble to cope with his depression.

chinese: 无产者在这个革命中失去的只是锁链。
pinyin: Wúchǎnzhě zài zhège gémìng zhōng shīqù de zhǐ shì suǒliàn.
english: The proletarians lose nothing in this revolution but their chains.

chinese: 小李经常失眠，因为他的邻居老是大声地吵架。
pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīngcháng shīmián, yīnwèi tā de línjū lǎoshi dàshēng de chǎojià.
english: Xiaoli often loses sleep because his neighbours are always arguing loudly.

chinese: 我都不知道该怎么夸他们了。
pinyin: Wǒ dōu bù zhīdào gāi zěnme kuā tāmen le.
english: I cannot praise them too highly.

chinese: 汤姆找不到锅铲了，只好用夹子为煎饼翻面。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ zhǎobudào guōchǎn le, zhǐhǎo yòng jiāzi wèi jiānbǐng fān miàn.
english: Unable to find a spatula, Tom used tongs to flip the pancakes.

chinese: 我能等奇迹发生，是不是？
pinyin: Wǒ néng děng qíjì fāshēng, shìbùshì?
english: I can hope for a miracle, can't I?

chinese: 我也想要和你身上那件同样的外套。
pinyin: Wǒ yě xiǎngyào hé nǐ shēnshang nèi jiàn tóngyàng de wàitào.
english: I want the same jacket as you are wearing.

chinese: 我买了一套新的音响。
pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yītào xīn de yīnxiǎng.
english: I bought a set of brand new speakers.

chinese: 请为这位女士叫辆出租车。
pinyin: Qǐng wèi zhèwèi nǚshì jiào liàng chūzūchē.
english: Please call this lady a taxi.

chinese: 这个女士看起来很悲伤，也很疲惫。
pinyin: Zhège nǚshì kànqǐlai hěn bēishāng, yě hěn píbèi.
english: The lady looked sad, also tired.

chinese: 她是一位品行端正的女士。
pinyin: Tā shì yī wèi pǐnxíng duānzhèng de nǚshì.
english: She is a very correct lady.

chinese: “洞里发生了什么？我很好奇。”“我一点也不知道。”
pinyin: "Dòng lǐ fāshēng le shénme? Wǒ hěn hàoqí." "Wǒ yīdiǎn yě bù zhīdào."
english: "What's going on in the cave? I'm curious." "I have no idea."

chinese: 如今已经没什么能防范大规模杀伤性武器了。
pinyin: Rújīn yǐjīng méi shénme néng fángfàn dàguīmóshāshāngxìngwǔqì le.
english: Nowadays it's not possible to protect oneself against weapons of mass destruction.

chinese: 问题是我们如何应付目前的困难。
pinyin: Wèntí shì wǒmen rúhé yìngfu mùqián de kùnnan.
english: The problem is how we cope with the present difficulties.

chinese: 工程师告诉我们如何使用机器。
pinyin: Gōngchéngshī gàosu wǒmen rúhé shǐyòng jīqì.
english: The engineer told us how to use the machine.

chinese: 如何提高工作效率是我们现在要面临的难题。
pinyin: Rúhé tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ shì wǒmen xiànzài yào miànlín de nántí.
english: The challenge we are going to face is how to increase work efficiency.

chinese: 群众妨碍了警员执行任务。
pinyin: Qúnzhòng fáng'ài le jǐng yuán zhíxíng rènwu.
english: The crowd obstructed the police in the discharge of their duties.

chinese: 虽然她有些缺点，但我始终还是爱她。
pinyin: Suīrán tā yǒuxiē quēdiǎn, dàn wǒ shǐzhōng háishi ài tā.
english: She has faults, but I love her none the less.

chinese: 她觉得自己受了委屈。
pinyin: Tā jué de zì jǐ shòu le wěi qu。
english: She felt that she had been treated unfairly.

chinese: 我是个委托人。
pinyin: Wǒ shì gè wěituōrén.
english: I'm a client.

chinese: 请注意坐着的姿势。
pinyin: Qǐng zhù yì zuò zhe de zī shì。
english: Please pay attention to your sitting posture.

chinese: 用这种好事来威胁我？我巴不得呢。
pinyin: Yòng zhèzhǒng hǎoshì lái wēixié wǒ? wǒ bābude ne.
english: Don't threaten me with a good time.

chinese: 你认为他还想娶我吗？
pinyin: Nǐ rènwéi tā hái xiǎng qǔ wǒ ma?
english: Do you think he still wants to marry me?

chinese: 萨米这段不堪入目的婚外情毁了他的婚姻。
pinyin: Sà mǐ zhè duàn bùkānrùmù de hūnwàiqíng huǐ le tā de hūnyīn.
english: Sami's sordid love affair destroyed his marriage.

chinese: 我们还从来没参加过中国人的婚礼呢。
pinyin: Wǒmen hái cóngláiméi cānjiā guo Zhōngguórén de hūnlǐ ne.
english: We'd still never been to a Chinese person's wedding.

chinese: 汤姆从没忘记在婚礼周年纪念日送给他妻子花。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ cóngméi wàngjì zài hūnlǐ zhōunián jìniànrì sònggěi tā qīzi huā.
english: Tom never forgets to give his wife flowers on their wedding anniversary.

chinese: 大家听了，都很高兴，觉得这个婚礼又新颖又有意义。
pinyin: Dàjiā tīng le, dōu hěn gāoxìng, juéde zhège hūnlǐ yòu xīnyǐng yòu yǒuyìyì.
english: Everyone listened and was very happy, thinking this wedding was both original and meaningful.

chinese: 我告诉他，我永远不会嫁给他。
pinyin: Wǒ gàosu tā, wǒ yǒngyuǎn bù huì jià gěi tā.
english: I told him, once and for all, that I would not marry him.

chinese: 你觉得汤姆是不是太嫩了？
pinyin: Nǐ juéde Tāngmǔ shì bù shì tài nèn le?
english: Do you think Tom is too young?

chinese: 大象是如今现存的陆生动物里最大的。
pinyin: Dàxiàng shì rújīn xiàncún de lùshēng dòngwù lǐ zuì dà de.
english: Elephants are the largest land animals alive today.

chinese: 我们今天所认识的工业在那个时代不存在。
pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān suǒ rènshi de gōngyè zài nèige shídài bù cúnzài.
english: Industry as we know it today didn't exist in those days.

chinese: 法律架构的存在，使战争罪犯的责任可以追究。
pinyin: Fǎlǜ jiàgòu de cúnzài, shǐ zhànzhēngzuì fàn de zérèn kěyǐ zhuījiū.
english: Legal frameworks exist to hold war criminals accountable.

chinese: 学生工作、文化工作和学术工作应该同时推进。
pinyin: Xuésheng gōngzuò, wénhuà gōngzuò hé xuéshù gōngzuò yīnggāi tóngshí tuījìn.
english: Schoolwork, cultural work and academic work should all be promoted together.

chinese: 这位老师很有学问。
pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo shī hěn yǒu xué wèn。
english: This teacher is very knowledgeable.

chinese: 我不想坐汽车去，宁可走去。
pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng zuò qìchē qù, nìngkě zǒuqù.
english: I don't want to go in the car. I would rather walk.

chinese: 宇宙无穷无尽。
pinyin: Yǔzhòu wúqióngwújìn.
english: The universe is endless.

chinese: 我不知道该说什么来安慰你。
pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào gāi shuō shénme Lái'ān wèi nǐ.
english: I don't know what to say to make you feel better.

chinese: 这男人试着安装他自己的天线。
pinyin: Zhè nánrén shìzhe ānzhuāng tā zìjǐ de tiānxiàn.
english: The man tried to install his own antenna.

chinese: 这个系统存在着许多缺陷和不尽完善的地方。
pinyin: Zhège xìtǒng cúnzài zhe xǔduō quēxiàn hé bù jìn wánshàn de dìfang.
english: This system is bristling with defects and drawbacks.

chinese: 我们想要完整的句子。
pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎngyào wánzhěng de jùzi.
english: We want complete sentences.

chinese: 因此，必须进行额外的测试以确保完整的安全性。
pinyin: Yīncǐ, bìxū jìnxíng éwài de cèshì yǐ quèbǎo wánzhěng de ānquánxìng.
english: As a consequence, additional tests must be carried out to ensure complete security.

chinese: 当然，杂技演员必须有完美的平衡感。
pinyin: Dāngrán, zájìyǎnyuán bìxū yǒu wánměi de pínghéng gǎn.
english: Of course, an acrobat must have a perfect sense of balance.

chinese: 我的汉语并不完美，但能大致听懂他所说的。
pinyin: Wǒ de Hànyǔ bìngbù wánměi, dàn néng dàzhì tīngdǒng tā suǒ shuō de.
english: My Chinese is far from perfect, but I can roughly understand everything he is saying.

chinese: 你最好别提到宗教和政治这些话题。
pinyin: Nǐ zuì hǎo bié tídào zōngjiào Hézhèng zhì zhèxiē huàtí.
english: You'd better avoid discussion of religion and politics.

chinese: 挣钱是他的宗教。
pinyin: Zhèngqián shì tā de zōngjiào.
english: Making money is his religion.

chinese: 宗教不过是有组织的迷信加上一本畅销书。
pinyin: Zōngjiào bùguò shì yǒu zǔzhī de míxìn jiāshàng yī běn chàngxiāoshū.
english: Religion is just organised superstition with a bestseller.

chinese: 他是一位诚实的官。
pinyin: Tā shì yī wèi chéng shí de guān。
english: He is an honest official.

chinese: 这个球是那个男孩的宝贝。
pinyin: Zhège qiú shì nàge nánhái de bǎobèi.
english: This ball is the treasure of that boy.

chinese: 时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。
pinyin: Shíjiān shì shìjiè shàng zuì bǎoguì de dōngxi.
english: Time is the world's most valuable thing.

chinese: 明天我们将迎来第一个实习生。
pinyin: Míngtiān wǒmen jiāng yíng lái dìyī gè shíxísheng.
english: Tomorrow we will welcome the first intern.

chinese: 她终于实现了自己的梦想。
pinyin: Tā zhōng yú shí xiàn le zì jǐ de mèng xiǎng。
english: She finally achieved her dream.

chinese: 有一台笔记本电脑很实用。
pinyin: Yǒu yī tái bǐjìběndiànnǎo hěn shíyòng.
english: It's practical to have a laptop.

chinese: 你们应该实行你们最初的计划。
pinyin: Nǐmen yīnggāi shíxíng nǐmen zuì chū de jìhuà.
english: You must carry out your first plan.

chinese: 我们需要把学到的方法用于实践。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào bǎ xué dào de fāng fǎ yòng yú shí jiàn。
english: We need to put the methods we have learned into practice.

chinese: 该实验的每一步都是经过深思熟虑的。
pinyin: Gāi shíyàn de měi yī bù dōu shì jīngguò shēnsīshúlǜ de.
english: Every step in the experiment was deliberate.

chinese: 美国政府一直视英国为美国的宠物。
pinyin: Měiguó zhèngfǔ yīzhí shì Yīngguó wèi Měiguó de chǒngwù.
english: The American government has always regarded England as America's house pet.

chinese: 我新家的客厅很宽敞。
pinyin: Wǒ xīn jiāde kètīng hěn kuānchang.
english: The living room in my new house is very spacious.

chinese: 宣传由我来负责。
pinyin: Xuānchuán yóu wǒ lái fùzé.
english: I'm in charge of the propaganda.

chinese: 老师宣布明天放假。
pinyin: Lǎo shī xuān bù míng tiān fàng jià。
english: The teacher announced that there would be no classes tomorrow.

chinese: 在江户时代赏月的宴会非常受欢迎。
pinyin: Zài Jiānghù shídài shǎngyuè de yànhuì fēicháng shòuhuānyíng.
english: In the Edo period, moon-viewing parties were very popular.

chinese: 在你们远离家乡之前请给父母一个拥抱。
pinyin: Zài nǐmen yuǎnlí jiāxiāng zhīqián qǐng gěi fùmǔ yī gè yōngbào.
english: Give a hug to your parents before you get far away from your hometown.

chinese: 夫妻分担家务的情况愈来愈普遍。
pinyin: Fūqī fēndān jiāwù de qíngkuàng yù lái yù pǔbiàn.
english: More and more married couples share household chores.

chinese: 上星期天我的家庭去了动物园看熊猫。
pinyin: Shàngxīngqī tiān wǒ de jiātíng qù le dòngwùyuán kàn xióngmāo.
english: My family went to the zoo to see pandas last Sunday.

chinese: 多款经典家庭游戏也将于下个月同步上架。
pinyin: Duō kuǎn jīngdiǎn jiātíng yóuxì yě jiāng yú xiàgèyuè tóngbù shàngjià.
english: Several classic, family-friendly games will also join the service next month.

chinese: 这个家庭热情地接待了我。
pinyin: Zhège jiātíng rèqíng de jiēdài le wǒ.
english: The family received me very warmly.

chinese: 我把笔记落在宿舍了，我现在就回去拿。
pinyin: Wǒ bǎ bǐjì luò zài sùshè le, wǒ xiànzài jiù huíqu ná.
english: I left the notes in the dormitory. I'll go back and get them now.

chinese: 她的生活很寂寞。
pinyin: Tā de shēnghuó hěn jìmò.
english: She lived a lonely life.

chinese: 他主张的是出生的先后次序和个性有很密切的关系。
pinyin: Tā zhǔzhāng de shì chūshēng de xiānhòu cìxù hé gèxìng yǒu hěn mìqiè de guānxi.
english: His claim is that there is a close relation between birth order and personality.

chinese: 对于他来说，这是一件十分重要的事情。
pinyin: Duìyú tā lái shuō, zhè shì yī jiàn shífēn zhòngyào de shìqing.
english: For him, this is a serious enough matter.

chinese: 老师应该一视同仁地对待他们的学生。
pinyin: Lǎoshī yīnggāi yīshìtóngrén de duìdài tāmen de xuésheng.
english: Teachers should treat all their students impartially.

chinese: 除了相信对方以外，你们没什么要做的了。
pinyin: Chúle xiāngxìn duìfāng yǐwài, nǐmen méi shénme yào zuò de le.
english: All you need to do is trust each other.

chinese: 请对比这两张照片。
pinyin: Qǐng duì bǐ zhè liǎng zhāng zhào piàn。
english: Please compare these two photographs.

chinese: 这名采访者确认了他的采访对象。
pinyin: Zhè míng cǎifǎng zhě quèrèn le tā de cǎifǎng duìxiàng.
english: The interviewer identifies his interviewees.

chinese: 这座寺庙是何时建的呢？
pinyin: Zhè zuò sìmiào shì héshí jiàn de ne?
english: When was this temple built?

chinese: 他是个富有才能的年轻导演。
pinyin: Tā shì gè fùyǒu cáinéng de niánqīng dǎoyǎn.
english: He's a talented young director.

chinese: 这小伙子既能干又积极，真是没说的。
pinyin: Zhè xiǎohuǒzi jì nénggàn yòu jījí, zhēnshi méishuōde.
english: The young man is both capable and energetic, needless to say.

chinese: 那个小偷在公交车上摸到了一部手机。
pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu zài gōngjiāochē shàng mō dào le yī bù shǒujī.
english: That thief stole a phone on the bus.

chinese: 她绝望地看着小偷践踏她花园里的植物。
pinyin: Tā juéwàng de kàn zhe xiǎotōu jiàntà tā huāyuán lǐ de zhíwù.
english: She watched in despair as the thief stomped on her garden plants.

chinese: 派对上有很多美味的小吃。
pinyin: Pàiduì shàng yǒu hěn duō měiwèi de xiǎochī.
english: There were many delicious snacks at the party.

chinese: 凡事要尽力而为，更要量力而行。
pinyin: Fánshì yào jìnlì'érwéi, gèng yào liànglì'érxíng.
english: One needs to do their best in all things, and more importantly work within their abilities.

chinese: 请尽量批评。
pinyin: Qǐng jǐnliàng pīpíng.
english: Please criticise as much as possible.

chinese: 皮皮一看到主人回家，就兴奋地摇尾巴。
pinyin: Pípi yí kàn dào zhǔrén huíjiā, jiù xīngfèn de yáo wěiba.
english: The moment Pip saw its owner come home, it excitedly wagged its tail.

chinese: 我没想到今天居然会哭的。
pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎng dào jīntiān jūrán huì kū de.
english: I never expected I would end up crying today.

chinese: 在上一届世界杯上，新西兰在比赛中被墨西哥淘汰。
pinyin: Zài shàng yī jiè Shìjièbēi shàng, Xīnxīlán zài bǐsài zhōng bèi Mòxīgē táotài.
english: In the last World Cup, New Zealand was knocked out of the competition by Mexico.

chinese: 我租了一间离这里不远的屋子。
pinyin: Wǒ zū le yī jiān lí zhèlǐ bù yuǎn de wūzi.
english: I've rented a room not far from here.

chinese: 我们分散开来并在树林中展开搜索。
pinyin: Wǒmen fēnsàn kāi lái bìng zài shùlín zhōng zhǎnkāi sōusuǒ.
english: We spread out and began to search through the woods.

chinese: 他们属于哪一个佛教宗派？
pinyin: Tāmen shǔyú nǎyīge Fójiào zōngpài?
english: Which Buddhist school of thought do they belong to?

chinese: 政府用直升机把物资送到了那个小岛。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yòng zhíshēngjī bǎ wùzī sòng dào le nàge xiǎodǎo.
english: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.

chinese: 解放龟岛！
pinyin: Jiěfàng guī dǎo!
english: Free Turtle Island!

chinese: 先生，请别生我的气！我是新来的工人！
pinyin: Xiānsheng, qǐng bié shēng wǒ de qì! wǒ shì xīn lái de gōngrén!
english: Please don't get mad, sir! I'm a new worker!

chinese: 他的梦想是成为航天航空工程师。
pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng shì chéngwéi hángtiān hángkōng gōngchéngshī.
english: His dream is to become an aerospace engineer.

chinese: 人们可以很容易地看出其中的差别。
pinyin: Rénmen kěyǐ hěn róngyì de kànchū qízhōng de chābié.
english: People can easily tell the difference between them.

chinese: 她买了一些布料，打算为自己做一条裙子。
pinyin: Tā mǎi le yīxiē bùliào, dǎsuàn wèi zìjǐ zuò yī tiáo qúnzi.
english: She has bought some cloth; she is going to make herself a dress.

chinese: 这种布既便宜又结实。
pinyin: Zhèzhǒng bù jì piányi yòu jiēshí.
english: This kind of cloth is both cheap and sturdy.

chinese: 她缺乏常识。
pinyin: Tā quēfá chángshí.
english: She is lacking in common sense.

chinese: 我无法看着这幅画而不想起我母亲。
pinyin: Wǒ wúfǎ kàn zhe zhè fú huà ér bù xiǎngqǐ wǒ mǔqīn.
english: I can't look at this painting without thinking of my mom.

chinese: 他们每天都在地里干活儿。
pinyin: Tā men měi tiān dōu zài dì lǐ gàn huó r。
english: They work in the fields every day.

chinese: 我不知道该怎么回答，便干脆什么也不说。
pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào gāi zěnme huídá, biàn gāncuì shénme yě bù shuō.
english: Not knowing how to answer, I kept silent.

chinese: 欧洲人每年平均饮用十二点五公升的纯酒精。
pinyin: Ōuzhōurén měinián píngjūn yǐnyòng shí'èr diǎn wǔ gōngshēng de chún jiǔjīng.
english: Europeans drink, on average, 12.5 liters of pure alcohol per year.

chinese: 他定已错过了他平常坐的那班列车。
pinyin: Tā dìng yǐ cuòguò le tā píngcháng zuò de nà bān lièchē.
english: He must have missed his usual train.

chinese: 我的老师教我负数也可以开平方根。
pinyin: Wǒ de lǎoshī jiāo wǒ fùshù yě kěyǐ kāi píngfānggēn.
english: My teacher taught me that you can take the square root of a negative number.

chinese: 所有语言都是平等的，但英语比其他语言更平等。
pinyin: Suǒyǒu yǔyán dōu shì píngděng de, dàn Yīngyǔ bǐ qítā yǔyán gèng píngděng.
english: All languages are equal, but English is more equal than the others.

chinese: 我很平静，直到我看到了注射器。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn píngjìng, zhídào wǒ kàn dào le zhùshèqì.
english: I was calm until I saw the syringe.

chinese: 一九六零年代，美国兴起民权运动。
pinyin: Yī jiǔ liù líng niándài, Měiguó xīngqǐ mínquán yùndòng.
english: The 1960s saw the emergence of the Civil Rights movement in the United States.

chinese: 我奶奶年轻的时候身材很苗条，现在年纪大了就发福了。
pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai niánqīng de shíhou shēncái hěn miáotiao, xiànzài niánjì dà le jiù fāfú le.
english: When my grandmother was young, her body was very slim. Now in her old age she's grown plump.

chinese: 幸亏你提醒了我。
pinyin: Xìng kuī nǐ tí xǐng le wǒ。
english: Luckily, you reminded me.

chinese: 很幸运地，我在机场遇到了我的老朋友。
pinyin: Hěn xìngyùn de, wǒ zài jīchǎng yù dào le wǒ de lǎo péngyou.
english: Quite by chance, I met my old friend at the airport.

chinese: 你对人类的未来有什么幻想吗？
pinyin: Nǐ duì rénlèi de wèilái yǒu shénme huànxiǎng ma?
english: What are your dreams for the future of humankind?

chinese: 幼儿园的老师告诉小朋友们要互敬互爱。
pinyin: Yòu'éryuán de lǎoshī gàosu xiǎopéngyǒu men yào hù jìng hù ài.
english: The teacher of the kindergarten told the pupils to respect, and cherish each other.

chinese: 再要开眼界，去看人民广场下面的地下商场。
pinyin: Zài yào kāiyǎnjiè, qù kàn Rénmín Guǎngchǎng xiàmiàn de dìxià shāngchǎng.
english: To broaden your view, go see the underground shopping mall beneath People's Square.

chinese: 英语是目前在世界上使用最广泛的语言。
pinyin: Yīngyǔ shì mùqián zàishì jiè shàng shǐyòng zuì guǎngfàn de yǔyán.
english: English is by far the most widely-spoken language in the world.

chinese: 我们可以把间断平衡理论应用到语言上。
pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ bǎ jiànduàn pínghéng lǐlùn yìngyòng dào yǔyán shàng.
english: We could apply the theory of punctuated equilibrium to languages.

chinese: 她想应聘这份工作。
pinyin: Tā xiǎng yìng pìn zhè fèn gōng zuò。
english: She wants to apply for this job.

chinese: 别说废话了，你知道那是不可能的。
pinyin: Bié shuōfèihuà le, nǐ zhīdào nàshi bù kěnéng de.
english: Don't talk nonsense, you know that's impossible.

chinese: 我想延长这里的住宿多几天。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yáncháng zhèli de zhùsù duō jǐ tiān.
english: I want to extend my stay here for a few more days.

chinese: 警方将催泪弹投掷到了建筑中。
pinyin: Jǐngfāng jiāng cuīlèidàn tóuzhì dào le jiànzhù zhōng.
english: The cops threw tear-gas bombs into the building.

chinese: 敌人对那栋建筑物使出了强力攻击。
pinyin: Dírén duì nà dòng jiànzhùwù shǐchū le qiánglì gōngjī.
english: The enemy made a strong attack on that building.

chinese: 特种部队包围了建筑物。
pinyin: Tèzhǒng bùduì bāowéi le jiànzhùwù.
english: Special forces surrounded the building.

chinese: 我的一个叔叔给我了一些有用的建议。
pinyin: Wǒ de yī gè shūshu gěi wǒ le yīxiē yǒuyòng de jiànyì.
english: An uncle of mine gave me some useful advice.

chinese: 这里正在筹划建设一座发电站。
pinyin: Zhèlǐ zhèngzài chóuhuà jiànshè yī zuò fādiànzhàn.
english: Plans are being drawn up to build a power station here.

chinese: 我们国家必须开发自然资源。
pinyin: Wǒmen guójiā bìxū kāifā zìránzīyuán.
english: Our country must develop its natural resources.

chinese: 昨天举办了开幕式。
pinyin: Zuótiān jǔbàn le kāimùshì.
english: The opening ceremony took place yesterday.

chinese: 当我看到你时，我感到很开心。
pinyin: Dāng wǒ kàn dào nǐ shí, wǒ gǎndào hěn kāixīn.
english: Whenever I see you, I feel happy.

chinese: 算了，我们聊点开心的事吧！
pinyin: Suànle, wǒmen liáo diǎn kāixīn de shì ba!
english: Forget it, let us talk about happy stuff!

chinese: 这家博物馆周末开放。
pinyin: Zhè jiā bó wù guǎn zhōu mò kāi fàng。
english: This museum is open to the public on weekends.

chinese: 当您开车的时候，应该在转弯处减速。
pinyin: Dāng nín kāichē de shíhou, yīnggāi zài zhuǎnwān chǔ jiǎnsù.
english: When you are driving, you should slow down on corners.

chinese: 洋子阿姨的身体太虚弱了而无法工作。
pinyin: Yáng zǐ āyí de shēntǐ tàixū ruò le ér wúfǎ gōngzuò.
english: Aunt Yoko is too weak to work.

chinese: 她病了很久，现在还很虚弱，无法随意走动。
pinyin: Tā bìng le hěn jiǔ, xiànzài hái hěn xūruò, wúfǎ suíyì zǒudòng.
english: She has been ill for a long time and she is still too weak to get about.

chinese: 麻理子的父母强烈反对她和美国人结婚。
pinyin: Málǐzǐ de fùmǔ qiáng lièfǎnduì tā hé Měiguórén jiéhūn.
english: Mariko's parents are strongly opposed to her marrying an American.

chinese: 我想特别强调这一点。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tèbié qiángdiào zhè yīdiǎn.
english: I want to emphasize this point in particular.

chinese: 中国的当代青年文化很空洞。
pinyin: Zhōngguó de dāngdài qīngnián wénhuà hěn kōngdòng.
english: Contemporary Chinese youth culture is very shallow.

chinese: 汤姆想在发出录取通知前先确认申请人的品行证明。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ xiǎng zài fāchū lùqǔ tōngzhī qián xiān quèrèn shēnqǐngrén de pǐnxíng zhèngmíng.
english: Tom wanted to check the applicant's character reference before extending an offer.

chinese: 那台录音机录下了他的声音。
pinyin: Nà tái lùyīnjī lù xià le tā de shēngyīn.
english: That tape recorder recorded his voice.

chinese: 两相比较，他那边的形势更不利一些。
pinyin: Liǎngxiāng bǐjiào, tā nàbian de xíngshì gèng bù lì yīxiē.
english: The comparison between the two was to his disadvantage.

chinese: 这个形容词是用来形容女人的。
pinyin: Zhège xíngróngcí shì yònglái xíngróng nǚrén de.
english: This adjective is used to describe women.

chinese: 在这儿使用的语法形式是现在进行时。
pinyin: Zài zhèr shǐyòng de yǔfǎ xíngshì shì xiànzài jìnxíng shí.
english: The grammatical form employed here is the present progressive.

chinese: 这些经历形成了他的性格。
pinyin: Zhè xiē jīng lì xíng chéng le tā de xìng gé。
english: These experiences shaped his personality.

chinese: 那房子因为其少有的形状被突显出来。
pinyin: Nà fángzi yīnwèi qí shǎoyǒu de xíngzhuàng bèi tūxiǎn chūlái.
english: The house stood out because of its unusual shape.

chinese: 他们完全损坏了国家的形象。
pinyin: Tāmen wánquán sǔnhuài le guójiā de xíngxiàng.
english: They completely destroyed the image of the country.

chinese: 我不能一小时内彻底的了解那堂课程。
pinyin: Wǒ bù néng yī xiǎoshí nèi chèdǐ de liǎojiě nà táng kèchéng.
english: I can't absorb all of the lesson in an hour.

chinese: 汤姆很不高兴，因为她从来不征求他的意见。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ hěn bù gāoxìng, yīnwèi tā cóngláibù zhēngqiú tā de yìjiàn.
english: Tom was unhappy because she wouldn't ask him anything.

chinese: 我不习惯这样的待遇。
pinyin: Wǒ bù xíguàn zhèyàng de dàiyù.
english: I'm not accustomed to such treatment.

chinese: 这个女孩面带微笑向我打招呼。
pinyin: Zhège nǚhái miàndài wēixiào xiàng wǒ dǎzhāohu.
english: The girl greeted me with a smile.

chinese: 这几年有关心理之谜的心理恐怖片很热门。
pinyin: Zhè jǐnián yǒuguān xīnlǐ zhī mí de xīnlǐ kǒngbùpiàn hěn rèmén.
english: Psycho-horror films dealing with the mysteries of human psychology are popular these days.

chinese: 遭受心脏病困扰的人数增加了。
pinyin: Zāoshòu xīnzàngbìng kùnrǎo de rénshù zēngjiā le.
english: The number of people suffering from heart disease has increased.

chinese: 他心脏停止了跳动, 随即死亡。
pinyin: Tā xīnzàng tíngzhǐ le tiàodòng, suíjí sǐwáng.
english: His heart stopped beating and he died immediately.

chinese: 他们的相遇是必然的。
pinyin: Tāmen de xiāngyù shì bìrán de.
english: Their meeting was inevitable.

chinese: 我们有必要为上这门课买本教材吗？
pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu bìyào wèi shàng zhè mén kè mǎi běn jiàocái ma?
english: Will it be necessary for us to buy a book for this class?

chinese: 食物、衣服和住所都是生活的必需品。
pinyin: Shíwù, yīfu hé zhùsuǒ dōu shì shēnghuó de bìxūpǐn.
english: We need food, clothes and a home in order to live.

chinese: 看到他那可笑的样子，大家忍不住笑了。
pinyin: Kàn dào tā nà kěxiào de yàngzi, dàjiā rěnbuzhù xiào le.
english: Upon seeing how ridiculous he looked, everyone could not help but laughing.

chinese: 那两个人不是因为过于上网而忽视他们的孩子。
pinyin: Nà liǎng gèrén bù shì yīnwèi guòyú shàngwǎng ér hūshì tāmen de háizi.
english: Those people did not neglect their child because they used the Internet too much.

chinese: 佛教思想分为哪一些宗派？
pinyin: Fójiào sīxiǎng fēnwéi nǎ yīxiē zōngpài?
english: Which schools is Buddhist thought divided into?

chinese: 思想自由为宪法所保障。
pinyin: Sīxiǎng zìyóu wéi xiànfǎ suǒ bǎozhàng.
english: Freedom of thought is guaranteed by the constitution.

chinese: 回答之前，请认真思考。
pinyin: Huí dá zhī qián， qǐng rèn zhēn sī kǎo。
english: Please think carefully before answering.

chinese: 我们需要了解这种材料的性质。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào liǎo jiě zhè zhǒng cái liào de xìng zhì。
english: We need to understand the properties of this material.

chinese: 我今天总共买了十本书。
pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zǒnggòng mǎi le shí běn shū.
english: Today, I bought ten books in all.

chinese: 他是这个国家的总理。
pinyin: Tā shì zhège guójiā de zǒnglǐ.
english: He is the prime minister of this country.

chinese: 我们总算准时到那里了。
pinyin: Wǒmen zǒngsuàn zhǔnshí dào nàli le.
english: We managed to get there on time.

chinese: 美国总统有权否决与退回法案。
pinyin: Měiguó zǒngtǒng yǒuquán fǒujué yǔ tuìhuí fǎ'àn.
english: The President of the United States has the power to veto and send back legislation.

chinese: 总统不由自主地笑了起来。
pinyin: Zǒngtǒng bùyóuzìzhǔ de xiào le qǐlai.
english: The president laughed in spite of himself.

chinese: 总统不得解散国会。
pinyin: Zǒngtǒng bù dé jiěsàn Guóhuì.
english: The President cannot disband the Parliament.

chinese: 我提醒他要去会见总裁。
pinyin: Wǒ tíxǐng tā yào qù huìjiàn zǒngcái.
english: I reminded him of his interview with the president.

chinese: 不，直到现在她都没有恋爱过。
pinyin: Bù, zhídàoxiànzài tā dōu méiyǒu liàn'ài guo.
english: No, until now she has never fallen in love.

chinese: 这部电影很恐怖。
pinyin: Zhè bù diàn yǐng hěn kǒng bù。
english: This movie is terrifying.

chinese: 他还没有从妻子去世的悲痛中恢复过来。
pinyin: Tā hái méiyǒu cóng qīzi qùshì de bēitòng zhōng huīfù guòlai.
english: He hasn't got over the death of his wife yet.

chinese: 这并不是因为我恨他，相反我爱他。
pinyin: Zhè bìngbù shì yīnwèi wǒ hèn tā, xiāngfǎn wǒ ài tā.
english: It is not because I hate him, but because I love him.

chinese: 他静悄悄地走出了房间，谁也没有发现。
pinyin: Tā jìngqiāoqiāo de zǒuchū le fángjiān, shéi yě méiyǒu fāxiàn.
english: He went out of the room without being noticed by anyone.

chinese: 不要感觉那么悲观。
pinyin: Bù yào gǎnjué nàme bēiguān.
english: Don't be so pessimistic.

chinese: 对一个科学家来说，情绪化是不好的。
pinyin: Duì yī gè kēxuéjiā lái shuō, qíngxùhuà shì bù hǎo de.
english: It is not good for a scientist to get emotional.

chinese: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。
pinyin: Rènhé qíngxù, zhǐyào tā shì zhēnchéng de, jiù shuōmíng tā shì fāzì nèixīn de zìrán liúlù.
english: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.

chinese: 我很惭愧，这是我第一次对我爸说谎。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn cánkuì, zhè shì wǒ dìyīcì duì wǒ bà shuōhuǎng.
english: This is the first time I've ever lied to my father and I am ashamed of myself.

chinese: 有些人，你才刚离开，就已经开始想念了。
pinyin: Yǒuxiērén, nǐ cái gāng líkāi, jiù yǐjīng kāishǐ xiǎngniàn le.
english: There are people who you already miss when you've only just left them.

chinese: 你可以想象在月球上行走吗？
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ xiǎngxiàng zài yuèqiú shàng xíngzǒu ma?
english: Can you imagine walking on the moon?

chinese: 没有爱的人生没有意义。
pinyin: Méiyǒu ài de rénshēng méiyǒuyìyì.
english: Life without love has no meaning.

chinese: 什么赋予了人生意义？
pinyin: Shénme fùyǔ le rénshēng yìyì?
english: What gives life its meaning?

chinese: 不要害怕意外，但要有准备。
pinyin: Bù yàohài pà yìwài, dàn yàoyǒu zhǔnbèi.
english: Do not fear the unexpected, but be prepared for it.

chinese: 你对这场比赛有什么感想？
pinyin: Nǐ duì zhè chǎng bǐsài yǒu shénme gǎnxiǎng?
english: How did you feel about the game?

chinese: 我深深地感激你的建议和好心。
pinyin: Wǒ shēnshēn de gǎnjī nǐ de jiànyì hé hǎoxīn.
english: I deeply appreciate your advice and kindness.

chinese: 我们吃甜点的时候，去那个国家旅游的愿望更强烈了。
pinyin: Wǒmen chī tiándiǎn de shíhou, qù nàge guójiā lǚyóu de yuànwàng gèng qiángliè le.
english: While eating dessert, our desire to travel to that country grew stronger.

chinese: 对他自己的成就他从不感到满意。
pinyin: Duì tā zìjǐ de chéngjiù tā cóngbù gǎndào mǎnyì.
english: He was never content with his success.

chinese: 他成立了自己的公司的时候还不到二十岁。
pinyin: Tā chénglì le zìjǐ de gōngsī de shíhou hái bù dào èrshí suì.
english: He was still in his teens when he founded a company.

chinese: 问心无愧是一个成语。
pinyin: Wènxīnwúkuì shì yī gè chéngyǔ.
english: "Having a clear conscience" is an idiom.

chinese: 更多投资在教育的钱将会刺激经济成长。
pinyin: Gèng duō tóuzī zàijiào yù de qián jiānghuì cìjī jīngjì chéngzhǎng.
english: More money for education will spur economic growth.

chinese: 我会帮你把戒指找回来的。
pinyin: Wǒ huì bāng nǐ bǎ jièzhi zhǎohuílái de.
english: I will find you your lost ring.

chinese: 突然，他拿出了一个戒指，跪在地上，向我求婚。
pinyin: Tūrán, tā náchū le yī gè jièzhi, guì zài dìshàng, xiàng wǒ qiúhūn.
english: Suddenly, he took out a ring, kneeled on the ground, and asked me to marry him.

chinese: 我觉得这钻石戒指太奢侈了。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè zuànshí jièzhi tài shēchǐ le.
english: This diamond ring is too extravagant for me.

chinese: 你不觉得这个名字很讽刺吗，「神圣的战争」？
pinyin: Nǐ bù juéde zhège míngzi hěn fěngcì ma,「 shénshèng de zhànzhēng 」?
english: Don't you think the name "The Sacred War" sounds a bit sarcastic?

chinese: 我的六十岁的房东为什么买了一个蹦床？
pinyin: Wǒ de liùshí suì de fángdōng wèishénme mǎi le yī gè bèngchuáng?
english: Why did my sixty-year-old landlord buy a trampoline?

chinese: 附近有一所学校。
pinyin: Fù jìn yǒu yī suǒ xué xiào。
english: There is a school nearby.

chinese: 看来这些所谓的画家啥也不会画。
pinyin: Kànlai zhèxiē suǒwèi de huàjiā shá yě bù huì huà.
english: Looks like these so-called painters can't paint anything.

chinese: 所谓的先进国家经常把拉丁美洲人看成石器时代的原始人。
pinyin: Suǒwèi de xiānjìn guójiā jīngcháng bǎ Lādīng Měizhōu rén kànchéng Shíqì Shídài de yuánshǐrén.
english: People from the so-called first world look at us Latinos as if we hadn't invented the wheel yet.

chinese: 这是一把中式扇子。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī bǎ zhòngshì shànzi.
english: This is a Chinese fan.

chinese: 我最喜欢的德文字是「手套」。
pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de Déwén zì shì 「 shǒutào 」.
english: My favorite word in German is the word for "glove".

chinese: 我们去办一下手续吧。
pinyin: Wǒmen qù bàn yīxià shǒuxù ba.
english: Let's deal with the formalities.

chinese: 我想向你打听点他的事。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiàng nǐ dǎting diǎn tā de shì.
english: I want to ask you about him.

chinese: 我想我要打喷嚏了。。。给我张纸巾。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng wǒ yào dǎpēntì le... gěi wǒ zhāng zhǐjīn.
english: I think I'm gonna sneeze. Give me a tissue.

chinese: 他注意到我在场，但是没向我打招呼。
pinyin: Tā zhùyì dào wǒ zàichǎng, dànshì méi xiàng wǒ dǎzhāohu.
english: He was aware that I was around, but didn't come to greet me.

chinese: 先生，我可以看看你的驾驶执照吗？
pinyin: Xiānsheng, wǒ kěyǐ kànkan nǐ de jiàshǐzhízhào ma?
english: May I see your driver's license, sir?

chinese: 我们会认真执行这个计划。
pinyin: Wǒ men huì rèn zhēn zhí xíng zhè gè jì huà。
english: We will carry out this plan carefully.

chinese: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。
pinyin: Hú shàng de bīng tài báo le, chéngshòu bù liǎo nǐ de zhòngliàng.
english: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.

chinese: 这个梯子是否足够坚固以承受我的重量？
pinyin: Zhège tīzi shìfǒu zúgòu jiāngù yǐ chéngshòu wǒ de zhòngliàng?
english: Is this ladder strong enough to bear my weight?

chinese: 我不想承担这样一个风险。
pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng chéngdān zhèyàng yī ge fēngxiǎn.
english: I don't want to take such a risk.

chinese: 你会抄我的句子。
pinyin: Nǐ huì chāo wǒ de jùzi.
english: You will copy my phrases.

chinese: 买房要量力而行，但也要把握时机。
pinyin: Mǎifáng yào liànglì'érxíng, dàn yě yào bǎwò shíjī.
english: One needs to buy a house that's within one's means, but one also needs to grasp an opportunity.

chinese: 如果你不抓紧的话，你就会赶不上火车。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù zhuājǐn dehuà, nǐ jiù huì gǎnbùshàng huǒchē.
english: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the train.

chinese: 在我们看来，太阳能电池是一项很好的投资。
pinyin: Zài wǒmen kànlai, tàiyángnéngdiànchí shì yī xiàng hěn hǎo de tóuzī.
english: In our opinion, solar panels are a good investment.

chinese: 他把我妹妹的玩具都抢走了。
pinyin: Tā bǎ wǒ mèimei de wánjù dōu qiǎngzǒu le.
english: He deprived my little sister of all her toys.

chinese: 在明天前完成报告几乎是不可能的。
pinyin: Zài míngtiān qián wánchéng bàogào jīhū shì bù kěnéng de.
english: Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.

chinese: 她在肩上披了一条围巾。
pinyin: Tā zài jiān shàng pī le yī tiáo wéi jīn。
english: She draped a scarf over her shoulders.

chinese: 她把梳子放在抽屉里面。
pinyin: Tā bǎ shūzi fàng zài chōuti lǐmiàn.
english: She put the comb in the drawer.

chinese: 我喜欢把东西拆开，看看里面的结构。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan bǎ dōngxi chāikāi, kànkan lǐ miàndī jiégòu.
english: I like to take things apart to see what makes them tick.

chinese: 拍火车的照片什么的，有什么好玩的呀？
pinyin: Pāi huǒchē de zhàopiàn shénme de, yǒu shénme hǎowán de ya?
english: What's so fun about taking pictures of trains?

chinese: 到了路口，请向右拐弯。
pinyin: Dào le lù kǒu， qǐng xiàng yòu guǎi wān。
english: Please turn right at the intersection.

chinese: 做餐馆服务员啊、酒吧招待员啊，都可以。
pinyin: Zuò cānguǎn fúwùyuán ā, jiǔbā zhāodàiyuán ā, dōu kěyǐ.
english: Either as a waiter at a restaurant or a bartender, both are OK.

chinese: 他张开双臂, 似乎要拥抱这个世界。
pinyin: Tā zhāngkāi shuāngbì, sìhū yào yōngbào zhège shìjiè.
english: He spread his arms as though he wanted to embrace the world.

chinese: 火车拥挤极了，我整趟车程都没有位子坐。
pinyin: Huǒchē yōngjǐ jíle, wǒ zhěng tàng chēchéng dōu méiyǒu wèizi zuò.
english: The train was so crowded that I had to stand all the way.

chinese: 你为什么只拦下了外国人？
pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme zhǐ lán xià le wàiguórén?
english: Why did you stop only the foreigners?

chinese: 因为酷暑一直持续着，请谨防食物中毒。
pinyin: Yīnwèi kùshǔ yīzhí chíxù zhe, qǐng jǐnfáng shíwùzhòngdú.
english: Hot weather will continue, so please watch out for food poisoning.

chinese: 这类运动可以单人练习，不需教练指导。
pinyin: Zhèlèi yùndòng kěyǐ dānrén liànxí, bù xū jiàoliàn zhǐdǎo.
english: This type of exercise can be practiced alone and does not require a coach's guidance.

chinese: 掌管指挥所。
pinyin: Zhǎngguǎn zhǐhuī suǒ.
english: Take control of the command post.

chinese: 这份工作没什么挑战性。
pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò méishénme tiǎozhàn xìng.
english: I don't get enough challenge in this job.

chinese: 请把椅子拿走，它挡着道儿了。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yǐzi názǒu, tā dǎng zhe dàor le.
english: Please remove that chair because it is in the way.

chinese: 说到天使，你就听到他们翅膀挥动的声音。
pinyin: Shuōdào tiānshǐ, nǐ jiù tīngdào tāmen chìbǎng huīdòng de shēngyīn.
english: Speak of angels and you hear their wings.

chinese: 手机突然振动起来。
pinyin: Shǒu jī tū rán zhèn dòng qi lai。
english: The phone suddenly began to vibrate.

chinese: 他的死对我们公司是一个巨大的损失。
pinyin: Tā de sǐ duì wǒmen gōngsī shì yī gè jùdà de sǔnshī.
english: His death was a great loss to our firm.

chinese: 比尔承担了损失的过失责任。
pinyin: Bǐ'ěr chéngdān le sǔnshī de guòshī zérèn.
english: Bill took the blame for the loss.

chinese: 压缩数据的算法能分为两种：一种会造成数据损失，另一种则不会。
pinyin: Yāsuō shùjù de suànfǎ néng fēnwéi liǎng zhǒng: yīzhǒng huì zàochéng shùjù sǔnshī, lìngyī zhǒng zé bù huì.
english: Data compression algorithms can be classified in two categories: those with data loss and those without data loss.

chinese: 据说《哈姆雷特》是写出来的最有意思的剧本。
pinyin: Jùshuō 《 Hāmǔléitè 》 shì xiě chūlái de zuì yǒu yìsi de jùběn.
english: It is said that "Hamlet" is the most interesting play ever written.

chinese: 年轻人伸出他的手，接着我和他握了手。
pinyin: Niánqīngrén shēnchū tā de shǒu, jiēzhe wǒ hé tā wò le shǒu.
english: The young man put out his hand and I shook it.

chinese: 日本有必要和西方各国接触。
pinyin: Rìběn yǒu bìyào hé Xīfāng gèguó jiēchù.
english: Japan needed contact with the Western countries.

chinese: 别再接近我的女朋友了！
pinyin: Bié zài jiējìn wǒ de nǚpéngyou le!
english: Don't you ever go near my girl again.

chinese: 控制自己会说的语言可不简单呀！
pinyin: Kòngzhì zìjǐ huì shuō de yǔyán kěbu jiǎndān ya!
english: It's not easy to control the languages that you can speak!

chinese: 控制一个班级需要你做老师的所有技能。
pinyin: Kòngzhì yī gè bānjí xūyào nǐ zuò lǎoshī de suǒyǒu jìnéng.
english: To control a class calls for all your skills as a teacher.

chinese: 我们需要推广这种方法。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào tuī guǎng zhè zhǒng fāng fǎ。
english: We need to popularize this method.

chinese: 我不推荐在那家餐馆吃饭。食物糟糕透了。
pinyin: Wǒ bù tuījiàn zài nà jiā cānguǎn chīfàn. shíwù zāogāo tòu le.
english: I don't recommend eating in that restaurant. The food is awful.

chinese: 我强烈推荐任何想学习一门手艺的人都去读这本书。
pinyin: Wǒ qiángliè tuījiàn rènhé xiǎng xuéxí yī mén shǒuyì de rén dōu qù dú zhè běn shū.
english: I greatly recommend reading it to anybody thinking of learning a craft.

chinese: 虽受邀参加今晚一个精彩万分的派对，奈何明日不得不打起精神出席会议，只好推辞了。
pinyin: Suī shòu yāo cānjiā jīnwǎn yī gè jīngcǎi wànfēn de pàiduì, nàihé míngrì bùdébù dǎ qǐ jīngshén chūxí huìyì, zhǐhǎo tuīcí le.
english: I got an invitation to a party tonight that I know would be a lot of fun but I have to be in my best form for tomorrow's meeting so I had to turn it down.

chinese: 我们采取了强有力的预防措施。
pinyin: Wǒmen cǎiqǔ le qiángyǒulì de yùfáng cuòshī.
english: We took strong measures to prevent it.

chinese: 我打算描写我们的公园和山。
pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn miáoxiě wǒmen de gōngyuán hé shān.
english: I am going to write about our parks and mountains.

chinese: 你可以帮我提我的袋子吗?
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ tí wǒ de dàizi ma?
english: Could you carry my bags for me?

chinese: 有没有一个国家比美国更提倡爱国主义？
pinyin: Yǒuméiyǒu yī gè guójiā bǐ Měiguó gèng tíchàng àiguózhǔyì?
english: Does any other country fan the flames of patriotism as much as America?

chinese: 请仔细阅读这份提纲。
pinyin: Qǐng zǐ xì yuè dú zhè fèn tí gāng。
english: Please read this outline carefully.

chinese: 贝丝很喜欢在别人说话的时候插嘴。
pinyin: Bèi sī hěn xǐhuan zài biéren shuōhuà de shíhou chāzuǐ.
english: Beth has a strong habit of interrupting people while they are talking.

chinese: 人会因为体温而在红外线摄影机上显现。
pinyin: Rén huì yīnwèi tǐwēn ér zài hóngwàixiàn shèyǐngjī shàng xiǎnxiàn.
english: People show up bright on an infrared camera because of their body heat.

chinese: 电视机不应该摆太接近，摆更远一点。
pinyin: Diànshìjī bù yīnggāi bǎi tài jiējìn, bǎi gèng yuǎn yīdiǎn.
english: The TV shouldn't be so close. Put it a little further back.

chinese: 一群年轻人在操场上打手球。
pinyin: Yì qún niánqīngrén zài cāochǎng shàng dǎ shǒuqiú.
english: A group of young men are playing handball in the playground.

chinese: 别太操心了，不然会掉头发的。
pinyin: Bié tài cāoxīn le, bù rán huì diào tóufa de.
english: Don't worry too much, or you'll go bald.

chinese: 我买了三支铅笔。
pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le sān zhī qiān bǐ。
english: I bought three pencils.

chinese: 我可以用旅行支票支付吗？
pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ yòng lǚxíngzhīpiào zhīfù ma?
english: May I pay with a travelers' check?

chinese: 我可以在这里兑换这张支票吗？
pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ zài zhèlǐ duìhuàn zhè zhāng zhīpiào ma?
english: Can I cash this check here?

chinese: 麻烦我要一张收据。
pinyin: Máfan wǒ yào yī zhāng shōujù.
english: I'd like a receipt, please.

chinese: 在收获季节里农民非常忙碌。
pinyin: Zài shōuhuò jìjié lǐ nóngmín fēicháng mánglù.
english: Farmers are very busy during the harvest.

chinese: 有很多的方法可以改善人的一生。
pinyin: Yǒu hěn duō de fāngfǎ kěyǐ gǎishàn rén de yīshēng.
english: There are many ways to improve one's life.

chinese: 这个政策的目的是改善最贫困城市的环境。
pinyin: Zhège zhèngcè de mùdì shì gǎishàn zuì pínkùn chéngshì de huánjìng.
english: The aim of this policy is to improve the environment in the poorest cities.

chinese: 如果你发现有错的话请帮忙改正。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ fāxiàn yǒu cuò dehuà qǐng bāngmáng gǎizhèng.
english: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.

chinese: 改革者的目标是要改进政府。
pinyin: Gǎigézhě de mùbiāo shì yào gǎijìn zhèngfǔ.
english: Reformers aim to improve the government.

chinese: 政治家以揭露政府官员的腐败来推动改革。
pinyin: Zhèngzhìjiā yǐ jiēlù zhèngfǔguānyuán de fǔbài lái tuīdòng gǎigé.
english: The politician pushed for reform by denouncing the corruption of the government officials.

chinese: 考试结束后，我们可以放松一下了。
pinyin: Kǎoshì jiéshù hòu, wǒmen kěyǐ fàngsōng yīxià le.
english: After the exam, we can relax.

chinese: 我想要按摩。我需要放松。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngyào ànmó. wǒ xūyào fàngsōng.
english: I want a massage. I need to relax.

chinese: 问题不是政治不纯洁，而是整个政治博弈已经腐朽。
pinyin: Wèntí bù shì zhèngzhì bù chúnjié, érshì zhěnggè zhèngzhì bóyì yǐjīng fǔxiǔ.
english: The trouble is not with impure politics, but that the whole game of politics is rotten.

chinese: 这个议案合符我们的政策内容。
pinyin: Zhège yì'àn hé fú wǒmen de zhèngcè nèiróng.
english: This measure is in accord with our policy.

chinese: 该政策在两种意见之间摇摆。
pinyin: Gāi zhèngcè zài liǎng zhǒng yìjiàn zhījiān yáobǎi.
english: The policy fluctuated between two opinions.

chinese: 我们最大的敌人不是别人，可能是自己。
pinyin: Wǒmen zuì dà de dírén bù shì biéren, kěnéng shì zìjǐ.
english: Our biggest enemy may not be someone else, but ourselves.

chinese: 仔细搜寻敌人可能藏身的灌木丛。
pinyin: Zǐxì sōuxún dírén kěnéng cángshēn de guànmùcóng.
english: Investigate thoroughly the bushes where the enemy may be hiding.

chinese: 反叛者践踏敌人的旗帜，以示挑衅。
pinyin: Fǎnpàn zhě jiàntà dírén de qízhì, yǐ shì tiǎoxìn.
english: Rebels stomped on the enemy’s flags as a sign of defiance.

chinese: 在正确使用的情况下，枪可以救人性命。
pinyin: Zài zhèngquè shǐyòng de qíngkuàng xià, qiāng kěyǐ jiù rénxìng mìng.
english: Guns can be life-savers when used properly.

chinese: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？
pinyin: Wèile jiù xǔduō rén xīshēng yīgèrén shìfǒu dàodé?
english: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?

chinese: 他救了那个婴儿，但是却牺牲了自己的生命。
pinyin: Tā jiù le nàge yīng'ér, dànshì què xīshēng le zìjǐ de shēngmìng.
english: He saved the baby at the cost of his life.

chinese: 请你们快点来一辆救护车，快！
pinyin: Qǐng nǐmen kuàidiǎn lái yī liàng jiùhùchē, kuài!
english: Please get here with the ambulance quickly. Hurry up!

chinese: 足球教练站在边线上对自己的队伍喊出指令。
pinyin: Zúqiú jiàoliàn zhàn zài biānxiàn shàng duì zìjǐ de duìwǔ hǎn chū zhǐlìng.
english: The manager and coach stood on the touchline shouting out instructions to their team.

chinese: 他想给他点教训。
pinyin: Tā xiǎng gěi tā diǎn jiàoxun.
english: He wants to teach him a lesson.

chinese: 我们都很敬爱这位老师。
pinyin: Wǒ men dōu hěn jìng ài zhè wèi lǎo shī。
english: We all respect and love this teacher.

chinese: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。
pinyin: Shùjù biǎomíng niánqīngrén chōuyān de xiànxiàng méiyǒu jiǎnshǎo.
english: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.

chinese: 爸爸把那份法文的文件翻译成了日文。
pinyin: Bàba bǎ nà fèn Fǎwén de wénjiàn fānyì chéngle Rìwén.
english: Father translated the French document into Japanese.

chinese: 这就是他用来签署那份文件的笔了。
pinyin: Zhè jiù shì tāyòng lái qiānshǔ nà fèn wénjiàn de bǐ le.
english: This is the pen that he signed the document with.

chinese: 这些都是他的文具。
pinyin: Zhèxiē dōu shì tā de wénjù.
english: All of this stationery is his.

chinese: 你知道人类文明有多少年的历史吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào rénlèi wénmíng yǒu duōshao nián de lìshǐ ma?
english: Do you know how many years old human civilization is?

chinese: 有一家便利店在马路斜对面。
pinyin: Yǒu yījiā biànlìdiàn zài mǎlù xiéduì miàn.
english: There's a convenience store diagonally across the street.

chinese: 大多数中国小孩初学汉字，会使用印有方格的特殊册子，可以辅助工整书写。
pinyin: Dàduōshù Zhōngguó xiǎohái chū xué hànzì, huì shǐyòng yìn yǒufāng gé de tèshū cèzi, kěyǐ fǔzhù gōngzhěng shūxiě.
english: Most kids in China start learning Chinese characters with a special notebook which has square grids that help them write neatly.

chinese: 不论你怎么说，我还是会照我的方式做。
pinyin: Bù lùn nǐ zěnme shuō, wǒ háishi huì zhào wǒ de fāngshì zuò.
english: Whatever you say, I'll do it my way.

chinese: 你能容忍他做事的方式么？
pinyin: Nǐ néng róngrěn tā zuòshì de fāngshì me?
english: Can you put up with the way he behaves?

chinese: 令我吃惊的是，他很容易就想出了一个方案。
pinyin: Lìng wǒ chījīng de shì, tā hěn róngyì jiù xiǎngchū le yī gè fāng'àn.
english: To my surprise, he easily came up with a plan.

chinese: 我无奈只得跟随着她。
pinyin: Wǒ wúnài zhǐdé gēnsuí zhe tā.
english: I couldn't help but follow her.

chinese: 夜空中有无数的星星。
pinyin: Yè kōng zhōng yǒu wú shù de xīng xing。
english: There are countless stars in the night sky.

chinese: 在西班牙日历中，一周的开始是周一。
pinyin: Zài Xībānyá rìlì zhōng, yīzhōu de kāishǐ shì Zhōuyī.
english: In the Spanish calendar, the week begins with Monday.

chinese: 你去那个超级市场，几乎什么日用品都买得到。
pinyin: Nǐ qù nàge chāojí shìchǎng, jīhū shénme rìyòngpǐn dōu mǎidedào.
english: If you go to that supermarket, you can buy most things you use in your daily life.

chinese: 日程表只受到了这次延误的轻微影响。
pinyin: Rìchéngbiǎo zhǐ shòudào le zhè cì yánwu de qīngwēi yǐngxiǎng.
english: The schedule is only slightly affected by this delay.

chinese: 在那个时代，男女发式大体相似。
pinyin: Zài nàge shídài, nánnǚ fàshì dàtǐ xiāngsì.
english: In that age, men and women wore similar hairstyles.

chinese: 地震时时刻刻都有可能发生。
pinyin: Dìzhèn shíshíkèkè dōu yǒukěnéng fāshēng.
english: Earthquakes may occur at any moment.

chinese: 跟上最近潮流时尚是件非常花钱的事儿。
pinyin: Gēnshàng zuì jìn cháoliú shíshàng shì jiàn fēicháng huāqián de shìr.
english: It is very expensive to keep up with the latest fashions.

chinese: 太空竞赛是历史上激动人心的时期。
pinyin: Tàikōng jìngsài shì lìshǐshàng jīdòng rénxīn de shíqī.
english: The space race was an exciting time in history.

chinese: 这件衣服很时髦。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fu hěn shí máo。
english: This piece of clothing is very fashionable.

chinese: 谁是你最喜爱的电视明星？
pinyin: Shéi shì nǐ zuì xǐ'ài de diànshì míngxīng?
english: Who is your favorite TV star?

chinese: 很明显的是这两者之间有很强烈的分歧。
pinyin: Hěn míngxiǎn de shì zhè liǎngzhě zhījiān yǒu hěn qiángliè de fēnqí.
english: It's clear that there's a rather strong disagreement between the two.

chinese: 我要明确表示我不会再来了。
pinyin: Wǒ yào míngquè biǎoshì wǒ bù huì zài lái le.
english: I will make it clear that I won't come again.

chinese: 我想知道明天是否会下雨。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào míngtiān shìfǒu huì xiàyǔ.
english: I wonder if it will rain tomorrow.

chinese: 她穿着高跟鞋，这样显得更高一些。
pinyin: Tā chuān zhe gāogēnxié, zhèyàng xiǎnde gèng gāo yīxiē.
english: She wears high heels to make herself look taller.

chinese: 显然没有人有新的建议。
pinyin: Xiǎnrán méiyǒu rén yǒu xīn de jiànyì.
english: It is clear that no one has anything new to suggest.

chinese: 眼前的景色让齐里感到自身的渺小。
pinyin: Yǎnqián de jǐngsè ràng qí lǐ gǎndào zìshēn de miǎoxiǎo.
english: Ziri felt humbled by such a scenery.

chinese: 有智慧才能分辨善恶邪正；有谦虚才能建立美满人生。
pinyin: Yǒu zhìhuì cáinéng fēnbiàn shàn'è xié zhèng; yǒu qiānxū cáinéng jiànlì měimǎn rénshēng.
english: Only with wisdom can one distinguish between good and evil; only with humility can one build a happy life.

chinese: 台湾曾经是日本的殖民地。
pinyin: Táiwān céngjīng shì Rìběn de zhímíndì.
english: Taiwan was once a colony of Japan.

chinese: 加拿大国歌的歌词最初是用法文写的。
pinyin: Jiānádà guógē de gēcí zuì chū shì yòng Fǎwén xiě de.
english: The text of the national anthem of Canada was first written in French.

chinese: 这本书介绍了中国不同的朝代。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū jiè shào le Zhōng guó bù tóng de cháo dài。
english: This book describes different Chinese dynasties.

chinese: “你期待这次会议吗？” “它没什么值得期待的。”
pinyin: "nǐ qīdài zhè cì huìyì ma?" "tā méishénme zhíde qīdài de."
english: "Are you looking forward to the conference?" "There's nothing to look forward to about it."

chinese: 我问了比尔他旅行期间天气怎么样。
pinyin: Wǒ wèn le Bǐ'ěr tā lǚxíng qījiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng.
english: I asked Bill what the weather had been like during his travel.

chinese: 他用一块木头刻出一尊佛像。
pinyin: Tāyòng yīkuài mùtou kè chū yī zūn fóxiàng.
english: He carved a Buddha statue from wood.

chinese: 木头或许能在水里呆上十年，但它终究不可能变成一条鳄鱼。
pinyin: Mùtou huòxǔ néng zài Shuǐlǐ dāi shàng shí nián, dàn tā zhōngjiū bù kěnéng biànchéng yī tiáo èyú.
english: Wood may remain ten years in the water, but it will never become a crocodile.

chinese: 未来，机器人会像个人电脑一样普及吗？
pinyin: Wèilái, jīqìrén huì xiàng gèréndiànnǎo yīyàng pǔjí ma?
english: In the future, will robots be as common as personal computers?

chinese: 我数着星宿的星光来预测我爱情的未来。
pinyin: Wǒ shǔ zhe xīngxiù de xīngguāng lái yùcè wǒ àiqíng de wèilái.
english: I count the sparkle of constellations to foretell the future of my love.

chinese: 她正在读本科。
pinyin: Tā zhèng zài dú běn kē。
english: She is studying for an undergraduate degree.

chinese: 他有修理自行车的本领。
pinyin: Tā yǒu xiū lǐ zì xíng chē de běn lǐng。
english: He knows how to repair bicycles.

chinese: 每个机器人身上都安装了一台发声器。
pinyin: Měi gè jīqìrén shēnshang dōu ānzhuāng le yī tái fāshēngqì.
english: Each robot is equipped with a talking machine.

chinese: 如果被他知道我们在这里，他会杀了我们。
pinyin: Rúguǒ bèi tā zhīdào wǒmen zài zhèlǐ, tā huì shā le wǒmen.
english: If he knows that we're here he'll kill us.

chinese: 汤姆穿着一件防弹衣，所以子弹没把他杀死。
pinyin: Tāng mǔ chuānzhe yī jiàn fángdànyī, suǒyǐ zǐdàn méi bǎ tā shāsǐ.
english: Tom was wearing a bulletproof vest, so the bullet didn't kill him.

chinese: 在空无一物的地方, 皇帝再大的权力也无用。
pinyin: Zài kōng wú yī wù de dìfang, huángdì zài dà de quánlì yě wúyòng.
english: In an empty place, an emperor has no power.

chinese: 接受对方的准则就是给予他权力。
pinyin: Jiēshòu duìfāng de zhǔnzé jiù shì gěiyǔ tā quánlì.
english: Accepting the other's norms is submitting to the other's power.

chinese: 这些东西构成了一顿营养均衡的饭。
pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi gòuchéng le yī dùn yíngyǎng jūnhéng de fàn.
english: These things constitute a balanced meal.

chinese: 橡树的果实是什么？
pinyin: Xiàngshù de guǒshí shì shénme?
english: What is the fruit of the oak?

chinese: 他们听到远处传来一下枪声。
pinyin: Tāmen tīngdào yuǎnchù chuánlái yīxià qiāngshēng.
english: They heard a gun go off in the distance.

chinese: 我把我的手枪指向了目标。
pinyin: Wǒ bǎ wǒ de shǒuqiāng zhǐxiàng le mùbiāo.
english: I aimed my gun at the target.

chinese: 男子从口袋中掏出枪，吓了我一跳。
pinyin: Nánzǐ cóng kǒudài zhōng tāochū qiāng, xià le wǒ yī tiào.
english: To my horror, the man took a gun out of his pocket.

chinese: 你得要更注意拼字和标点符号。
pinyin: Nǐ děiyào gèng zhùyì pīnzì hé biāodiǎnfúhào.
english: You must be more careful about spelling and punctuation.

chinese: 世界语的思想核心在于一切语言文化的平等。
pinyin: Shìjièyǔ de sīxiǎng héxīn zàiyú yīqiè yǔyán wénhuà de píngděng.
english: The heart of Esperanto ideology is the equality of all languages and cultures.

chinese: 我们上课时学了九的根是三。
pinyin: Wǒmen shàngkè shí xué le jiǔ de gēn shì sān.
english: We learned at school that the square root of nine is three.

chinese: 这个世界上有些事物根本不能用言语形容。
pinyin: Zhège shìjièshàng yǒuxiē shìwù gēnběn bù néngyòng yányǔ xíngróng.
english: There are things in this world which simply cannot be expressed in the form of words.

chinese: 从根本上说，十二生肖的形成，与动物崇拜有关。
pinyin: Cóng gēnběn shàng shuō, shí'èr shēngxiào de xíngchéng, yǔ dòngwù chóngbài yǒuguān.
english: On a fundamental level, the 12 forms of the Chinese zodiac are related to animal worship.

chinese: 今天的花格外美丽。
pinyin: Jīn tiān de huā gé wài měi lì。
english: The flowers are especially beautiful today.

chinese: 你曾经用德语和那棵小桃树打过招呼吗？
pinyin: Nǐ céngjīng yòng Déyǔ hé nà kē xiǎo táoshù dǎ guòzhāo hū ma?
english: Have you ever greeted the small peach tree in German?

chinese: 我想尝尝这里的桔子。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng cháng cháng zhè lǐ de jú zi。
english: I would like to try the tangerines here.

chinese: 这只梨闻上去很香。
pinyin: Zhè zhī lí wénshàngqù hěn xiāng.
english: This pear smells nice.

chinese: 这块地里种的是棉花。
pinyin: Zhè kuài dì lǐ zhòng de shì mián hua。
english: Cotton is grown in this field.

chinese: 你的想法真棒！
pinyin: Nǐ de xiǎng fǎ zhēn bàng！
english: Your idea is excellent!

chinese: 美国是一个可以用一个字来概括的国家。我曾与习近平主席一起在喜马拉雅山麓。
pinyin: Měiguó shì yī gè kěyǐ yòng yī gè zì lái gàikuò de guójiā. wǒ céng yǔ Xí Jìnpíng zhǔxí yīqǐ zài Xǐmǎlāyǎshān lù.
english: America is a nation that can be defined in a single word. I was in the foothills of the Himalayas with Xi Jinping.

chinese: 你从这里过去到那里，穿过第二条横马路就是。
pinyin: Nǐ cóng zhèlǐ guòqù dào nàli, chuānguò dì'èr tiáo héng mǎlù jiùshì.
english: You can get there by crossing the street at the second intersection.

chinese: 我用橡皮擦掉了这个字。
pinyin: Wǒ yòng xiàng pí cā diào le zhè gè zì。
english: I erased this character with an eraser.

chinese: 关于那件事你欠我一个道歉。
pinyin: Guānyú nà jiàn shì nǐ qiàn wǒ yī gè dàoqiàn.
english: You owe me an apology for that.

chinese: 女性永远只能扮演次要角色吗？
pinyin: Nǚxìng yǒngyuǎn zhǐnéng bànyǎn cìyào juésè ma?
english: Must the woman always play the secondary role?

chinese: 你看起来累了。你该歇息一会儿了。
pinyin: Nǐ kànqǐlai lèi le. Nǐ gāi xiēxi yīhuìr le.
english: You look tired. You should rest a little.

chinese: 我正想打电话给你，你的电报就送来了。
pinyin: Wǒ zhèng xiǎng dǎdiànhuà gěi nǐ, nǐ de diànbào jiù sòng lái le.
english: Your telegram arrived just as I was about to telephone you.

chinese: 此外，中国人喜欢睡午觉。
pinyin: Cǐwài, Zhōngguórén xǐhuan shuìwǔjiào.
english: What's more, Chinese people like taking naps.

chinese: 请介绍一下这个步骤。
pinyin: Qǐng jiè shào yī xià zhè gè bù zhòu。
english: Please tell us about this step.

chinese: 她每周都练习武术。
pinyin: Tā měi zhōu dōu liàn xí wǔ shù。
english: She practices martial arts every week.

chinese: 我们需要准确计算比例。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào zhǔn què jì suàn bǐ lì。
english: We need to calculate the proportion accurately.

chinese: 比如说，我要到市中心，有什么车子可以坐吗？
pinyin: Bǐrú shuō, wǒ yào dào shìzhōngxīn, yǒu shénme chēzi kěyǐ zuò ma?
english: For example, if I want to get downtown what bus should I take?

chinese: 我不是很中国人，比如我不觉得台湾是中国领土。
pinyin: Wǒ bù shì hěn Zhōngguórén, bǐrú wǒ bù juéde Táiwān shì Zhōngguó lǐngtǔ.
english: I'm not very Chinese. For example, I don't believe that Taiwan is Chinese territory.

chinese: 比起紫色的毛衣，我更喜欢灰色的毛衣。
pinyin: Bǐqǐ zǐsè de máoyī, wǒ gèng xǐhuan huīsè de máoyī.
english: I like the gray sweater more than the purple one.

chinese: 为了增添节日的气氛 ，那里的人用盆栽装饰他们的家。
pinyin: Wèile zēngtiān jiérì de qìfēn, nàli de rén yòng pénzāi zhuāngshì tāmen de jiā.
english: People there decorate their homes with potted flowers to add to the festival atmosphere.

chinese: 今天的汇率是多少？
pinyin: Jīntiān de huìlǜ shì duōshao?
english: What is the exchange rate today?

chinese: 孩子们在池子边玩。
pinyin: Hái zi men zài chí zi biān wán。
english: The children are playing beside the pond.

chinese: 汽车快没有汽油了。
pinyin: Qì chē kuài méi yǒu qì yóu le。
english: The car is nearly out of gasoline.

chinese: 因为不知道该说什么，我保持了沉默。
pinyin: Yīnwèi bù zhīdào gāi shuō shénme, wǒ bǎochí le chénmò.
english: Not knowing what to say, I remained silent.

chinese: 我们发现了沙滩上的脚印。
pinyin: Wǒmen fāxiàn le shātān shàng de jiǎoyìn.
english: We found the footprints in the sand.

chinese: 沙漠里很少下雨。
pinyin: Shā mò lǐ hěn shǎo xià yǔ。
english: It rarely rains in the desert.

chinese: 以前人们以为只有人类才懂得用语言沟通。
pinyin: Yǐqián rénmen yǐwéi zhǐ yǒurén lèi cái dǒngde yòngyǔ yán gōutōng.
english: People used to think that only humans could use language.

chinese: 阿嗄拉咭是源自非洲的巴西食品，是豇豆面团、洋葱和盐，经棕榈油炸，与虾和辣酱一起食用的食品。
pinyin: Ā á lā jī shì yuánzì Fēizhōu de Bāxī shípǐn, shì jiāngdòu miàntuán, yángcōng hé yán, jīng zōnglǘyóu zhá, yǔ há hé là jiàng yīqǐ shíyòng de shípǐn.
english: Acaraje, a Brazilian food from Africa, is a ball of caupi bean dough, onions, and salt, fried in palm oil and served with shrimp and a spicy sauce.

chinese: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。
pinyin: Yùfáng cuòshī bǐ zhēnzhèng de zhìliáo gèng yǒuxiào.
english: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.

chinese: 被告会向上级法院上诉。
pinyin: Bèigào huì xiàng shàngjí fǎyuàn shàngsù.
english: The defendant will appeal to a higher court.

chinese: 你需要在星期一前注册。
pinyin: Nǐ xūyào zài Xīngqīyī qián zhùcè.
english: You need to register by Monday.

chinese: 公司派他去北京工作。
pinyin: Gōng sī pài tā qù Běi jīng gōng zuò。
english: The company sent him to work in Beijing.

chinese: 说话就如过眼云烟，文字却能流传千古。
pinyin: Shuōhuà jiù rú guòyǎnyúnyān, wénzì què néng liúchuán qiāngǔ.
english: Words fly, texts remain.

chinese: 他思想肤浅，这个我们知道就好。
pinyin: Tā sīxiǎng fūqiǎn, zhège wǒmen zhīdào jiù hǎo.
english: Between you and me, he's a shallow thinker.

chinese: 你可不可以帮忙除草浇花？
pinyin: Nǐ kě bù kěyǐ bāngmáng chú cǎo jiāo huā?
english: Could you please pull the weeds and water the flowers?

chinese: 他这次测验不合格可不是开玩笑的。
pinyin: Tā zhè cì cèyàn bù hégé kěbushì kāiwánxiào de.
english: His failing the test is no laughing matter.

chinese: 我在机场被海关人员搜查。
pinyin: Wǒ zài jīchǎng bèi hǎiguān rényuán sōuchá.
english: I was searched by the customs officers at the airport.

chinese: 如果你喜欢吃海鲜的话，你就来对地方了！
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xǐhuan chī hǎixiān dehuà, nǐ jiù lái duìdì fāng le!
english: If you like seafood, you've come to the right place!

chinese: 你吃不喜欢的食物会消化不良。
pinyin: Nǐ chī bù xǐhuan de shíwù huì xiāohuàbùliáng.
english: Food you eat that you don't like will not be digested well.

chinese: 他们奋斗的目标是消灭天花。
pinyin: Tāmen fèndòu de mùbiāo shì xiāomiè tiānhuā.
english: They are struggling with the goal of wiping out smallpox.

chinese: 酒的消费每年都在上升。
pinyin: Jiǔ de xiāofèi měinián dōu zài shàngshēng.
english: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.

chinese: 物价上涨是多方因素造成的。
pinyin: Wùjià shàngzhǎng shì duōfāng yīnsù zàochéng de.
english: Several factors operated to help prices go up.

chinese: 今天想吃清淡的食物呢。
pinyin: Jīntiān xiǎng chī qīngdàn de shíwù ne.
english: Today I want to eat something light.

chinese: 对一年的这个时候来说，天气很温暖。
pinyin: Duì yī nián de zhège shíhou lái shuō, tiānqì hěn wēnnuǎn.
english: It's warm for this time of year.

chinese: 如果你要我们可以一起去滑冰。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yào wǒmen kěyǐ yīqǐ qù huábīng.
english: We could go skating if you like.

chinese: 做个桶滚。
pinyin: Zuò gè tǒng gǔn.
english: Do a barrel roll.

chinese: 复活节滚彩蛋活动每年复活节周一都会在白宫的草地上举行。
pinyin: Fùhuójié gǔncǎidàn huódòng měinián Fùhuójié Zhōuyī dōu huì zài Báigōng de cǎodì shàng jǔxíng.
english: The Easter Egg Roll is an annual event that is held on the lawn of the White House each Easter Monday.

chinese: 对不起，我们无法满足您的要求。
pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒmen wúfǎ mǎnzú nín de yāoqiú.
english: I am sorry, we are unable to satisfy your demand.

chinese: 轮胎漏气了。
pinyin: Lúntāi lòuqì le.
english: The tire leaks air.

chinese: 我们激烈的讨论了这个问题。
pinyin: Wǒmen jīliè de tǎolùn le zhège wèntí.
english: We had a heated discussion about it.

chinese: 这根湿掉的火柴点不出火的。
pinyin: Zhè gēn shī diào de huǒchái diǎn bù chū huǒ de.
english: This damp match won't light.

chinese: 我用吸尘机把地上的灰尘吸掉了。
pinyin: Wǒ yòng xīchénjī bǎ dìshang de huīchén xī diào le.
english: I sucked up the dust on the floor with a vacuum cleaner.

chinese: 他很坚强，不会那么容易灰心。
pinyin: Tā hěn jiānqiáng, bù huì nàme róngyì huīxīn.
english: He won't be easily discouraged, because he's a tough guy.

chinese: 他是一个脑子灵活的人。
pinyin: Tā shì yī gè nǎozi línghuó de rén.
english: He is a quick-witted man.

chinese: 她正在炒青菜。
pinyin: Tā zhèng zài chǎo qīng cài。
english: She is stir-frying some greens.

chinese: 他点头表示同意。
pinyin: Tā diǎn tóu biǎo shì tóng yì。
english: He nodded to show agreement.

chinese: 啊，吃点心的时间到了。
pinyin: Ā, chī diǎnxin de shíjiān dào le.
english: Ahh, it's dim sim time.

chinese: 结果，我们在那破破烂烂的餐馆里吃了饭。
pinyin: Jiéguǒ, wǒmen zài nà pò pòlàn làn de cānguǎn lǐ chī le fàn.
english: In the end, we ended up eating at that shabby restaurant.

chinese: 我们在中餐厅吃了北京烤鸭。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài Zhōngcān tīng chī le Běijīngkǎoyā.
english: We ate Peking duck in the Chinese restaurant.

chinese: 他把情感藏进了心底，装出热心的样子。
pinyin: Tā bǎ qínggǎn cáng jìn le xīndǐ, zhuāngchū rèxīn de yàngzi.
english: He hid his emotions and pretended to be enthusiastic.

chinese: 老板在的时候他就装成一副很热心的样子。
pinyin: Lǎobǎn zài de shíhou tā jiù zhuāngchéng yī fù hěn rèxīn de yàngzi.
english: He pretends to be enthusiastic when his boss is around.

chinese: 他的演说赢得了观众热烈的掌声。
pinyin: Tā de yǎnshuō yíngdé le guānzhòng rèliè de zhǎngshēng.
english: The audience clapped loudly after his speech.

chinese: 我去用锅煎一个蛋。
pinyin: Wǒ qù yòng guō jiān yī gè dàn.
english: I am going to fry an egg in a pan.

chinese: 这家公司销售煤炭。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōng sī xiāo shòu méi tàn。
english: This company sells coal.

chinese: 就连最黑暗的夜晚都会结束，太阳仍会照常升起。
pinyin: Jiù lián zuì hēi'àn de yèwǎn dōu huì jiéshù, tàiyang réng huì zhàocháng shēngqǐ.
english: Even the darkest night will end, and the sun will still rise as usual.

chinese: 我煮饭的时候你都没露面过，现在你来了？
pinyin: Wǒ zhǔfàn de shíhou nǐ dōu méi lòumiàn guo, xiànzài nǐ lái le?
english: You didn't even show your nose the whole time I was cooking, and now you're here?

chinese: 这房子正在燃烧着。
pinyin: Zhè fángzi zhèngzài ránshāo zhe.
english: The house is burning.

chinese: 她用爱心帮助需要照顾的孩子。
pinyin: Tā yòng ài xīn bāng zhù xū yào zhào gu de hái zi。
english: She helps children who need care with kindness.

chinese: 我们因为只有一个地球，所以更要懂得爱护它。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnwèi zhǐ yǒu yī gè dìqiú, suǒyǐ gèng yào dǒngde àihù tā.
english: Because we only have one earth, we need to understand more how to care for it.

chinese: 爱护文物, 人人有责。
pinyin: Àihù wénwù, rénrényǒuzé.
english: It is everyone's duty to cherish cultural relics.

chinese: 我吃了两片面包。
pinyin: Wǒ chī le liǎng piàn miàn bāo。
english: I ate two slices of bread.

chinese: 只听一方的意见会很片面。
pinyin: Zhǐ tīng yī fāng de yì jiàn huì hěn piàn miàn。
english: Listening to only one side gives a one-sided view.

chinese: 我从来没有看过他穿牛仔裤。
pinyin: Wǒ cóngláiméiyǒu kàn guo tā chuān niúzǎikù.
english: I've never seen him in jeans.

chinese: 他有一本关于物理学的书被出版了。
pinyin: Tā yǒu yī běn guānyú wùlǐxué de shū bèi chūbǎn le.
english: He had a book on physics published.

chinese: 这个垃圾袋不含任何有害化学物质。
pinyin: Zhège lājīdài bù hán rènhé yǒuhài huàxué wùzhì.
english: This trash bag does not contain any dangerous chemicals.

chinese: 妈妈牵着孩子的手。
pinyin: Mā ma qiān zhe hái zi de shǒu。
english: The mother is holding her child's hand.

chinese: 变性者需要不断服用激素来维持性别特征吗？
pinyin: Biànxìng zhě xūyào bù duàn fúyòng jīsù lái wéichí xìngbié tèzhēng ma?
english: Do transgender people need to continuously use hormones to maintain their sexual characteristics?

chinese: 为了赶上那趟火车，我特意起了个大早。
pinyin: Wèile gǎnshàng nà tàng huǒchē, wǒ tèyì qǐ le gè dà zǎo.
english: I got up early to be in time for the train.

chinese: 他似乎对自己的状况不满意。
pinyin: Tā sìhū duì zìjǐ de zhuàngkuàng bù mǎnyì.
english: He does not seem pleased with his condition.

chinese: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。
pinyin: Zìcóng shǒushù hòu, wǒ fùqīn yīzhí chǔyú liánghǎo de zhuàngtài.
english: My father has been in good shape since his operation.

chinese: 德国人很狡猾。
pinyin: Déguórén hěn jiǎohuá.
english: The Germans are very crafty.

chinese: 这些花有一种独特的气味。
pinyin: Zhèxiē huā yǒu yīzhǒng dútè de qìwèi.
english: These flowers have a unique smell.

chinese: 那个时候，墨西哥还没有独立于西班牙。
pinyin: Nàge shíhou, Mòxīgē hái méiyǒu dúlì yú Xībānyá.
english: At that time, Mexico was not yet independent of Spain.

chinese: 有一天，她在森林里遇到一头狼。
pinyin: Yǒu yī tiān, tā zài sēnlín lǐ yùdào yītóu láng.
english: One day she met a wolf in the woods.

chinese: 雅妮像中了圈套的狼一样惊慌
pinyin: Yǎ nī xiàng zhōng le quāntào de láng yīyàng jīnghuāng
english: Yanni panicked like a wolf in a snare.

chinese: 故事里的王子住在城堡里。
pinyin: Gù shi lǐ de wáng zǐ zhù zài chéng bǎo lǐ。
english: The prince in the story lives in a castle.

chinese: 希望与现实之间的矛盾，因何而起？
pinyin: Xīwàng yǔ xiànshí zhījiān de máodùn, yīn hé ér qǐ?
english: From what stems this contradiction between our hopes and our reality?

chinese: 如用现金付款，我们给予九折优惠。
pinyin: Rú yòng xiànjīn fùkuǎn, wǒmen jǐyǔ jiǔzhé yōuhuì.
english: We give a 10% discount for cash.

chinese: 不要踩在碎玻璃上。
pinyin: Bù yào cǎi zài suì bōli shàng.
english: Don't step on the broken glass.

chinese: 我至今还珍惜你十年前给我的项链。
pinyin: Wǒ zhìjīn hái zhēnxī nǐ shí nián qián gěi wǒ de xiàngliàn.
english: I still cherish the necklace you gave me ten years ago.

chinese: 我遇见了以前的班主任时，他问候了我的父母。
pinyin: Wǒ yùjiàn le yǐqián de bānzhǔrèn shí, tā wènhòu le wǒ de fùmǔ.
english: When I met my former teacher, he inquired after my parents.

chinese: 我的哥哥是很狂热的足球迷。
pinyin: Wǒ de gēge shì hěn kuángrè de zúqiúmí.
english: My older brother is a very enthusiastic soccer fan.

chinese: 无理由乱发脾气会让别人反感。
pinyin: Wúlǐ yóu luàn fāpíqì huì ràng biéren fǎngǎn.
english: Losing your temper for no reason would invite the resentment of others.

chinese: 如果运气好的话，我一天可以生产好几件。
pinyin: Rúguǒ yùnqi hǎo dehuà, wǒ yī tiān kěyǐ shēngchǎn hǎojǐ jiàn.
english: I can produce several pieces a day if I'm lucky.

chinese: 老师的例子很生动。
pinyin: Lǎo shī de lì zi hěn shēng dòng。
english: The teacher's example is vivid.

chinese: 文字处理软件和电脑不同的是，它只有一个用途。
pinyin: Wénzìchǔlǐ ruǎnjiàn hé diànnǎo bù tóng de shì, tā zhǐ yǒu yī gè yòngtú.
english: Compared to a computer, a word processor has a single purpose.

chinese: 我们都想知道她为什么甩了这么好的一个男人。
pinyin: Wǒmen dōu xiǎng zhīdào tā wèishénme shuǎi le zhème hǎo de yī gè nánrén.
english: We all wondered why she had dumped such a nice man.

chinese: 阳光照亮田野，痛苦点亮心灵。
pinyin: Yángguāng zhàoliàng tiányě, tòngkǔ diǎnliàng xīnlíng.
english: Sun lights the landscape, pain illuminates the soul.

chinese: 你最喜欢的电台是什么？
pinyin: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan de diàn tái shì shénme?
english: What's your favorite radio station?

chinese: 电池续航力对我来说很重要。
pinyin: Diànchí xùháng lì duìwǒláishuō hěn zhòngyào.
english: Battery life is really important to me.

chinese: 车发动不了因为电池没电了。
pinyin: Chē fādòng buliǎo yīnwèi diànchí méidiàn le.
english: The car won't start because the battery has run down.

chinese: 这个计划听起来有点疯狂。
pinyin: Zhè gè jì huà tīng qi lai yǒu diǎn fēng kuáng。
english: This plan sounds a little crazy.

chinese: 他疲劳过度，又睡眠不足，最后便病倒了。
pinyin: Tā píláo guòdù, yòu shuìmiánbùzú, zuì hòu biàn bìngdǎo le.
english: What with fatigue and lack of sleep, he has fallen ill at last.

chinese: 汤姆在可疑的网站上看视频的时候中了电脑病毒。
