pinyin: Tāngmǔ zài kěyí de wǎngzhàn shàng kàn shìpín de shíhou zhòng le diànnǎo bìngdú.
english: Tom got a computer virus while he was watching videos on dubious Internet sites.

chinese: 你又皮发痒了，找抽，是吧？
pinyin: Nǐ yòu pí fāyǎng le, zhǎochōu, shì ba?
english: You just can't stand still, huh? What are you, looking for a fight?

chinese: 昨天我们玩得特别痛快!
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen wán de tèbié tòngkuài!
english: Yesterday, we had a blast!

chinese: 他儿子的犯罪行为给他带来了很大的痛苦。
pinyin: Tā érzi de fànzuìxíngwéi gěi tā dàilái le hěn dà de tòngkǔ.
english: His son's criminal activities caused him great pain.

chinese: 什么痛苦能让你想用酒精去麻醉自己？
pinyin: Shénme tòngkǔ néng ràng nǐ xiǎng yòng jiǔjīng qù mázuì zìjǐ?
english: What pain are you trying to cover up with alcohol?

chinese: 请把登机牌放在桌上。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ dēng jī pái fàng zài zhuō shàng。
english: Please put the boarding pass on the table.

chinese: 那座泳池看来的确很吸引人。
pinyin: Nà zuò yǒngchí kànlai díquè hěn xīyǐn rén.
english: That pool really looks inviting.

chinese: 皇后的后冠是用黄金铸成的。
pinyin: Huánghòu de hòu guān shì yòng huángjīn zhùchéng de.
english: The Queen's crown was made of gold.

chinese: 台风天记得把窗台上的盆景拿下来。
pinyin: Táifēng tiān jìde bǎ chuāngtái shàng de pénjǐng náxià lái.
english: Don't forget to take your bonsai off the windowsill for typhoon season.

chinese: 这个果酱瓶的盖子卡住了，打不开。
pinyin: Zhège guǒjiàngpíng de gàizi kǎzhù le, dǎbukāi.
english: This jam jar's lid is stuck and won't open.

chinese: 请仔细阅读这份目录。
pinyin: Qǐng zǐ xì yuè dú zhè fèn mù lù。
english: Please read this catalog carefully.

chinese: 北海道有很多又长又直的路。
pinyin: Běihǎidào yǒu hěn duō yòu cháng yòu zhí de lù.
english: There are a lot of long and straight roads in Hokkaido.

chinese: 相关关系不导致因果关系。
pinyin: Xiāngguān guānxi bù dǎozhì yīnguǒ guānxi.
english: Correlation does not imply causation.

chinese: 为了缓解就业压力，国家已经制定了一系列相关政策。
pinyin: Wèile huǎnjiě jiùyè yālì, guójiā yǐjīng zhìdìng le yīxìliè xiāngguān zhèngcè.
english: In order to alleviate employment pressures, the nation has established a series of relevant policies.

chinese: 她应该能跟我奶奶相处得来。
pinyin: Tā yīnggāi néng gēn wǒ nǎinai xiāngchǔ de lái.
english: She will get along with my grandmother.

chinese: 那个谦逊的男人跟邻里相处得很好。
pinyin: Nàge qiānxùn de nánrén gēn línlǐ xiāngchǔ dehěn hǎo.
english: The humble man is getting along with his neighbors.

chinese: 他和他所有的同学相处融洽。
pinyin: Tā hé tā suǒyǒu de tóngxué xiāngchǔ róngqià.
english: He's getting along well with all of his classmates.

chinese: 去美国旅行一次相当于她两年的工资。
pinyin: Qù Měiguó lǚxíng yīcì xiāngdāngyú tā liǎng nián de gōngzī.
english: A trip to America was equivalent to a two-year salary for her.

chinese: 老师和学生一样盼望假期。
pinyin: Lǎoshī hé xuésheng yīyàng pànwàng jiàqī.
english: Not only the student but their teacher is looking forward to holiday.

chinese: 省略掉无用的词！
pinyin: Shěnglüè diào wúyòng de cí!
english: Omit needless words!

chinese: 小林的眉毛长得浓，眼睛又大，睫毛很长。
pinyin: Xiǎolín de méimao zhǎngde nóng, yǎnjing yòu dà, jiémáo hěn cháng.
english: Xiaolin's eyebrows are thick, his eyes are big, and his eyelashes are long.

chinese: 我们不应该看不起任何人。
pinyin: Wǒmen bù yīnggāi kànbuqǐ rènhé rén.
english: We shouldn't look down on other people.

chinese: 它在网际网路上，所以它一定是真实的。
pinyin: Tā zài wǎngjìwǎnglù shàng, suǒyǐ tā yīdìng shì zhēnshí de.
english: It's in the internet, so it must be true.

chinese: 她承认我的声明是真实的。
pinyin: Tā chéngrèn wǒ de shēngmíng shì zhēnshí de.
english: She acknowledged that my statement was true.

chinese: 大部分人只想听到他们自己的真理。
pinyin: Dàbùfen rén zhǐ xiǎng tīngdào tāmen zìjǐ de zhēnlǐ.
english: Most people only want to hear their own truth.

chinese: 在城堡最秘密的密室里有全球宝中之宝——《真理经》。
pinyin: Zài chéngbǎo zuì mìmì de mìshì lǐ yǒu quánqiú bǎo zhōng zhī bǎo ——《 zhēnlǐ jīng 》.
english: In the most secret chamber of the castle lay the greatest treasure on earth—the Book of Truth.

chinese: 她衣衫单薄，恐会着凉。
pinyin: Tā yīshān dānbó, kǒng huì zháoliáng.
english: She wore such thin clothes that she might well catch a cold.

chinese: 他的左眼瞎了。
pinyin: Tā de zuǒ yǎn xiā le。
english: He has lost the sight in his left eye.

chinese: 路边有一块很大的石头。
pinyin: Lù biān yǒu yī kuài hěn dà de shí tou。
english: There is a large stone beside the road.

chinese: 我喜欢喝天然的矿泉水。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan hē tiānrán de kuàngquánshuǐ.
english: I like to drink natural mineral water.

chinese: 所有苹果树都被砍倒了。
pinyin: Suǒyǒu píngguǒ shù dōu bèi kǎn dǎo le.
english: All the apple trees were cut down.

chinese: 他被宣告破产。
pinyin: Tā bèi xuāngào pòchǎn.
english: He was declared bankrupt.

chinese: 用户应该拥有硬件和软件的使用自由，操作系统应该是开放的，而不是封闭的。
pinyin: Yònghù yīnggāi yōngyǒu yìngjiàn hé ruǎnjiàn de shǐyòng zìyóu, cāozuòxìtǒng yīnggāi shì kāifàng de, ér bù shì fēngbì de.
english: A user should have freedom with respect to both hardware and software. An operating system should be open, not closed.

chinese: 这是自动投币电话，用一元硬币来打的。
pinyin: Zhè shì zìdòng tóubì diànhuà, yòng yīyuán yìngbì lái dǎdī.
english: This is an automated payphone; you use it by inserting a coin.

chinese: 他偶然在古董店里发现了这个旧硬币。
pinyin: Tā ǒurán zài gǔdǒng diàn lǐ fāxiàn le zhège jiù yìngbì.
english: He came across this old coin in an antique shop.

chinese: 父亲确定所有的灯都关了后才去睡觉。
pinyin: Fùqīn quèdìng suǒyǒu de dēng dōu guān le hòu cái qù shuìjiào.
english: Father makes sure that all the lights are off before he goes to bed.

chinese: 请快点把碎了的那个换掉好吗？
pinyin: Qǐng kuàidiǎn bǎ suì le de nàge huàn diào hǎo ma?
english: Would you please replace the broken one promptly?

chinese: 他磕碎了下巴，掉了几颗牙。
pinyin: Tā kē suì le xiàba, diào le jǐ kē yá.
english: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.

chinese: 他把他的那段话从磁带里删除了。
pinyin: Tā bǎ tā de nèi duàn huà cóng cídài lǐ shānchú le.
english: He erased his speech from the tape.

chinese: 上个礼拜天我刚好有空。
pinyin: Shàngge Lǐbàitiān wǒ gānghǎo yǒukòng.
english: It happened that I was free last Sunday.

chinese: 我们应该尊重自己的祖先。
pinyin: Wǒ men yīng gāi zūn zhòng zì jǐ de zǔ xiān。
english: We should respect our ancestors.

chinese: 我们所有人都祝福你。
pinyin: Wǒmen suǒyǒu rén dōu zhùfú nǐ.
english: Best wishes from all of us.

chinese: 不要太神经质。
pinyin: Bù yào tài shénjīngzhì.
english: You don't have to be so nervous.

chinese: 骇客们找到渗透私人或公共网络的新方法。
pinyin: Hàikè men zhǎodào shèntòu sīrén huò gōnggòng wǎngluò de xīn fāngfǎ.
english: Hackers find new ways of infiltrating private or public networks.

chinese: 秘书正在安排会议。
pinyin: Mì shū zhèng zài ān pái huì yì。
english: The secretary is arranging the meeting.

chinese: 你知道书架背后藏着一条秘密通道吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào shūjià bèihòu cáng zhe yī tiáo mìmì tōngdào ma?
english: Did you know there was a secret passage hidden behind the bookcase?

chinese: 汤姆和我之间的秘密被曝光了。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ hé wǒ zhījiān de mìmì bèi bàoguāng le.
english: Tom and my secret came to light.

chinese: 他开始说他的秘密的时候，我们都竖起了耳朵来听。
pinyin: Tā kāishǐ shuō tā de mìmì de shíhou, wǒmen dōu shùqǐ le ěrduo lái tīng.
english: We were all ears when he started to tell us his secret.

chinese: 经过几十年的内战，秩序恢复了。
pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ shí nián de nèizhàn, zhìxù huīfù le.
english: After decades of civil war, order was restored.

chinese: 第一次听到弟弟称呼我姐姐。
pinyin: Dì yī cì tīng dào dìdi chēnghu wǒ jiějie.
english: This is the first time I've heard my little brother call me "big sister."

chinese: 不管我怎么称赞他们，都不会过分。
pinyin: Bù guǎn wǒ zěnme chēngzàn tāmen, dōu bù huì guòfèn.
english: I cannot praise them too highly.

chinese: 手指在键盘上快速的移动。
pinyin: Shǒuzhǐ zài jiànpán shàng kuàisù de yídòng.
english: The fingers move fast on the keyboard.

chinese: 你何时移民到我们国家?
pinyin: Nǐ héshí yímín dào wǒmen guójiā?
english: When did you immigrate to our country?

chinese: 你喜欢棒球到什么程度？
pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan bàngqiú dào shénme chéngdù?
english: To what degree are you interested in baseball?

chinese: 这些指控令人震惊:洗钱、逃税和妨碍司法公正。
pinyin: Zhèxiē zhǐkòng lìngrén zhènjīng: xǐqián, táoshuì hé fáng'ài sīfǎ gōngzhèng.
english: The accusations are shocking: money laundering, tax evasion and obstruction of justice.

chinese: 他是个性格强、稳定且可靠的男人。
pinyin: Tā shì ge xìnggé qiáng, wěndìng qiě kěkào de nánrén.
english: He is a man of strong, stable and trustworthy character.

chinese: 经济繁荣稳定，是每个政府都想达到的目标。
pinyin: Jīngjìfánróng wěndìng, shì měi gè zhèngfǔ dōu xiǎng dádào de mùbiāo.
english: A stable economy is the aim of every government.

chinese: 我把空闲时间全都花在阅读上。
pinyin: Wǒ bǎ kòngxián shíjiān quán dōu huā zài yuèdú shàng.
english: I spend what time I can spare reading.

chinese: 这间房间没有空间再放一张床了。
pinyin: Zhè jiān fángjiān méiyǒu kōngjiān zài fàng yī zhāng chuáng le.
english: There's no space in the room for another bed.

chinese: 我门牙突出。
pinyin: Wǒ ményá tūchū.
english: My front teeth stick out.

chinese: 这个进程必须立即停止，否则服务器会故障。
pinyin: Zhège jìnchéng bìxū lìjí tíngzhǐ, fǒuzé fúwùqì huì gùzhàng.
english: This process must be stopped immediately, otherwise the server will break down.

chinese: 可以立即排除事件之间缺乏关联的可能性
pinyin: Kěyǐ lìjí páichú shìjiàn zhījiān quēfá guānlián de kěnéngxìng
english: The possibility of a lack of connection between the events can be dismissed immediately.

chinese: 三的立方是二十七。
pinyin: Sān de lìfāng shì èr shí qī.
english: 3 cubed is 27.

chinese: 二加三等于五。
pinyin: Èr jiā sān děng yú wǔ。
english: Two plus three equals five.

chinese: 请在被叫到名字之前坐在椅子上等候。
pinyin: Qǐng zài bèi jiào dào míngzi zhīqián zuò zài yǐzi shàng děnghòu.
english: Please have a seat and wait until your name is called.

chinese: 等待一位漂亮的姑娘是我的荣幸。
pinyin: Děngdài yī wèi piàoliang de gūniang shì wǒ de róngxìng.
english: It is my pleasure to wait for a beautiful lady.

chinese: 他答应我六点钟的时候他会在这里。
pinyin: Tā dāying wǒ liù diǎnzhōng de shíhou tā huì zài zhèlǐ.
english: He promised me he would be here at six.

chinese: 有东西卡在管子里。
pinyin: Yǒu dōngxi kǎ zài guǎnzi lǐ.
english: Something is stuck in the pipe.

chinese: 他把我们弄糊涂了。
pinyin: Tā bǎ wǒmen nòng hútu le.
english: He confused us.

chinese: 那家馆子物美价廉，美中不足的是他们糟糕的位置。
pinyin: Nà jiā guǎnzi wù měi jià lián, měi zhōng bù zú de shì tāmen zāogāo de wèizhi.
english: That place's food is great, and their prices are good, but the fly in the ointment is their terrible location.

chinese: 她在中文系学习。
pinyin: Tā zài zhōng wén xì xué xí。
english: She studies in the Chinese language department.

chinese: 其中我最常用的是一种抽认卡系统。
pinyin: Qízhōng wǒ zuì chángyòng de shì yīzhǒng chōurènkǎ xìtǒng.
english: Of those, the one I use most often is a flashcard system.

chinese: 系统会调整成允许你看到的内容。
pinyin: Xìtǒng huì tiáozhěng chéng yǔnxǔ nǐ kàn dào de nèiróng.
english: The system will be adjusted to what it is that you are allowed to see.

chinese: 系统故障的修复工作持续了一整个晚上。
pinyin: Xìtǒng gùzhàng de xiūfù gōngzuò chíxù le yī zhěnggè wǎnshang.
english: The repair for the system malfunction lasted for an entire night.

chinese: 我会系领带。
pinyin: Wǒ huì jì lǐng dài。
english: I know how to tie a necktie.

chinese: 这些鞋子太紧了，伤脚。
pinyin: Zhèxiē xiézi tài jǐn le, shāng jiǎo.
english: These shoes are too tight. They hurt.

chinese: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。
pinyin: Jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià, nín kěyǐ liánxì wǒ.
english: If there's anything urgent, you can get in touch with me.

chinese: 渔民用他的网捕到了一只紫色的水母。
pinyin: Yúmín yòng tā de wǎng bǔ dào le yī zhī zǐsè de shuǐmǔ.
english: The fisherman caught a purple jellyfish in his net.

chinese: 如果将蓝色和红色混合，就会得到紫色。
pinyin: Rúguǒ jiāng lánsè hé hóngsè hùnhé, jiù huì dédào zǐsè.
english: If you mix blue and red, you'll get purple.

chinese: 随氧化变成蓝色，最终呈现出鲜艳的红紫色。
pinyin: Suí yǎnghuà biànchéng lánsè, zuì zhōng chéngxiàn chū xiān yàn de hóng zǐsè.
english: As it oxidizes, the color turns blue and finally becomes a brilliant reddish-purple hue.

chinese: 他刷新了百米短跑的世界纪录。
pinyin: Tā shuāxīn le bǎi mǐ duǎnpǎo de shìjièjìlù.
english: His record is a new world record in the 100-meter dash.

chinese: 学生应该遵守学校的纪律。
pinyin: Xué sheng yīng gāi zūn shǒu xué xiào de jì lǜ。
english: Students should follow the school's rules.

chinese: 上周我寄了一些美国纪念品给他。
pinyin: Shàng zhōu wǒ jì le yīxiē Měiguó jìniànpǐn gěi tā.
english: Last week, I mailed him some souvenirs from the U.S.

chinese: 众人纷纷结伴跳起了舞来。
pinyin: Zhòngrén fēnfēn jiébàn tiào qǐ le wǔ lái.
english: Everyone paired off and began dancing.

chinese: 这里你可以看到漂亮的颜色组合。
pinyin: Zhèlǐ nǐ kěyǐ kàn dào piàoliang de yánsè zǔhé.
english: Here you can see beautiful colour combinations.

chinese: 别想了，那不过是些无关紧要的细节。
pinyin: Bié xiǎng le, nà bùguò shì xiē wúguānjǐnyào de xìjié.
english: Forget it, those are just trivial details.

chinese: 我以前经营一家在商场里的小书店。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián jīngyíng yījiā zài shāngchǎng lǐ de xiǎo shūdiàn.
english: I used to run a small bookstore in a shopping centre.

chinese: 我们的结论基于之前对这个问题的研究。
pinyin: Wǒmen de jiélùn jīyú zhīqián duì zhège wèntí de yánjiū.
english: Our conclusion is based on previous studies of the problem.

chinese: 我们得出结论，这个计划目前是不可行的。
pinyin: Wǒmen déchū jiélùn, zhège jìhuà mùqián shì bù kěxíng de.
english: We have come to the conclusion that this plan is not feasible currently.

chinese: 吃完饭后，我们一起去结账。
pinyin: Chī wán fàn hòu， wǒ men yī qǐ qù jié zhàng。
english: After the meal, we went to pay the bill.

chinese: 电脑现在是一个绝对必要的东西了。
pinyin: Diànnǎo xiànzài shì yī gè juéduì bìyào de dōngxi le.
english: A computer is an absolute necessity now.

chinese: 他试着统一不同的团体。
pinyin: Tā shìzhe tǒngyī bù tóng de tuántǐ.
english: He tried to unify the various groups.

chinese: 统治一个国家不是一件简单的工作。
pinyin: Tǒngzhì yī gè guójiā bù shì yī jiàn jiǎndān de gōngzuò.
english: To rule a country is no easy task.

chinese: 这位领导人统治了他的国家五十年。
pinyin: Zhèwèi lǐngdǎorén tǒngzhì le tā de guójiā wǔshí nián.
english: The leader governed his country for more than 50 years.

chinese: 我叫她不要松开绳子，但是她做了。
pinyin: Wǒ jiào tā bù yào sōngkāi shéngzi, dànshì tā zuò le.
english: I told her not to let go of the rope, but she did.

chinese: 我们需要维护自己的权益。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào wéi hù zì jǐ de quán yì。
english: We need to protect our rights.

chinese: 这种药可以暂时缓解身体的疼痛，你需要的话就拿去吧。
pinyin: Zhèzhǒng yào kěyǐ zànshí huǎnjiě shēntǐ de téngtòng, nǐ xūyào dehuà jiù ná qù ba.
english: This kind of medicine can temporarily alleviate pain. If you need it, just take it.

chinese: 我们应该对人使用基因编辑吗？
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi duì rén shǐyòng jīyīn biānjí ma?
english: Should we use genetic engineering on people?

chinese: 因为我这份工作的缘故，我总是要打领带。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ zhè fèn gōngzuò de yuángù, wǒ zǒngshì yào dǎ lǐngdài.
english: I always have to wear a tie because of my job.

chinese: 我们需要缩小差距。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào suō xiǎo chā jù。
english: We need to narrow the gap.

chinese: 别吸烟。吸烟可能缩短你的阴茎。
pinyin: Bié xīyān. xīyān kěnéng suōduǎn nǐ de yīnjīng.
english: Don't smoke. Smoking can shorten your penis.

chinese: 他缺乏工作经验。
pinyin: Tā quē fá gōng zuò jīng yàn。
english: He lacks work experience.

chinese: 我会尝试在商店后面的水果罐头区旁边寻找它。
pinyin: Wǒ huì chángshì zài shāngdiàn hòumiàn de shuǐguǒ guàntou qū pángbiān xúnzhǎo tā.
english: I'd try looking for it next to the tinned fruit section at the back of the shop.

chinese: 有一个危险的罪犯从监狱里逃了出来。
pinyin: Yǒu yī gè wēixiǎn de zuìfàn cóng jiānyù lǐ táo le chūlái.
english: A dangerous criminal escaped from prison.

chinese: 我想去美术馆胜过去电影院。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù měishùguǎn shèngguò qù diànyǐngyuàn.
english: I would rather go to the art museum than to the movie theater.

chinese: 那艘船失去平衡，翻了过来。
pinyin: Nà sōu chuán shīqù pínghéng, fān le guòlai.
english: The ship keeled over and capsized.

chinese: 他是个老实的人，从来不说谎。
pinyin: Tā shì gè lǎo shi de rén， cóng lái bù shuō huǎng。
english: He is an honest person and never lies.

chinese: 我老板把艰巨的任务指派给了我。
pinyin: Wǒ lǎobǎn bǎ jiānjù de rènwu zhǐpài gěi le wǒ.
english: My boss assigned the hard job to me.

chinese: 老板对你的工作有很高的评价。
pinyin: Lǎobǎn duì nǐ de gōngzuò yǒu hěn gāo de píngjià.
english: The boss has a good opinion of your work.

chinese: 许多老百姓加入了军队。
pinyin: Xǔduō lǎobǎixìng jiārù le jūnduì.
english: A great number of citizens went into the army.

chinese: 这只老鼠是死还是活的？
pinyin: Zhè zhī lǎoshǔ shì sǐ háishi huó de?
english: Is the rat alive or dead?

chinese: 我发现你玩绝对不耽误学习。我就不行。
pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn nǐ wán juéduì bù dānwu xuéxí. wǒ jiù bù xíng.
english: I've noticed that having fun doesn't interfere at all with your studies. I just can't.

chinese: 卡尔马克思说了：“全世界无产者，联合起来！”
pinyin: Kǎ'ěr Mǎkèsī shuō le:"quánshìjiè wúchǎnzhě, liánhé qǐlai!"
english: Karl Marx said: "Workers of the world, unite!"

chinese: 周末我们有一个聚会。
pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ men yǒu yī gè jù huì。
english: We have a get-together this weekend.

chinese: 运动可以锻炼肌肉。
pinyin: Yùn dòng kě yǐ duàn liàn jī ròu。
english: Exercise can build muscle.

chinese: 这块肥皂里添加了天然香料。
pinyin: Zhè kuài féizào lǐ tiānjiā le tiānrán xiāngliào.
english: This soap is infused with natural fragrances.

chinese: 我的肩膀很痛，我不知道怎么办。
pinyin: Wǒ de jiānbǎng hěn tòng, wǒ bù zhīdào zěnmebàn.
english: My shoulder hurts so much, I don't know what to do.

chinese: 那个男人在一周前死于肺癌。
pinyin: Nàge nánrén zài yī zhōu qián sǐ yú fèi'ái.
english: That man died of lung cancer a week ago.

chinese: 他为什么会胃痛的原因很明显。
pinyin: Tā wèishénme huì wèitòng de yuányīn hěn míngxiǎn.
english: It's obvious why his stomach hurts.

chinese: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。
pinyin: Bù yào yīnwèi chī de tài duō ér rǎoluàn wèi de zhèngcháng xiāohuà.
english: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.

chinese: 我得了胃肿瘤，必须动手术切除。
pinyin: Wǒ déle wèi zhǒngliú, bìxū dòngshǒu shù qiēchú.
english: I got a stomach tumor and had to have it operated on.

chinese: 癌细胞已经扩散到她的胃。
pinyin: Áixìbāo yǐjīng kuòsàn dào tā de wèi.
english: The cancer has spread to her stomach.

chinese: “坦白说，我有恐高症。”“你是个胆小鬼！”
pinyin: "Tǎnbái shuō, wǒ yǒu kǒnggāozhèng." "Nǐ shì ge dǎnxiǎoguǐ!"
english: "To tell you the truth, I am scared of heights." "You are a coward!"

chinese: 请背这首诗。
pinyin: Qǐng bèi zhè shǒu shī。
english: Please memorize this poem.

chinese: 图片的背景是一座城堡。
pinyin: Túpiàn de bèijǐng shì yī zuò chéngbǎo.
english: There is a castle in the background of the picture.

chinese: 这是一个轻松取得的胜利。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè qīngsōng qǔdé de shènglì.
english: It's an easy victory.

chinese: 你别胡说！
pinyin: Nǐ bié húshuō!
english: Don't talk nonsense!

chinese: 光有胡须不能造就一位哲学家。
pinyin: Guāng yǒu húxū bù néng zàojiù yī wèi zhéxuéjiā.
english: A beard does not make a philosopher.

chinese: 我需要胶水。
pinyin: Wǒ xūyào jiāoshuǐ.
english: I need glue.

chinese: 胸口有点儿疼，所以吃不下饭。
pinyin: Xiōngkǒu yǒudiǎnr téng, suǒyǐ chībuxià fàn.
english: My chest hurts a bit, so I am not going to eat.

chinese: 你的脑袋充满了新点子。
pinyin: Nǐ de nǎodài chōngmǎn le xīn diǎnzi.
english: Your head was bursting with new ideas.

chinese: 你认为汤姆的腰围是多少？
pinyin: Nǐ rènwéi Tāngmǔ de yāowéi shì duōshao?
english: What do you think Tom's waist size is?

chinese: 自从公司合并了以后，一切都变得十分混乱。
pinyin: Zìcóng gōngsī hébìng le yǐhòu, yīqiè dōu biànde shífēn hùnluàn.
english: The office has been topsy-turvy since the merger upset everything.

chinese: 自从我弄断了两条腿，我就拄着拐杖走路了。
pinyin: Zìcóng wǒ nòng duàn le liǎng tiáo tuǐ, wǒ jiù zhǔ zhe guǎizhàng zǒulù le.
english: I'm on crutches since I broke both my legs.

chinese: 哪来那么大的自信啊？
pinyin: Nǎ lái nàme dà de zìxìn ā?
english: Where did all that self-confidence come from?

chinese: 我自愿加入中国共产党。
pinyin: Wǒ zìyuàn jiārù Zhōngguó Gòngchǎndǎng.
english: I willingly join the Chinese Communist Party.

chinese: 现在言论自由被当作是理所当然的事。
pinyin: Xiànzài yánlùnzìyóu bèi dàngzuò shì lǐsuǒdāngrán de shì.
english: Freedom of speech is now taken as a matter of course.

chinese: 没有什么可以阻挡，我对自由的向往。
pinyin: Méiyǒu shénme kěyǐ zǔdǎng, wǒ duì zìyóu de xiàngwǎng.
english: Nothing can keep me from yearning for freedom.

chinese: 自由是我们所力争的。
pinyin: Zìyóu shì wǒmen suǒ lìzhēng de.
english: Freedom is what we're fighting for.

chinese: 请大家自觉遵守规定。
pinyin: Qǐng dà jiā zì jué zūn shǒu guī dìng。
english: Please follow the rules of your own accord.

chinese: 你为你的工作感到自豪吗？
pinyin: Nǐ wèi nǐ de gōngzuò gǎndào zìháo ma?
english: Do you take pride in your work?

chinese: 至于我, 我没有什么更多要说的。
pinyin: Zhìyú wǒ, wǒ méiyǒushénme gèng duō yàoshuō de.
english: As for me, there is nothing more I want to say.

chinese: 舌头和上颚都是味觉器官。
pinyin: Shétou hé shàng'è dōu shì wèijué qìguān.
english: The tongue and the palate are the taste organs.

chinese: 他住在一个舒适的小房子里。
pinyin: Tā zhù zài yī gè shūshì de xiǎo fángzi lǐ.
english: He lives in a cozy little house.

chinese: 要想有良好的人格魅力，必须要有聪慧的头脑。
pinyin: Yào xiǎng yǒu liánghǎo de réngémèilì, bìxū yàoyǒu cōnghuì de tóunǎo.
english: If you want to have an attractive personality, you need to have a good head on your shoulders.

chinese: 这节课很有意思。
pinyin: Zhè jié kè hěn yǒu yì si。
english: This class is very interesting.

chinese: 电脑为我们节省了很多时间，解决了很多问题。
pinyin: Diànnǎo wèi wǒmen jiéshěng le hěn duō shíjiān, jiějué le hěn duō wèntí.
english: Computers save us a lot of time and trouble.

chinese: 花生过敏是最常见的食物过敏。
pinyin: Huāshēng guòmǐn shì zuì chángjiàn de shíwù guòmǐn.
english: Peanut allergy is the most common of food allergies.

chinese: 我爸爸年轻的时候一定很英俊。
pinyin: Wǒ bàba niánqīng de shíhou yīdìng hěn yīngjùn.
english: My father must have been handsome in his youth.

chinese: 尽管受到暴君的迫害，英雄还顽强地斗争。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shòudào bàojūn de pòhài, yīngxióng hái wánqiáng de dòuzhēng.
english: In spite of the tyrant’s persecution, the hero valiantly carried on the struggle.

chinese: 我很荣幸能见到你。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn róngxìng néng jiàndào nǐ.
english: I am honored to meet you.

chinese: 顺便问一下，餐厅晚上几点钟开始营业？
pinyin: Shùnbiàn wèn yīxià, cāntīng wǎnshang jǐ diǎnzhōng kāishǐ yíngyè?
english: By the way, may I ask when in the evening your restaurant opens?

chinese: 我们应该读报纸，不落后于时代。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi dú bàozhǐ, bù luòhòu yú shídài.
english: We should read the newspaper so as not to lag behind the times.

chinese: 一到晚上，买几样蔬菜，看看电视，喝喝酒。
pinyin: Yī dào wǎnshang, mǎi jǐyàng shūcài, kànkan diànshì, hē hējiǔ.
english: At nighttime, buy some vegetables, watch TV, and have a drink.

chinese: 我们应该虚心听取别人的意见。
pinyin: Wǒ men yīng gāi xū xīn tīng qǔ bié ren de yì jiàn。
english: We should humbly listen to other people's opinions.

chinese: 你总是跟蜜蜂一样地忙碌。
pinyin: Nǐ zǒngshì gēn mìfēng yīyàng de mánglù.
english: You are always as busy as a bee.

chinese: 蜜蜂为花卉和树木授粉，并采集花蜜来制造蜂蜜、蜂胶和蜂毒。
pinyin: Mìfēng wèi huāhuì hé shùmù shòufěn, bìng cǎijí huāmì lái zhìzào fēngmì, fēngjiāo hé fēngdú.
english: Bees pollinate flowers and trees, and collect nectar to make honey, bee glue and bee venom.

chinese: 洗手台上有一个红色的蜡烛。
pinyin: Xǐshǒutái shàng yǒu yī gè hóngsè de làzhú.
english: There's a red candle on top of the bathroom sink.

chinese: 蜡烛是自己熄灭的，而不是被扑灭的。
pinyin: Làzhú shì zìjǐ xīmiè de, ér bù shì bèi pūmiè de.
english: The candle went out instead of having been put out.

chinese: 您在英国从事中医行业多长时间了？
pinyin: Nín zài Yīngguó cóngshì Zhōngyī hángyè duō cháng shíjiān le?
english: How long have you been practising Chinese medicine in the UK?

chinese: 这是很有前景的行业。
pinyin: Zhè shì hěn yǒu qiánjǐng de hángyè.
english: This is a very promising industry.

chinese: 你的行为已经冒犯了他的尊严。
pinyin: Nǐ de xíngwéi yǐjīng màofàn le tā de zūnyán.
english: Your action has offended his dignity.

chinese: 行人应该走人行道。
pinyin: Xíng rén yīng gāi zǒu rén xíng dào。
english: Pedestrians should use the sidewalk.

chinese: 他们认为当时是采取行动的最好时机。
pinyin: Tāmen rènwéi dāngshí shì cǎiqǔxíngdòng de zuì Hǎoshí jī.
english: They decided it was a perfect time to make the move.

chinese: 听说适时地补充水分可以预防中暑。
pinyin: Tīngshuō shìshí de bǔchōng shuǐfèn kěyǐ yùfáng zhòngshǔ.
english: I hear that keeping yourself hydrated at appropriate times can help prevent heatstroke.

chinese: 从他们的表情可以知道，他们大概是失败了。
pinyin: Cóng tāmen de biǎoqíng kěyǐ zhīdào, tāmen dàgài shì shībài le.
english: From the way they look, I would say that they failed.

chinese: 我不会表现出恐惧。
pinyin: Wǒ bù huì biǎoxiàn chū kǒngjù.
english: I'm not going to show any fear.

chinese: 这部手机和一些预装的应用一起出售。
pinyin: Zhè bù shǒujī hé yīxiē yùzhuāng de yìngyòng yīqǐ chūshòu.
english: The cellphone came with several applications already pre-installed.

chinese: 许多人都会在圣诞节期间装饰自己的家。
pinyin: Xǔduō rén dōu huì zài Shèngdànjié qījiān zhuāngshì zìjǐ de jiā.
english: Many people decorate their homes for Christmas.

chinese: 要是不放心的话，你去做个胃镜查一查。
pinyin: Yàoshi bù fàngxīn dehuà, nǐ qù zuò ge wèijìng chá yī chá.
english: If you're worried, go for an endoscopy to have it checked out.

chinese: 医生继续观察病人的一举一动。
pinyin: Yīshēng jìxù guānchá bìngrén de yījǔyīdòng.
english: The doctor continued to observe the patient's behavior.

chinese: 这条规则不是什么时候都适用的。
pinyin: Zhè tiáo guīzé bù shì shénme shíhou dōu shìyòng de.
english: This rule doesn't apply to every case.

chinese: 跨国公司预料到了规模经济的实行。
pinyin: Kuàguógōngsī yùliào dào le guīmó jīngjì de shíxíng.
english: The multinational corporation has forecast the implementation of economies of scale.

chinese: 汤姆是体育解说员。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ shì tǐyù jiěshuōyuán.
english: Tom is a sports commentator.

chinese: 不先与我们的承包商讨论的话我无法计算出最后的费用。
pinyin: Bù xiān yǔ wǒmen de chéngbāoshāng tǎolùn dehuà wǒ wúfǎ jìsuàn chū zuì hòu de fèiyòng.
english: I can't calculate the final cost without first discussing it with our contractors.

chinese: 要是我说错话被人议论，我是不管的。
pinyin: Yàoshi wǒ shuōcuò huà bèi rén yìlùn, wǒ shì bùguǎn de.
english: I don't mind being criticized when I am wrong.

chinese: 她把每一样买了的东西都记录起来。
pinyin: Tā bǎ měi yīyàng mǎi le de dōngxi dōu jìlù qǐlai.
english: She keeps a record of everything she buys.

chinese: 那件事在我们的脑海中还记忆犹新。
pinyin: Nà jiàn shì zài wǒmen de nǎohǎi zhōng hái jìyìyóuxīn.
english: The event is still fresh in our memory.

chinese: 劳拉很讲究她的服装。
pinyin: Láolā hěn jiǎngjiu tā de fúzhuāng.
english: Laura is very particular about her clothes.

chinese: 这间医院有很多新设备。
pinyin: Zhè jiān yīyuàn yǒu hěn duō xīn shèbèi.
english: This hospital has a lot of new equipment.

chinese: 这几套衣服是同一位服装师设计的.
pinyin: Zhè jǐ tào yīfu shì tóngyī wèi fúzhuāngshī shèjì de.
english: These dresses were designed by the same designer.

chinese: 你需要携带两张白底的个人证件照。
pinyin: Nǐ xūyào xiédài liǎng zhāng bái dǐ de gèrén zhèngjiàn zhào.
english: You will need to bring two passport-sized photos of yourself taken with a white background.

chinese: 诊断患有“网络成瘾症”的人差不多总是也有其他的困难。
pinyin: Zhěnduàn huànyǒu "wǎngluòchéngyǐn zhèng " de rén chàbuduō zǒngshì yě yǒu qítā de kùnnan.
english: People “diagnosed” with “Internet addiction” are nearly always diagnosed with other difficulties as well.

chinese: 他仔细地查了一遍自己的试卷。
pinyin: Tā zǐxì de chá le yībiàn zìjǐ de shìjuàn.
english: He carefully checked his test paper.

chinese: 她的态度很诚恳。
pinyin: Tā de tài du hěn chéng kěn。
english: Her attitude is very sincere.

chinese: 我们之间应该有共同话题。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhījiān yīnggāi yǒu gòngtóng huàtí.
english: There should be something for us to talk about.

chinese: 他找不到洗手间，只好向店员询问方向。
pinyin: Tā zhǎobudào xǐshǒujiān, zhǐhǎo xiàng diànyuán xúnwèn fāngxiàng.
english: He couldn't find the restroom, so he had to ask the shopkeeper for directions.

chinese: 你有没有发现他说话的语气有点古怪？
pinyin: Nǐ yǒuméiyǒu fāxiàn tā shuōhuà de yǔqì yǒudiǎn gǔguài?
english: Did you pick up on that strange tone in his voice?

chinese: 我一个月没见到小王了，他说不定已经回国了。
pinyin: Wǒ yī gè yuè méi jiàndào xiǎo Wáng le, tā shuōbudìng yǐjīng huíguó le.
english: I haven't seen Xiaowang for a month now; perhaps he's already gone back to his own country.

chinese: 说服他中止旅行真是件苦差事。
pinyin: Shuōfú tā zhōngzhǐ lǚxíng zhēnshi jiàn kǔchāishi.
english: I had a hard time trying to persuade him to cancel the trip.

chinese: 他拒绝了我加好友的请求。
pinyin: Tā jùjué le wǒ jiā hǎoyǒu de qǐngqiú.
english: He refused my friend request.

chinese: 今年我们提供与去年相同的语言课程。
pinyin: Jīnnián wǒmen tígōng yǔ qùnián xiāngtóng de yǔyán kèchéng.
english: This year we offer the same language course as last year.

chinese: 烹饪课程应该作为学校的必修课。
pinyin: Pēngrèn kèchéng yīnggāi zuòwéi xuéxiào de bìxiūkè.
english: A cooking course should be mandatory in schools.

chinese: 我不调皮。
pinyin: Wǒ bù tiáopí.
english: I am not mischievous.

chinese: 这个谜语很有趣，你能猜出来吗？
pinyin: Zhè gè mí yǔ hěn yǒu qù， nǐ néng cāi chū lái ma？
english: This riddle is interesting. Can you solve it?

chinese: 关于用什么方式和那些人说话，你要谨慎一些。
pinyin: Guānyú yòng shénme fāngshì hé nàxiē rén shuōhuà, nǐ yào jǐnshèn yīxiē.
english: You should be more careful with respect to how you talk to those people.

chinese: 她是素食者，所以她没吃火鸡，而是吃了豆腐。
pinyin: Tā shì sùshízhě, suǒyǐ tā méi chī huǒjī, érshì chī le dòufu.
english: She's vegetarian, so she ate tofu instead of turkey.

chinese: 说明年夜饭的饺子是亲人团聚的象征。
pinyin: Shuōmíng niányèfàn de jiǎozi shì qīnrén tuánjù de xiàngzhēng.
english: This means that eating dumplings on New Year's eve is a symbol of family reunion.

chinese: 这条腰带对我来说成为了恐惧的象征。
pinyin: Zhè tiáo yāodài duìwǒláishuō chéngwéi le kǒngjù de xiàngzhēng.
english: The belt became a symbol of fear for me.

chinese: 爷爷教我下象棋。
pinyin: Yé ye jiāo wǒ xià xiàng qí。
english: Grandpa teaches me to play Chinese chess.

chinese: 新剧院看上去很豪华。
pinyin: Xīn jùyuàn kànshangqu hěn háohuá.
english: The new theatre looks very luxurious.

chinese: 每个人都有能力作贡献。
pinyin: Měigerén dōu yǒunénglì zuò gòngxiàn.
english: And everyone has the ability to contribute.

chinese: 他在遗嘱里说要把他的财产全部留给他的妻子。
pinyin: Tā zài yízhǔ lǐ shuō yào bǎ tā de cáichǎn quánbù liúgěi tā de qīzi.
english: He left all his property to his wife in his will.

chinese: 我责备你。
pinyin: Wǒ zébèi nǐ.
english: I blame you.

chinese: 他被取消了参赛资格。
pinyin: Tā bèi qǔxiāo le cānsài zīgé.
english: He was disqualified from the competition.

chinese: 水、森林和矿物都是重要的天然资源。
pinyin: Shuǐ, sēnlín hé kuàngwù dōu shì zhòngyào de tiānrán zīyuán.
english: Water, forests, and minerals are important natural resources.

chinese: 日本自然资源贫乏。
pinyin: Rìběn zìránzīyuán pínfá.
english: Japan is poor in natural resources.

chinese: 谁来为风险投资提供资金？
pinyin: Shéi lái wèi fēngxiǎn tóuzī tígōng zījīn?
english: Who will provide capital for the venture?

chinese: 你需要赔偿他损失的钱。
pinyin: Nǐ xūyào péicháng tā sǔnshī de qián.
english: You must compensate him for the money he lost.

chinese: 我赞成你的建议。
pinyin: Wǒ zàn chéng nǐ de jiàn yì。
english: I agree with your suggestion.

chinese: 他把她的话当作是一种赞美。
pinyin: Tā bǎ tā dehuà dàngzuò shì yīzhǒng zànměi.
english: He took her words as a compliment.

chinese: 你的脸色这么差，还是赶快去睡觉吧。
pinyin: Nǐ de liǎnsè zhème chà, háishi gǎnkuài qù shuìjiào ba.
english: You look pale. You had better lie down in bed at once.

chinese: 我们要赶紧把他送去医院，他伤得很严重！
pinyin: Wǒmen yào gǎnjǐn bǎ tā sòngqù yīyuàn, tā shāng dehěn yánzhòng!
english: We have to take him to the hospital immediately; he is seriously injured!

chinese: 她很了解最新的时尚趋势。
pinyin: Tā hěn liǎojiě zuì xīn de shíshàng qūshì.
english: She knows a lot about the latest fashions.

chinese: 抢劫银行的后果就是在监狱里蹲十年。
pinyin: Qiǎngjié yínháng de hòuguǒ jiùshì zài jiānyù lǐ dūn shí nián.
english: Bank robbery will cost you ten years in prison.

chinese: 她有着一头金发，瘦高的身材。
pinyin: Tā yǒuzhe yītóu jīnfà, shòu gāo de shēncái.
english: She has blonde hair and a slim figure.

chinese: 他为什么在躲藏？
pinyin: Tā wèishénme zài duǒcáng?
english: Why is he hiding?

chinese: 火车的尾三节车厢损坏得很严重。
pinyin: Huǒchē de wěi sān jiē chēxiāng sǔnhuài dehěn yánzhòng.
english: The last three coaches of the train were badly damaged.

chinese: 我把车库改造成工作室使用。
pinyin: Wǒ bǎ chēkù gǎizào chéng gōngzuòshì shǐyòng.
english: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.

chinese: 我深信事情会往更好的方向转变。
pinyin: Wǒ shēnxìn shìqing huì wǎng gèng hǎo de fāngxiàng zhuǎnbiàn.
english: I am convinced that things will change for the better.

chinese: 请把这个消息转告给她。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè gè xiāo xi zhuǎn gào gěi tā。
english: Please pass this message on to her.

chinese: 我的刻录软件显示了一个错误信息。
pinyin: Wǒ de kèlù ruǎnjiàn xiǎnshì le yī gè cuòwù xìnxī.
english: My data-burning software is showing an error message.

chinese: 另外一队轻视了我们。
pinyin: Lìngwài yī duì qīngshì le wǒmen.
english: The other team took us lightly.

chinese: 营辅员应负责为学生提供指引和辅导。
pinyin: Yíng fǔ yuán yīng fùzé wèi xuésheng tígōng zhǐyǐn hé fǔdǎo.
english: The camp counselors are supposed to provide guidance and mentorship to the students.

chinese: 我的上司被逼迫辞职。
pinyin: Wǒ de shàngsi bèi bīpò cízhí.
english: My boss was forced to resign.

chinese: 您吃不吃辣椒？
pinyin: Nín chī bù chī làjiāo?
english: Do you want pepper on it?

chinese: 我们没有时间来辩论。
pinyin: Wǒmen méiyǒu shíjiān lái biànlùn.
english: We don't have time to argue.

chinese: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。
pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián duì zuòyè liáofǎ de xūqiú zài xùnsù zēngzhǎng.
english: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.

chinese: 你对任何药物过敏吗？
pinyin: Nǐ duì rènhé yàowù guòmǐn ma?
english: Are you allergic to any medicine?

chinese: 我要去机场迎接我的家人。
pinyin: Wǒ yào qù jīchǎng yíngjiē wǒ de jiārén.
english: I have to go to the airport to meet my family.

chinese: 他的成功要归结于他的辛勤工作和好运气。
pinyin: Tā de chénggōng yào guījié yú tā de xīnqín gōngzuò hé hǎo yùnqi.
english: He owes his success both to working hard and to good luck.

chinese: 我们需要运用这种方法。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào yùn yòng zhè zhǒng fāng fǎ。
english: We need to use this method.

chinese: 这本书详细记录了近代的情况。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū xiáng xì jì lù le jìn dài de qíng kuàng。
english: This book gives a detailed account of modern times.

chinese: 进口数量的急速增长让我们感到惊讶。
pinyin: Jìnkǒu shùliàng de jísù zēngzhǎng ràng wǒmen gǎndào jīngyà.
english: We're amazed by the rapid growth in import quantities.

chinese: 只要制定学习计划，就能有效地取得进步。
pinyin: Zhǐyào zhìdìng xuéxí jìhuà, jiù néng yǒuxiào de qǔdé jìnbù.
english: If you make a study plan, you can make progress efficiently.

chinese: 听到敲门声，她连忙去开门。
pinyin: Tīng dào qiāo mén shēng， tā lián máng qù kāi mén。
english: Hearing the knock, she hurried to open the door.

chinese: 我最近很喜欢看这部连续剧。
pinyin: Wǒ zuì jìn hěn xǐ huan kàn zhè bù lián xù jù。
english: I have really enjoyed watching this drama series lately.

chinese: 我们迫切需要找到新的方法。
pinyin: Wǒ men pò qiè xū yào zhǎo dào xīn de fāng fǎ。
english: We urgently need to find a new method.

chinese: 如果你迷路了，请向警察询问。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ mílù le, qǐng xiàng jǐngchá xúnwèn.
english: If you get lost in the street, ask a policeman.

chinese: 她追求的东西，可是永远无法得到的啊！
pinyin: Tā zhuīqiú de dōngxi, kěshì yǒngyuǎn wúfǎ dédào de ā!
english: She will never be able to get the things she pursues!

chinese: 我不确定该前进还是后退。
pinyin: Wǒ bù quèdìng gāi qiánjìn háishi hòutuì.
english: I was uncertain whether to advance or to retreat.

chinese: 从大学毕业到退休，老王一直担任教学工作。
pinyin: Cóng dàxué bìyè dào tuìxiū, lǎo Wáng yīzhí dānrèn jiàoxué gōngzuò.
english: From graduation to retirement, Laowang worked as a teacher without intermission.

chinese: 社会不是在进步，而是在退步。
pinyin: Shèhuì bù shì zài jìnbù, érshì zài tuìbù.
english: Social conditions are going backward rather than forward.

chinese: 幸运的是，我们找到了逃生通道。
pinyin: Xìngyùn de shì, wǒmen zhǎodào le táoshēng tōngdào.
english: Luckily, we found an escape route.

chinese: 没有人能逃过衰老。
pinyin: Méiyǒu rén néng táo guo shuāilǎo.
english: No one can escape growing old.

chinese: 不要逃避，我要你回答我的问题。
pinyin: Bù yào táobì, wǒ yào nǐ huídá wǒ de wèntí.
english: Don't dodge the issue, I want you to answer my question.

chinese: 你半透明的裙子让我高度兴奋。
pinyin: Nǐ bàntòumíng de qúnzi ràng wǒ gāodù xīngfèn.
english: I am completely agog over your diaphanous dress.

chinese: 整个晚上他都在开玩笑逗我们开心。
pinyin: Zhěnggè wǎnshang tā dōu zài kāiwánxiào dòu wǒmen kāixīn.
english: He entertained us with jokes all evening.

chinese: 通常学生们喜欢理解他们问题的老师。
pinyin: Tōngcháng xuésheng men xǐhuan lǐjiě tāmen wèntí de lǎoshī.
english: Students generally like a teacher who understands their problems.

chinese: 即时策略游戏通常会融入街机元素。
pinyin: Jíshí cèlüè yóuxì tōngcháng huì róngrù jiējī yuánsù.
english: Real-time strategy games usually include arcade elements.

chinese: 这份报告详细介绍了通讯。
pinyin: Zhè fèn bào gào xiáng xì jiè shào le tōng xùn。
english: This report describes communication in detail.

chinese: 这种行为可能造成意外。
pinyin: Zhèzhǒng xíngwéi kěnéng zàochéng yìwài.
english: Such behavior can cause an accident.

chinese: 他的解释很有逻辑。
pinyin: Tā de jiě shì hěn yǒu luó ji。
english: His explanation is logical.

chinese: 在这座城市里，公共道德不再受到尊重。
pinyin: Zài zhè zuò chéngshì lǐ, gōnggòng dàodé bù zài shòudào zūnzhòng.
english: Public morals are not respected anymore in this town.

chinese: 她就是不讲道理。讨厌死了。
pinyin: Tā jiùshì bù jiǎngdào lǐ. tǎoyàn sǐ le.
english: You simply cannot reason with her, which is quite annoying.

chinese: 我们应该尽量避免把我们自己的信念强加在别人身上。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi jìnliàng bìmiǎn bǎ wǒmen zìjǐ de xìnniàn qiángjiā zài biéren shēnshang.
english: We should try to avoid imposing our own beliefs on others.

chinese: 她年轻的时候住在东京的郊区。
pinyin: Tā niánqīng de shíhou zhù zài Dōngjīng de jiāoqū.
english: She lived in the suburbs of Tokyo when she was young.

chinese: 我们需要配合医生的检查。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào pèi hé yī shēng de jiǎn chá。
english: We need to cooperate during the doctor's examination.

chinese: 如果你唱歌了，他们就会把你踢出酒吧。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ chànggē le, tāmen jiù huì bǎ nǐ tī chū jiǔbā.
english: If you sang, they'd kick you out of the bar.

chinese: 把米饭和鸡蛋还有酱油拌在了一起。
pinyin: Bǎ mǐfàn hé jīdàn háiyǒu jiàngyóu bàn zài le yīqǐ.
english: Mix the rice and eggs with soy sauce.

chinese: 你是不是喝醉到能再说一遍德语的程度？
pinyin: Nǐ shìbùshì hēzuì dào néng zàishuō yībiàn Déyǔ de chéngdù?
english: Are you drunk enough to speak German once again?

chinese: 我们需要买醋。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào mǎi cù.
english: We need to buy vinegar.

chinese: 政府将采取强制措施来解决这一问题。
pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jiāng cǎiqǔ qiángzhì cuòshī lái jiějué zhè yī wèntí.
english: The government will adopt enforcement measures to solve this problem.

chinese: 让我来帮你吧。你的包看起来很重。
pinyin: Ràng wǒ lái bāng nǐ ba. Nǐ de bāo kànqǐlai hěn zhòng.
english: Let me help you. Your bag looks very heavy.

chinese: 红木书桌上有一个金属杯子和一个蓝色杯垫。
pinyin: Hóngmù shūzhuō shàng yǒu yī gè jīnshǔ bēizi hé yī gè lánsè bēidiàn.
english: On the mahogany desk, there is a metal cup and a blue coaster.

chinese: 今个月的钢铁产量和上个月比起来，估计会上升两个巴仙。
pinyin: Jīn gè yuè de gāngtiě chǎnliàng hé shànggèyuè bǐqǐ lái, gūjì huì shàngshēng liǎng gè bāxiān.
english: Steel production will increase 2% this month from last month.

chinese: 她一听到铃响，就接了电话。
pinyin: Tā yī tīngdào líng xiǎng, jiù jiē le diànhuà.
english: As soon as she heard the bell ring, she answered the telephone.

chinese: 现在我开始发铜牌。
pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ kāishǐ fā tóngpái.
english: Now I am starting to issue copper medals.

chinese: 常言道：言语是银，沉默是金。
pinyin: Chángyán dào: yányǔ shì yín, chénmòshìjīn.
english: As the saying goes: Speech is silver, silence is gold.

chinese: 这家火锅店的味道真不错，下次我们再来吃吧。
pinyin: Zhè jiā huǒguō diàn de wèidao zhēn bù cuò, xiàcì wǒmen zài lái chī ba.
english: The food at this hot pot restaurant tastes really good. Let's come here again next time.

chinese: 面条下锅前要先掰成小块。
pinyin: Miàntiáo xià guō qián yào xiān bāi chéng xiǎo kuài.
english: Before you put the noodles in the pot, you have to break them up into small pieces.

chinese: 好的。房间里长途电话可以直拨吗？
pinyin: Hǎo de. fángjiān lǐ chángtúdiànhuà kěyǐ zhí bō ma?
english: Good. Can you make long distance calls from the room?

chinese: 闪电常常伴随着雷鸣。
pinyin: Shǎndiàn chángcháng bànsuí zhe léimíng.
english: Lightning is usually followed by thunder.

chinese: 一个入室盗窃者趁我去旅游的时候闯入了我家。
pinyin: Yī gè rù shì dàoqiè zhě chèn wǒ qù lǚyóu de shíhou chuǎngrù le wǒ jiā.
english: A burglar broke into my house while I was away on a trip.

chinese: 我闻到了花的香味。
pinyin: Wǒ wén dào le huā de xiāng wèi。
english: I smelled the fragrance of the flowers.

chinese: 刚才下了一阵雨。
pinyin: Gāng cái xià le yī zhèn yǔ。
english: There was a brief shower just now.

chinese: 您可以跳过认证过程的第三阶段，直接进入第六阶段。
pinyin: Nín kěyǐ tiào guo rènzhèng guòchéng de dì sān jiēduàn, zhíjiē jìnrù dì liù jiēduàn.
english: You can skip stage three of the certification process and advance immediately to stage six.

chinese: 谁也不能阻止这个计划的实行。
pinyin: Shéi yě bù néng zǔzhǐ zhège jìhuà de shíxíng.
english: Nobody can prevent this plan from being carried out.

chinese: 在多款体育类模拟游戏陆续登场后，这款作品为热爱球类运动的玩家带来更真实的管理体验。
pinyin: Zài duō kuǎn tǐyù lèi mónǐ yóuxì lùxù dēngchǎng hòu, zhè kuǎn zuòpǐn wèi rè'ài qiúlèi yùndòng de wánjiā dàilái gèng zhēnshí de guǎnlǐ tǐyàn.
english: Following a wave of other recent sports simulations, this release offers ball game fans a more authentic management experience.

chinese: 我看见一位陌生女人在那儿。
pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn yī wèi mòshēng nǚrén zàinar.
english: I saw a strange woman there.

chinese: 请脱去除内裤和内衣外的所有衣物。
pinyin: Qǐng tuōqù chú nèikù hé nèiyī wài de suǒyǒu yīwù.
english: Please take off all your clothes except your underpants and bra.

chinese: 尤其是在中国北方，包饺子、吃饺子，已经成为大多数家庭欢度除夕的一个重要活动。
pinyin: Yóuqí shì zài Zhōngguó běifāng, bāo jiǎozi, chī jiǎozi, yǐjīng chéngwéi dàduōshù jiātíng huāndù Chúxī de yī gè zhòngyào huódòng.
english: Especially in northern China, wrapping and eating dumplings has become an important activity for happily spending New Year's Eve in many households.

chinese: 除非他们事先修好刹车，我才会买车子。
pinyin: Chúfēi tāmen shìxiān xiūhǎo shāchē, wǒ cái huì mǎi chēzi.
english: I'll only buy the car if they fix the brakes first.

chinese: 住在隔壁的男孩常常很晚回来。
pinyin: Zhù zài gébì de nánhái chángcháng hěn wǎn huílai.
english: The boy who lives next door often comes home late.

chinese: 难怪她表示不想再见到他了。因为他们分手了。
pinyin: Nánguài tā biǎoshì bù xiǎng zàijiàn dào tā le. yīnwèi tāmen fēnshǒu le.
english: No wonder she doesn't want to see him again. Because they broke up.

chinese: 你凌晨两点才去睡觉吗？难怪你今天看起来这么没精神了。
pinyin: Nǐ língchén liǎng diǎn cái qù shuìjiào ma? nánguài nǐ jīntiān kànqǐlai zhème méi jīngshén le.
english: You went to bed at 2 o'clock in the morning? No wonder you look sleepy today.

chinese: 难看的不是人的外貌，而是人的衣服。
pinyin: Nánkàn de bù shì rén de wàimào, érshì rén de yīfu.
english: It's not the person that's ugly, but the clothes.

chinese: 明天，我将飞越雄伟的喜马拉雅山脉。
pinyin: Míngtiān, wǒ jiāng fēiyuè xióngwěi de Xǐmǎlāyǎshānmài.
english: Tomorrow, I'll fly over the magnificent Himalayas.

chinese: 我没法集中注意力。你介意关掉电视吗?
pinyin: Wǒ méifǎ jízhōng zhùyìlì. nǐ jièyì guāndiào diànshì ma?
english: I can't concentrate. Do you mind turning off the TV?

chinese: 他在利用集体的名义，为自己谋利。
pinyin: Tā zài lìyòng jítǐ de míngyì, wèi zìjǐ móulì.
english: He is making use of the collective's name for his own profit.

chinese: 她雇佣我来帮助她。
pinyin: Tā gùyōng wǒ lái bāngzhù tā.
english: She hired me to help her.

chinese: 这台电视机是十年前制造的, 现在已经没有零件可换, 所以要修理它是不可能的事了。
pinyin: Zhè tái diànshìjī shì shí niánqián zhìzào de, xiànzài yǐjīng méiyǒu língjiàn kě huàn, suǒyǐ yào xiūlǐ tā shì bù kěnéng de shì le.
english: This TV was made ten years ago and there are no parts available, so it is impossible to repair it.

chinese: 我们有任何我可以当零食吃的东西吗？
pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu rènhé wǒ kěyǐ dāng língshí chī de dōngxi ma?
english: Do we have anything I can snack on?

chinese: 我听到了远处的雷声。
pinyin: Wǒ tīngdào le yuǎnchù de léishēng.
english: I heard it thunder in the distance.

chinese: 因为大雾所以看不清道路。
pinyin: Yīnwèi dàwù suǒyǐ kànbuqīng dàolù.
english: Due to the thick fog, the road was difficult to see.

chinese: 突然，从茫茫大雾中出现了一艘船。
pinyin: Tūrán, cóng mángmáng dàwù zhōng chūxiàn le yī sōu chuán.
english: Suddenly, a ship appeared through the fog.

chinese: 跟你妹妹说一声，她的丁字裤露出来了。
pinyin: Gēn nǐ mèimei shuō yīshēng, tā de dīngzìkù lùchū lái le.
english: Tell your sister her thong is showing.

chinese: 台湾的森林终年常青。
pinyin: Táiwān de sēnlín zhōngnián chángqīng.
english: The forests in Taiwan stay green all year round.

chinese: 汤姆是个普通的青少年。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ shì gè pǔtōng de qīngshàonián.
english: Tom is a normal teenager.

chinese: 当我们回眸青春，仿佛有一种说不出的痛。
pinyin: Dāng wǒmen huímóu qīngchūn, fǎngfú yǒu yīzhǒng shuōbuchū de tòng.
english: When we look back at our youth, there seems to be an indescribable pain.

chinese: 限制非母语人士可提供的英文例句数量，是在侮辱他们的智力，和对合作专案做出的巨大努力。
pinyin: Xiànzhì fēi mǔyǔ rénshì kě tígōng de Yīngwén lìjù shùliàng, shì zài wǔrǔ tāmen de zhìlì, hé duì hézuò zhuān'àn zuòchū de jùdà nǔlì.
english: Placing a restriction on the number of example sentences that non-native speakers can offer in English is an affront to their intelligence and the significant efforts they make to contribute to this collaborative project.

chinese: 日本正面临着严重的经济问题。
pinyin: Rìběn zhèng miànlín zhe yánzhòng de jīngjì wèntí.
english: Japan is confronted with severe economic problems.

chinese: 和一只恐龙面对面是一段有趣的经历。
pinyin: Hé yī zhǐ kǒnglóng miànduìmiàn shì yī duàn yǒuqù de jīnglì.
english: Coming face to face with a dinosaur was a funny experience.

chinese: 革命之后，法国成为了一个共和国。
pinyin: Gémìng zhīhòu, Fǎguó chéngwéi le yī gè gònghéguó.
english: After the revolution, France became a republic.

chinese: 春节的时候，我们听到了鞭炮的声音。
pinyin: Chūn jié de shí hou， wǒ men tīng dào le biān pào de shēng yīn。
english: During the Spring Festival, we heard firecrackers.

chinese: 这是一项重要的任务。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī xiàng zhòng yào de rèn wu。
english: This is an important task.

chinese: 根据当前的状况，这个项目绝对会成功。
pinyin: Gēnjù dāngqián de zhuàngkuàng, zhège xiàngmù juéduì huì chénggōng.
english: Judging from the current situation, this project is sure to succeed.

chinese: 火车上有预订的座位吗？
pinyin: Huǒchē shàng yǒu yùdìng de zuòwèi ma?
english: Are there reserved seats on the train?

chinese: 那么你频道换掉也行啊。
pinyin: Nàme nǐ píndào huàn diào yě xíng ā.
english: You can just switch channels.

chinese: 跳过做不出来的题目，继续往后做。
pinyin: Tiào guo zuò bù chūlái de tímù, jìxù wǎnghòu zuò.
english: Skip the problems you can not do and go ahead.

chinese: 比尔，如果你跟我来，你也会飘。
pinyin: Bǐěr, rúguǒ nǐ gēn wǒ lái, nǐ yě huì piāo.
english: Bill, if you'll come with me, you'll float, too.

chinese: 我给你吃个馒头。
pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ chī gè mántou.
english: I give you a steamed bun to eat.

chinese: 你知道怎么驾驶这玩意儿吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào zěnme jiàshǐ zhè wányìr ma?
english: Do you know how to drive this thing?

chinese: 在小学的时候，她常常被老师骂。
pinyin: Zài xiǎoxué de shíhou, tā chángcháng bèi lǎoshī mà.
english: When she was in elementary school, the teacher often scolded her.

chinese: 四处奔跑的狗找到了骨头。
pinyin: Sìchù bēnpǎo de gǒu zhǎodào le gǔtou.
english: The dog that trots about finds a bone.

chinese: 汤姆和玛丽入住了一家高档酒店。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ hé Mǎlì rùzhù le yī jiā gāodàng jiǔdiàn.
english: Tom and Mary stayed at a fancy hotel.

chinese: 高速列车在欧洲很常见。
pinyin: Gāosù lièchē zài Ōuzhōu hěn chángjiàn.
english: High speed trains are common in Europe.

chinese: 而在晴天的时候鸽子们都飞回家了。
pinyin: Ér zài qíngtiān de shíhou gēzi men dōu fēi huíjiā le.
english: And on sunny days all the pigeons flew home.

chinese: 刚才我的麦克风没起作用，不知道为什么。
pinyin: Gāngcái wǒ de màikèfēng méi qǐzuòyòng, bù zhīdào wèishénme.
english: For some reason the microphone didn't work earlier.

chinese: 那条黄瓜多长啊！
pinyin: Nà tiáo huángguā duō cháng ā!
english: What a long cucumber!

chinese: 哪个比较重，铅还是黄金？
pinyin: Nǎge bǐjiào zhòng, qiān háishi huángjīn?
english: Which is heavier, lead or gold?

chinese: 我的鼠标不能用了。
pinyin: Wǒ de shǔ biāo bù néng yòng le。
english: My computer mouse has stopped working.

chinese: 他检查文件时一丝不苟。
pinyin: Tā jiǎn chá wén jiàn shí yī sī bù gǒu。
english: He checks documents meticulously.

chinese: 骑车上班既省钱又锻炼身体，真是一举两得。
pinyin: Qí chē shàng bān jì shěng qián yòu duàn liàn shēn tǐ， zhēn shì yī jǔ liǎng dé。
english: Cycling to work saves money and provides exercise: two benefits at once.

chinese: 他不顾我们的一再劝告。
pinyin: Tā bù gù wǒmen de yīzài quàngào.
english: He ignored all of our warnings.

chinese: 他穿衣服一向很随便，颜色、样式都无所谓。
pinyin: Tā chuān yīfu yīxiàng hěn suíbiàn, yánsè, yàngshì dōu wúsuǒwèi.
english: He always dresses very casually, and doesn't care about color or style.

chinese: 她一如既往地支持我们。
pinyin: Tā yī rú jì wǎng de zhī chí wǒ men。
english: She supports us just as she always has.

chinese: 我们路上一帆风顺，直到遇上暴风雪。
pinyin: Wǒmen lùshang yī fān fēng shùn, zhídào yùshàng bàofēngxuě.
english: We made good time until we ran into a blizzard.

chinese: 他一度想放弃这个计划。
pinyin: Tā yī dù xiǎng fàng qì zhè gè jì huà。
english: For a while, he wanted to give up this plan.

chinese: 所有学生一律遵守规定。
pinyin: Suǒ yǒu xué sheng yī lǜ zūn shǒu guī dìng。
english: All students must follow the rules without exception.

chinese: 我们没机会赢那些一流选手。
pinyin: Wǒmen méi jīhuì yíng nèixiē yīliú xuǎnshǒu.
english: We have no chance against those top players.

chinese: 男人老不老,自己心中有数;女人老不老,别人一目了然.
pinyin: Nánrén lǎo bù lǎo, zìjǐ xīnzhōngyǒushù; nǚrén lǎo bù lǎo, biéren yīmùliǎorán.
english: A man is as old as he feels and a woman as old as she looks.

chinese: 他一贯认真负责。
pinyin: Tā yī guàn rèn zhēn fù zé。
english: He has always been conscientious and responsible.

chinese: 他因车祸受了重伤的消息让我震惊万分。
pinyin: Tā yīn chēhuò shòu le zhòngshāng de xiāoxi ràng wǒ zhènjīng wànfēn.
english: I am very much surprised to hear that he got badly injured in a motorcar accident.

chinese: 新经理下个月上任。
pinyin: Xīn jīng lǐ xià gè yuè shàng rèn。
english: The new manager takes office next month.

chinese: 河的上游很美。
pinyin: Hé de shàngyóu hěn měi.
english: The upper reaches of the river are very beautiful.

chinese: 他玩这个游戏上瘾了。
pinyin: Tā wán zhè gè yóu xì shàng yǐn le。
english: He has become addicted to this game.

chinese: 他很重视上进心。
pinyin: Tā hěn zhòng shì shàng jìn xīn。
english: He attaches great importance to motivation.

chinese: 这位下属很有经验。
pinyin: Zhè wèi xià shǔ hěn yǒu jīng yàn。
english: This subordinate is very experienced.

chinese: 你这样对待朋友，太不像话了。
pinyin: Nǐ zhè yàng duì dài péng you， tài bù xiàng huà le。
english: It is outrageous to treat a friend like this.

chinese: 你真是不可思议。
pinyin: Nǐ zhēnshi bùkěsīyì.
english: You are fantastic.

chinese: 他对我的提议不屑一顾。
pinyin: Tā duì wǒ de tíyì bùxièyīgù.
english: He wouldn't look at my proposal.

chinese: 这不是我们的错……大家都是逼不得已才这么做。
pinyin: Zhè bù shì wǒmen de cuò …… dàjiā dōu shì bī bùdéyǐ cái zhème zuò.
english: It wasn't our fault... We all had to do it.

chinese: 战争必须不惜一切代价地去避免。
pinyin: Zhànzhēng bìxū bù xī yīqiè dàijià de qù bìmiǎn.
english: War must be avoided at all costs.

chinese: 她不愧是一位优秀的老师。
pinyin: Tā bù kuì shì yī wèi yōu xiù de lǎo shī。
english: She truly deserves to be called an excellent teacher.

chinese: 为了正当目的并非总是可以不择手段.
pinyin: Wèile zhèngdāng mùdì bìngfēi zǒngshì kěyǐ bùzéshǒuduàn.
english: The end does not always justify the means.

chinese: 不敢当。
pinyin: Bùgǎndāng.
english: I don't deserve it.

chinese: 我带了雨伞，不料天晴了。
pinyin: Wǒ dài le yǔ sǎn， bù liào tiān qíng le。
english: I brought an umbrella, but unexpectedly it cleared up.

chinese: 他时不时地因为工作去东京。
pinyin: Tā shíbùshí de yīnwèi gōngzuò qù Dōngjīng.
english: He sometimes goes to Tokyo on business.

chinese: 现在不止要男女薪金平等，而且还要平均分配家务。
pinyin: Xiànzài bù zhǐ yào nánnǚ xīnjīn píngděng, érqiě hái yào píngjūn fēnpèi jiāwù.
english: It is time not only to equalize men's and women's wages, but also to equalize responsibility for housework.

chinese: 看到这些照片，我不由得想起了家人。
pinyin: Kàn dào zhè xiē zhào piàn， wǒ bù yóu de xiǎng qǐ le jiā rén。
english: Seeing these photographs, I could not help thinking of my family.

chinese: 这两位选手的水平不相上下。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng wèi xuǎn shǒu de shuǐ píng bù xiāng shàng xià。
english: These two competitors are evenly matched.

chinese: 看着眼前凄凉的景象，我们不禁流下了泪来。
pinyin: Kàn zhe yǎnqián qīliáng de jǐngxiàng, wǒmen bù jīn liú xià le lèi lái.
english: The pitiful sight moved us to tears.

chinese: 不言而喻。
pinyin: Bùyán'éryù.
english: That goes without saying.

chinese: 我叔叔不顾医生劝阻，还是继续喝酒。
pinyin: Wǒ shūshu bù gù yīshēng quànzǔ, háishi jìxù hējiǔ.
english: My uncle kept on drinking in spite of his doctor's advice.

chinese: 我们不能容忍这种丑恶的行为。
pinyin: Wǒ men bù néng róng rěn zhè zhǒng chǒu è de xíng wéi。
english: We cannot tolerate such ugly behavior.

chinese: 英特尔公司由那个发明取得着巨大的专利权收入
pinyin: Yīngtè'ěr gōngsī yóu nàge fāmíng qǔdé zhe jùdà de zhuānlìquán shōurù
english: Intel gets a huge royalty from the invention.

chinese: 这所医院有很多专科。
pinyin: Zhè suǒ yī yuàn yǒu hěn duō zhuān kē。
english: This hospital has many specialist departments.

chinese: 他专程来这里看望老师。
pinyin: Tā zhuān chéng lái zhè lǐ kàn wàng lǎo shī。
english: He made a special trip here to visit his teacher.

chinese: 写作是她的专长。
pinyin: Xiě zuò shì tā de zhuān cháng。
english: Writing is her specialty.

chinese: 我们举办了一场环保专题讲座。
pinyin: Wǒ men jǔ bàn le yī chǎng huán bǎo zhuān tí jiǎng zuò。
english: We held a lecture on the topic of environmental protection.

chinese: 他们的家人世代住在这里。
pinyin: Tā men de jiā rén shì dài zhù zài zhè lǐ。
english: Their family has lived here for generations.

chinese: 不同的经历会影响一个人的世界观。
pinyin: Bù tóng de jīng lì huì yǐng xiǎng yī gè rén de shì jiè guān。
english: Different experiences can influence a person's worldview.

chinese: 重庆是一座丘陵的城市，道路弯弯曲曲的。
pinyin: Chóngqìng shì yī zuò qiūlíng de chéngshì, dàolù wānwānqūqū de.
english: Chongqing is a hilly city with winding streets.

chinese: 上课时不要东张西望。
pinyin: Shàng kè shí bù yào dōng zhāng xī wàng。
english: Do not look around distractedly during class.

chinese: 作为东道主，我们要照顾好客人。
pinyin: Zuò wéi dōng dào zhǔ， wǒ men yào zhào gu hào kè rén。
english: As hosts, we must take good care of our guests.

chinese: 他出门总是丢三落四。
pinyin: Tā chū mén zǒng shì diū sān là sì。
english: He always forgets things when going out.

chinese: 哎，今天真丢人，我把衣服穿反了。
pinyin: Āi, jīntiān zhēn diūrén, wǒ bǎ yīfu chuānfǎn le.
english: Argh, I was so embarrassed today. I wore my clothes inside-out.

chinese: 我们要严厉。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào yánlì.
english: We have to be strict.

chinese: 我们需要制定严密的计划。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào zhì dìng yán mì de jì huà。
english: We need to draw up a rigorous plan.

chinese: 今天早上天气严寒。
pinyin: Jīntiān zǎoshang tiānqì yánhán.
english: We had a heavy frost this morning.

chinese: 形势似乎非常紧张严峻。
pinyin: Xíngshì sìhū fēicháng jǐnzhāng yánjùn.
english: The situation seemed very tense and dangerous.

chinese: 该国严禁进口稀有野生动物。
pinyin: Gāi guó yánjìn jìnkǒu xīyǒu yěshēngdòngwù.
english: The importation of rare wild animals to this country is strictly prohibited.

chinese: 看着自己的房子被烧得精光，他顿时丧失了理智。
pinyin: Kàn zhe zìjǐ de fángzi bèi shāo de jīngguāng, tā dùnshí sàngshī le lǐzhì.
english: He lost his reason when he saw his house burn down.

chinese: 每个个体都有自己的特点。
pinyin: Měi gè gè tǐ dōu yǒu zì jǐ de tè diǎn。
english: Each individual has their own characteristics.

chinese: 不好意思，请问到中央公园要怎么走?
pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, qǐngwèn dào zhōngyāng gōngyuán yào zěnme zǒu?
english: Excuse me, but could you tell me how to get to Central Park?

chinese: 大雨使比赛中断了。
pinyin: Dà yǔ shǐ bǐ sài zhōng duàn le。
english: Heavy rain interrupted the match.

chinese: 瑞士是一个中立的国家。
pinyin: Ruìshì shì yī gèzhōng lì de guójiā.
english: Switzerland is a neutral country.

chinese: 预期今年稻米会丰收。
pinyin: Yùqī jīnnián dàomǐ huì fēngshōu.
english: This year promises a good harvest of rice.

chinese: 小说中的人物形象很丰满。
pinyin: Xiǎo shuō zhōng de rén wù xíng xiàng hěn fēng mǎn。
english: The characters in this novel are well developed.

chinese: 她为我们煮了丰盛的一餐。
pinyin: Tā wèi wǒmen zhǔ le fēngshèng de yī cān.
english: She cooked us a wonderful meal.

chinese: 他们在无重力状态下进行了一连串的实验。
pinyin: Tāmen zài wú zhònglì zhuàngtài xià jìnxíng le yīliánchuàn de shíyàn.
english: They conducted a series of experiments under zero gravity.

chinese: 不是所有的临床研究都是假设驱动的。
pinyin: Bù shì suǒyǒu de línchuáng yánjiū dōu shì jiǎshè qūdòng de.
english: Not all clinical studies are hypothesis-driven.

chinese: 新竹的贡丸和米粉非常有名，吸引不少游客品尝。
pinyin: Xīnzhú de gòngwán hé mǐfěn fēicháng yǒumíng, xīyǐn bù shǎo yóukè pǐn cháng.
english: Hsinchu's meatballs and rice noodles are very famous, attracting many tourists to taste them.

chinese: 我们参加了为期三天的培训。
pinyin: Wǒ men cān jiā le wéi qī sān tiān de péi xùn。
english: We attended a training course lasting three days.

chinese: 我觉得您说的很有道理，但是依照您出的条件处理的话，我们也很为难。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde nín shuō de hěn yǒudàoli, dànshì yīzhào nín chū de tiáojiàn chǔlǐ dehuà, wǒmen yě hěn wéinán.
english: I think what you said makes sense, but I would rather not just follow your conditions.

chinese: 他们组成了一个以她为首的小组。
pinyin: Tā men zǔ chéng le yī gè yǐ tā wéi shǒu de xiǎo zǔ。
english: They formed a group headed by her.

chinese: 我们需要主办这次会议。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào zhǔ bàn zhè cì huì yì。
english: We need to host this conference.

chinese: 她在这个项目中起主导作用。
pinyin: Tā zài zhè gè xiàng mù zhōng qǐ zhǔ dǎo zuò yòng。
english: She plays a leading role in this project.

chinese: 我们需要保卫台湾的主权。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào bǎowèi Táiwān de zhǔquán.
english: We need to defend Taiwan's sovereignty.

chinese: 这种观点已经成为主流。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng guān diǎn yǐ jīng chéng wéi zhǔ liú。
english: This view has already become mainstream.

chinese: 我刚跟主管人谈过。
pinyin: Wǒ gāng gēn zhǔguǎn rén tán guo.
english: I just talked to the person in charge.

chinese: 在英国，以珍稀物种为主题的公园变得越来越受人们的欢迎。
pinyin: Zài Yīngguó, yǐ zhēnxī wùzhǒng wéi zhǔtí de gōngyuán biànde yuèláiyuè shòu rénmen de huānyíng.
english: In England, parks taking rare breeds of animals as their theme are becoming increasingly popular with people.

chinese: 这场比赛举世瞩目。
pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐ sài jǔ shì zhǔ mù。
english: This competition attracts worldwide attention.

chinese: 这是一座举世闻名的城市。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī zuò jǔ shì wén míng de chéng shì。
english: This is a world-famous city.

chinese: 他友好的举动让大家很感动。
pinyin: Tā yǒu hǎo de jǔ dòng ràng dà jiā hěn gǎn dòng。
english: His friendly gesture moved everyone.

chinese: 她在团队中起着举足轻重的作用。
pinyin: Tā zài tuán duì zhōng qǐ zhe jǔ zú qīng zhòng de zuò yòng。
english: She plays a crucial role in the team.

chinese: 她有一头乌黑的长发。
pinyin: Tā yǒu yī tóu wū hēi de cháng fà。
english: She has long jet-black hair.

chinese: 如果它是高品质的东西我会很乐意多付一点钱。
pinyin: Rúguǒ tā shì gāo pǐnzhì de dōngxi wǒ huì hěn lèyì duō fù yīdiǎn qián.
english: I'd gladly pay more for something if it's of high quality.

chinese: 他的人缘向来很好，因此一旦遭遇急难，朋友都乐意帮忙。
pinyin: Tā de rényuán xiànglái hěn hǎo, yīncǐ yīdàn zāoyù jínàn, péngyou dōu lèyì bāngmáng.
english: He is always popular among his friends. So whenever he comes across troubles or emergencies, they are happy to offer help.

chinese: 有时我会在一瞬间忽然迷失说话的脉络，像是忽然刮来一阵狂风，将正在演奏的乐谱吹得无影无踪。
pinyin: Yǒushí wǒ huì zài yī shùnjiān hūrán míshī shuōhuà de màiluò, xiàng shì hūrán guā lái yī zhèn kuángfēng, jiāng zhèngzài yǎnzòu de yuèpǔ chuī de wúyǐng-wúzōng.
english: Sometimes I will lose the context of my speech in an instant, as if a sudden gust of wind blows away the music score being played without leaving a trace.

chinese: 那是一个给我们带来无穷乐趣的传奇性的演出。
pinyin: Nàshi yī gè gěi wǒmen dàilái wúqióng lèqù de chuánqí xìng de yǎnchū.
english: It was a fabulous show which brought us an endless delight.

chinese: 乘务员提醒大家系好安全带。
pinyin: Chéng wù yuán tí xǐng dà jiā jì hǎo ān quán dài。
english: The attendant reminded everyone to fasten their seat belts.

chinese: 我把身上的钱全都给了那个乞丐。
pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shēnshang de qián quándōu gěi le nàge qǐgài.
english: I gave the beggar what money I had.

chinese: 你应该多接触本文化，多了解一些传统习俗。
pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi duō jiēchù běn wénhuà, duō liǎojiě yīxiē chuántǒng xísú.
english: You should interact with the local culture more, to better understand some traditions.

chinese: 我们走访了附近的乡镇。
pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu fǎng le fù jìn de xiāng zhèn。
english: We visited the nearby villages and towns.

chinese: 我对书法略知一二。
pinyin: Wǒ duì shūfǎ lüèzhīyī'èr.
english: I know a bit about calligraphy.

chinese: 他们在图书馆装备了新的书籍。
pinyin: Tāmen zài túshūguǎn zhuāngbèi le xīn de shūjí.
english: They furnished the library with new books.

chinese: 直到党委书记出面加以解释，才算打消了这种想法。
pinyin: Zhídào dǎngwěi shūji chūmiàn jiāyǐ jiěshì, cái suàn dǎxiāo le zhèzhǒng xiǎngfǎ.
english: Only when the Party Committee Secretary came in person to resolve it was this point of view dispelled entirely.

chinese: 对合理的建议，我们应该予以支持。
pinyin: Duì hé lǐ de jiàn yì， wǒ men yīng gāi yǔ yǐ zhī chí。
english: We should give our support to reasonable suggestions.

chinese: 孩子们争先恐后地回答问题。
pinyin: Hái zi men zhēng xiān kǒng hòu de huí dá wèn tí。
english: The children rushed to answer the question.

chinese: 两支队伍正在争夺冠军。
pinyin: Liǎng zhī duì wǔ zhèng zài zhēng duó guàn jūn。
english: Two teams are competing for the championship.

chinese: 这孩子很争气，学习一直很认真。
pinyin: Zhè hái zi hěn zhēng qì， xué xí yī zhí hěn rèn zhēn。
english: This child makes the family proud by studying diligently.

chinese: 在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。
pinyin: Zài zhège chéngshì, báirén hé hēirén jiān de zhēngduān yù yǎn yù liè.
english: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.

chinese: 他挑起争议性高的话题，制造纷争。
pinyin: Tā tiǎoqǐ zhēngyìxìng gāo de huàtí, zhìzào fēnzhēng.
english: He sows discord by raising controversial subjects.

chinese: 她把时间和精力投入了自己的事业。
pinyin: Tā bǎ shí jiān hé jīng lì tóu rù le zì jǐ de shì yè。
english: She devoted her time and energy to her career.

chinese: 这是个重要事件。
pinyin: Zhè shì gè zhòngyào shìjiàn.
english: This is an important event.

chinese: 他无权干涉我们的家庭事务。
pinyin: Tā wúquán gānshè wǒmen de jiātíng shìwù.
english: He has no right to interfere in our family affairs.

chinese: 警方正在了解事态的发展。
pinyin: Jǐng fāng zhèng zài liǎo jiě shì tài de fā zhǎn。
english: The police are assessing how the situation is developing.

chinese: 那场事故让我们陷入了不寻常的局势。
pinyin: Nà cháng shìgù ràng wǒmen xiànrù le bù xúncháng de júshì.
english: We were faced with an unusual situation because of the accident.

chinese: 很不幸地，我的邻居被卷入交通事故，呈现昏迷状态。
pinyin: Hěn bù xìng de, wǒ de línjū bèi juǎnrù jiāotōng shìgù, chéngxiàn hūnmí zhuàngtài.
english: Unfortunately, my neighbor was involved in a traffic accident, and is currently in a coma.

chinese: 我还留着那起事故的伤疤。
pinyin: Wǒ hái liú zhe nà qǐ shìgù de shāngbā.
english: I'll still have a scar from that accident.

chinese: "文学作品是关系到一个国家统治的伟大成就，以及永恒地位的辉煌事迹"。
pinyin: "wénxué zuòpǐn shì guānxìdào yī gè guójiā tǒngzhì de wěidà chéngjiù, yǐjí yǒnghéng dìwèi de huīhuáng shìjì ".
english: "Literary composition is a great achievement that concerns the ruling of a state, a splendid affair of eternal standing".

chinese: 关于财务方面的事项，公司里没有人比琼斯先生更了解。
pinyin: Guānyú cáiwù fāngmiàn de shìxiàng, gōngsī lǐ méiyǒu rén bǐ Qióngsī xiānsheng gèng liǎojiě.
english: With respect to financial matters, Mr Jones knows more than anyone else in the company.

chinese: 二氧化碳是燃烧煤、石油或天然气这样的燃料时会产生的气体。
pinyin: Èryǎnghuàtàn shì ránshāo méi, shíyóu huò tiānránqì zhèyàng de ránliào shí huì chǎnshēng de qìtǐ.
english: Carbon dioxide is a gas that is produced every time a fuel such as coal, oil, or natural gas is burned.

chinese: 他从来没有亏待过朋友。
pinyin: Tā cóng lái méi yǒu kuī dài guo péng you。
english: He has never treated his friends unfairly.

chinese: 这家公司去年出现了亏损。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōng sī qù nián chū xiàn le kuī sǔn。
english: This company made a loss last year.

chinese: 互联网的广泛应用使新一代的年轻人诞生了。
pinyin: Hùliánwǎng de guǎngfàn yìngyòng shǐ xīnyīdài de niánqīngrén dànshēng le.
english: The proliferation of Internet usage has given birth to a new generation of young people.

chinese: 主要互联网的搜索引擎之一说：“快比慢好”。
pinyin: Zhǔyào Hùliánwǎng de sōusuǒyǐnqíng zhīyī shuō:"kuài bǐ màn hǎo ".
english: One of the major Internet search engines states that ‘Fast is better than slow’.

chinese: 我今天有点不舒服。那户井水是许多疾病的源头。
pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān yǒudiǎn bù shūfu. nà hù jǐng shuǐ shì xǔduō jíbìng de yuántóu.
english: I don't feel well today. That well water is the cause of many illnesses.

chinese: 她在这次比赛中获得了亚军。
pinyin: Tā zài zhè cì bǐ sài zhōng huò dé le yà jūn。
english: She was the runner-up in this competition.

chinese: 把玛丽交代你去做的事告诉汤姆。
pinyin: Bǎ Mǎlì jiāodài nǐ qù zuò de shì gàosu Tāngmǔ.
english: Tell Tom what Mary asked you to do.

chinese: 火车在快到交叉路口的时候减速、按喇叭。
pinyin: Huǒchē zài kuài dào jiāochā lùkǒu de shíhou jiǎnsù, àn lǎba.
english: The train slowed and blared its horn as it approached the railway crossing.

chinese: 你最好不要和那样的男人交往。
pinyin: Nǐ zuì hǎobù yào hé nàyàng de nánrén jiāowǎng.
english: It'd be better if you didn't associate with men like that.

chinese: 这是一笔不错的交易。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī bǐ bù cuò de jiāoyì.
english: It's a good deal.

chinese: 他们正在就这个问题进行交涉。
pinyin: Tā men zhèng zài jiù zhè gè wèn tí jìn xíng jiāo shè。
english: They are negotiating over this issue.

chinese: 有朋自远方来，不亦乐乎？
pinyin: Yǒu péng zì yuǎnfāng lái, bùyìlèhū?
english: When a friend comes from afar, is that not delightful?

pinyin: Wǒmen xiànzài néng kěndìng de shuō, zhège jiǎshè shì chénglì de.
english: We can now say definitely that this hypothesis holds water.

chinese: 我想早点出门，偏偏下雨了。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zǎo diǎn chū mén， piān piān xià yǔ le。
english: I wanted to leave early, but it happened to rain.

chinese: 那个位置很偏僻。
pinyin: Nàge wèizhi hěn piānpì.
english: It's quite a remote spot.

chinese: 我们正在讨论如何解决偏差的问题。
pinyin: Wǒ men zhèng zài tǎo lùn rú hé jiě jué piān chā de wèn tí。
english: We are discussing how to deal with the problem of bias.

chinese: 人们趋向于带着偏见看待他人。
pinyin: Rénmen qūxiàng yú dài zhe piānjiàn kàndài tārén.
english: People tend to look at others with prejudice.

chinese: 今天由我做东，请大家吃饭。
pinyin: Jīn tiān yóu wǒ zuò dōng， qǐng dà jiā chī fàn。
english: I will be the host today and treat everyone to a meal.

chinese: 这件事我不能替你做主。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ bù néng tì nǐ zuò zhǔ。
english: I cannot make this decision for you.

chinese: 那艘船停泊在港口。
pinyin: Nà sōu chuán tíng bó zài gǎng kǒu。
english: That ship is anchored in the harbor.

chinese: 阿尔及尔从不停滞不前。
pinyin: Ā'ěrjí'ěr cóngbù tíngzhìbùqián.
english: Algiers never stands still.

chinese: 他不停顿地说了十分钟。
pinyin: Tā bù tíngdùn de shuō le shí fēnzhōng.
english: He spoke for ten minutes without a pause.

chinese: 我们需要健全的管理制度。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào jiàn quán de guǎn lǐ zhì dù。
english: We need a sound management system.

chinese: 面粉是那些你始终应该储备在厨房里的产品之一。
pinyin: Miànfěn shì nàxiē nǐ shǐzhōng yīnggāi chǔbèi zài chúfáng lǐ de chǎnpǐn zhīyī.
english: Flour is one of those products you should always have in your kitchen.

chinese: 快点储存！
pinyin: Kuàidiǎn chǔcún!
english: Save now!

chinese: 如果你想安享晚年，现在就要开始储蓄了。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng ān xiǎng wǎnnián, xiànzài jiùyào kāishǐ chǔxù le.
english: If you want security in your old age, begin saving now.

chinese: 他吓得全身僵硬。
pinyin: Tā xià de quánshēn jiāngyìng.
english: He was rigid with terror.

chinese: 这位元首很有经验。
pinyin: Zhè wèi yuán shǒu hěn yǒu jīng yàn。
english: This head of state is very experienced.

chinese: 粮仓充实了，百姓才会懂得礼仪规矩；衣食丰足了，人们才会知晓荣辱羞耻。
pinyin: Liángcāng chōngshí le, bǎixìng cái huì dǒngde lǐyí guīju; yīshí fēngzú le, rénmen cái huì zhīxiǎo róngrǔ xiūchǐ.
english: When the granaries are full, people observe rules of decorum; when food and clothing are sufficient, people understand honor and disgrace.

chinese: 我小睡后就感到精力充沛。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshuì hòu jiù gǎndào jīnglì chōngpèi.
english: A little nap and, just like that, I'm as fresh as a daisy.

chinese: 这些宝石很有光彩。
pinyin: Zhè xiē bǎo shí hěn yǒu guāng cǎi。
english: These gemstones shine brightly.

chinese: 我在这个世界散发着自己的光芒。
pinyin: Wǒ zài zhège shìjiè sànfā zhe zìjǐ de guāngmáng.
english: I shine light in the world.

chinese: 这个发现将会在历史上留下光辉的一页。
pinyin: Zhège fāxiàn jiānghuì zài lìshǐshàng liúxià guānghuī de yī yè.
english: This discovery will be recorded in history.

chinese: 医生正在研究免疫系统。
pinyin: Yī shēng zhèng zài yán jiū miǎn yì xì tǒng。
english: The doctor is studying the immune system.

chinese: 我们需要兑现自己的承诺。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào duì xiàn zì jǐ de chéng nuò。
english: We need to fulfill our promises.

chinese: 党为自己的利益追求势力。我们对别人不体贴；我们只追求势力。
pinyin: Dǎng wèi zìjǐ de lìyì zhuīqiú shìli. wǒmen duì biéren bù tǐtiē; wǒmen zhǐ zhuīqiú shìli.
english: The Party seeks power entirely for its own sake. We are not interested in the good of others; we are interested solely in power.

chinese: 他工作一直兢兢业业。
pinyin: Tā gōng zuò yī zhí jīng jīng yè yè。
english: He has always worked conscientiously.

chinese: 我们全力以赴来完成工作。
pinyin: Wǒmen quánlìyǐfù lái wánchéng gōngzuò.
english: We went all out to get the job done.

chinese: 做决定时，我们要考虑全局。
pinyin: Zuò jué dìng shí， wǒ men yào kǎo lǜ quán jú。
english: When making decisions, we must consider the overall situation.

chinese: 他们公司的公关团队非常强悍。
pinyin: Tāmen gōngsī de gōngguān tuánduì fēicháng qiánghàn.
english: Their company's public relations team is very strong.

chinese: 他今天有公务要处理。
pinyin: Tā jīn tiān yǒu gōng wù yào chǔ lǐ。
english: He has official business to deal with today.

chinese: 请阅读门口的公告。
pinyin: Qǐng yuè dú mén kǒu de gōng gào。
english: Please read the announcement at the entrance.

chinese: 她今天去看望公婆。
pinyin: Tā jīn tiān qù kàn wàng gōng pó。
english: She is visiting her parents-in-law today.

chinese: 她去公安局办理手续。
pinyin: Tā qù gōng ān jú bàn lǐ shǒu xù。
english: She went to the public security bureau to complete the paperwork.

chinese: 你知道这些公式是从哪里来的吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào zhèxiē gōngshì shì cóng nǎlǐ lái de ma?
english: Do you know where these equations come from?

chinese: 民主主义者是屈服于大部分人的自由公民。
pinyin: Mínzhǔzhǔyìzhě shì qūfú yú dàbùfen rén de zìyóu gōngmín.
english: A democrat is a free citizen who yields to the will of the majority.

chinese: 公众人物在面对公然侮辱时，碍于社会声望与舆论压力，只能宽容忍让，唾面自干。
pinyin: Gōngzhòngrénwù zài miànduì gōngrán wǔrǔ shí, ài yú shèhuì shēngwàng yǔ yúlùn yālì, zhǐnéng kuānróng rěnràng, tuòmiànzìgān.
english: When public figures, constrained by their social standing and the pressures of public opinion, face open insults, they can only tolerate and endure them, letting the spit on their face dry by itself.

chinese: 她是大家公认的优秀教师。
pinyin: Tā shì dà jiā gōng rèn de yōu xiù jiào shī。
english: She is widely recognized as an excellent teacher.

chinese: 这份文件需要办理公证。
pinyin: Zhè fèn wén jiàn xū yào bàn lǐ gōng zhèng。
english: This document needs notarization.

chinese: 我们想为弗洛依德讨要公道。
pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎng wèi fú Luò yī dé tǎo yào gōngdào.
english: We want justice for Floyd.

chinese: 这次活动共计二十人参加。
pinyin: Zhè cì huó dòng gòng jì èr shí rén cān jiā。
english: A total of twenty people took part in this activity.

chinese: 这个故事引起了大家的共鸣。
pinyin: Zhè gè gù shi yǐn qǐ le dà jiā de gòng míng。
english: This story resonated with everyone.

chinese: 我会关照它的。
pinyin: Wǒ huì guānzhào tā de.
english: I'll take care of it.

chinese: 这家店的生意很兴旺。
pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de shēng yì hěn xīng wàng。
english: Business at this shop is thriving.

chinese: 她兴致勃勃地介绍自己的计划。
pinyin: Tā xìng zhì bó bó de jiè shào zì jǐ de jì huà。
english: She enthusiastically explained her plan.

chinese: 这家商店的生意很兴隆。
pinyin: Zhè jiā shāng diàn de shēng yì hěn xīng lóng。
english: Business at this shop is thriving.

chinese: 孩子们兴高采烈地走进公园。
pinyin: Hái zi men xìng gāo cǎi liè de zǒu jìn gōng yuán。
english: The children entered the park in high spirits.

chinese: 这是一个典型的例子。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè diǎn xíng de lì zi。
english: This is a typical example.

chinese: 我理所当然地认为她会参加我们的结婚典礼。
pinyin: Wǒ lǐsuǒdāngrán de rènwéi tā huì cānjiā wǒmen de jiéhūn diǎnlǐ.
english: I took it for granted that she would come to our wedding.

chinese: 记者正在调查这件事的内幕。
pinyin: Jì zhě zhèng zài diào chá zhè jiàn shì de nèi mù。
english: The reporter is investigating the inside story of this matter.

chinese: 老师解释了这首诗的内涵。
pinyin: Lǎo shī jiě shì le zhè shǒu shī de nèi hán。
english: The teacher explained the deeper meaning of this poem.

chinese: 取得进步以后，我们还要再接再厉。
pinyin: Qǔ dé jìn bù yǐ hòu， wǒ men hái yào zài jiē zài lì。
english: After making progress, we must keep up our efforts.

chinese: 他冒充医生骗取信任。
pinyin: Tā mào chōng yī shēng piàn qǔ xìn rèn。
english: He pretended to be a doctor to gain people's trust.

chinese: 我必须说, 你的写作达到了非常好的水准。
pinyin: Wǒ bìxū shuō, nǐ de xiězuò dádào le fēicháng hǎo de shuǐzhǔn.
english: I must say that your writing is at a pretty good level!

chinese: 军队镇压了叛乱。
pinyin: Jūnduì zhènyā le pànluàn.
english: The army quelled the rebellion.

chinese: 中国农历年的一月一日为春节，是中国人民最隆重的传统节日。
pinyin: Zhōngguó nónglì nián de Yīyuè yī rì wèi Chūnjié, shì Zhōngguórén mín zuì lóngzhòng de chuántǒng jiérì.
english: The first day of the first month in the Chinese lunar calendar is Spring Festival, the most important festival for the people of China.

chinese: 请不要冤枉无辜的人。
pinyin: Qǐng bù yào yuān wang wú gū de rén。
english: Please do not falsely accuse innocent people.

chinese: 昨天下了一场冰雹。
pinyin: Zuó tiān xià le yī chǎng bīng báo。
english: There was a hailstorm yesterday.

chinese: 魅力冲击视觉，美德征服心灵。
pinyin: Mèilì chōngjī shìjué, měidé zhēngfú xīnlíng.
english: Charms strike the sight, but merit wins the soul.

chinese: 他叫自己的妻子不要冲动购物。
pinyin: Tā jiào zìjǐ de qīzi bù yàochōng dòng gòuwù.
english: He told his wife not to buy on impulse.

chinese: 安乐死与希波克拉底誓言相冲突。
pinyin: Ānlèsǐ yǔ Xībōkèlādǐ shìyán xiāng chōngtū.
english: Euthanasia comes into conflict with the Hippocratic oath.

chinese: 他参加了董事会的一些决策会议。
pinyin: Tā cānjiā le dǒngshìhuì de yīxiē juécè huìyì.
english: He sat in on some of the board's policy-making meetings.

chinese: 你这么漂亮，况且又这么聪明，怎么可能没人追你呢？
pinyin: Nǐ zhème piàoliang, kuàngqiě yòu zhème cōngming, zěnme kěnéng méi rén zhuī nǐ ne?
english: You're beautiful and intelligent, how is it possible that no man is chasing after you?

chinese: 在你侍酒前最好先将白葡萄酒冷却一下。
pinyin: Zài nǐ shì jiǔ qián zuì hǎo xiān jiāng bái pútaojiǔ lěngquè yīxià.
english: It's better to chill white wine before you serve it.

chinese: 他冷酷的性格使朋友们一个一个地疏远了他。
pinyin: Tā lěngkù de xìnggé shǐ péngyou men yī gè yī gè de shūyuǎn le tā.
english: His coolness has alienated his friends.

chinese: 我将建筑称作被冻结的音乐。
pinyin: Wǒ jiāng jiànzhù chēngzuò bèi dòngjié de yīnyuè.
english: I call architecture frozen music.

chinese: 今天的午饭就简单凑合一下吧。
pinyin: Jīn tiān de wǔ fàn jiù jiǎn dān còu he yī xià ba。
english: Let us make do with a simple lunch today.

chinese: 水泥会在数个小时内凝固。
pinyin: Shuǐní huì zài shù gè xiǎoshí nèi nínggù.
english: The cement will set in a couple of hours.

chinese: 这次活动凝聚了大家的力量。
pinyin: Zhè cì huó dòng níng jù le dà jiā de lì liang。
english: This activity brought everyone's strength together.

chinese: 女孩凝视着洋娃娃。
pinyin: Nǚhái níngshì zhe yángwáwa.
english: The girl was gazing at the doll.

chinese: 这只狗看起来很凶恶。
pinyin: Zhè zhī gǒu kàn qi lai hěn xiōng è。
english: This dog looks fierce.

chinese: 园丁后来发现就是凶手。
pinyin: Yuándīng hòulái fāxiàn jiù shì xiōngshǒu.
english: The gardener turned out to be the murderer.

chinese: 这块石头表面凹凸不平。
pinyin: Zhè kuài shí tou biǎo miàn āo tū bù píng。
english: The surface of this stone is uneven.

chinese: 无论发生什么事，我也绝对不会出卖我的朋友。
pinyin: Wúlùn fāshēng shénme shì, wǒ yě juéduì bù huì chūmài wǒ de péngyou.
english: I will never sell my friend down the river for anything in the world.

chinese: 一个真正的绅士不会出卖他的朋友。
pinyin: Yī gè zhēnzhèng de shēnshì bù huì chūmài tā de péngyou.
english: A true gentleman would not betray his friends.

chinese: 我没出息。
pinyin: Wǒ méi chūxī.
english: I have no future.

chinese: 我在大家面前出洋相了。
pinyin: Wǒ zài dà jiā miàn qián chū yáng xiàng le。
english: I made a fool of myself in front of everyone.

chinese: 她看着窗外，出神了。
pinyin: Tā kàn zhe chuāng wài， chū shén le。
english: She gazed out of the window, lost in thought.

chinese: 那是唯一的出路。
pinyin: Nàshi wéiyī de chūlù.
english: It was the only way to go.

chinese: 我父母在的时候，请你言语注意分寸。
pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ zài de shíhou, qǐng nǐ yányǔ zhùyì fēncun.
english: Please keep your language decent while my parents are here.

chinese: 欧洲四季分明，是最适合人类居住的地区。
pinyin: Ōuzhōu sìjì fēnmíng, shì zuì shìhé rénlèi jūzhù de dìqū.
english: Europe, with its four distinct seasons, is the most suitable environment for the human race to live in.

chinese: 这种植物会分泌一种液体。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhí wù huì fēn mì yī zhǒng yè tǐ。
english: This plant secretes a liquid.

chinese: 公司今年给股东分红了。
pinyin: Gōng sī jīn nián gěi gǔ dōng fēn hóng le。
english: The company distributed dividends to shareholders this year.

chinese: 进入地球大气层后，小行星分裂成了无数的小块。
pinyin: Jìnrù dìqiú dàqìcéng hòu, xiǎoxíngxīng fēnliè chéngle wúshù de xiǎo kuài.
english: The asteroid broke up into small pieces as it entered Earth's atmosphere.

chinese: 我们需要分解这种物质。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào fēn jiě zhè zhǒng wù zhì。
english: We need to break down this substance.

chinese: 一个像她那么大的小孩能够分辨是非吗？
pinyin: Yī gè xiàng tā nàme dà de xiǎohái nénggòu fēnbiàn shìfēi ma?
english: Can a child of her age distinguish good from bad?

chinese: 我们需要准确计算分量。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào zhǔn què jì suàn fèn liang。
english: We need to calculate the weight accurately.

chinese: 相信你的梦想，不论它们有多么地不切实际。
pinyin: Xiāngxìn nǐ de mèngxiǎng, bù lùn tāmen yǒu duōme de bùqièshíjì.
english: Believe in your dreams, no matter how impossible they seem.

chinese: 请把刊物放在桌上。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ kān wù fàng zài zhuō shàng。
english: Please put the publication on the table.

chinese: 我在报纸上刊登了我的房子的广告。
pinyin: Wǒ zài bàozhǐ shàng kāndēng le wǒ de fángzi de guǎnggào.
english: I advertised my house in the newspaper.

chinese: 他正在研究刑事法律。
pinyin: Tā zhèng zài yán jiū xíng shì fǎ lǜ。
english: He is studying criminal law.

chinese: 我们把任务划分成三个部分。
pinyin: Wǒ men bǎ rèn wu huà fēn chéng sān gè bù fen。
english: We divided the task into three parts.

chinese: 我们需要列举几个例子。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào liè jǔ jǐ gè lì zi。
english: We need to list a few examples.

chinese: 毕业以后，她决定自己创业。
pinyin: Bì yè yǐ hòu， tā jué dìng zì jǐ chuàng yè。
english: After graduation, she decided to start her own business.

chinese: 不知道要等多长时间，我的创作能力才能进步。
pinyin: Bù zhīdào yào děng duō cháng shíjiān, wǒ de chuàngzuò nénglì cáinéng jìnbù.
english: I don't know how long I'll have to wait before my creative ability improves.

chinese: 这家公司重视技术创新。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōng sī zhòng shì jì shù chuàng xīn。
english: This company values technological innovation.

chinese: 我们的学校是在一九九零年创立的。
pinyin: Wǒmen de xuéxiào shì zài yī jiǔ jiǔ líng nián chuànglì de.
english: Our school was founded in 1990.

chinese: 我们已经有了初步的计划。
pinyin: Wǒ men yǐ jīng yǒu le chū bù de jì huà。
english: We already have a preliminary plan.

chinese: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。
pinyin: Fǎtíng duì tā de móushā zuìmíng zuòchū le wúzuì pànjué.
english: The court acquitted him of the charge of murder.

chinese: 我们要仔细考虑这件事的利害关系。
pinyin: Wǒ men yào zǐ xì kǎo lǜ zhè jiàn shì de lì hài guān xi。
english: We must carefully consider the interests involved in this matter.

chinese: 利率还是低。
pinyin: Lìlǜ háishi dī.
english: Interest rates are still low.

chinese: 这栋别墅的主人是谁？
pinyin: Zhè dòng biéshù de zhǔrén shì shéi?
english: Who owns this villa?

chinese: 她今天显得很别扭。
pinyin: Tā jīn tiān xiǎn de hěn biè niu。
english: She seems awkward today.

chinese: 这座建筑的设计很别致。
pinyin: Zhè zuò jiàn zhù de shè jì hěn bié zhì。
english: The design of this building is unique.

chinese: 有个穿白色制服的女孩帮我量了体温。
pinyin: Yǒu gè chuān báisè zhìfú de nǚhái bāng wǒ liáng le tǐwēn.
english: The girl in a white uniform took my temperature.

chinese: 制止她！
pinyin: Zhìzhǐ tā!
english: Stop her!

chinese: 资金不足制约了公司的发展。
pinyin: Zī jīn bù zú zhì yuē le gōng sī de fā zhǎn。
english: Insufficient funds constrained the company's development.

chinese: 几个国家决定对它实施经济制裁。
pinyin: Jǐ gè guó jiā jué dìng duì tā shí shī jīng jì zhì cái。
english: Several countries decided to impose economic sanctions on it.
