pinyin: Wǒ fājué shuō Yīngyǔ hěn jiǎndān.
english: I found it easy to speak English.

chinese: 汤姆和玛丽要发财了。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ hé Mǎlì yào fācái le.
english: Tom and Mary are going to be rich.

chinese: 我们需要取缔非法的组织。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào qǔ dì fēi fǎ de zǔ zhī。
english: We need to ban illegal organizations.

chinese: 生病的时候，他觉得很受罪。
pinyin: Shēng bìng de shí hou， tā jué de hěn shòu zuì。
english: He felt that being ill was a real ordeal.

chinese: 突如其来的变故改变了我们的计划。
pinyin: Tū rú qí lái de biàn gù gǎi biàn le wǒ men de jì huà。
english: An unexpected event changed our plans.

chinese: 牛奶变质了。
pinyin: Niúnǎi biànzhì le.
english: The milk has gone bad.

chinese: 这本书记录了城市的变迁。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū jì lù le chéng shì de biàn qiān。
english: This book records the changes in the city.

chinese: 我不需要你口头上的温柔。
pinyin: Wǒ bù xūyào nǐ kǒutóu shàng de wēnróu.
english: I don't need your verbal gentleness.

chinese: 他说话的口气很友好。
pinyin: Tā shuō huà de kǒu qì hěn yǒu hǎo。
english: He speaks in a friendly tone.

chinese: 医生仔细检查了他的口腔。
pinyin: Yī shēng zǐ xì jiǎn chá le tā de kǒu qiāng。
english: The doctor carefully examined his mouth.

chinese: 我花了好长时间才适应了委内瑞拉的口音。
pinyin: Wǒ huā le hǎo cháng shíjiān cái shìyìng le Wěinèiruìlā de kǒuyīn.
english: It took a long time for me to get accustomed to the Venezuelan accent.

chinese: 他说话夹杂着台湾口音。
pinyin: Tā shuōhuà jiāzá zhe Táiwān kǒuyīn.
english: He spoke with a Taiwanese accent mixed in.

chinese: 真的不敢相信你在吃医生叮嘱不要食用的东西。
pinyin: Zhēn de bù gǎn xiāngxìn nǐ zài chī yīshēng dīngzhǔ bù yào shíyòng de dōngxi.
english: I can't believe you are eating something the doctor has told you repeatedly you shouldn't eat.

chinese: 这道菜很可口。
pinyin: Zhè dào cài hěn kě kǒu。
english: This dish is delicious.

chinese: 你应该认为这是个很可观的改进。
pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi rènwéi zhè shì gè hěn kěguān de gǎijìn.
english: You must think of this as a great improvement.

chinese: 台风造成了河水泛滥。
pinyin: Táifēng zàochéng le héshuǐ fàn làn.
english: The typhoon caused the river to flood.

chinese: 我们需要号召大家一起参加。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào hào zhào dà jiā yī qǐ cān jiā。
english: We need to call on everyone to join in.

chinese: 这位司令很有经验。
pinyin: Zhè wèi sī lìng hěn yǒu jīng yàn。
english: This commanding officer is very experienced.

chinese: 他看着账单叹气。
pinyin: Tā kàn zhe zhàng dān tàn qì。
english: He sighed as he looked at the bill.

chinese: 汤姆吃力地去碰脚趾。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ chīlì de qù pèng jiǎozhǐ.
english: Tom struggled to touch his toes.

chinese: 好奇会吃苦头的。
pinyin: Hàoqí huì chīkǔtou de.
english: Curiosity killed the cat.

chinese: 讨论时，大家可以各抒己见。
pinyin: Tǎo lùn shí， dà jiā kě yǐ gè shū jǐ jiàn。
english: During the discussion, everyone can express their own views.

chinese: 他的行为既不违法也不完全合乎道德，介于一种灰色地带之间。
pinyin: Tā de xíngwéi jì bù wéifǎ yě bù wánquán héhū dàodé, jièyú yīzhǒng huīsèdìdài zhījiān.
english: His actions are neither illegal nor entirely ethical, falling somewhere in a gray area.

chinese: 我们需要合成这种物质。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào hé chéng zhè zhǒng wù zhì。
english: We need to synthesize this substance.

chinese: 买这套书比单独买更合算。
pinyin: Mǎi zhè tào shū bǐ dān dú mǎi gèng hé suàn。
english: Buying this set of books is more economical than buying them separately.

chinese: 这些裤子我穿起来很合身。
pinyin: Zhèxiē kùzi wǒ chuān qǐlai hěn héshēn.
english: These pants fit me well.

chinese: 我们祝您新年吉祥。
pinyin: Wǒ men zhù nín xīn nián jí xiáng。
english: We wish you good fortune in the New Year.

chinese: 汤姆向他的朋友吐露他要上吊自杀。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ xiàng tā de péngyou tǔlù tā yào shàngdiào zìshā.
english: Tom confided in his friend that he was going to hang himself.

chinese: 我的一个女性朋友喜欢跟我一起去同志酒吧。
pinyin: Wǒ de yí gè nǚxìng péngyou xǐhuan gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù tóngzhì jiǔbā.
english: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.

chinese: 他不愿意为同胞作证。
pinyin: Tā bù yuànyì wèi tóngbāo zuòzhèng.
english: He is not willing to testify for his compatriot.

chinese: 她是一位名副其实的专家。
pinyin: Tā shì yī wèi míng fù qí shí de zhuān jiā。
english: She truly is an expert in every sense.

chinese: 他在比赛中取得了很好的名次。
pinyin: Tā zài bǐ sài zhōng qǔ dé le hěn hǎo de míng cì。
english: He achieved a very good placing in the competition.

chinese: 尽管有金钱和名誉，他还是不幸福。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yǒu jīnqián hé míngyù, tā háishi bù xìngfú.
english: Even with all his wealth and fame, he's unhappy.

chinese: 这次活动只有二十个名额。
pinyin: Zhè cì huó dòng zhǐ yǒu èr shí gè míng é。
english: There are only twenty places available for this activity.

chinese: 我们需要为后代保护环境。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào wèi hòu dài bǎo hù huán jìng。
english: We need to protect the environment for future generations.

chinese: 有了家人的支持，她没有后顾之忧。
pinyin: Yǒu le jiā rén de zhī chí， tā méi yǒu hòu gù zhī yōu。
english: With her family's support, she has no worries holding her back.

chinese: 他担任我的向导。
pinyin: Tā dānrèn wǒ de xiàngdǎo.
english: He acted as my guide.

chinese: 玛莉不喜欢跟汤姆一样吝啬的男人。
pinyin: Mǎlì bù xǐhuān gēn Tāngmǔ yīyàng lìnsè de nánrén.
english: Mary doesn't like men who are stingy like Tom.

chinese: 食物在吞咽前要经过咀嚼。
pinyin: Shíwù zài tūnyàn qián yào jīngguò jǔjué.
english: Food should be chewed before being swallowed.

chinese: 接下来该怎么做，我完全听从您的吩咐。
pinyin: Jiēxiàlái gāi zěnme zuò, wǒ wánquán tīngcóng nín de fēnfù.
english: I will follow your advice fully from here onwards.

chinese: 我抓不到句子的确切含义。
pinyin: Wǒ zhuā bù dào jùzi de quèqiè hányì.
english: I can't get at the exact meaning of the sentence.

chinese: 两位学者为一句意思含糊的藏文句子争论了一番。
pinyin: Liǎng wèi xuézhě wèi yījù yìsi hánhu de Zàngwén jùzi zhēnglùn le yī fān.
english: The two scholars wrangled over the meaning of an obscure Tibetan phrase.

chinese: 门口贴着一张招工启事。
pinyin: Mén kǒu tiē zhe yī zhāng zhāo gōng qǐ shì。
english: A recruitment notice is posted at the entrance.

chinese: 这个故事给了我很大的启示。
pinyin: Zhè gè gù shi gěi le wǒ hěn dà de qǐ shì。
english: This story gave me valuable insights.

chinese: 我们启程开车去卡比利亚。
pinyin: Wǒmen qǐchéng kāichē qù kǎ Bǐlì yà.
english: We started driving to Kabylie.

chinese: 不要沉迷于过去，而是要从中吸取教训。
pinyin: Bùyào chénmíyú guòqù, érshì yào cóngzhōng xīqǔ jiàoxun.
english: Never live in the past but always learn from it.

chinese: 请客观评价，不要过分吹捧。
pinyin: Qǐng kè guān píng jià， bù yào guò fèn chuī pěng。
english: Please give an objective assessment without excessive flattery.

chinese: 消磨时间的最有效办法当然还是聊天吹牛侃大山。
pinyin: Xiāomóshíjiān de zuì yǒuxiào bànfǎ dāngrán háishi liáotiān chuīniú kǎndàshān.
english: The most effective way to kill time, of course, is chatting, bragging, and having wild conversations.

chinese: 对你的电脑吼一点帮助也没有。
pinyin: Duì nǐ de diànnǎo hǒu yīdiǎn bāngzhù yě méiyǒu.
english: Shouting at your computer will not help.

chinese: 老师告诫我们不要粗心。
pinyin: Lǎo shī gào jiè wǒ men bù yào cū xīn。
english: The teacher warned us not to be careless.

chinese: 告辞！
pinyin: Gàocí!
english: Goodbye!

chinese: 你是否有恶心呕吐的感觉。
pinyin: Nǐ shìfǒu yǒu ěxīn ǒutù de gǎnjué.
english: Do you feel nauseous?

chinese: 她对这次旅行做了周密的安排。
pinyin: Tā duì zhè cì lǚ xíng zuò le zhōu mì de ān pái。
english: She made thorough arrangements for this trip.

chinese: 经过很多周折，我们终于找到了他。
pinyin: Jīng guò hěn duō zhōu zhé， wǒ men zhōng yú zhǎo dào le tā。
english: After many complications, we finally found him.

chinese: 他背周期表只是为了好玩。
pinyin: Tā bèi zhōuqībiǎo zhǐshì wèile hǎowán.
english: He learnt the periodic table by heart just for fun.

chinese: 这笔钱可以帮助公司周转。
pinyin: Zhè bǐ qián kě yǐ bāng zhù gōng sī zhōu zhuǎn。
english: This money can help the company maintain cash flow.

chinese: 这个国家将周边的所有国家都视作威胁。
pinyin: Zhège guójiā jiāng zhōubiān de suǒyǒu guójiā dōu shìzuò wēixié.
english: This country considers every neighboring country as a threat.

chinese: 他对着双手呵气。
pinyin: Tā duì zhe shuāng shǒu hē qì。
english: He breathes onto his hands.

chinese: 我们提出了请求支持的呼吁。
pinyin: Wǒmen tíchū le qǐngqiú zhīchí de hūyù.
english: We made an appeal for support.

chinese: 寒风在窗外呼啸。
pinyin: Hán fēng zài chuāng wài hū xiào。
english: The cold wind whistled outside the window.

chinese: 以动物命名人的属相，是因为我们的先民与这些动物有密切关系。
pinyin: Yǐ dòngwù mìngmíng rén de shǔxiàng, shì yīnwèi wǒmen de xiānmín yǔ zhèxiē dòngwù yǒu mìqiè guānxi.
english: Our ancestors used animals to name the years of people's births as their lives were closely connected to these animals.

chinese: 这件事咋办？
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zǎ bàn？
english: What should we do about this?

chinese: 和气点。
pinyin: Héqi diǎn.
english: Be nice.

chinese: 他是一个和蔼可亲的老师。
pinyin: Tā shì yī gè hé'ǎikěqīn de lǎoshī.
english: He is a kind teacher.

chinese: 他们和解了，并再次成为了朋友。
pinyin: Tāmen héjiě le, bìng zàicì chéngwéi le péngyou.
english: They made up and became friends again.

chinese: 我们的性生活不是十分和谐。
pinyin: Wǒmen de xìngshēnghuó bù shì shífēn héxié.
english: Our sex life is not completely harmonious.

chinese: 想到被骗的经历，他气得咬牙切齿。
pinyin: Xiǎng dào bèi piàn de jīng lì， tā qì de yǎo yá qiè chǐ。
english: Thinking of being cheated made him gnash his teeth in anger.

chinese: 他很重视品德。
pinyin: Tā hěn zhòng shì pǐn dé。
english: He attaches great importance to moral character.

chinese: 妈妈轻声哄孩子睡觉。
pinyin: Mā ma qīng shēng hǒng hái zi shuì jiào。
english: The mother gently soothes her child to sleep.

chinese: 他冷得直哆嗦。
pinyin: Tā lěng de zhí duō suo。
english: He was shivering from the cold.

chinese: 哇，这里真漂亮！
pinyin: Wā， zhè lǐ zhēn piào liang！
english: Wow, it is really beautiful here!

chinese: 行动比语言更响亮。
pinyin: Xíngdòng bǐ yǔyán gèng xiǎngliàng.
english: Actions speak louder than words.

chinese: 大家响应了他的号召。
pinyin: Dà jiā xiǎng yìng le tā de hào zhào。
english: Everyone responded to his call.

chinese: 哦，我才想起来，身份证不要忘了带。
pinyin: Ò, wǒ cái xiǎngqilai, shēnfènzhèng bù yào wàng le dài.
english: Oh, I just remembered, do not forget to bring your ID.

chinese: 裁判吹哨两次，向大家宣布已经终场。
pinyin: Cáipàn chuīshào liǎng cì, xiàng dàjiā xuānbù yǐjīng zhōngchǎng.
english: The referee blew his whistle twice to tell everyone it was full-time.

chinese: 非洲地松鼠互帮互助，对其他哺乳动物没有攻击性。
pinyin: Fēizhōu de sōngshǔ hù bāng hùzhù, duì qítā bǔrǔdòngwù méiyǒu gōngjī xìng.
english: The African ground squirrels collaborate and are not aggressive to other mammals.

chinese: 哼，我就知道事情会变成这样。
pinyin: Hēng, wǒ jiù zhīdào shìqing huì biànchéng zhèyàng.
english: Hmph, I just knew things would turn out this way.

chinese: 别唠叨！我需要学习。
pinyin: Bié láodao! wǒ xūyào xuéxí.
english: Don't chatter! I have to study.

chinese: 快乐存在于过去和未来，唯独不存在于现在。
pinyin: Kuàilè cúnzài yú guòqù hé wèilái, wéidú bù cúnzài yú xiànzài.
english: Pleasure is always in the past or in the future, never in the present.

chinese: 讲话时不要把唾沫喷到别人身上。
pinyin: Jiǎng huà shí bù yào bǎ tuò mo pēn dào bié ren shēn shàng。
english: Do not spray saliva on others when speaking.

chinese: 小狗正在啃骨头。
pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu zhèng zài kěn gǔ tou。
english: The puppy is gnawing on a bone.

chinese: 请确认商标是否正确。
pinyin: Qǐng què rèn shāng biāo shì fǒu zhèng què。
english: Please check whether the trademark is correct.

chinese: 汤姆想不通为啥没人想去动物园了。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ xiǎngbutōng wèishá méi rén xiǎng qù dòngwùyuán le.
english: Tom couldn't understand why no one else wanted to go to the zoo.

chinese: 我们要回去啦，你托我们的事情一定留心着。
pinyin: Wǒmen yào huíqu lā, nǐ tuō wǒmen de shìqing yīdìng liúxīn zhe.
english: We're heading back. We'll make sure to take care of what you asked us to do.

chinese: 请说得简洁一些，不要太啰唆。
pinyin: Qǐng shuō de jiǎn jié yī xiē， bù yào tài luō suo。
english: Please be concise and not too long-winded.

chinese: 我的喉咙又干又红、又痛又痒。
pinyin: Wǒ de hóulóng yòu gān yòu hóng, yòu tòng yòu yǎng.
english: My throat feels dry and raw and scratchy.

chinese: 跑完步后，他不停地喘气。
pinyin: Pǎo wán bù hòu， tā bù tíng de chuǎn qì。
english: After running, he kept panting.

chinese: 这是一种大家喜闻乐见的表演。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī zhǒng dà jiā xǐ wén lè jiàn de biǎo yǎn。
english: This is a kind of performance that everyone enjoys.

chinese: 狗的嗅觉比人类敏锐得多。
pinyin: Gǒu de xiùjué bǐ rénlèi mǐnruì de duō.
english: A dog's sense of smell is much keener than a human's.

chinese: 嗨，我可能没钱，但我一直有我的骄傲。
pinyin: Hāi, wǒ kěnéng méi qián, dàn wǒ yīzhí yǒu wǒ de jiāo'ào.
english: Hey, I may have no money, but I still have my pride.

chinese: 「喂！这里跑步很危险的。」「嗯？……啊、啊、啊！！」「唉，我刚才不是和你说了吗？」
pinyin: 「 wèi! zhèlǐ pǎobù hěn wēixiǎn de.」「 ēn?…… ā, ā, ā!!」「 āi, wǒ gāngcái bù shì hé nǐ shuō le ma?」
english: "Hey! It's dangerous to run here." "Eh? ... A-a-Aaah!!" "Oh dear, what did I tell you?"

chinese: 日本是一个非常嘈杂的国家。
pinyin: Rìběn shì yī gè fēicháng cáozá de guójiā.
english: Japan is an extremely noisy country.

chinese: 你的嘴唇上有东西。
pinyin: Nǐde zuǐchún shàng yǒu dōngxi.
english: You've got something on your lip.

chinese: 嘿，汤姆，我们可以买两箱生菜吗？
pinyin: Hēi, Tāngmǔ, wǒmen kěyǐ mǎi liǎng xiāng shēngcài ma?
english: Hey, Tom, can we get two bins of lettuce?

chinese: 生意停顿了以后，许多公共浴堂都添置了桑拿浴室、健身器材等的新设备，希望能吸引多点人来光顾。
pinyin: Shēngyi tíngdùn le yǐhòu, xǔduō gōnggòng yù táng dōu tiānzhì le sāngná yùshì, jiànshēn qìcái děng de xīn shèbèi, xīwàng néng xīyǐn duō diǎn rén lái guānggù.
english: After business came to a halt, many bathhouses added new facilities, such as saunas and exercise equipment, in an effort to attract customers.

chinese: 他在城市里一直受到噪音或者其他的干扰。
pinyin: Tā zài chéngshì lǐ yīzhí shòudào zàoyīn huòzhě qítā de gānrǎo.
english: He was always annoyed in the city by noises of one sort or another.

chinese: 医生仔细检查了他的四肢。
pinyin: Yī shēng zǐ xì jiǎn chá le tā de sì zhī。
english: The doctor carefully examined his arms and legs.

chinese: 如果在暗中做善事，也总是有一个良好的回报。
pinyin: Rúguǒ zài ànzhōng zuò shànshì, yě zǒngshì yǒu yī gè liánghǎo de huíbào.
english: Secret gifts are openly rewarded.

chinese: 那些材料都是可回收且可再利用的。
pinyin: Nàxiē cáiliào dōu shì kě huíshōu qiě kě zài lìyòng de.
english: These materials are all reusable and recyclable.

chinese: 请不要回避这个问题。
pinyin: Qǐng bù yào huí bì zhè gè wèn tí。
english: Please do not avoid this question.

chinese: 我会记会议笔记，下次会议前可以回顾一下。
pinyin: Wǒ huì jì huìyì bǐjì, xiàcì huìyì qián kěyǐ huígù yīxià.
english: I'll keep the meeting notes to review them before the next session.

chinese: 带孩子团体去图书馆一点问题都没有。
pinyin: Dài háizi tuántǐ qù túshūguǎn yīdiǎn wèntí dōu méiyǒu.
english: Taking the group of children to the library was no problem.

chinese: 春节是家人团圆的日子。
pinyin: Chūn jié shì jiā rén tuán yuán de rì zi。
english: The Spring Festival is a time for families to reunite.

chinese: 总统呼吁全国民众在对抗贫穷或疾病的时候，一定要团结一致。
pinyin: Zǒngtǒng hūyù quánguó mínzhòng zài duìkàng pínqióng huò jíbìng de shíhou, yīdìngyào tuánjié yīzhì.
english: The president called on the people to unite in fighting poverty and disease.

chinese: 不要干预不关你的事！

english: The waterways branch out across the plain.

chinese: 是你该放弃你幼稚手段的时候了。

chinese: 请仔细阅读这本书的序言。

chinese: 如果我当时有空，我一定会应邀的。

english: He does not like attending too many social engagements.

english: His motto is to keep learning.

chinese: 她不喜欢这种庸俗的玩笑。

english: Repairing this bridge is the most urgent task.

chinese: 当你过马路的时候要当心汽车。
pinyin: Dāng nǐ guòmǎlù de shíhou yào dāngxīn qìchē.
english: Watch out for cars when you cross the street.

chinese: 我觉得汤姆不太可能会当选。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde Tāngmǔ bù tài kěnéng huì dāngxuǎn.
english: I think it's unlikely that Tom will get elected.

chinese: 如果你们之间有问题，应该当面告诉他，不要在背后说他。

english: If you have a bone to pick with a person, tell it to his face instead of saying things behind his back.

english: The picture brought back a lot of memories.

english: This disciple is very experienced.

english: Saving money at the cost of health is not worth it.

chinese: 这个药很得力。
pinyin: Zhège yào hěn délì.
english: This medicine is very effective.

pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu dé tiān dú hòu de zì rán tiáo jiàn。
english: This place enjoys exceptionally favorable natural conditions.

pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng dé zui nǐ。
english: I do not want to offend you.

pinyin: Tā zài mén wài pái huái le hěn jiǔ。
english: He paced outside the door for a long time.

pinyin: Xuéxí shì yī gè xúnxùjiànjìn de guòchéng.
english: Studying is a step-by-step process.

chinese: 和大家的努力相比，我的贡献微不足道。
pinyin: Hé dà jiā de nǔ lì xiāng bǐ， wǒ de gòng xiàn wēi bù zú dào。
english: Compared with everyone's efforts, my contribution is negligible.

chinese: 我们还需要从微观角度分析这个问题。
pinyin: Wǒ men hái xū yào cóng wēi guān jiǎo dù fēn xī zhè gè wèn tí。
english: We also need to analyze this issue at a detailed level.

pinyin: Tā hé wǒ men fēn xiǎng le xué xí de xīn dé。
english: She shared what she had learned from studying with us.

pinyin: Gēnsuí nǐ de xīnlíng, bù yào gēnsuí nǐ de kǒngjù.
english: Follow your heart, not your fears.

pinyin: Kàn dào hái zi shòu shāng， mā ma hěn xīn téng。
english: Seeing her child hurt caused the mother great distress.

english: He's bound to notice your mistake.

english: He carried out the scheme faithfully.

chinese: 翻译就像一个女人。她漂亮就会不忠诚；她忠诚就肯定不会漂亮。

pinyin: Tā jīn tiān xiǎn de hěn kuài huo。
english: She seems happy today.

chinese: 如果我是你，我就忽略它。

pinyin: Qǐng yuán liàng wǒ men zhāo dài bù zhōu， dài màn le kè rén。
english: Please forgive our poor hospitality toward our guests.

pinyin: Xué xí yǔ yán bù néng jí yú qiú chéng。
english: You cannot expect instant success when learning a language.

english: He is sometimes annoyed.

chinese: 他为自己的行为感到悔恨。
pinyin: Tā wèi zì jǐ de xíng wéi gǎn dào huǐ hèn。
english: He feels remorse for his behavior.

chinese: 医生在患者还活着的时候就把他送入了太平间。
pinyin: Yīshēng zài huànzhě hái huózhe de shíhou jiù bǎ tā sòngrù le tàipíngjiān.
english: The doctor sent the live patient to the morgue.

chinese: 游客沿着悬崖峭壁慢慢前进。
pinyin: Yóu kè yán zhe xuán yá qiào bì màn màn qián jìn。
english: The visitors moved slowly along the steep cliffs.

chinese: 这个故事的结尾留下了悬念。
pinyin: Zhè gè gù shi de jié wěi liú xià le xuán niàn。
english: The ending of this story leaves a sense of suspense.

chinese: 人们普遍认为悬挂式滑翔运动是危险的。
pinyin: Rénmen pǔbiàn rènwéi xuánguàshìhuáxiáng yùndòng shì wēixiǎn de.
english: There is a tendency for people to think that hang gliding is dangerous.

chinese: 她的眼神里充满了悲哀。
pinyin: Tā de yǎnshén lǐ chōngmǎn le bēi'āi.
english: Her eyes were full of sadness.

chinese: 这个故事有一个悲惨的结局。
pinyin: Zhège gùshi yǒu yī gè bēicǎn de jiéjú.
english: This story has a sad ending.

chinese: 我已经不记得第一次碰到汤姆的情形了。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng bù jìde dìyīcì pèngdào Tāngmǔ de qíngxing le.
english: I don't remember the first time I met Tom.

chinese: 他说的话不合情理。
pinyin: Tā shuō dehuà bù hé qínglǐ.
english: What he says is total nonsense.

chinese: 这件事情像是电影情节。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqing xiàng shì diànyǐng qíngjié.
english: That's something like a movie scenario.

chinese: 请小声一点，别惊动孩子。
pinyin: Qǐng xiǎo shēng yī diǎn， bié jīng dòng hái zi。
english: Please be quiet so that you do not disturb the child.

chinese: 感到惊讶、感到惊奇就是明白的开始。
pinyin: Gǎndào jīngyà, gǎndào jīngqí jiùshì míngbai de kāishǐ.
english: To be surprised, to wonder, is to begin to understand.

chinese: 在那种地方碰到你的老师，你应该很惊讶吧。
pinyin: Zài nàzhǒng dìfang pèngdào nǐ de lǎoshī, nǐ yīnggāi hěn jīngyà ba.
english: You must have been surprised to meet your teacher in such a place.

chinese: 大家对这个结果感到惋惜。
pinyin: Dà jiā duì zhè gè jié guǒ gǎn dào wǎn xī。
english: Everyone felt regret over this outcome.

chinese: 她一直惦记着远方的家人。
pinyin: Tā yī zhí diàn jì zhe yuǎn fāng de jiā rén。
english: She keeps thinking with concern about her family far away.

chinese: 要是我们做了同样的事，我们将会受到惩罚。
pinyin: Yàoshi wǒmen zuò le tóngyàng de shì, wǒmen jiānghuì shòudào chéngfá.
english: Were we to do such a thing, we should be punished.

chinese: 按照惯例，我们每周开一次会。
pinyin: Àn zhào guàn lì， wǒ men měi zhōu kāi yī cì huì。
english: As usual, we hold a meeting once a week.

chinese: 她想方设法以一己之力完成了工作。
pinyin: Tā xiǎngfāngshèfǎ yǐ yījǐ zhī lì wánchéng le gōngzuò.
english: She managed to finish the work on her own.

chinese: 他的急脾气迟早会惹祸上身。
pinyin: Tā de jí píqi chízǎo huì rěhuò shàngshēn.
english: His quick temper will get him in trouble one day.

chinese: 双方都有合作的意向。
pinyin: Shuāng fāng dōu yǒu hé zuò de yì xiàng。
english: Both sides intend to cooperate.

chinese: 热天气不仅仅意味着人们觉得有点不高兴。
pinyin: Rè tiānqì bù jǐnjǐn yìwèizhe rénmen juéde yǒudiǎn bù gāoxìng.
english: Hot weather doesn’t just mean that people feel a little unhappy.

chinese: 坚定的意志帮助他克服困难。
pinyin: Jiān dìng de yì zhì bāng zhù tā kè fú kùn nan。
english: A strong will helped him overcome difficulties.

chinese: 这个结果出乎我们的意料。
pinyin: Zhè gè jié guǒ chū hū wǒ men de yì liào。
english: This result was unexpected.

chinese: 那个时候我才意识到我把钱包忘在家里了。
pinyin: Nàge shíhou wǒ cái yìshí dào wǒ bǎ qiánbāo wàng zài jiālǐ le.
english: Only then did I realize that I had left my wallet at home.

chinese: 如果你做了愚蠢的事，你就必须无怨尤接受痛苦惩罚。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ zuò le yúchǔn de shì, nǐ jiù bìxū wú yuànyóu jiēshòu tòngkǔ chéngfá.
english: If you do silly things, you must accept the consequences without complaining.

chinese: 听到这个故事，她感慨万分。
pinyin: Tīng dào zhè gè gù shi， tā gǎn kǎi wàn fēn。
english: She was deeply moved on hearing this story.

chinese: 我被他的故事感染了。
pinyin: Wǒ bèi tā de gùshi gǎnrǎn le.
english: I was very impressed by his story.

chinese: 听到这个消息，他愣了一下。
pinyin: Tīng dào zhè gè xiāo xi， tā lèng le yī xià。
english: He was momentarily stunned by the news.

chinese: 这位老师给人的感觉很慈祥。
pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo shī gěi rén de gǎn jué hěn cí xiáng。
english: This teacher gives an impression of being kindly.

chinese: 他慌忙跑出了教室。
pinyin: Tā huāng máng pǎo chū le jiào shì。
english: He hurried out of the classroom.

chinese: 选择朋友要慎重。
pinyin: Xuǎnzé péngyou yào shènzhòng.
english: You should choose your friends very carefully.

chinese: 这是一种慢性病。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī zhǒng màn xìng bìng。
english: This is a chronic illness.

chinese: 我们需要慰问受灾的家庭。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào wèi wèn shòu zāi de jiā tíng。
english: We need to offer comfort to families affected by the disaster.

chinese: 我很钦佩他的慷慨大方。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn qīnpèi tā de kāngkǎi dàfāng.
english: I had great admiration for his generosity.

chinese: 他把想说的话憋在心里。
pinyin: Tā bǎ xiǎng shuō de huà biē zài xīn lǐ。
english: He kept the words he wanted to say bottled up inside.

chinese: 明天，明天，只是不是今天-所有的懒惰的人都这么说。
pinyin: Míngtiān, míngtiān, zhǐshì bù shì jīntiān - suǒyǒu de lǎnduò de rén dōu zhème shuō.
english: Tomorrow, tomorrow, just not today - say all lazy people.

chinese: 双方同意价格后就成交了。
pinyin: Shuāng fāng tóng yì jià gé hòu jiù chéng jiāo le。
english: The deal was completed after both sides agreed on the price.

chinese: 他成天都在练习中文。
pinyin: Tā chéng tiān dōu zài liàn xí zhōng wén。
english: He practices Chinese all day long.

chinese: 他不是成心让你生气的。
pinyin: Tā bù shì chéng xīn ràng nǐ shēng qì de。
english: He did not deliberately try to make you angry.

chinese: 这种方法取得了很好的成效。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng fāng fǎ qǔ dé le hěn hǎo de chéng xiào。
english: This method produced very good results.

chinese: 守卫一直保持戒备。
pinyin: Shǒu wèi yī zhí bǎo chí jiè bèi。
english: The guard remains alert.

chinese: 我不记得我看过这封信，但或许我读过它。
pinyin: Wǒ bù jìde wǒ kàn guo zhè fēng xìn, dàn huòxǔ wǒ dú guo tā.
english: I do not remember seeing the letter, but perhaps I read it.

chinese: 很多士兵在这场战役中严重受伤。
pinyin: Hěn duōshì bīng zài zhè chǎng zhànyì zhōng yánzhòng shòushāng.
english: Many soldiers suffered terrible wounds in the battle.

chinese: 尽管受了伤，他们还是继续战斗。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shòu le shāng, tāmen háishi jìxù zhàndòu.
english: Though wounded, they continued to fight.

chinese: 现代战术并无指明士兵必须全副武装上阵才能发挥其最大的战斗力。
pinyin: Xiàndài zhànshù bìng wú zhǐmíng shìbīng bìxū quánfùwǔzhuāng shàngzhèn cáinéng fāhuī qí zuì dà de zhàndòulì.
english: The art of modern warfare does not necessarily require soldiers to be armed to the teeth to be effective as combatants.

chinese: 中国正将阿尔及利亚纳入「一带一路」战略。
pinyin: Zhōngguó zhèng jiāng Ā'ěrjílìyà nàrù 「 Yīdài Yīlù 」 zhànlüè.
english: China is incorporating Algeria into its Belt and Road strategy.

chinese: 截至上周，我还没有收到答复。
pinyin: Jiézhì shàng zhōu, wǒ hái méiyǒu shōudào dáfù.
english: Up to last week, I hadn't received a reply.

chinese: 使用这个香蕉盒，可以让您运送香蕉时不会压扁它们。
pinyin: Shǐyòng zhège xiāngjiāo hé, kěyǐ ràng nín yùnsòng xiāngjiāo shí bù huì yābiǎn tāmen.
english: By using this banana case, you can transport bananas without squashing them.

chinese: 她给我打了一个看不懂的手势。
pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ dǎ le yī gè kànbudǒng de shǒushì.
english: She gave me a hand gesture I didn't understand.

chinese: 伊隆马斯克将「凡是与你作对的人都是恋童癖」这一保守派惯用的抹黑手法发挥得淋漓尽致。
pinyin: Yī lōng Mǎsīkè jiāng 「 fánshì yǔ nǐ zuòduì de rén dōu shì liàntóngpǐ 」 zhè yī bǎoshǒupài guànyòng de mǒhēi shǒufǎ fāhuī de línlíjìnzhì.
english: Elon Musk embodies the conservative propaganda tactic of calling everyone who crosses you a pedophile.

chinese: 我很钦佩他的才干。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn qīnpèi tā de cáigàn.
english: I feel admiration for his talent.

chinese: 他的汉语基础很扎实。
pinyin: Tā de Hàn yǔ jī chǔ hěn zhā shi。
english: He has a solid foundation in Chinese.

chinese: 就算我的家发生火灾，也会很快就被扑熄的。
pinyin: Jiùsuàn wǒ de jiā fāshēng huǒzāi, yě huì hěn kuài jiù bèi pū xī de.
english: Even if my house catches fire it would soon be put out.

chinese: 再惹我生气，小心我扒了你的皮！
pinyin: Zài rě wǒ shēngqì, xiǎoxīn wǒ bā le nǐ de pí!
english: Anger me again, I might just peel your skin off.

chinese: 饿着肚子是没法打仗的。
pinyin: È zhe dùzi shì méifǎ dǎzhàng de.
english: You can't fight on an empty stomach.

chinese: 这个消息对他是很大的打击。
pinyin: Zhè gè xiāo xi duì tā shì hěn dà de dǎ jī。
english: This news was a severe blow to him.

chinese: 我觉得我们需要一个打包盒。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde wǒmen xūyào yī gè dǎbāohé.
english: I think we need a doggy bag.

chinese: 他们为了这件事打官司。
pinyin: Tā men wèi le zhè jiàn shì dǎ guān si。
english: They went to court over this matter.

chinese: 乔纳森吃牌了，因为与对方球员打架。
pinyin: Qiáonàsēn chī pái le, yīnwèi yǔ duìfāng qiúyuán dǎjià.
english: Jonathan was booked because he got into a fight with a player on the other team.

chinese: 他喜欢打猎。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuan dǎliè.
english: He likes to hunt.

chinese: 他把我从头到脚打量了一番。
pinyin: Tā bǎ wǒ cóngtóudàojiǎo dǎliang le yī fān.
english: He stared at me from head to foot.

chinese: 我们需要托运这些行李。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào tuō yùn zhè xiē xíng Lǐ。
english: We need to check in this baggage.

chinese: 我扛着米袋。
pinyin: Wǒ káng zhe mǐdài.
english: I carry a bag of rice.

chinese: 我们需要扩充自己的知识。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào kuò chōng zì jǐ de zhī shi。
english: We need to expand our knowledge.

chinese: 城市扩张会对环境造成破坏。
pinyin: Chéngshì kuòzhāng huì duì huánjìng zàochéng pòhuài.
english: Urban sprawl is environmentally damaging.

chinese: 我们需要批判这种观点。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào pī pàn zhè zhǒng guān diǎn。
english: We need to criticize this view.

chinese: 这家公司批发各种水果。
pinyin: Zhè jiā gōng sī pī fā gè zhǒng shuǐ guǒ。
english: This company sells various fruits wholesale.

chinese: 我们需要承办这次会议。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào chéng bàn zhè cì huì yì。
english: We need to organize this conference.

chinese: 演说家为了征服他的听众，不惜使用他在交流课上学到的修辞技巧。
pinyin: Yǎnshuō jiā wèile zhēngfú tā de tīngzhòng, bù xī shǐyòng tā zài jiāoliú kè shàngxué dào de xiūcí jìqiǎo.
english: To win his audience, the speaker resorted to using rhetorical techniques he learned from his communication courses.

chinese: 我们请专家为产品质量把关。
pinyin: Wǒ men qǐng zhuān jiā wèi chǎn pǐn zhì liàng bǎ guān。
english: We asked an expert to oversee product quality.

chinese: 那通电话是引他离开房子的一个小把戏。
pinyin: Nà tōngdiànhuà shì yǐn tā líkāi fángzi de yī gè xiǎo bǎxì.
english: The phone call was a trick to get him out of the house.

chinese: 这扇门的把手坏了。
pinyin: Zhè shàn mén de bǎ shou huài le。
english: The handle on this door is broken.

chinese: 当她看到那件衣服, 她无法抑制自己的笑声。
pinyin: Dāng tā kàn dào nà jiàn yīfu, tā wúfǎ yìzhì zìjǐ de xiàoshēng.
english: She could hardly keep from laughing when she saw the dress.

chinese: 投资不应该只是短期投机。
pinyin: Tóu zī bù yīng gāi zhǐ shì duǎn qī tóu jī。
english: Investment should not consist merely of short-term speculation.

chinese: 在美国，大多数人能在十八岁以后投票。
pinyin: Zài Měiguó, dàduōshù rén néng zài shíbā suì yǐhòu tóupiào.
english: In the U.S., most people can vote when they reach eighteen years of age.

chinese: 士兵们放下武器，决定投降。
pinyin: Shì bīng men fàng xià wǔ qì， jué dìng tóu xiáng。
english: The soldiers put down their weapons and decided to surrender.

chinese: 再折磨他也没用，他不会招供的。
pinyin: Zài zhémó tā yě méiyòng, tā bù huì zhāogòng de.
english: There's no point in torturing him, he isn't going to confess.

chinese: 别再折腾了，早点休息吧。
pinyin: Bié zài zhē teng le， zǎo diǎn xiū xi ba。
english: Stop fussing and get some rest early.

chinese: 虽然她在日本被抚养长大，但是她精通英语。
pinyin: Suīrán tā zài Rìběn bèi fǔyǎng zhǎngdà, dànshì tā jīngtōng Yīngyǔ.
english: She has a good command of English though she was brought up in Japan.

chinese: 为抢救病人医生已尽力了。
pinyin: Wéi qiǎngjiù bìngrén yīshēng yǐ jìnlì le.
english: The doctor tried every possible means to save his patient.

chinese: 他为了替死去的父亲报仇而杀了他。
pinyin: Tā wèile tì sǐqù de fùqīn bàochóu ér shā le tā.
english: He killed him to avenge his dead father.

chinese: 新生明天到学校报到。
pinyin: Xīn shēng míng tiān dào xué xiào bào dào。
english: New students report to the school tomorrow.

chinese: 他对杀父凶手进行了报复。
pinyin: Tā duì shā fù xiōngshǒu jìnxíng le bàofù.
english: He avenged the murder of his father.

chinese: 他希望将来能够报答父母。
pinyin: Tā xī wàng jiāng lái néng gòu bào dá fù mǔ。
english: He hopes to repay his parents in the future.

chinese: 让我们平分这个报酬吧。
pinyin: Ràng wǒmen píngfēn zhège bàochou ba.
english: Let's split the reward fifty-fifty.

chinese: 你们学校真好，还帮你们报销来回的机票。
pinyin: Nǐmen xuéxiào zhēn hǎo, hái bāng nǐmen bàoxiāo láihuí de jīpiào.
english: Your school is so kind to reimburse you for the return airfare.

chinese: 除了抱怨，这一整天，她什么都没有做。
pinyin: Chúle bàoyuàn, zhè yī zhěngtiān, tā shénme dōu méiyǒu zuò.
english: She did nothing all day except complain.

chinese: 他有抱负，所以他很努力工作。
pinyin: Tā yǒu bàofù, suǒyǐ tā hěn nǔlì gōngzuò.
english: He has ambition, so he works hard.

chinese: 他们决定抵制这种产品。
pinyin: Tā men jué dìng dǐ zhì zhè zhǒng chǎn pǐn。
english: They decided to boycott this product.

chinese: 我抵抗不了甜食的诱惑。
pinyin: Wǒ dǐkàngbuliǎo tiánshí de yòuhuò.
english: I can't resist sweet things.

chinese: 他们将于下个星期的今天抵达。
pinyin: Tāmen jiāng yú xiàgèxīngqī de jīntiān dǐdá.
english: They will arrive a week from today.

chinese: 不能抹杀他的贡献。
pinyin: Bù néng mǒ shā tā de gòng xiàn。
english: His contribution must not be dismissed.

chinese: 请抽空给家人打个电话。
pinyin: Qǐng chōu kòng gěi jiā rén dǎ gè diàn huà。
english: Please find time to call your family.

chinese: 我当你的担保人.
pinyin: Wǒ dāng nǐ de dānbǎo rén.
english: I will be your guarantor.

chinese: 学习需要时间，不能拔苗助长。
pinyin: Xué xí xū yào shí jiān， bù néng bá miáo zhù zhǎng。
english: Learning takes time; trying to force progress is counterproductive.

chinese: 我不像我以前那么拖延了。
pinyin: Wǒ bù xiàng wǒ yǐqián nàme tuōyán le.
english: I don't procrastinate as much as I used to.

chinese: 她今天显得很拘束。
pinyin: Tā jīn tiān xiǎn de hěn jū shù。
english: She seems self-conscious today.

chinese: 这项工程需要进行招投标。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōng chéng xū yào jìn xíng zhāo tóu biāo。
english: This project needs to go through a tendering process.

chinese: 这所学校今年招收新学生。
pinyin: Zhè suǒ xué xiào jīn nián zhāo shōu xīn xué sheng。
english: This school is admitting new students this year.

chinese: 大妈, 我们给您拜年来啦！
pinyin: Dàmā, wǒmen gěi nín bàinián lái lā!
english: Auntie, we’ve come to wish you a Happy New Year.

chinese: 拜托，请帮我一个忙。
pinyin: Bài tuō， qǐng bāng wǒ yī gè máng。
english: Please do me a favor.

chinese: 当我还小的时候他常常来拜访我们。
pinyin: Dāng wǒ hái xiǎode shíhou tā chángcháng lái bàifǎng wǒmen.
english: He used to visit us often when I was young.

chinese: 我们需要拟定新的计划。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào nǐ dìng xīn de jì huà。
english: We need to draft a new plan.

chinese: 我们需要拥护这个决定。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào yōng hù zhè gè jué dìng。
english: We need to support this decision.

chinese: 艺术家必须拥有敏锐的色彩眼光。
pinyin: Yìshùjiā bìxū yōngyǒu mǐnruì de sècǎi yǎnguāng.
english: An artist has to have a color-sensitive eye.

chinese: 她用力拧毛巾，把水拧出来。
pinyin: Tā yòng lì níng máo jīn， bǎ shuǐ níng chū lái。
english: She wrings the water out of the towel.

chinese: 我可以用这部电话拨打外线电话吗？
pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ yòng zhè bù diànhuà bōdǎ wàixiàn diànhuà ma?
english: Can I make an outside call on this phone?

chinese: 她用拳头拍了桌子。
pinyin: Tā yòng quántou pāi le zhuōzi.
english: She banged the table with her fist.

chinese: 我拼命地跑，但还是错过了末班车。
pinyin: Wǒ pīnmìng de pǎo, dàn háishi cuòguò le mòbānchē.
english: I ran as fast as I could, but I missed the last train.

chinese: 他们为实现目标努力拼搏。
pinyin: Tā men wèi shí xiàn mù biāo nǔ lì pīn bó。
english: They are striving hard to achieve their goal.

chinese: 孩子拽着妈妈的衣服。
pinyin: Hái zi zhuài zhe mā ma de yī fu。
english: The child was tugging at his mother's clothes.

chinese: 他拾起了书。
pinyin: Tā shí qǐ le shū.
english: He picked up the book.

chinese: 为什么你做饭那么拿手呢？
pinyin: Wèishénme nǐ zuòfàn nàme náshǒu ne?
english: Why are you so good at cooking?

chinese: 生活中绝对没有什么是持久的。
pinyin: Shēnghuó zhōng juéduì méiyǒushénme shì chíjiǔ de.
english: Absolutely nothing is permanent in life.

chinese: 他在指定时间的五分钟后到了。
pinyin: Tā zài zhǐdìng shíjiān de wǔ fēnzhōng hòu dào le.
english: He came five minutes behind the appointed time.

chinese: 我们没指望过他在那么短的时间里完成工作。
pinyin: Wǒmen méi zhǐwàng guo tā zài nàme duǎn de shíjiān lǐ wánchéng gōngzuò.
english: We did not expect him to finish the task in so short a time.

chinese: 请确认指标是否正确。
pinyin: Qǐng què rèn zhǐ biāo shì fǒu zhèng què。
english: Please check whether the target is correct.

chinese: 我一面咬着指甲一面担心着你。
pinyin: Wǒ yīmiàn yǎo zhe zhǐjia yīmiàn dānxīn zhe nǐ.
english: I was biting my nails, worrying about you.

chinese: 我们知道汤姆有时不会按照指示行事。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhīdào Tāngmǔ yǒushí bù huì ànzhào zhǐshì xíngshì.
english: We know Tom doesn't always do what he's told.

chinese: 你怎么敢指责我做这种事？我决不会动手打我的儿子。
pinyin: Nǐ zěnme gǎn zhǐzé wǒ zuò zhèzhǒng shì? wǒ juébù huì dòngshǒu dǎ wǒ de érzi.
english: How can you accuse me of such a thing? I would never lay a hand on my child.

chinese: 她挎着一个小包走进教室。
pinyin: Tā kuà zhe yī gè xiǎo bāo zǒu jìn jiào shì。
english: She walked into the classroom with a small bag on her arm.

chinese: 他对西装和领带的选择非常挑剔。
pinyin: Tā duì xīzhuāng hé lǐngdài de xuǎnzé fēicháng tiāoti.
english: He's picky about suits and ties.

chinese: 不要挑拨朋友之间的关系。
pinyin: Bù yào tiǎo bō péng you zhī jiān de guān xi。
english: Do not sow discord between friends.

chinese: 我们需要挖掘自己的潜力。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào wā jué zì jǐ de qián lì。
english: We need to explore our potential.

chinese: 汤姆挣扎着站了起来。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ zhēngzhá zhe zhàn le qǐlai.
english: Tom struggled to his feet.

chinese: 他不应该挥霍父母的钱。
pinyin: Tā bù yīng gāi huī huò fù mǔ de qián。
english: He should not squander his parents' money.

chinese: 世界上许多人在挨饿。
pinyin: Shìjiè shàng xǔduō rén zài ái'è.
english: Many people are suffering from hunger around the world.

chinese: 请把椅子挪到窗边。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yǐ zi nuó dào chuāng biān。
english: Please move the chair next to the window.

chinese: 一个人得遇到多大的挫折才会自杀？
pinyin: Yīgèrén de yùdào duōdà de cuòzhé cái huì zìshā?
english: How frustrated must a person be to commit suicide?

chinese: 他们希望振兴家乡的经济。
pinyin: Tā men xī wàng zhèn xīng jiā xiāng de jīng jì。
english: They hope to revitalize their hometown's economy.

chinese: 振奋起来！
pinyin: Zhènfèn qǐlai!
english: Chin up!

chinese: 门口那棵树长得很挺拔。
pinyin: Mén kǒu nà kē shù zhǎng de hěn tǐng bá。
english: The tree at the entrance stands tall and straight.

chinese: 但与此同时，它却在消逝：时间无可挽回地流逝， 而我们却四处游荡，成为我们对细节的热爱的囚徒。
pinyin: Dàn yǔcǐtóngshí, tā què zài xiāoshì: shíjiān wúkěwǎnhuí de liúshì, ér wǒmen què sìchù yóudàng, chéngwéi wǒmen duì xìjié de rè'ài de qiútú.
english: But meanwhile it flees: time flees irretrievably, while we wander around, prisoners of our love of detail.

chinese: 我们需要挽救他的生命。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào wǎn jiù tā de shēng mìng。
english: We need to save his life.

chinese: 他把这些箱子捆绑在一起。
pinyin: Tā bǎ zhè xiē xiāng zi kǔn bǎng zài yī qǐ。
english: He ties these boxes together.

chinese: 我会捍卫我的原则。
pinyin: Wǒ huì hànwèi wǒ de yuánzé.
english: I'll stick to my principles.

chinese: 请帮我捎一封信给她。
pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ shāo yī fēng xìn gěi tā。
english: Please take a letter to her for me.

chinese: 她轻轻捏了捏孩子的脸。
pinyin: Tā qīng qīng niē le niē hái zi de liǎn。
english: She gently pinched the child's cheek.

chinese: 他们利用陷阱捕捉狐狸。
pinyin: Tāmen lìyòng xiànjǐng bǔzhuō húli.
english: Using a trap, they caught the fox.

chinese: 想从贼身上捞点儿什么是很难的
pinyin: Xiǎng cóng zéi shēnshang lāo diǎnr shénme shì hěn nán de
english: It's hard to steal from a thief.

chinese: 火很快便被扑熄了，房子只受到轻微损坏。
pinyin: Huǒ hěn kuài biàn bèi pū xī le, fángzi zhǐ shòudào qīngwēi sǔnhuài.
english: The house did not suffer much damage because the fire was quickly put out.

chinese: 请安静，不要在课堂上捣乱。
pinyin: Qǐng ān jìng， bù yào zài kè táng shàng dǎo luàn。
english: Please be quiet and do not disrupt the class.

chinese: 据悉，新的公园下个月开放。
pinyin: Jù xī， xīn de gōng yuán xià gè yuè kāi fàng。
english: According to reports, the new park opens next month.

chinese: 微风在湖面上掀起了一丝丝涟漪。
pinyin: Wēifēng zài hú miàn shàng xiānqǐ le yī sī sī liányī.
english: A gentle wind made ripples on the surface of the pond.

chinese: 他们在画展上授予了她一等奖。
pinyin: Tāmen zài huàzhǎn shàng shòuyǔ le tā yīděngjiǎng.
english: They awarded her first prize at the art exhibition.

chinese: 放开我，你正在掐着我的脖子。
pinyin: Fàngkāi wǒ, nǐ zhèngzài qiā zhe wǒ de bózi.
english: Let me go, you're choking me.

chinese: 由于一些工厂使用矿物燃料，化学品的排放已经产生严重的环境问题。
pinyin: Yóuyú yīxiē gōngchǎng shǐyòng kuàngwùránliào, huàxuépǐn de páifàng yǐjīng chǎnshēng yánzhòng de huánjìng wèntí.
english: As a result of some factories using fossil fuels, chemical emissions have already caused serious environmental problems.

chinese: 不要排斥不同的意见。
pinyin: Bù yào pái chì bù tóng de yì jiàn。
english: Do not reject differing opinions.

chinese: 战争中，许多资源被掠夺了。
pinyin: Zhàn zhēng zhōng， xǔ duō zī yuán bèi lüè duó le。
english: Many resources were plundered during the war.

chinese: 我已经很久没有探望过祖母了。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng hěn jiǔ méiyǒu tànwàng guo zǔmǔ le.
english: It's been a long time since I visited my grandmother.

chinese: 这个设备可以探测水的深度。
pinyin: Zhè gè shè bèi kě yǐ tàn cè shuǐ de shēn dù。
english: This device can measure the depth of the water.

chinese: 我想要去探索世界。那是我的梦想。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngyào qù tànsuǒ shìjiè. nàshi wǒ de mèngxiǎng.
english: I want to explore the world. It’s my dream.

chinese: 学生们在探讨语言和文化。
pinyin: Xuésheng men zài tàntǎo yǔyán hé wénhuà.
english: The students are talking about language and culture.

chinese: 他接连回答了三个问题。
pinyin: Tā jiē lián huí dá le sān gè wèn tí。
english: He answered three questions in succession.

chinese: 请说明你的推理过程。
pinyin: Qǐng shuō míng nǐ de tuī lǐ guò chéng。
english: Please explain your reasoning.

chinese: 这个推论需要更多证据。
pinyin: Zhè gè tuī lùn xū yào gèng duō zhèng jù。
english: This inference needs more evidence.

chinese: 推销员经常是语速快的人。
pinyin: Tuīxiāoyuán jīngcháng shì yǔ sù kuài de rén.
english: Salesmen are usually fast talkers.

chinese: 汤姆，你能帮我掩护吗？
pinyin: Tāngmǔ, nǐ néng bāng wǒ yǎnhù ma?
english: Tom, will you cover for me?

chinese: 她没有试图掩盖真相。
pinyin: Tā méiyǒu shìtú yǎngài zhēnxiàng.
english: She didn't try to hide the truth.

chinese: 她正在揉面。
pinyin: Tā zhèng zài róu miàn。
english: She is kneading dough.

chinese: 汤姆把他揍得满地找牙。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ bǎ tā zòu de mǎndìzhǎoyá.
english: Tom knocked him down.

chinese: 我们需要提拔优秀的人才。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào tí bá yōu xiù de rén cái。
english: We need to promote talented people.

chinese: 油是从橄榄中提炼出来的。
pinyin: Yóu shì cóng gǎnlǎn zhōng tíliàn chūlái de.
english: Oil is extracted from olives.

chinese: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。
pinyin: Diànhuà yùnyíngshāng tíshì láidiàn rén děnghòu jiētōng.
english: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.

chinese: 我看不出有其他方法能让他接受我们的提议。
pinyin: Wǒ kànbuchū yǒu qítā fāngfǎ néng ràng tā jiēshòu wǒmen de tíyì.
english: I can't think of any other way of getting him to accept our proposal.

chinese: 我们需要揭发违法的行为。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào jiē fā wéi fǎ de xíng wéi。
english: We need to expose illegal behavior.

chinese: 她搀着老人走过马路。
pinyin: Tā chān zhe lǎo rén zǒu guo mǎ lù。
english: She helped the elderly person across the road by the arm.

chinese: 妈妈轻轻搂着孩子。
pinyin: Mā ma qīng qīng lǒu zhe hái zi。
english: The mother gently held her child in her arms.

chinese: 搅拌机对真的喜欢冰沙的人来说很不错。
pinyin: Jiǎobànjī duì zhēn de xǐhuan bīngshā de rén lái shuō hěn bù cuò.
english: Blenders are nice for people who really like smoothies.

chinese: 角斗士在罗马竞技场中搏斗。
pinyin: Jiǎodòushì zài Luómǎ jìngjìchǎng zhōng bódòu.
english: Gladiators fought in the Colosseum.

chinese: 帮我搓一下背好吗？
pinyin: Bāng wǒ cuō yīxià bèi hǎo ma?
english: Can you rub my back?

chinese: 我已经搭了最近比较早一点的火车来上班。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng dā le zuì jìn bǐjiào zǎo yīdiǎn de huǒchē lái shàngbān.
english: I've been coming to work one train earlier lately.

chinese: 您真的点了地瓜片来搭配素食汉堡吗？
pinyin: Nín zhēn de diǎn le dìguā piàn lái dāpèi sùshí hànbǎo ma?
english: Did you really order sweet potato fries to go with your veggie burger?

chinese: 今天的气温是二十摄氏度。
pinyin: Jīn tiān de qì wēn shì èr shí shè shì dù。
english: The temperature today is twenty degrees Celsius.

chinese: 我已经头疼三天了，还没摆脱它。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng tóuténg sān tiān le, hái méi bǎituō tā.
english: I've had a headache for three days and I can't get rid of it.

chinese: 当飞机穿越强风时，它们会像这样摇晃，但是别担心。
pinyin: Dāng fēijī chuānyuè qiángfēng shí, tāmen huì xiàng zhèyàng yáohuàng, dànshì bié dānxīn.
english: Passing through the strong wind, the planes rock like this, but don't worry.

chinese: 日本的年轻人喜爱摇滚乐和爵士乐。
pinyin: Rìběn de niánqīngrén xǐ'ài yáogǔnyuè hé juéshìyuè.
english: Japanese young people like rock and jazz music.

chinese: 她在市场上开了一个小摊儿。
pinyin: Tā zài shì chǎng shàng kāi le yī gè xiǎo tān r。
english: She set up a small stall in the market.

chinese: 他快速浏览摘要，寻找要找的论文。
pinyin: Tā kuàisù liúlǎn zhāiyào, xúnzhǎo yào zhǎo de lùnwén.
english: He quickly read through the abstracts to find the paper he was looking for.

chinese: 战争摧残了无数家庭。
pinyin: Zhàn zhēng cuī cán le wú shù jiā tíng。
english: War devastated countless families.

chinese: 这两个零件之间会产生摩擦。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge líng jiàn zhī jiān huì chǎn shēng mó cā。
english: Friction occurs between these two parts.

chinese: 他们不断地摸索。
pinyin: Tāmen bù duàn de mōsuo.
english: They kept on feeling their way.

chinese: 他保证不再撒谎。
pinyin: Tā bǎozhèng bù zài sāhuǎng.
english: He promised not to tell lies again.

chinese: 撤退！
pinyin: Chètuì!
english: Retreat!

chinese: 公司决定撤销这个计划。
pinyin: Gōng sī jué dìng chè xiāo zhè gè jì huà。
english: The company decided to cancel this plan.

chinese: 请播放这首歌。
pinyin: Qǐng bō fàng zhè shǒu gē。
english: Please play this song.

chinese: 农民在春天播种。
pinyin: Nóngmín zài chūntiān bōzhǒng.
english: Farmers sow seeds in the spring.

chinese: 请不要擅自改变计划。
pinyin: Qǐng bù yào shàn zì gǎi biàn jì huà。
english: Please do not change the plan without permission.

chinese: 即使我在学校学习了三年，我仍然不擅长说法语。
pinyin: Jíshǐ wǒ zài xuéxiào xuéxí le sān nián, wǒ réngrán bù shàncháng shuō Fǎyǔ.
english: Even though I studied French for three years in school, I'm not good at speaking it.

chinese: 我不知道怎么操作这台电脑.
pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme cāozuò zhè tái diànnǎo.
english: I don't know how to operate this computer.

chinese: 她为家人操劳了一整天。
pinyin: Tā wèi jiā rén cāo láo le yī zhěng tiān。
english: She worked hard for her family all day.

chinese: 幕后操纵者是谁？
pinyin: Mùhòucāozòng zhě shì shéi?
english: Who's behind it?

chinese: 我们需要操练这些动作。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào cāo liàn zhè xiē dòng zuò。
english: We need to practice these movements.

chinese: 他是第一个在冬季攀登富士山的人。
pinyin: Tā shì dìyī gè zài dōngjì pāndēng Fùshì Shān de rén.
english: He was the first man to climb Mt. Fuji in the winter.

chinese: 他正在攒钱买自行车。
pinyin: Tā zhèng zài zǎn qián mǎi zì xíng chē。
english: He is saving money to buy a bicycle.

chinese: 我们的线上客服台和训练有素的支援代理能够快速识别和解决问题。
pinyin: Wǒmen de xiànshàng kèfú tái hé xùnliàn yǒu sù de zhīyuán dàilǐ nénggòu kuàisù shíbié héjiě jué wèntí.
english: Our on-line Customer Service Desk and trained support agents enable problems to be quickly identified and addressed.

chinese: 日本的经济是由一群勤奋工作的大城市上班族支撑起的。
pinyin: Rìběn de jīngjì shì yóu yī qún qínfèn gōngzuò de dàchéngshì shàngbānzú zhīchēng qǐ de.
english: Japan has an economy that is supported by hard-working company employees in big cities.

chinese: 农业是当地经济的重要支柱。
pinyin: Nóng yè shì dāng dì jīng jì de zhòng yào zhī zhù。
english: Agriculture is an important pillar of the local economy.

chinese: 亚马逊河有很多支流。
pinyin: Yàmǎxùn Hé yǒu hěn duō zhīliú.
english: The Amazon is fed by a large number of tributaries.

chinese: 我想她想要的是束缚与支配。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tā xiǎngyào de shì shùfù yǔ zhīpèi.
english: I guess she's into bondage and domination.

chinese: 金属冷却的时候会收缩。
pinyin: Jīnshǔ lěngquè de shíhou huì shōusuō.
english: Metals contract when they cool.

chinese: 我想看看您的邮票收藏。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kànkan nín de yóupiào shōucáng.
english: I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.

chinese: 收音机太响了。你不能把音量调低一点吗？
pinyin: Shōuyīnjī tài xiǎng le. Nǐ bù néng bǎ yīnliàng tiáo dī yīdiǎn ma?
english: The radio is too loud. Can't you turn it down a little?

chinese: 通过遗传修饰，我们可以改良农作物。
pinyin: Tōngguò yíchuán xiūshì, wǒmen kěyǐ gǎiliáng nóngzuòwù.
english: Through genetic modification, we can improve crops.

chinese: 我们需要攻克这个难题。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào gōng kè zhè gè nán tí。
english: We need to solve this difficult problem.

chinese: 这台显微镜能把物体放大一百倍。
pinyin: Zhè tái xiǎnwēijìng néng bǎ wùtǐ fàngdà yī bǎibèi.
english: This microscope magnifies objects by 100 times.

chinese: 人们常说拿在手里没有感觉的东西还是放手的好。
pinyin: Rénmen cháng shuō ná zài shǒulǐ méiyǒu gǎnjué de dōngxi háishi fàngshǒu de hǎo.
english: People often say: "If something in your hand no longer feels right, it's better to let it go."

chinese: 世界上有什么地方能比得上你的故乡好啊？
pinyin: Shìjiè shàng yǒu shénmedìfang néng bǐ de shàng nǐ de gùxiāng hǎo ā?
english: What place on Earth could be better than the place your people came from?

chinese: 改进方法可以提高经济效益。

chinese: 她对当下的流行很敏感。

chinese: 可怜的猫！ 她无法抓住敏捷的老鼠。

english: The gas gives off a strong, unpleasant smell.

english: He isn't a poet; he's a prose writer.

chinese: 我们需要准确计算数目。

chinese: 我们需要准确计算数额。

english: Please answer seriously rather than brushing the question aside.

english: This teacher gives an impression of being elegant.

english: I examined this stripe carefully.

pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng huā diǎn shíjiān zhēnzhuó zhēnzhuó zài zuò juédìng.
english: I'd like some time to consider before I make a decision.

pinyin: Yǔ duànduànxùxù dìxià le yī zhěngtiān.
english: It rained on and off all day.

pinyin: Tā gēn tāmen gāncuì de duànjué láiwǎng le.
english: He made a clean break with them.

pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo shī gěi rén de gǎn jué hěn sī wén。

english: Exercise helps promote metabolism.

chinese: 我们需要准确计算方位。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào zhǔn què jì suàn fāng wèi。

english: Faced with this outcome, she felt helpless.

pinyin: Tīng dào zhè gè xiāo xi， tā gǎn dào wú bǐ gāo xìng。

pinyin: Tā zài wúlǐqǔnào.

english: He looks listless today.

pinyin: Wǒ duì nǐ de hòuyánwúchǐ gǎndào jīngyà.
english: I am amazed at your audacity.

english: It's not that I am unsympathetic, but I am not able to help you.

pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē de jūmín dàduō shì wúlài.
english: Most of the residents on this street are wrong 'uns.

chinese: 他无非是别人的跟屁虫。

english: He is only someone's stooge.

english: I need a week to adjust to the time difference.

pinyin: Wǒ shí'ér lèguān, shí'ér bēiguān.
english: I am by turns an optimist and a pessimist.

chinese: 三十年前的时装款式又流行起来了。
pinyin: Sānshí niánqián de shízhuāng kuǎnshì yòu liúxíng qǐlai le.

chinese: 他把数枚硬币强行塞进了我的口袋中。

chinese: 我做事该果断。

chinese: 我灵感枯竭了。

english: We planted three trees in the garden.

pinyin: Zhè fèn bào gào xiáng xì jiè shào le zhèng fù。
english: This report describes positive and negative values in detail.

english: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.

chinese: 洗衣服时，水里有很多泡沫。
pinyin: Xǐ yī fu shí， shuǐ lǐ yǒu hěn duō pào mò。
english: There is plenty of foam in the water when washing clothes.

chinese: 波浪拍打着海岸。
pinyin: Bōlàng pāida zhe hǎi'àn.
english: Waves are beating the shore.

chinese: 今天海上波涛汹涌。
pinyin: Jīn tiān hǎi shàng bō tāo xiōng yǒng。
english: The sea is rough with surging waves today.

chinese: 我会给你注射止痛药。
pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ zhùshè zhǐtòngyào.
english: I'll give you a painkilling injection.

chinese: 她注视着一个不明飞行物，哑口无言。
pinyin: Tā zhùshì zhe yī gè bùmíngfēixíngwù, yǎkǒuwúyán.
english: She stared at a UFO in silence.

chinese: 我们需要注重学习的质量。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào zhù zhòng xué xí de zhì liàng。
english: We need to focus on the quality of our learning.

chinese: 他是文学界的泰斗。
pinyin: Tā shì wén xué jiè de tài dǒu。
english: He is a leading figure in the literary world.

chinese: 他往他自己身上泼了一盆冷水。
pinyin: Tā wǎng tā zìjǐ shēnshang pō le yī pén lěngshuǐ.
english: He poured cold water over himself.

chinese: 汤姆将会是第一个进入那洞穴的人。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ jiānghuì shì dìyī gè jìnrù nà dòngxué de rén.
english: Tom will be the first person to enter the cave.

chinese: 小镇被暴风雨后的洪水摧毁了。
pinyin: Xiǎozhèn bèi bàofēngyǔ hòu de hóngshuǐ cuīhuǐ le.
english: The town was destroyed by the flood after the storm.

chinese: 虽然上了年纪，他依旧充满活力。
pinyin: Suīrán shàng le niánjì, tā yījiù chōngmǎn huólì.
english: He may be old, but he's still full of energy.

chinese: 你明明知道会迟到，还不早点走，真是活该。
pinyin: Nǐ míng míng zhī dào huì chí dào， hái bù zǎo diǎn zǒu， zhēn shì huó gāi。
english: You knew you would be late but did not leave earlier; it serves you right.

chinese: 这些艺术家属于不同的派别。
pinyin: Zhè xiē yì shù jiā shǔ yú bù tóng de pài bié。
english: These artists belong to different schools of thought.

chinese: 公司派遣她到国外工作。
pinyin: Gōng sī pài qiǎn tā dào guó wài gōng zuò。
english: The company sent her to work abroad.

chinese: 当流浪汉有钱了, 就被称为游客。
pinyin: Dāng liúlànghàn yǒuqián le, jiù bèi chēngwéi yóukè.
english: The vagabond, when rich, is called a tourist.

chinese: 这种货币在当地广泛流通。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huò bì zài dāng dì guǎng fàn liú tōng。
english: This currency circulates widely in the area.

chinese: 我们测量了这条河的深度。
pinyin: Wǒmen cèliáng le zhè tiáo hé de shēndù.
english: We measured the depth of the river.

chinese: 那个学生被老师盯着看，觉得浑身不自在。
pinyin: Nàge xuésheng bèi lǎoshī dīng zhe kàn, juéde húnshēn bù zìzai.
english: The student became very nervous with the teacher watching him.

chinese: 他对历史有浓厚的兴趣。
pinyin: Tā duì lì shǐ yǒu nóng hòu de xìng qù。
english: He has a keen interest in history.

chinese: 阿尔卑斯山脉义大利一侧的海拔通常较低。
pinyin: Ā'ěrbēisī shānmài Yìdàlì yī cè de hǎibá tōngcháng jiào dī.
english: The Alps are generally lower on the Italian side.

chinese: 我们需要浸泡这些豆子。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào jìn pào zhè xiē dòu zi。
english: We need to soak these beans.

chinese: 将它们放在烤盘上并且涂抹蛋白。
pinyin: Jiāng tāmen fàng zài kǎopán shàng bìngqiě túmǒ dànbái.
english: Put them on the baking pan and smear them with egg whites.

chinese: 他的性格很消极。
pinyin: Tā de xìnggé hěn xiāojí.
english: He has a passive character.

chinese: 这个看热闹的人差点把消防车的路挡住了。
pinyin: Zhège kànrènao de rén chàdiǎn bǎ xiāofángchē de lù dǎngzhù le.
english: This onlooker almost got in the way of the fire truck.

chinese: 比赛中涌现了很多优秀选手。
pinyin: Bǐ sài zhōng yǒng xiàn le hěn duō yōu xiù xuǎn shǒu。
english: Many outstanding competitors emerged in the contest.

chinese: 吃火锅时，我们涮了一些蔬菜。
pinyin: Chī huǒ guō shí， wǒ men shuàn le yī xiē shū cài。
english: We cooked some vegetables briefly in the hotpot.

chinese: 他被雨淋湿了。
pinyin: Tā bèi yǔ lín shī le。
english: He was soaked by the rain.

chinese: 我受不了淘气的小孩。
pinyin: Wǒ shòubùliǎo táoqì de xiǎohái.
english: I can't stand naughty children.

chinese: 在旅游淡季，机票会很便宜。
pinyin: Zài lǚyóu dànjì, jīpiào huì hěn piányi.
english: When out of tourist season, the tickets will be cheap.

chinese: 有了这个装置，把海水净化成淡水就不是难事了。
pinyin: Yǒule zhège zhuāngzhì, bǎ hǎishuǐ jìnghuà chéng dànshuǐ jiù bù shì nán shì le.
english: This device made it possible to turn sea-water into fresh water easily.

chinese: 这是一道深奥的数学题。
pinyin: Zhè shì yīdào shēn'ào de shùxué tí.
english: This is a difficult math problem.

chinese: 我们不会忘记朋友的深情厚谊。
pinyin: Wǒ men bù huì wàng jì péng you de shēn qíng hòu yì。
english: We will not forget our friends' deep affection.

chinese: 这位老师给人的感觉很深沉。
pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo shī gěi rén de gǎn jué hěn shēn chén。
english: This teacher gives an impression of being thoughtful.

chinese: 雨后，河水变得混浊。
pinyin: Yǔ hòu， hé shuǐ biàn de hùn zhuó。
english: After the rain, the river water became muddy.

chinese: 别混淆美洲和美国，美洲人和美国人。
pinyin: Bié hùnxiáo Měizhōu hé Měiguó, Měizhōurén hé Měiguórén.
english: Don't mix up the Americas with the United States of America, or citizens of the Americas with citizens of the United States.

chinese: 我不喜欢在清晨开的会议。
pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuan zài qīngchén kāi de huìyì.
english: I don't like early morning meetings.

chinese: 鼠类也有用处。它们能帮着清洁管道。
pinyin: Shǔ lèi yě yǒuyòng chǔ. tāmen néng bāng zhe qīngjié guǎndào.
english: Rats also have a function. They help to clean the pipes.

chinese: 烹饪结束后请清洁炉灶和烤箱。
pinyin: Pēngrèn jiéshù hòu qǐng qīngjié lúzào hé kǎoxiāng.
english: Clean the stove and oven after cooking.

chinese: 你的歌声像太平洋的海水一样清澈。
pinyin: Nǐ de gēshēng xiàng Tàipíng Yáng de hǎishuǐ yīyàng qīngchè.
english: You sing with a voice as clear as the waters of the Pacific Ocean.

chinese: 清理的时候，我们看到了些他的东西。
pinyin: Qīnglǐ de shíhou, wǒmen kàn dào le xiē tā de dōngxi.
english: While cleaning, we saw some of his things.

chinese: 这是一座房子，那是一座清真寺。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī zuò fángzi, nàshi yī zuò qīngzhēnsì.
english: This is a house and that is a mosque.

chinese: 早上起来，我的头脑很清醒。
pinyin: Zǎo shang qi lai， wǒ de tóu nǎo hěn qīng xǐng。
english: My mind is clear when I get up in the morning.

chinese: 她帮我清除积雪。
pinyin: Tā bāng wǒ qīngchú jīxuě.
english: She helped me to clear snow away.

chinese: 喝完茶后，请清理杯里的茶渣。
pinyin: Hē wán chá hòu， qǐng qīng lǐ bēi lǐ de chá zhā。
english: After drinking the tea, please clear the tea residue from the cup.

chinese: 就现在这个节气来说天气是相当温和了。
pinyin: Jiù xiànzài zhège jiéqi lái shuō tiānqì shì xiāngdāng wēnhé le.
english: It's fairly mild for this time of year.

chinese: 汽笛声响起，船开始慢慢地驶离港口。
pinyin: Qìdí shēngxiǎng qǐ, chuán kāishǐ mànmàn de shǐlí gǎngkǒu.
english: A whistle blew, and the boat slowly began to pull out of port.

chinese: 他们正在参观这处港湾。
pinyin: Tā men zhèng zài cān guān zhè chù gǎng wān。
english: They are visiting this harbor.

chinese: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu kěwàng zhīdào qiánguān jūn dézhǔ fāshēng le shénme.
english: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.

chinese: 车子经过的时候把泥水溅到了我的身上。
pinyin: Chēzi jīngguò de shíhou bǎ níshuǐ jiàn dào le wǒ de shēnshang.
english: The passing car splashed muddy water on me.

chinese: 水是生命的源泉。
pinyin: Shuǐ shì shēngmìng de yuánquán.
english: Life cannot exist without water.

chinese: 那两个人偷偷溜进了房子里，给人看见了。
pinyin: Nà liǎng gèrén tōutōu liū jìn le fángzi lǐ, gěi rén kànjiàn le.
english: The two men were seen to steal into the house.

chinese: 糖很容易溶解在水里。
pinyin: Táng hěn róng yì róng jiě zài shuǐ lǐ。
english: Sugar dissolves easily in water.

chinese: 这种水果的滋味很好。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐ guǒ de zī wèi hěn hǎo。
english: This fruit tastes good.

chinese: 不能让这种错误的观念滋长。
pinyin: Bù néng ràng zhè zhǒng cuò wù de guān niàn zī zhǎng。
english: We must not let this mistaken idea grow.

chinese: 他讲起旅行的经历就滔滔不绝。
pinyin: Tā jiǎng qǐ lǚ xíng de jīng lì jiù tāo tāo bù jué。
english: He talks nonstop about his travels.

chinese: 因为大雪，旅客滞留在机场。
pinyin: Yīn wèi dà xuě， lǚ kè zhì liú zài jī chǎng。
english: Because of heavy snow, travelers were stranded at the airport.

chinese: 海水看起来一片碧绿，巨大的冰山漂浮在周围。
pinyin: Hǎishuǐ kànqǐlai yī piàn bìlǜ, jùdà de bīngshān piāofú zài zhōuwéi.
english: The sea looked quite green, and large icebergs were floating about.

chinese: 起初的天灾迅速演变为了人祸。
pinyin: Qǐchū de tiānzāi xùnsù yǎnbiàn wèile rénhuò.
english: What was at first a natural disaster rapidly became a man-made debacle.

chinese: 我想听清楚演讲内容，便坐在了前面。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tīngqīng chǔ yǎnjiǎng nèiróng, biàn zuò zài le qiánmiàn.
english: I sat at the front in order to hear the lecture clearly.

chinese: 我爸爸每周给我零用钱，我会用来买漫画书和冰激凌。
pinyin: Wǒ bàba měizhōu gěi wǒ língyòngqián, wǒ huì yònglái mǎi mànhuà shū hé bīngjīlíng.
english: My dad gives me a weekly allowance that I use to buy comics and ice cream.

chinese: 他们终于在漫长的讨论之后得出了一个计划。
pinyin: Tāmen zhōngyú zài màncháng de tǎolùn zhīhòu déchū le yī gè jìhuà.
english: They came up with a plan after a long discussion.

chinese: 他有极大的潜力。
pinyin: Tā yǒu jídà de qiánlì.
english: He has enormous potential.

chinese: 你曾试过用水肺潜水吗？
pinyin: Nǐ céng shì guo yòng shuǐfèi qiánshuǐ ma?
english: Have you ever tried scuba diving?

chinese: 父母的行为会潜移默化地影响孩子。
pinyin: Fù mǔ de xíng wéi huì qián yí mò huà de yǐng xiǎng hái zi。
english: Parents' behavior subtly influences their children.

chinese: 让我们来澄清一下这个问题。
pinyin: Ràng wǒmen lái chéngqīng yīxià zhège wèntí.
english: Let's clear up this problem.

chinese: 他的演说激励了所有的男孩。
pinyin: Tā de yǎnshuō jīlì le suǒyǒu de nánhái.
english: His speech inspired all the boys.

chinese: 这个故事激发了孩子们的兴趣。
pinyin: Zhè gè gù shi jī fā le hái zi men de xìng qù。
english: This story sparked the children's interest.

chinese: 诗人对他爱的女人表达了他火热的激情。
pinyin: Shīrén duì tā ài de nǚrén biǎodá le tā huǒrè de jīqíng.
english: The poet expressed his burning passion for the woman he loved.

chinese: 这是一个濒临灭绝的物种。
pinyin: Zhè shì yī gè bīnlín mièjué de wùzhǒng.
english: It is an endangered species.

chinese: 我看见那儿有个很美的瀑布。
pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn nàr yǒu gè hěn Měidí pùbù.
english: I saw a beautiful waterfall there.

chinese: 我们需要灌溉农田。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào guàn gài nóng tián。
english: We need to irrigate the farmland.

chinese: 用本生灯加热钾，火焰就会呈现淡紫色。
pinyin: Yòng Běnshēngdēng jiārè jiǎ, huǒyàn jiù huì chéngxiàn dàn zǐsè.
english: Potassium, heated with a Bunsen burner, gives the flame a lilac color.

chinese: 你们知道谁发明了火药吗？
pinyin: Nǐmen zhīdào shéi fāmíng le huǒyào ma?
english: Do you know who invented gunpowder?

chinese: 从古到今，没有过不灭亡的国家。
pinyin: Cóng gǔ dào jīn, méiyǒu guo bù mièwáng de guójiā.
english: There has never been a nation that was not eventually destroyed.

chinese: 我的母亲是一位天使，也是我的灵感来源。
pinyin: Wǒ de mǔqīn shì yī wèi tiānshǐ, yě shì wǒ de línggǎn láiyuán.
english: My mother was an angel and an inspiration to me.

chinese: 这个设备很灵敏。
pinyin: Zhè gè shè bèi hěn líng mǐn。
english: This device is very sensitive.

chinese: 从那时起，他就把他整个灵魂投入到他的工作。
pinyin: Cóng nàshí qǐ, tā jiù bǎ tā zhěnggè línghún tóurù dào tā de gōngzuò.
english: Since then he has put his soul into his work.

chinese: 听起来好像他是这场灾难的罪魁祸首。
pinyin: Tīngqilai hǎoxiàng tā shì zhè chǎng zāinàn de zuìkuíhuòshǒu.
english: It sounds as if he were to blame for the disaster.

chinese: 夏天的天气很炎热。
pinyin: Xià tiān de tiān qì hěn yán rè。
english: The weather is very hot in summer.

chinese: 众多村庄点缀着福斯湾的岸边，优美如画。初次于此航行的陌生人，必定会留下深刻印象。
pinyin: Zhòngduō cūnzhuāng diǎnzhuì zhe Fúsī wān de ànbiān, yōuměi rúhuà. chūcì yú cǐ hángxíng de mòshēngrén, bìdìng huì liúxià shēnkè yìnxiàng.
english: The stranger who sails for the first time up the Firth of Forth must be struck with the numerous villages that stud its picturesque shores.

chinese: 他在火旁烘干他的湿衣服。
pinyin: Tā zài huǒ páng hōnggān tā de shīyī fú.
english: He dried his wet clothes by the fire.

chinese: 昨晚，烟花厂发生了爆炸。
pinyin: Zuówǎn, yānhuāchǎng fāshēng le bàozhà.
english: Yesterday, an explosion occurred at the fireworks factory.

chinese: 他热泪盈眶。
pinyin: Tā rèlèiyíngkuàng.
english: His eyes were brimming over with tears.

chinese: 等不到孩子的消息，妈妈很焦急。
pinyin: Děng bù dào hái zi de xiāo xi， mā ma hěn jiāo jí。
english: The mother is anxious because she has not heard from her child.

chinese: 这件事成为了大家讨论的焦点。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì chéng wéi le dà jiā tǎo lùn de jiāo diǎn。
english: This matter became the focus of everyone's discussion.

chinese: 我们需要照应前面的内容。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào zhào yìng qián miàn de nèi róng。
english: We need to refer back to the earlier content.

chinese: 她忙着照料孩子。
pinyin: Tā mángzhe zhàoliào háizi.
english: She is busy with the care of her children.

chinese: 他没有朋友，没有钱，没有房子……他照样玩得很开心。
pinyin: Tā méiyǒu péngyou, méiyǒu qián, méiyǒu fángzi …… tā zhàoyàng wán dehěn kāixīn.
english: He had no friends, no money, no home...but he played happily all the same.

chinese: 月亮和星星在上空照耀着。
pinyin: Yuèliang hé xīngxing zài shàngkōng zhàoyào zhe.
english: The moon and stars were shining above us.

chinese: 她从小受到艺术的熏陶。
pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo shòu dào yì shù de xūn táo。
english: She has been influenced by art since childhood.

chinese: 先熨烫领子的里面，然后是外面。
pinyin: Xiān yùntàng lǐngzi de lǐmiàn, ránhòu shì wàimiàn.
english: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.

chinese: 早上，我十分后悔昨天熬夜到那么晚。
pinyin: Zǎoshang, wǒ shífēn hòuhuǐ zuótiān áoyè dào nàme wǎn.
english: I thoroughly regretted staying up so late, come morning.

chinese: 不知道第三次世界大战会不会爆发。
pinyin: Bù zhīdào Dì-sān Cì Shìjiè Dàzhàn huìbuhuì bàofā.
english: I wonder if a third world war will break out.

chinese: 他们趁炸弹还没有爆炸的时候就把它拆掉了。
pinyin: Tāmen chèn zhàdàn hái méiyǒu bàozhà de shíhou jiù bǎ tā chāi diào le.
english: They defused the bomb before it could blow up.

chinese: 这本书让她爱不释手。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū ràng tā ài bù shì shǒu。
english: She loves this book so much that she cannot put it down.

chinese: 他受人民的爱戴。
pinyin: Tā shòu rénmín de àidài.
english: He is loved by his people.

chinese: 朋友之间，大家谈谈心，非常爽快。
pinyin: Péngyou zhījiān, dàjiā tántán xīn, fēicháng shuǎngkuai.
english: Between friends, to have a heart-to-heart is really rejuvenating.

chinese: 犹豫了片刻之后，他把书放在了桌子上。
pinyin: Yóuyù le piànkè zhīhòu, tā bǎ shū fàng zài le zhuōzi shàng.
english: After some hesitation, he laid the book on the desk.

chinese: 请介绍一下这个片断。
pinyin: Qǐng jiè shào yī xià zhè gè piàn duàn。
english: Please tell us about this part.

chinese: 这本书有两个不同的版本。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǒu liǎng ge bù tóng de bǎn běn。
english: This book has two different editions.

chinese: 行动比语言更有说服力。别发牢骚多做事。
pinyin: Xíngdòng bǐ yǔyán gèng yǒushuōfúlì. bié fāláosāo duō zuòshì.
english: Actions speak louder than words. Stop complaining and do it.

chinese: 图阿雷格人该把他们的牲畜转移到山谷去了。

english: It's time for the Tuaregs to transfer their herds to the valley.

chinese: 我不想被牵扯到这件事里。

english: I don't want to be involved in that matter.

chinese: 这种方法只适用于特定的情况。

english: This method applies only in specific circumstances.

chinese: 所谓的＂男性特色教育学＂根本就不存在。

english: There is no "masculine" way of learning.

chinese: 这只犬在门口等主人。
pinyin: Zhè zhī quǎn zài mén kǒu děng zhǔ rén。
english: This dog is waiting for its owner at the entrance.

chinese: 平静的湖面犹如一面镜子。
pinyin: Píng jìng de hú miàn yóu rú yī miàn jìng zi。
english: The calm surface of the lake is like a mirror.

chinese: 他不忍心做出这么狠心的决定。
pinyin: Tā bù rěn xīn zuò chū zhè me hěn xīn de jué dìng。
english: He could not bear to make such a cruel decision.

chinese: 人们反对独裁，要求自由。
pinyin: Rén men fǎn duì dú cái， yāo qiú zì yóu。
english: People oppose dictatorship and demand freedom.

chinese: 他在一条狭窄的道路上走。
pinyin: Tā zài yī tiáo xiázhǎi de dàolù shàng zǒu.
english: The man is hiking on a narrow path.

chinese: 别让狭隘的人让你相信你的梦想过于宏大。
pinyin: Bié ràng xiá'ài de rén ràng nǐ xiāngxìn nǐ de mèngxiǎng guòyú hóngdà.
english: Don't let narrow-minded people convince you that your dreams are too big.

chinese: 她今天显得很狼狈。
pinyin: Tā jīn tiān xiǎn de hěn láng bèi。
english: She seems flustered today.

chinese: 这些人的行为越来越猖狂。
pinyin: Zhè xiē rén de xíng wéi yuè lái yuè chāng kuáng。
english: These people's behavior is becoming increasingly brazen.

chinese: 风刮得很猛烈。
pinyin: Fēng guā de hěn měng liè。
english: The wind is blowing fiercely.

chinese: 她率领团队完成了任务。
pinyin: Tā shuài lǐng tuán duì wán chéng le rèn wu。
english: She led the team to complete the task.

chinese: 你不该玩弄他的感情。
pinyin: Nǐ bù gāi wánnòng tā de gǎnqíng.
english: You should not trifle with his feelings.

chinese: 拉伸是运动前后不可忽略的重要环节。

english: Stretching is an important part of exercise that should not be ignored before and after workouts.

chinese: 警方根据现场遗下的证物把贼子找了出来。
pinyin: Jǐngfāng gēnjù xiànchǎng yí xià de zhèngwù bǎ zéi zǐ zhǎo le chūlái.
english: The burglar was traced by one of the things he had left on the scene.

chinese: 我们可以使用现成的材料。
pinyin: Wǒ men kě yǐ shǐ yòng xiàn chéng de cái liào。
english: We can use ready-made materials.

chinese: 我们需要先了解公司的现状。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào xiān liǎo jiě gōng sī de xiàn zhuàng。
english: We first need to understand the company's current situation.

chinese: 日本人在一九四一年十二月七日袭击珍珠港。
pinyin: Rìběnrén zài yī jiǔ sì yī nián Shí'èryuè qī rì xíjī Zhēnzhū Gǎng.
english: The Japanese attacked Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941.

chinese: 因为有充分的理由，她说话理直气壮。
pinyin: Yīn wèi yǒu chōng fèn de lǐ yóu， tā shuō huà lǐ zhí qì zhuàng。
english: With sound reasons on her side, she spoke confidently.

chinese: 凱特看了克里斯一眼，然後不理睬他，使他感到痛苦。
pinyin: Kǎitè kàn le Kèlǐsī yīyǎn, ránhòu bù lǐcǎi tā, shǐ tā gǎndào tòngkǔ.
english: Kate glanced at Chris and then ignored him, making him feel miserable.

chinese: 他正在琢磨这道题的答案。
pinyin: Tā zhèng zài zuó mo zhè dào tí de dá àn。
english: He is pondering the answer to this question.

chinese: 这个组织逐渐瓦解了。
pinyin: Zhè gè zǔ zhī zhú jiàn wǎ jiě le。
english: This organization gradually fell apart.

chinese: 我甘心为你做任何事。
pinyin: Wǒ gānxīn wèi nǐ zuò rènhé shì.
english: I am ready to do anything for you.

chinese: 如果没有了水，没有人能够在地球上生存。
pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu le shuǐ, méiyǒurén nénggòu zài dìqiúshàng shēngcún.
english: If it were not for water, no one could live on earth.

chinese: 我们需要保护这里的生态环境。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào bǎo hù zhè lǐ de shēng tài huán jìng。
english: We need to protect the local ecological environment.

chinese: 春天来了，花园充满了生机。
pinyin: Chūn tiān lái le， huā yuán chōng mǎn le shēng jī。
english: Spring has come, and the garden is full of vitality.

chinese: 他研究生物学已经有差不多十年的时间了。
pinyin: Tā yánjiū shēngwùxué yǐjīng yǒu chàbuduō shí nián de shíjiān le.
english: He has been engaged in the study of biology for nearly ten years.

chinese: 今天的课程介绍了生理。
pinyin: Jīn tiān de kè chéng jiè shào le shēng lǐ。
english: Today’s lesson introduced physiology.

chinese: 很久没练习，这些动作有点生疏了。
pinyin: Hěn jiǔ méi liàn xí， zhè xiē dòng zuò yǒu diǎn shēng shū le。
english: After a long time without practice, these movements feel unfamiliar.

chinese: 帕查玛玛是安地斯山脉土著居民敬仰的大地和生育女神。
pinyin: Pà chá mǎ mǎ shì Āndìsī shānmài tǔzhù jūmín jìngyǎng de dàdì hé shēngyù nǚshén.
english: Pachamama is a goddess of earth and fertility revered by the indigenous peoples of the Andes.

chinese: 这把旧锁已经生锈了。
pinyin: Zhè bǎ jiù suǒ yǐ jīng shēng xiù le。
english: This old lock has rusted.

chinese: 就我所知，他是个很用功的学生。
pinyin: Jiù wǒ suǒzhī, tā shì gè hěn yònggōng de xuésheng.
english: As far as I know, he's a diligent student.

english: Many of the user reviews on Amazon are fake.

chinese: 这件事你甭担心。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ béng dān xīn。
english: You need not worry about this.

pinyin: Tiánjìngyùndòng huì yīn tiān yǔ guānxi qǔxiāo le.
english: The track and field meet was canceled due to rain.

chinese: 你有任何要申报的东西吗？
pinyin: Nǐ yǒu rènhé yào shēnbào de dōngxi ma?
english: Do you have anything to declare?

pinyin: Diànyuán zhuǎnjiē qì de bāozhuāng hé zài nǎlǐ?
english: Where's the box the power supply came in?

chinese: 不要画蛇添足。
pinyin: Bù yào huàshétiānzú.
english: Let well alone.

chinese: 今天的道路很畅通。
pinyin: Jīn tiān de dào lù hěn chàng tōng。
english: The roads are clear today.

chinese: 这本书很畅销。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn chàng xiāo。
english: This book sells very well.

chinese: 所有的事物都要被怀疑、被验证，思想没有界限。
pinyin: Suǒyǒu de shìwù dōu yào bèi huáiyí, bèi yànzhèng, sīxiǎng méiyǒu jièxiàn.
english: Everything has been suspected and been inspected; thoughts have no boundaries.

chinese: 让我们拍照留念。
pinyin: Ràng wǒmen pāizhào liúniàn.
english: Let's take a picture for memory's sake.

chinese: 你一定要活在当下，不能总是留恋过去。
pinyin: Nǐ yīdìngyào huó zài dāngxià, bù néng zǒngshì liúliàn guòqù.
english: You must live in the present, not in the past.

chinese: 请留神看着我的手提箱。
pinyin: Qǐng liúshén kàn zhe wǒ de shǒutíxiāng.
english: Please keep an eye on my suitcase.

chinese: 这位农民向我们介绍了畜牧。
pinyin: Zhè wèi nóng mín xiàng wǒ men jiè shào le xù mù。
english: This farmer told us about animal husbandry.

chinese: 气温略微下降了。
pinyin: Qì wēn lüè wēi xià jiàng le。
english: The temperature dropped slightly.

pinyin: Wǒ wèi zhè cì kǎoshì hǎohǎo zhǔnbèi le yī fān.
english: I prepared well for this examination.

english: I wonder why I feel so lonely when it gets cold.

pinyin: Tā de bízi shàng cháng le yī gè xiǎo gēda.
english: On his nose grew a small pimple.

pinyin: Nǐ kànqǐlai hěn píjuàn.
english: You look tired.

pinyin: Méiyǒu yàowù nénggòu zhìliáo zhèzhǒng jíbìng.
english: No medicine can cure this disease.

pinyin: Tā méiyǒu liúxià hénjì jiù xiāoshī le.
english: He disappeared without a trace.

english: His paralysis is progressing, and soon he won't be able to get out of bed.

pinyin: Shòu shāng hòu， tā de tuǐ yǒu diǎn qué。
english: After the injury, he had a slight limp.

pinyin: Zhè wǔ nián tòngkǔ de áizhèng zhìliáo tā zhōngyú jiānchí xiàlai le.
english: Throughout the five years of painful cancer treatments, he managed to keep a stiff upper lip.

pinyin: Yǒuguān áizhèng chéngyīn de yánjiū hàofèi pō jù.
english: Research on the causes of cancer is very expensive.

pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào dēng lù zì jǐ de zhàng hù。
english: We need to log in to our accounts.

pinyin: Jīn nián de zēng zhǎng lǜ tí gāo le liǎng ge bǎi fēn diǎn。
english: This year's growth rate rose by two percentage points.

pinyin: Rénzào pígé shì bǐbùshàng zhēnpí de.
english: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.

pinyin: Zhè piàn pén dì de tǔ dì fēi cháng féi wò。
english: The soil in this basin is very fertile.

pinyin: Jīnnián wǒmen huì yínglì de.
english: We'll be profitable this year.

pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào jiān dū gōng chéng de zhì liàng。
english: We need to oversee the quality of the project.

chinese: 有人在监视。
pinyin: Yǒu rén zài jiānshì.
english: Someone is watching.

chinese: 我们需要盖章。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào gài zhāng。
english: We need to affix a seal.

english: A cloud of dust and debris rose and lingered in the sky for a few minutes afterward.

pinyin: Zhège bēizi lǐ chéng zhe shuǐ.

pinyin: Ālābó shèngchǎn shíyóu.
english: Arabia abounds in oil.

chinese: 谎言像一朵盛开的鲜花，外表美丽，生命短暂。

english: A lie is like a flower in full bloom. It may look pretty, but it wilts quickly.

pinyin: Zài Gēlúnbǐyà, Tiānzhǔjiào xísú shèngxíng.
english: In Colombia, Catholic customs prevail.

chinese: 他目睹了这场事故。
pinyin: Tā mù dǔ le zhè chǎng shì gù。
english: He witnessed this accident.

pinyin: Sùyán tài hàixiū le, qǐng bù yào dīng zhe wǒ kàn.
english: It's embarrassing to be seen without make-up so please don't stare.

pinyin: Diàn shì tái zhèng zài zhí bō zhè chǎng bǐ sài。
english: The television station is broadcasting this match live.

chinese: 我们会根据您提出的要求对不足之处作出相应的改正。
pinyin: Wǒmen huì gēnjù nín tíchū de yāoqiú duì bù zú zhī chǔ zuòchū xiāngyìng de gǎizhèng.
english: We will follow your demands and make the necessary corrections to those parts that need them.

chinese: 这两条线的长度相等。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiáo xiàn de cháng dù xiāng děng。
english: These two lines are equal in length.

pinyin: Xué xí hé liàn xí xiāng fǔ xiāng chéng。
english: Learning and practice complement each other.

chinese: 人们看待事情的角度不同取决于他们是富裕或贫穷。

english: We are visiting Grandma tomorrow.

english: In a wink, Gunter was gone.

pinyin: Tā xiàomīmī de duì wǒ zhāoshǒu.

chinese: 她向我使了个眼色。
pinyin: Tā xiàng wǒ shǐ le gè yǎn sè。
english: She gave me a meaningful look.

chinese: 人们都很坏，他们只想着他们自己，只剩下我为自己着想。
pinyin: Rénmen dōu hěn huài, tāmen zhǐ xiǎng zhe tāmen zìjǐ, zhǐ shèngxià wǒ wèi zìjǐ zhuóxiǎng.
english: People are bad; they only think of themselves. I'm the only one who thinks about me.

pinyin: Wǒ men yǐ jīng zhuó shǒu zhǔn bèi zhè cì huó dòng。
english: We have already started preparing this event.

english: This article focuses on study methods.

chinese: 我们需要督促学生认真学习。

english: We need to urge the students to study seriously.

chinese: 问她问题的时候她冷冷地瞪了我一眼。

english: When I asked her a question, she gave me a cold look.

chinese: 游客来到这里瞻仰纪念碑。
pinyin: Yóu kè lái dào zhè lǐ zhān yǎng jì niàn bēi。
english: Visitors come here to pay their respects at the monument.

chinese: 他在麻醉剂的作用下，他失去了知觉。
pinyin: Tā zài mázuìjì de zuòyòng xià, tā shīqù le zhījué.

chinese: 谁都知道知足常乐。

pinyin: Chuán tíng zài mǎ tou páng biān。
english: The boat is moored beside the wharf.
