pinyin: Zhè piàn tǔ dì yùn cáng zhe fēng fù de zī yuán。
english: This land contains abundant resources.

chinese: 词汇是他学习中的薄弱环节。
pinyin: Cí huì shì tā xué xí zhōng de bó ruò huán jié。
english: Vocabulary is the weak point in his studies.

chinese: 汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。
pinyin: Tāngmǔ juān yībàn tā de xīnshuǐ gěi tā zuì xǐhuan de císhàn jīgòu.
english: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.

chinese: 我在部落格上发表了一篇文章，鼓励男性举报自己遭受家庭虐待的经历。
pinyin: Wǒ zài bùluògé shàng fābiǎo le yī piān wénzhāng, gǔlì nánxìng jǔbào zìjǐ zāoshòu jiātíng nüèdài de jīnglì.
english: I wrote a post to my blog encouraging men to report experiences with domestic abuse.

chinese: 我从来没有见过谁像你这么虚伪的。
pinyin: Wǒ cóngláiméiyǒu jiàn guo shéi xiàng nǐ zhème xūwěi de.
english: I've never known anyone as hypocritical as you.

chinese: 他有时候很虚荣。
pinyin: Tā yǒu shí hou hěn xū róng。
english: He is sometimes vain.

chinese: 这种食物含有丰富的蛋白质。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shí wù hán yǒu fēng fù de dàn bái zhì。
english: This food is rich in protein.

chinese: 请把螺丝钉放在桌上。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ luó sī dīng fàng zài zhuō shàng。
english: Please put the screw on the table.

chinese: 她加入了志愿者的行列。
pinyin: Tā jiā rù le zhì yuàn zhě de háng liè。
english: She joined the ranks of the volunteers.

chinese: 我认识了这位行政长官。
pinyin: Wǒ rènshi le zhèwèi xíngzhèngzhǎngguān.
english: I got acquainted with the chief executive.

chinese: 我们需要衔接前后的内容。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào xián jiē qián hòu de nèi róng。
english: We need to connect the preceding and following content.

chinese: 她穿着漂亮的衣裳。
pinyin: Tā chuān zhe piào liang de yī shang。
english: She is wearing beautiful clothes.

chinese: 公司为损失提供了补偿。
pinyin: Gōng sī wèi sǔn shī tí gōng le bǔ cháng。
english: The company provided compensation for the loss.

chinese: 这种问题该有补救办法。
pinyin: Zhèzhǒng wèntí gāi yǒu bǔjiù bànfǎ.
english: This type of problem should be able to be solved.

chinese: 我们需要表决这项提议。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào biǎo jué zhè xiàng tí yì。
english: We need to vote on this proposal.

chinese: 我们需要表彰优秀的员工。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào biǎo zhāng yōu xiù de yuán gōng。
english: We need to honor outstanding employees.

chinese: 我们需要表态。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào biǎo tài。
english: We need to make our position clear.

chinese: 我们不能愁闷地看着这个城市就这样衰退下去。
pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng chóumèn de kàn zhe zhège chéngshì jiù zhèyàng shuāituì xiàqù.
english: We can't just look on dejectedly while this city continues to go into decline.

chinese: 在此仅代表本公司向各位致上衷心的谢意。
pinyin: Zàicǐ jǐn dàibiǎo běn gōngsī xiàng gèwèi zhì shàng zhōngxīn de xièyì.
english: On behalf of the company, I would like to express our hearty thanks to you all.

chinese: 他不想一直处于被动的位置。
pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng yī zhí chǔ yú bèi dòng de wèi zhi。
english: He does not want to remain in a passive position.

chinese: 守门员用手碰到了球，裁判给了对方一个角球。
pinyin: Shǒuményuán yòng shǒu pèngdào le qiú, cáipàn gěi le duìfāng yī gè jiǎoqiú.
english: When the goalkeeper touched the ball, the referee awarded the other team a corner kick.

chinese: 丰田公司宣布将会在今年裁员一千人。
pinyin: Fēngtián gōngsī xuānbù jiānghuì zài jīnnián cáiyuán yī qiān rén.
english: Toyota Corporation announced that it would cut 1,000 positions this year.

chinese: 裁缝正在给我做衣服。
pinyin: Cái feng zhèng zài gěi wǒ zuò yī fu。
english: The tailor is making clothes for me.

chinese: 工人正在装卸货物。
pinyin: Gōng rén zhèng zài zhuāng xiè huò wù。
english: The workers are loading and unloading goods.

chinese: 我该走了，要不然我会迟到的。
pinyin: Wǒ gāi zǒu le, yàobùrán wǒ huì chídào de.
english: I have to go, otherwise I'll arrive late.

chinese: 今天热得要命。
pinyin: Jīn tiān rè de yào mìng。
english: It is unbearably hot today.

chinese: 请记住这三个要点。
pinyin: Qǐng jì zhù zhè sān gè yào diǎn。
english: Please remember these three main points.

chinese: 几位见义勇为的乘客把小偷抓住了，还把他送到了警方的手中。
pinyin: Jǐ wèi jiànyìyǒngwéi de chéngkè bǎ xiǎotōu zhuāzhù le, hái bǎ tā sòng dào le jǐngfāng de shǒu zhōng.
english: Some brave passengers caught the pickpocket and turned him over to the police.

chinese: 这位老人见多识广。
pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo rén jiàn duō shí guǎng。
english: This elderly person is experienced and knowledgeable.

chinese: 应该做什么，我和他的见解不同。
pinyin: Yīnggāi zuò shénme, wǒ hé tā de jiànjiě bù tóng.
english: My view was different from his as to what should be done.

chinese: 她向我们介绍了旅行中的见闻。
pinyin: Tā xiàng wǒ men jiè shào le lǚ xíng zhōng de jiàn wén。
english: She told us about what she saw and heard on her travels.

chinese: 他的工作是驾驶观光巴士。
pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò shì jiàshǐ guānguāng bāshì.
english: His job is driving a sight-seeing bus.

chinese: 和其他公司一样，我们得向前看，规划好未来。
pinyin: Hé qítā gōngsī yīyàng, wǒmen de xiàngqián kàn, guīhuà hǎo wèilái.
english: Like any company, we've got to look ahead and plan for the future.

chinese: 购买之前，请确认产品的规格。
pinyin: Gòu mǎi zhī qián， qǐng què rèn chǎn pǐn de guī gé。
english: Please check the product specifications before buying.

chinese: 我们想修改学校的规章制度。
pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎng xiūgǎi xuéxiào de guīzhāng zhìdù.
english: We want to modify the regulations of our school.

chinese: 她挥着她的手，直到火车消失在视线之外。
pinyin: Tā huī zhe tā de shǒu, zhídào huǒchē xiāoshī zài shìxiàn zhī wài.
english: She waved her hand until the train was out of sight.

chinese: 这间房的视野很好。
pinyin: Zhè jiān fáng de shì yě hěn hǎo。
english: This room has a very good view.

chinese: 这件事提高了他的环保觉悟。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tí gāo le tā de huán bǎo jué wù。
english: This incident increased his environmental awareness.

chinese: 这个故事描写了主人公的觉醒。
pinyin: Zhè gè gù shi miáo xiě le zhǔ rén gōng de jué xǐng。
english: This story describes the protagonist's awakening.

chinese: 房间的角落里整整齐齐地放着一叠书。
pinyin: Fángjiān de jiǎoluò lǐ zhěngzhěng-qíqí de fàng zhe yī dié shū.
english: There was a neat pile of books in the corner of the room.

chinese: 冷战以苏联解体结束。
pinyin: Lěngzhàn yǐ Sūlián jiětǐ jiéshù.
english: The Cold War ended when the Soviet Union collapsed.

chinese: "你没结婚吧!?" "哦，我们分手了。我们解除婚约了。"
pinyin: "nǐ méi jiéhūn ba!?" "ó, wǒmen fēnshǒu le. wǒmen jiěchú hūnyuē le."
english: "Didn't you get married!?" "Oh, we split up. We broke our engagement."

chinese: 他授权给我解雇了他们。
pinyin: Tā shòuquán gěi wǒ jiěgù le tāmen.
english: He gave me authority to fire them.

chinese: 我警告过他关于她的事，但他不听。
pinyin: Wǒ jǐnggào guo tā guānyú tā de shì, dàn tā bù tīng.
english: I tried to warn him about her, but he won't listen to me.

chinese: 不要放松警惕。
pinyin: Bù yào fàngsōng jǐngtì.
english: Don't let your guard down.

chinese: 你有出国过吗？譬如说，美国？
pinyin: Nǐ yǒu chūguó guo ma? pìrú shuō, Měiguó?
english: Have you visited foreign countries, say America?

chinese: 如果你不计较太多，生活会更容易些。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù jìjiào tài duō, shēnghuó huì gèng róngyì xiē.
english: Life would be so much better if you didn't care so much.

chinese: 我不认可他的行为。
pinyin: Wǒ bù rènkě tā de xíngwéi.
english: I don't approve of his conduct.

chinese: 我提交了行车记录器的影片，结果认定对方驾驶要负事故责任。
pinyin: Wǒ tíjiāo le xíngchē jìlùqì de yǐngpiàn, jiéguǒ rèndìng duìfāng jiàshǐ yào fù shìgù zérèn.
english: I sent in my dashcam video and the other driver was found at fault for the accident.

chinese: 不要讥笑别人的错误。
pinyin: Bù yào jī xiào bié ren de cuò wù。
english: Do not mock other people's mistakes.

chinese: 买东西时，她喜欢讨价还价。
pinyin: Mǎi dōng xi shí， tā xǐ huan tǎo jià huán jià。
english: She likes to bargain when shopping.

chinese: 对于我们来说，这已经是做出了最大限度的让步了。
pinyin: Duìyú wǒmen lái shuō, zhè yǐjīng shì zuòchū le zuì dàxiàn dù de ràngbù le.
english: In our view, we have already made the biggest possible compromise.

chinese: 我的记性不好。我简直不记得他的名字了。
pinyin: Wǒ de jìxing bù hǎo. wǒ jiǎnzhí bù jìde tā de míngzi le.
english: My memory failed me. I just could not remember his name.

chinese: 这本书记载了当地的历史。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū jì zǎi le dāng dì de lì shǐ。
english: This book records the local history.

chinese: 若天气许可的话，派对将会在户外举行。
pinyin: Ruò tiānqì xǔkě dehuà, pàiduì jiānghuì zàihùwài jǔxíng.
english: The party will be held outdoors, weather permitting.

chinese: 我在这些论坛上没有帐号。
pinyin: Wǒ zài zhèxiē lùntán shàng méiyǒu zhànghào.
english: I do not have an account in these forums.

chinese: 我们有充分的理由论证这个假设。
pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu chōngfèn de lǐyóu lùnzhèng zhège jiǎshè.
english: We have sufficient evidence to prove this hypothesis.

chinese: 我很喜欢你为人设想的性格。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan nǐ wéirén shèxiǎng de xìnggé.
english: I love how you think of other people's needs before your own.

chinese: 设立「普丁法庭」的程序已经启动。
pinyin: Shèlì 「 Pǔdīng fǎtíng 」 de chéngxù yǐjīng qǐdòng.
english: The process of creating a “tribunal for Putin” has been launched.

chinese: 我该在这个服务器上设置一个防火墙。
pinyin: Wǒ gāi zài zhège fúwùqì shàng shèzhì yī gè fánghuǒqiáng.
english: I need to configure this server with an appropriate firewall system.

chinese: 我拿到了考试合格的证书。
pinyin: Wǒ ná dào le kǎo shì hé gé de zhèng shū。
english: I received a certificate for passing the exam.

chinese: 调查证实了她说的话。
pinyin: Diào chá zhèng shí le tā shuō de huà。
english: The investigation confirmed what she said.

chinese: 戈雷利克表示，他在约旦的研究成果可用于评估叙利亚等其他中东国家的水资源短缺。
pinyin: Gēléilìkè biǎoshì, tā zài Yuēdàn de yánjiū chéngguǒ kě yòng yú pínggū Xùlìyà děng qítā Zhōngdōng guójiā de shuǐ zīyuán duǎnquē.
english: Gorelick said that the outcomes of his work in Jordan may be used to evaluate water scarcity in other Middle Eastern countries, such as Syria.

chinese: 我的评论引起了小组内的争论。
pinyin: Wǒ de pínglùn yǐnqǐ le xiǎozǔ nèi de zhēnglùn.
english: My comment sparked off an argument in the group.

chinese: 请不要回覆这封诈骗电邮，当然也不要点击电邮里的超连结。
pinyin: Qǐng bù yào huífù zhè fēng zhàpiàn diànyóu, dāngrán yě bù yàodiǎn jī diànyóu lǐ de chāoliánjié.
english: Please do not answer this fraudulent e-mail and certainly do not click on the links in the e-mail.

chinese: 双方希望通过诉讼解决纠纷。
pinyin: Shuāng fāng xī wàng tōng guò sù sòng jiě jué jiū fēn。
english: Both sides hope to resolve the dispute through litigation.

chinese: 你读那本书需要大量词汇。
pinyin: Nǐ dú nà běn shū xūyào dàliàng cíhuì.
english: You need a large vocabulary to read that book.

chinese: 父母试图将诚实和工作的重要性灌输给孩子。
pinyin: Fùmǔ shìtú jiāng chéngshí hé gōngzuò de zhòngyàoxìng guànshū gěi háizi.
english: Parents try to impress upon their children the importance of honesty and hard work.

chinese: 这位老师用试验论证了这个想法。
pinyin: Zhèwèi lǎoshī yòng shìyàn lùnzhèng le zhège xiǎngfǎ.
english: The teacher demonstrated the idea with an experiment.

chinese: 冷不防，老师让每个国家的学生用话筒给大家讲一下自己来哈尔滨的原因。
pinyin: Lěngbufáng, lǎoshī ràng měi gè guójiā de xuésheng yòng huàtǒng gěi dàjiā jiǎng yīxià zìjǐ lái Hā'ěrbīn de yuányīn.
english: Without warning, the teachers ask students from each country to take the microphone and explain to everyone their reasons for coming to Harbin.

chinese: 我们是为了死亡而诞生的。
pinyin: Wǒmen shì wèile sǐwáng ér dànshēng de.
english: We were born to die.

chinese: 今天是这位作家的诞辰纪念日。
pinyin: Jīn tiān shì zhè wèi zuò jiā de dàn chén jì niàn rì。
english: Today is the anniversary of this writer's birth.

chinese: 她今天显得很诧异。
pinyin: Tā jīn tiān xiǎn de hěn chà yì。
english: She seems surprised today.

chinese: 他被妻子诬陷了。
pinyin: Tā bèi qīzi wūxiàn le.
english: He was framed by his wife.

chinese: 我们需要准确计算误差。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào zhǔn què jì suàn wù chā。
english: We need to calculate the error accurately.

chinese: 请不要误解我的意思。
pinyin: Qǐng bù yào wù jiě wǒ de yì si。
english: Please do not misunderstand what I mean.

chinese: 您最好请教一下医生。
pinyin: Nín zuì hǎo qǐngjiào yīxià yīshēng.
english: You'd better consult the doctor.

chinese: 请把请柬放在桌上。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ qǐng jiǎn fàng zài zhuō shàng。
english: Please put the invitation card on the table.

chinese: 我们需要请示下一步的安排。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào qǐng shì xià yī bù de ān pái。
english: We need to ask for instructions for the next step.

chinese: 但这是诽谤！
pinyin: Dàn zhè shì fěibàng!
english: But this is libel!

chinese: 我是人类学的研究学生，课题是“中医在英国”。
pinyin: Wǒ shì rénlèixué de yánjiū xuésheng, kètí shì "Zhōngyī zài Yīngguó ".
english: I'm an anthropology research student, and my topic is 'Chinese medicine in Britain'.

chinese: 我们需要调剂生活。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào tiáo jì shēng huó。
english: We need to vary our daily routines.

chinese: 我们需要调动大家的积极性。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào diào dòng dà jiā de jī jí xìng。
english: We need to mobilize everyone’s enthusiasm.

chinese: 我们需要调和双方的利益。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào tiáo hé shuāng fāng de lì yì。
english: We need to reconcile the interests of both sides.

chinese: 请把调料放在桌上。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ tiáo liào fàng zài zhuō shàng。
english: Please put the seasoning on the table.

chinese: 音量调节在哪里？
pinyin: Yīnliàng tiáojié zài nǎlǐ?
english: Where's the volume control?

chinese: 我们需要调解双方的矛盾。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào tiáo jiě shuāng fāng de máo dùn。
english: We need to mediate the conflict between the two sides.

chinese: 我们需要谅解对方的困难。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào liàng jiě duì fāng de kùn nan。
english: We need to understand the other person’s difficulties.

chinese: 我们需要谋求更好的发展。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào móu qiú gèng hǎo de fā zhǎn。
english: We need to seek better development.

chinese: 我们需要谢绝不必要的邀请。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào xiè jué bù bì yào de yāo qǐng。
english: We need to politely decline unnecessary invitations.

chinese: 我听到了一个很有意思的谣言。
pinyin: Wǒ tīngdào le yī gè hěn yǒuyìsi de yáoyán.
english: I heard a very interesting rumor.

chinese: 这首诗表达了豪迈的感情。
pinyin: Zhè shǒu shī biǎo dá le háo mài de gǎn qíng。
english: This poem expresses bold and generous feelings.

chinese: 我在海滩上发现了一个漂亮的贝壳。
pinyin: Wǒ zài hǎitān shàng fāxiàn le yī gè piàoliang de bèiké.
english: I found a beautiful shell on the shore.

chinese: 她是一位勤劳贤惠的人。
pinyin: Tā shì yī wèi qín láo xián huì de rén。
english: She is a hardworking and caring person.

chinese: 这种行为会败坏公司的名声。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xíng wéi huì bài huài gōng sī de míng shēng。
english: This behavior will damage the company's reputation.

chinese: 国际货币基金组织不考虑再借款给该国。
pinyin: Guójì Huòbì Jījīn Zǔzhī bù kǎolǜ zài jièkuǎn gěi gāiguó.
english: The IMF ruled out any new loans to that country.

chinese: 他们在办公室安装了一台自动贩卖机。
pinyin: Tāmen zài bàngōngshì ānzhuāng le yī tái zìdòng fànmàijī.
english: They installed a vending machine at work.

chinese: 守财奴积聚钱财不是因为他谨慎，而是因为他贪婪。
pinyin: Shǒucáinú jījù qiáncái bù shì yīnwèi tā jǐnshèn, érshì yīnwèi tā tānlán.
english: A miser hoards money not because he is prudent but because he is greedy.

chinese: 政府正在调查贪污案件。
pinyin: Zhèng fǔ zhèng zài diào chá tān wū àn jiàn。
english: The government is investigating a corruption case.

chinese: 这个词带有贬义。
pinyin: Zhè gè cí dài yǒu biǎn yì。
english: This word has a negative connotation.

chinese: 不要通过贬低别人来表现自己。
pinyin: Bù yào tōng guò biǎn dī bié ren lái biǎo xiàn zì jǐ。
english: Do not try to show off by belittling others.

chinese: 我们需要贯彻新的规定。

english: I would like to try the filling here.

chinese: 你说得我馋死了！
pinyin: Nǐ shuō de wǒ chán sǐ le!
english: The way you describe it makes me drool.

chinese: 安全是我们的首要任务。
pinyin: Ān quán shì wǒ men de shǒu yào rèn wu。
english: Safety is our top priority.

chinese: 许多犹太人被德国人驱逐。
pinyin: Xǔduō Yóutàirén bèi Déguórén qūzhú.
english: Many Jews were expelled by the Germans.

chinese: 这支部队驻扎在边境。
pinyin: Zhè zhī bù duì zhù zhā zài biān jìng。
english: This unit is stationed at the border.

chinese: 工程完成后，需要进行验收。
pinyin: Gōng chéng wán chéng hòu， xū yào jìn xíng yàn shōu。
english: After the project is completed, it needs to be inspected and accepted.

chinese: 三天之后，也就是下周一，时机就成熟了，到时教授和其帮派的骨干分子都会落入警方的手掌心。
pinyin: Sān tiān zhīhòu, yě jiù shì xià Zhōuyī, shíjī jiù chéngshú le, dàoshí jiàoshòu hé qí bāngpài de gǔgàn fènzǐ dōu huì luòrù jǐngfāng de shǒuzhǎngxīn.
english: In three days—that is to say, on Monday next—matters will be ripe, and the Professor, with all the principal members of his gang, will be in the hands of the police.

chinese: 这位老师给人的感觉很高尚。
pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo shī gěi rén de gǎn jué hěn gāo shàng。
english: This teacher gives an impression of being noble.

chinese: 当时正是早高峰，来来往往的行人和车辆很多。
pinyin: Dāngshí zhèngshì zǎo gāofēng, lái láiwǎng wǎng de xíngrén hé chēliàng hěn duō.
english: It was the morning rush hour, and there were a lot of passing pedestrians and cars.

chinese: 这个办法确实很高明。
pinyin: Zhè gè bàn fǎ què shí hěn gāo míng。
english: This solution is indeed clever.

chinese: 大家的学习热情不断高涨。
pinyin: Dà jiā de xué xí rè qíng bù duàn gāo zhǎng。
english: Everyone's enthusiasm for learning keeps growing.

chinese: 你怎么确定你的女朋友没有假装高潮?
pinyin: Nǐ zěnme quèdìng nǐ de nǚpéngyou méiyǒu jiǎzhuāng gāocháo?
english: How can you be sure your girlfriend isn't faking her orgasms?

chinese: 他正在认真准备高考。
pinyin: Tā zhèng zài rèn zhēn zhǔn bèi gāo kǎo。
english: He is diligently preparing for the college entrance examination.

chinese: 无论是多么不协和的两种颜色，在技术高超的设计师手里，也能化成悦目的配搭。
pinyin: Wúlùn shì duōme bù xiéhé de liǎng zhǒng yánsè, zài jìshù gāochāo de shèjìshī shǒu lǐ, yě néng huà chéng yuè mùdì pèi dā.
english: In the hands of a skilled designer, any two colors can go well together.

chinese: 她处理问题很有魄力。
pinyin: Tā chǔ lǐ wèn tí hěn yǒu pò lì。
english: She handles problems with courage and determination.

chinese: 女孩变魔术一样地消失了。
pinyin: Nǚhái biànmóshù yīyàng de xiāoshī le.
english: The girl vanished like magic.

chinese: 忧愁就像魔鬼：谁不怕它，它就不能伤害谁。
pinyin: Yōuchóu jiù xiàng móguǐ: shéi bù pà tā, tā jiù bù néng shānghài shéi.
english: Worries are like ghosts - those who aren't afraid of them can't suffer at their hands.

chinese: 坐了很久以后，他的腿有些麻木。
pinyin: Zuò le hěn jiǔ yǐ hòu， tā de tuǐ yǒu xiē má mù。
english: After sitting for a long time, his legs felt somewhat numb.

chinese: 不能因为暂时安全就麻痹大意。
pinyin: Bù néng yīn wèi zàn shí ān quán jiù má bì dà yi。
english: We must not become complacent just because we are safe for now.

chinese: 我们需要鼓动大家一起参加。
pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào gǔ dòng dà jiā yī qǐ cān jiā。
english: We need to encourage everyone to join in.

chinese: 我流鼻涕。
pinyin: Wǒ liú bítì.
english: My nose is running.

chinese: 这家店的商品很齐全。
pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de shāng pǐn hěn qí quán。
english: This shop has a full range of goods.

chinese: 大家齐心协力完成了任务。
pinyin: Dà jiā qí xīn xié lì wán chéng le rèn wu。
english: Everyone worked together to complete the task.

chinese: 你好，欢迎来我们家！
pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, huānyíng lái wǒmen jiā!
english: Hello, welcome to our home!

chinese: 早上好，你睡得好吗？
pinyin: Zǎoshang hǎo, nǐ shuì de hǎo ma?
english: Good morning. Did you sleep well?

chinese: 好久不见，你还好吗？
pinyin: Hǎojiǔ bú jiàn, nǐ hái hǎo ma?
english: Long time no see. How are you?

chinese: 你最近工作忙吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn gōngzuò máng ma?
english: Have you been busy at work lately?

chinese: 我最近挺好的，谢谢关心。
pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn tǐng hǎo de, xièxie guānxīn.
english: I've been quite well lately. Thanks for asking.

chinese: 请问，你叫什么名字？
pinyin: Qǐngwèn, nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
english: May I ask your name?

chinese: 我叫小明，你呢？
pinyin: Wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng, nǐ ne?
english: My name is Xiaoming. What about you?

chinese: 认识你很高兴，以后多联系。
pinyin: Rènshi nǐ hěn gāoxìng, yǐhòu duō liánxì.
english: It's nice to meet you. Let's keep in touch.

chinese: 你是哪里人？我来自澳大利亚。
pinyin: Nǐ shì nǎlǐ rén? Wǒ láizì Àodàlìyà.
english: Where are you from? I'm from Australia.

chinese: 我们明天在学校见吧！
pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān zài xuéxiào jiàn ba!
english: Let's meet at school tomorrow!

chinese: 谢谢你帮我找到车站。
pinyin: Xièxie nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎodào chēzhàn.
english: Thank you for helping me find the station.

chinese: 不客气，很高兴能帮上忙。
pinyin: Bú kèqi, hěn gāoxìng néng bāng shàng máng.
english: You're welcome. I'm glad I could help.

chinese: 不好意思，我想从这里过去。
pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ xiǎng cóng zhèlǐ guòqu.
english: Excuse me, I'd like to get through here.

chinese: 对不起，我把你的名字记错了。
pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bǎ nǐ de míngzi jì cuò le.
english: I'm sorry. I remembered your name incorrectly.

chinese: 没关系，下次注意就好。
pinyin: Méi guānxi, xià cì zhùyì jiù hǎo.
english: It's okay. Just be careful next time.

chinese: 请稍等，我马上就来。
pinyin: Qǐng shāo děng, wǒ mǎshàng jiù lái.
english: Please wait a moment. I'll be right there.

chinese: 你能帮我拿一下这个袋子吗？
pinyin: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ ná yíxià zhège dàizi ma?
english: Could you hold this bag for me for a moment?

chinese: 今天真是麻烦你了，谢谢！
pinyin: Jīntiān zhēn shì máfan nǐ le, xièxie!
english: Thank you for going to so much trouble today!

chinese: 请进，外面很冷。
pinyin: Qǐng jìn, wàimiàn hěn lěng.
english: Please come in. It's cold outside.

chinese: 请坐，要不要喝点茶？
pinyin: Qǐng zuò, yào bu yào hē diǎn chá?
english: Please sit down. Would you like some tea?

chinese: 对不起，这句话我没听懂。
pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, zhè jù huà wǒ méi tīng dǒng.
english: Sorry, I didn't understand that sentence.

chinese: 最后一句，请再说一遍。
pinyin: Zuìhòu yí jù, qǐng zài shuō yí biàn.
english: Please repeat the last sentence.

chinese: 你能说慢一点吗？我还在学。
pinyin: Nǐ néng shuō màn yìdiǎn ma? Wǒ hái zài xué.
english: Could you speak a little more slowly? I'm still learning.

chinese: 这个词在这里是什么意思？
pinyin: Zhège cí zài zhèlǐ shì shénme yìsi?
english: What does this word mean here?

chinese: 这个东西用中文怎么说？
pinyin: Zhège dōngxi yòng Zhōngwén zěnme shuō?
english: What do you call this thing in Chinese?

chinese: 我在学中文，每天练习一点。
pinyin: Wǒ zài xué Zhōngwén, měitiān liànxí yìdiǎn.
english: I'm learning Chinese and practicing a little every day.

chinese: 我会说一点中文，但是说得不太好。
pinyin: Wǒ huì shuō yìdiǎn Zhōngwén, dànshì shuō de bú tài hǎo.
english: I speak a little Chinese, but not very well.

chinese: 请问，你会说英语吗？
pinyin: Qǐngwèn, nǐ huì shuō Yīngyǔ ma?
english: Excuse me, do you speak English?

chinese: 可以把地址写下来吗？
pinyin: Kěyǐ bǎ dìzhǐ xiě xiàlai ma?
english: Could you write down the address?

chinese: 你这样解释，我就明白了。
pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng jiěshì, wǒ jiù míngbai le.
english: Now that you've explained it that way, I understand.

chinese: 我有点饿了，我们吃饭吧。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒudiǎn è le, wǒmen chī fàn ba.
english: I'm a little hungry. Let's eat.

chinese: 我渴了，想喝点水。
pinyin: Wǒ kě le, xiǎng hē diǎn shuǐ.
english: I'm thirsty and would like some water.

chinese: 你今天想吃面还是吃米饭？
pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān xiǎng chī miàn háishi chī mǐfàn?
english: Would you like noodles or rice today?

chinese: 请给我一杯温水。
pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi wēn shuǐ.
english: Please give me a glass of warm water.

chinese: 我们可以先看一下菜单吗？
pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ xiān kàn yíxià càidān ma?
english: Could we look at the menu first?

chinese: 我要一碗米饭和一份青菜。
pinyin: Wǒ yào yì wǎn mǐfàn hé yí fèn qīngcài.
english: I'd like a bowl of rice and a serving of greens.

chinese: 这道菜请不要放辣椒。
pinyin: Zhè dào cài qǐng bú yào fàng làjiāo.
english: Please don't put chili in this dish.

chinese: 我不吃肉，有素菜吗？
pinyin: Wǒ bù chī ròu, yǒu sùcài ma?
english: I don't eat meat. Do you have vegetarian dishes?

chinese: 这个菜真好吃，是怎么做的？
pinyin: Zhège cài zhēn hǎochī, shì zěnme zuò de?
english: This dish is delicious. How is it made?

chinese: 服务员，麻烦帮我们结账。
pinyin: Fúwùyuán, máfan bāng wǒmen jié zhàng.
english: Excuse me, could we have the bill, please?

chinese: 请问，这件衣服多少钱？
pinyin: Qǐngwèn, zhè jiàn yīfu duōshao qián?
english: Excuse me, how much is this piece of clothing?

chinese: 这个有点贵，我再看看。
pinyin: Zhège yǒudiǎn guì, wǒ zài kànkan.
english: This is a little expensive. I'll look around some more.

chinese: 如果买两个，可以便宜一点吗？
pinyin: Rúguǒ mǎi liǎng ge, kěyǐ piányi yìdiǎn ma?
english: Could you lower the price a little if I buy two?

chinese: 我就要这个，请帮我装起来。
pinyin: Wǒ jiù yào zhège, qǐng bāng wǒ zhuāng qǐlai.
english: I'll take this one. Please pack it for me.

chinese: 谢谢，我想先自己看看。
pinyin: Xièxie, wǒ xiǎng xiān zìjǐ kànkan.
english: Thanks. I'd like to browse on my own first.

chinese: 这双鞋可以试穿吗？
pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié kěyǐ shì chuān ma?
english: May I try on these shoes?

chinese: 这件太小了，有大一点的吗？
pinyin: Zhè jiàn tài xiǎo le, yǒu dà yìdiǎn de ma?
english: This one is too small. Do you have a bigger one?

chinese: 除了黑色，还有别的颜色吗？
pinyin: Chúle hēisè, hái yǒu bié de yánsè ma?
english: Do you have colors other than black?

chinese: 我可以用微信付款吗？
pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ yòng Wēixìn fù kuǎn ma?
english: Can I pay with WeChat?

chinese: 这里能刷卡，还是只能付现金？
pinyin: Zhèlǐ néng shuā kǎ, háishi zhǐ néng fù xiànjīn?
english: Can I pay by card here, or is it cash only?

chinese: 请问，最近的洗手间在哪里？
pinyin: Qǐngwèn, zuìjìn de xǐshǒujiān zài nǎlǐ?
english: Excuse me, where is the nearest restroom?

chinese: 从这里去地铁站怎么走？
pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ qù dìtiězhàn zěnme zǒu?
english: How do I get to the subway station from here?

chinese: 沿着这条路一直往前走。
pinyin: Yánzhe zhè tiáo lù yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu.
english: Keep going straight along this road.

chinese: 到前面的路口再左转。
pinyin: Dào qiánmiàn de lùkǒu zài zuǒ zhuǎn.
english: Turn left when you reach the intersection ahead.

chinese: 博物馆离这里远不远？
pinyin: Bówùguǎn lí zhèlǐ yuǎn bu yuǎn?
english: Is the museum far from here?

chinese: 走到那里大概要多久？
pinyin: Zǒu dào nàlǐ dàgài yào duōjiǔ?
english: About how long does it take to walk there?

chinese: 师傅，请送我去机场。
pinyin: Shīfu, qǐng sòng wǒ qù jīchǎng.
english: Driver, please take me to the airport.

chinese: 麻烦在前面方便的地方停车。
pinyin: Máfan zài qiánmiàn fāngbiàn de dìfang tíng chē.
english: Please stop somewhere convenient up ahead.

chinese: 这路车经过火车站吗？
pinyin: Zhè lù chē jīngguò huǒchēzhàn ma?
english: Does this bus route pass the train station?

chinese: 我好像迷路了，你能帮我看看地图吗？
pinyin: Wǒ hǎoxiàng mílù le, nǐ néng bāng wǒ kànkan dìtú ma?
english: I think I'm lost. Could you help me look at the map?

chinese: 不好意思，请问现在几点了？
pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, qǐngwèn xiànzài jǐ diǎn le?
english: Excuse me, what time is it now?

chinese: 今天是星期几？我忘了。
pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqī jǐ? Wǒ wàng le.
english: What day of the week is it? I've forgotten.

chinese: 你明天下午有空吗？
pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān xiàwǔ yǒu kòng ma?
english: Are you free tomorrow afternoon?

chinese: 我们下午三点见面，可以吗？
pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sān diǎn jiànmiàn, kěyǐ ma?
english: Shall we meet at three in the afternoon?

chinese: 我们在地铁站门口见吧。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài dìtiězhàn ménkǒu jiàn ba.
english: Let's meet at the subway station entrance.

chinese: 我快到了，你再等我五分钟。
pinyin: Wǒ kuài dào le, nǐ zài děng wǒ wǔ fēnzhōng.
english: I'm almost there. Please wait another five minutes.

chinese: 路上有点堵，我可能会晚到。
pinyin: Lù shàng yǒudiǎn dǔ, wǒ kěnéng huì wǎn dào.
english: Traffic is a bit heavy. I might arrive late.

chinese: 今天事情比较多，我晚点联系你。
pinyin: Jīntiān shìqing bǐjiào duō, wǒ wǎn diǎn liánxì nǐ.
english: I have quite a lot to do today. I'll contact you later.

chinese: 这件事我们明天再讨论吧。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒmen míngtiān zài tǎolùn ba.
english: Let's discuss this tomorrow.

chinese: 这个周末你有什么计划？
pinyin: Zhège zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme jìhuà?
english: What plans do you have for this weekend?

chinese: 你吃过饭了吗？要不要一起吃？
pinyin: Nǐ chī guo fàn le ma? Yào bu yào yìqǐ chī?
english: Have you eaten? Would you like to eat together?

chinese: 你在忙什么？现在方便说话吗？
pinyin: Nǐ zài máng shénme? Xiànzài fāngbiàn shuō huà ma?
english: What are you busy with? Is now a good time to talk?

chinese: 我要出门上班了，晚上见。
pinyin: Wǒ yào chū mén shàng bān le, wǎnshang jiàn.
english: I'm heading out to work. See you tonight.

chinese: 我刚下班，正在回家的路上。
pinyin: Wǒ gāng xià bān, zhèngzài huí jiā de lù shàng.
english: I've just finished work and am on my way home.

chinese: 我已经到家了，你不用担心。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng dào jiā le, nǐ bú yòng dānxīn.
english: I'm home now. You don't need to worry.

chinese: 今天走了很多路，我有点累。
pinyin: Jīntiān zǒu le hěn duō lù, wǒ yǒudiǎn lèi.
english: I walked a lot today and am a little tired.

chinese: 我想先休息十分钟，再做饭。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān xiūxi shí fēnzhōng, zài zuò fàn.
english: I'd like to rest for ten minutes before cooking.

chinese: 今天太热了，我们去阴凉的地方吧。
pinyin: Jīntiān tài rè le, wǒmen qù yīnliáng de dìfang ba.
english: It's so hot today. Let's go somewhere cool and shady.

chinese: 外面下雨了，出门记得带伞。
pinyin: Wàimiàn xià yǔ le, chū mén jìde dài sǎn.
english: It's raining outside. Remember to take an umbrella when you go out.

chinese: 明天要早起，今晚早点睡吧。
pinyin: Míngtiān yào zǎo qǐ, jīnwǎn zǎo diǎn shuì ba.
english: We need to get up early tomorrow, so let's go to bed early tonight.

chinese: 你觉得这个办法怎么样？
pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhège bànfǎ zěnmeyàng?
english: What do you think of this approach?

chinese: 我觉得这个主意不错，可以试试。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhège zhǔyi bú cuò, kěyǐ shìshi.
english: I think it's a good idea. We could try it.

chinese: 我很喜欢这里安静的环境。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan zhèlǐ ānjìng de huánjìng.
english: I really like the quiet surroundings here.

chinese: 这个颜色我不太喜欢，想换一个。
pinyin: Zhège yánsè wǒ bú tài xǐhuan, xiǎng huàn yí ge.
english: I don't really like this color and would like a different one.

chinese: 我同意你的看法，我们就这样做吧。
pinyin: Wǒ tóngyì nǐ de kànfǎ, wǒmen jiù zhèyàng zuò ba.
english: I agree with your view. Let's do it that way.

chinese: 这个问题我也不知道答案。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí wǒ yě bù zhīdào dá'àn.
english: I don't know the answer to this question either.

chinese: 我还不确定，想再考虑一下。
pinyin: Wǒ hái bú quèdìng, xiǎng zài kǎolǜ yíxià.
english: I'm still not sure and would like to think about it some more.

chinese: 真的吗？你是怎么知道的？
pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Nǐ shì zěnme zhīdào de?
english: Really? How did you find out?

chinese: 没问题，这件事交给我吧。
pinyin: Méi wèntí, zhè jiàn shì jiāo gěi wǒ ba.
english: No problem. Leave this to me.

chinese: 如果你有时间，我们一起去吧。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu shíjiān, wǒmen yìqǐ qù ba.
english: If you have time, let's go together.

chinese: 方便留一下你的电话号码吗？
pinyin: Fāngbiàn liú yíxià nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ ma?
english: Would you be willing to leave your phone number?

chinese: 我们加个微信，以后联系方便。
pinyin: Wǒmen jiā ge Wēixìn, yǐhòu liánxì fāngbiàn.
english: Let's add each other on WeChat so it's easy to stay in touch.

chinese: 我把地址发给你，你看一下。
pinyin: Wǒ bǎ dìzhǐ fā gěi nǐ, nǐ kàn yíxià.
english: I'll send you the address for you to check.

chinese: 请问，这里有可以用的无线网络吗？
pinyin: Qǐngwèn, zhèlǐ yǒu kěyǐ yòng de wúxiàn wǎngluò ma?
english: Excuse me, is there Wi-Fi I can use here?

chinese: 无线网络的密码能告诉我吗？
pinyin: Wúxiàn wǎngluò de mìmǎ néng gàosu wǒ ma?
english: Could you tell me the Wi-Fi password?

chinese: 我的手机快没电了，这里能充电吗？
pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī kuài méi diàn le, zhèlǐ néng chōng diàn ma?
english: My phone is almost out of battery. Can I charge it here?

chinese: 我有点不舒服，想坐下来休息。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒudiǎn bù shūfu, xiǎng zuò xiàlai xiūxi.
english: I feel a little unwell and would like to sit down and rest.

chinese: 我需要看医生，附近有医院吗？
pinyin: Wǒ xūyào kàn yīshēng, fùjìn yǒu yīyuàn ma?
english: I need to see a doctor. Is there a hospital nearby?

chinese: 我的手机不见了，你有看到吗？
pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī bú jiàn le, nǐ yǒu kàn dào ma?
english: My phone is missing. Have you seen it?

chinese: 这里有人受伤了，请帮忙叫救护车！
pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu rén shòu shāng le, qǐng bāngmáng jiào jiùhùchē!
english: Someone is injured here. Please call an ambulance!
